MBPP+ then erases the in-domain advantage, showing that scheduling governs search while the test suite alone governs what "preserving behavior" means. The result is an auditable division of labor: models widen the search for removable code, order bounds the damage a mis-ranked proposal can do, and execution retains authority over every committed deletion.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究在执行验证资源有限时，AI 系统如何安全删除冗余代码，而非继续以“氛围式编程”方式累加分支、保护逻辑和回退代码。作者将冗余代码削减表述为候选删除语句的调度问题：排序器给出单语句删除候选，执行测试套件接受第一个通过验证的候选，并受验证预算限制。提出的 DELSCOUT 采用静态最短优先候选与学习式互补候选相结合的调度策略；在 MBPP 多次复现实验中，五次验证预算下相对提高已验证删除覆盖率 9.5%，同时略减少验证器调用。
authors: Ruitong Li, Binjie Guo, Aisheng Mo, Guowei Su, Han Wang, Jie Li, Ru Zhang

articles.title: Text2GraphQuery-Bench: A Text to Graph Query Benchmark
articles.title_zh: Text2GraphQuery-Bench：文本到图查询基准
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.11745v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Graph models are fundamental to data analysis in domains rich with complex relationships. Unlike SQL, which benefits from a rel- atively unified standard and widespread familiarity, graph query languages are diverse (e.g., Cypher, GQL, SQL/PGQ) and far less fa- miliar to most users, making them significantly harder to learn and use. Text-to-Graph-Query systems address this barrier by trans- lating natural language into executable graph queries, enabling LLMs to serve as interfaces for Graph Database Management Systems (GDBMS). Existing benchmarks are limited in language coverage, rely on rigid synthesis, and lack comprehensive evaluation. We present Text2GraphQuery-Bench, the first benchmark covering all mainstream declarative property graph query languages (Cypher, GQL, and SQL/PGQ). It contains 267,276 (Question, Graph Query) pairs across 34 databases and 13 domains. Its construction supports adaptation from heterogeneous resources and domain-aware synthesis, while its Graph-IR-based design enables rapid extension to new languages. The evaluation protocol reports Grammar, GLEU, Similarity, and EX under graph-native difficulty, question abstraction, and schema aliasing. Experiments on 8 LLMs reveal: (i) a significant language gap exists - zero-shot GQL and SQL/PGQ Grammar is far below Cypher, yet few-shot prompting largely recovers it; (ii) fine-tuning an 8B model reaches or exceeds zero-shot large models, indicating unfamiliarity - rather than model capacity - is the primary barrier; (iii) as supervision increases, syntax errors recede, shifting bottlenecks to aggregation logic in GQL and schema linking in SQL/PGQ; (iv) higher question abstraction degrades EX due to intent-to-schema grounding issues, while schema aliasing has minimal impact; (v) EX consistently degrades from Easy to Extra Hard, with Extra Hard remaining a persistent bottleneck. *(Due to arXiv constraints, this abstract is shortened. See PDF for the full version.)*
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 Text2GraphQuery-Bench，用于评估自然语言到图数据库查询语言的转换系统，覆盖 Cypher、GQL 和 SQL/PGQ 等主流声明式属性图查询语言。基准包含 34 个数据库、13 个领域中的 267276 个“问题—图查询”对，并通过 Graph-IR 设计支持向新语言快速扩展。其评估协议结合语法、GLEU、相似度和可执行结果等指标，并考虑图查询原生难度，以弥补现有基准语言覆盖有限、合成方式僵化和评估不充分的问题。
authors: Songlin Lyu, Lujie Ban, Zihang Wu, Tianqi Luo, Jirong Liu, Ayoub Moussaid, Oskar van Rest, Heng Lin, Chenhao Ma, Nan Tang, Shipeng Qi, Yongchao Liu, Zhan Qiu, Juelu Zhang, Jiajun Zheng

articles.title: CogniFold: Always-On Proactive Memory via Cognitive Folding
articles.title_zh: CogniFold：通过认知折叠实现常开式主动记忆
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.13438v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Existing agent memory remains predominantly reactive and retrieval-based, lacking the capacity to autonomously organize experience into persistent cognitive structure. Toward genuinely autonomous agents, we introduce CogniFold, a brain-inspired "always-on" agent memory designed for the next generation of proactive assistants. CogniFold continuously folds fragmented event streams into self-emerging cognitive structures, bootstrapping progressively higher-level cognition from incoming events and accumulated knowledge. We ground this by extending Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) theory from two layers (hippocampus, neocortex) to three, adding a prefrontal intent layer. Emulating the prefrontal cortex as the locus of intentional control and decision-making, CogniFold achieves this through graph-topology self-organization: cognitive structures proactively assemble under the stream, merge when semantically similar, decay when stale, relink through associative recall, and surface intents when concept-cluster density crosses a threshold. We evaluate structural formation using CogEval-Bench, demonstrating that CogniFold uniquely produces memory structures that match cognitive expectations and concept emergence. Furthermore, across eight downstream benchmarks -- two probing long-term conversational memory (LoCoMo, LongMemEval) and six spanning other cognitive domains -- we validate that CogniFold simultaneously performs robustly on conventional memory tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/OpenNorve/CogniFold.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 CogniFold，一种面向自主智能体的“常开式”主动记忆框架，旨在将碎片化事件流持续组织为持久的认知结构，而不只是被动检索记忆。方法将互补学习系统理论从海马—新皮层两层扩展为加入前额叶意图层的三层模型，并通过图拓扑自组织实现结构合并、衰减、联想重连和意图浮现。作者使用 CogEval-Bench 评估结构形成能力，表明 CogniFold 能够从事件流中主动生成认知组织。
authors: Suli Wang, Yiqun Duan, Yu Deng, Rundong Zhao, Dai Shi, Minghua Deng, Chen Chen, Yiqi Wang, Xinliang Zhou

articles.title: Multidimensional characteristics and ecological risks of MPs in receiving waters from WWTP effluent
articles.title_zh: 污水处理厂尾水受纳水体中微塑料的多维特征与生态风险
articles.abstract: Tailwater from sewage treatment plants is an important source of anthropogenic microplastic pollution in receiving water bodies. This study investigates the spatial and temporal distribution, morphological characteristics, and ecological risks of microplastics in the Fuyang River affected by it, and explores the tailwater driving mechanism. The results show that the discharge outlet of the sewage treatment plant is a hotspot of persistent pollution: the peak abundance of microplastics reaches 3600 items/m³ in the dry season, and the affected area extends for about 1 km along the river. The concentration in the downstream still remains 2200-2600 items/m³; in the wet season, tailwater and urban surface runoff cooperate, causing the concentration of downstream urban areas to significantly increase by 32%, forming a dual stress of "tailwater base + runoff increment". Among the pollutants, fibre forms (>68%) and PE/PP polymers dominate, indicating that domestic sources dominate; however,the risk of highly toxic PVC at the discharge outlet accounts for 99.2%, with an ecotoxicity coefficient of 1241.29, triggering local high risks of Level IV-V (potential ecological risk index PERI>300). The pollution load index of the entire basin continues to exceed the standard (PLIzone=1.18), and the cumulative effect of microplastics is obvious. Research shows that tailwater reshapes the spatial differentiation and ecological risk pattern of river microplastics through continuous input and release of highly toxic components. It is urgent to develop source prevention and control strategies for industrial-source polymers.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察污水处理厂尾水影响下阜阳河微塑料的时空分布、形态组成和生态风险，并分析尾水驱动机制。结果显示，排放口是持续污染热点，枯水期微塑料丰度峰值达 3600 个/m³，影响范围沿河约 1 km，下游仍维持 2200–2600 个/m³；丰水期尾水与城市地表径流叠加，使下游城区浓度显著升高 32%。污染物以纤维状微塑料和 PE/PP 为主，提示生活源占主导，但排口处高毒性 PVC 风险贡献达 99.2%，生态毒性系数为 1241.29，并触发局部 IV–V 级高生态风险。

articles.title: Efficacy of a multisonic ultracleaning system, erbium lasers and passive ultrasonic irrigation in removing calcium hydroxide from a standardized groove: an in vitro study
articles.title_zh: 多声波超清洗系统、铒激光与被动超声冲洗去除标准化沟槽内氢氧化钙的体外研究
articles.abstract: Purpose To compare the efficacy of a multisonic ultracleaning system, an Er: YAG laser in R-SWEEPS mode, an Er, Cr: YSGG laser, passive ultrasonic irrigation, and conventional syringe-needle irrigation in removing calcium hydroxide from a standardized groove.Methods One hundred extracted human maxillary central incisors were prepared, and a standardized groove was cut in the apical part of the canal and filled with calcium hydroxide. After 7 days, the teeth were assigned to five groups (n = 20 each): conventional syringe-needle irrigation (SNI), passive ultrasonic irrigation (PUI), a multisonic ultracleaning system (GentleWave), an Er: YAG laser in R-SWEEPS mode, and an Er, Cr: YSGG laser. Residual calcium hydroxide was scored from 0 (empty groove) to 3 (groove completely filled) under a stereomicroscope. Data were analyzed with the Kruskal-Wallis test and Dunn's test with Bonferroni correction.Results The five groups differed significantly (p < 0.001). Syringe-needle irrigation left the most residual medicament, with 70% of specimens scored 3 and none scored 0. The multisonic system produced a clean groove in every specimen (100% scored 0), followed by the Er, Cr: YSGG laser (85%), the Er: YAG laser (75%), and passive ultrasonic irrigation (65%). Syringe-needle irrigation was significantly less effective than each of the other groups (p < 0.001), which did not differ from one another (p > = 0.72).Conclusion All activation systems removed calcium hydroxide more effectively than syringe-needle irrigation, with no significant differences among them. Some form of irrigant activation is therefore recommended when calcium hydroxide is removed before obturation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该体外研究比较传统注射针冲洗、被动超声冲洗、多声波超清洗系统 GentleWave、Er:YAG 激光 R-SWEEPS 模式和 Er,Cr:YSGG 激光去除根管标准化沟槽内氢氧化钙的效果。100 颗离体人上颌中切牙被制备并填入氢氧化钙，7 天后分为 5 组，使用体视显微镜按残留程度评分。五组差异显著；注射针冲洗残留最多，而多声波系统所有样本沟槽完全清洁，其次为 Er,Cr:YSGG 激光。

articles.title: Interpretable Hybrid CNN Transformer Framework with Cross Attention Fusion and Uncertainty Quantification for Multi Mechanism Corrosion and Erosion Detection
articles.title_zh: 用于多机制腐蚀与冲蚀检测的可解释混合 CNN-Transformer 框架：交叉注意力融合与不确定性量化
articles.abstract: Corrosion and flow-induced erosion of metallic infrastructure impose an estimated US2.5 trillion annual global burden and constitute leading causes of catastrophic failure across nuclear waste transport, oil and gas transmission, marine, and civil sectors. Automated visual inspection has advanced through convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and vision transformers (ViTs), yet each family alone is insufficient: CNNs capture local texture but struggle with global context, while ViTs model long-range dependencies but are texture-insensitive and data-hungry. Prior hybrid designs rely on static feature concatenation, forfeiting adaptive cross-modal interaction, and typically address binary rather than mechanism-differentiated classification. Here we present CorroSense-Net, a hybrid CNN–Transformer framework that couples a ResNet-50 branch and a ViT-B/16 branch through a novel Cross-Attention Fusion (CAF) module performing bidirectional gated attention between the two streams. The framework classifies industrial pipeline imagery into three physically grounded states—pristine, particle-impingement erosion, and chemical corrosion— and integrates Monte Carlo Dropout uncertainty quantification and quantitative Grad-CAM interpretability scored against expert annotations. We developed and validated the framework on 487 smartphone-captured images from two purpose-built laboratory rigs reproducing nuclear-waste-transport degradation mechanisms, with ultrasonic thickness measurements providing independent label verification. Under stratified five-fold cross-validation, CorroSense-Net achieved a macro-F1 of 0.961 ± 0.014 and ROC-AUC of 0.991 ± 0.006, outperforming ResNet-50, ViT-B/16, EfficientNet-B3, Swin-Tiny, and the concatenation-based hybrid HCT-Net by statistically significant margins after Bonferroni correction. Cross-Attention Fusion improved Grad-CAM alignment with expert masks by 7.5 IoU percentage points over concatenation-based fusion, and zero-shot inference on two public datasets confirmed cross-domain generalization. The framework establishes a template for interpretable, uncertainty-aware AI in safety-critical industrial inspection.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 CorroSense-Net，用于工业管道图像中完好、颗粒冲击冲蚀和化学腐蚀三类状态的自动识别。框架结合 ResNet-50 分支和 ViT-B/16 分支，并通过双向门控的交叉注意力融合模块实现局部纹理特征与全局上下文信息的自适应交互。方法还集成 Monte Carlo Dropout 进行不确定性量化，旨在克服单独 CNN 或 ViT 在上下文建模、纹理敏感性和数据需求方面的局限。

articles.title: Experimental and Machine Learning-Based Performance Evaluation of Ambient-Cured Geopolymer Mortar Using Microstructural Characterisation and ABAQUS Numerical Analysis
articles.title_zh: 常温养护地聚合物砂浆的实验与机器学习性能评估：结合微观结构表征和 ABAQUS 数值分析
articles.abstract: The geopolymer mortar has become a viable substitute for the normal cement mortar due to its light carbon footprint, effective use of industrial wastes and its high durability. The effects of different precursor materials and alkaline activator systems on the fresh, mechanical, microstructural, and structural performance of the ambient-cured geopolymer mortar are systematically studied in this work. Alkaline activators based on potassium and sodium were used to evaluate fly ash (FA), ground granulated blast furnace slag (GGBFS), metakaolin (MK), and steel slag (SS) separately and in hybrid combinations. The developed geopolymer mortars were tested for flowability and compressive strength at 7, 14, and 28 days. The mixes were further characterised using scanning electron microscopy (SEM), X-ray diffraction (XRD), and thermogravimetric analysis (TGA-DTG), which were optimised to ascertain the relationship between microstructural development, gel formation, thermal stability, and mechanical performance. To rapidly predict the strength, four machine learning models (Artificial Neural Network (ANN), Gaussian Process Regression (GPR), Random Forest (RF), and Support Vector Machine (SVM)) were developed and compared to the experimental data. The Shapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) analysis was utilised to explain the ANN network and determine the most important input variables. The 50% FA-50% GGBFS mix exhibited an excellent balance of strength and workability, while the 100% GGBFS mix had the greatest 28-day compressive strength of 68.51 MPa among the mixes examined. The NaOH-Na2SiO3 activator system has exhibited the best geopolymerization and mechanical performance in comparison to the other combinations of activators. The ANN model showed the greatest prediction with the others being compared, and SHAP analysis found that GGBFS content, sodium hydroxide concentration, sodium silicate dose, and additional water were the most influential factors to control the compressive strength. Moreover, nonlinear finite element analysis at ABAQUS revealed that geopolymer mortar jacketing, which is reinforced by three layers of hexagonal wire mesh, enhanced the load-bearing capacity, stiffness, crack resistance and structural behaviour of reinforced concrete beams. The combined experimental, microstructural, machine learning, and numerical study validates the high potential of geopolymer mortar as a high-performance, low-carbon material to be used as a sustainable construction and structural rehabilitation tool.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究系统考察粉煤灰、矿渣、偏高岭土、钢渣及其复合前驱体，以及钾基和钠基碱激发体系对常温养护地聚合物砂浆工作性、力学性能、微观结构和结构响应的影响。样品在 7、14 和 28 天测试流动性与抗压强度，并采用 SEM、XRD 和 TGA-DTG 分析凝胶生成、热稳定性与强度之间的关系。作者还使用 ANN、GPR、随机森林和 SVM 等机器学习模型快速预测强度，并结合 ABAQUS 数值分析评估结构性能。

articles.title: Agentic CAMA-DRL: A Context-Aware Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning Framework for Multi-Stakeholder Charging Coordination of Last-Mile Delivery E-Bikes
articles.title_zh: Agentic CAMA-DRL：面向末端配送电动自行车多利益相关方充电协调的情境感知多智能体深度强化学习框架
articles.abstract: The rapid electrification of urban last-mile logistics has created an acute need for charging strategies that are simultaneously proactive, stakeholder-aware, and sensitive to real-time operating context. We propose an Agentic AI framework integrating Context-Aware Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning (CAMA-DRL) to optimise charging infrastructure for last-mile delivery e-bikes in urban micro-mobility ecosystems. Four autonomous stakeholder agents—delivery operators, charging station operators, fleet planners, and environmental regulators—coordinate via Deep Q-Networks (DQN) conditioned on real-time contextual signals including delivery demand, battery state-of-charge, renewable energy availability, and traffic conditions. Unlike reactive rule-based controllers, each agent plans across an extended delivery horizon and shares a common reward structure that internalises the system-wide consequences of locally optimal decisions, enabling coordinated rather than competing charging behaviour. Evaluated in a high-fidelity London urban simulation, CAMA-DRL achieves a 28% increase in fleet utilisation, 35% reduction in station congestion, 32% improvement in delivery punctuality, and a 42% CO2 emission reduction compared to rule-based and single-agent baselines. A component-wise ablation further isolates a 5–8% contribution attributable specifically to real-time context encoding beyond multi-agent coordination alone, confirming that the two mechanisms are synergistic rather than merely additive. These results establish Agentic CAMA-DRL as a scalable, deployment-ready solution for sustainable urban last-mile logistics, and the modular architecture suggests a clear migration path towards mixed e-bike and electric-van fleets sharing common charging hubs.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种 Agentic AI 框架，将情境感知多智能体深度强化学习用于城市末端配送电动自行车充电基础设施优化。框架设置配送运营商、充电站运营商、车队规划者和环境监管者四类自主智能体，基于 DQN 并结合配送需求、电池荷电状态、可再生能源可用性和交通状态等实时信号进行协调决策。伦敦高保真城市仿真结果显示，该方法相较反应式规则控制可提高车队利用率 28%、降低站点拥堵 35%、提升配送准时率 32%，体现出跨利益相关方协同充电的优势。

articles.title: Highly Sensitive Graphene-MoS₂ Hybrid Surface Plasmon Resonance Biosensor for Malaria Detection via Refractive Index Analysis of Red Blood Cells
articles.title_zh: 用于疟疾检测的高灵敏石墨烯-MoS₂混合表面等离子体共振生物传感器：基于红细胞折射率分析
articles.abstract: Graphene-assisted surface plasmon resonance (SPR) biosensors have emerged as promising platforms for enhancing plasmonic coupling and improving refractive-index sensitivity through the unique optical properties of two-dimensional materials. In this work, a near-infrared (NIR) Kretschmann-configured SPR biosensor incorporating an SF10 prism, a 70-nm Ag film, and graphene/TMDC hybrid layers was systematically investigated for refractive-index-based analysis of malaria-infected red blood cells (RBCs). Four transition metal dichalcogenides (MoS₂, MoSe₂, WS₂, and WSe₂) were evaluated over multiple excitation wavelengths to identify the optimum plasmonic configuration. Reflectivity spectra were calculated using the ABCD transfer matrix formalism, and the optimized structure was subsequently analyzed using experimentally reported refractive indices of healthy and malaria-infected RBCs. The optimized graphene–MoS₂ configuration operating at 1100 nm achieved angular sensitivities of 198.08 Deg/RIU and 201.52 Deg/RIU for refractive-index variations of 0.005 and 0.007 RIU, respectively, with a relatively narrow FWHM of 7.43°. Distinct reflectivity responses were obtained for healthy RBCs (0.9530 a.u.) and malaria-infected cells at the ring (0.9439 a.u.), trophozoite (0.8946 a.u.), and schizont (0.8193 a.u.) stages. These results demonstrate that graphene/TMDC hybrid plasmonic structures can substantially improve SPR sensing performance and highlight the potential of the proposed platform for label-free discrimination of malaria infection stages based on refractive-index variations. The presented optimization strategy may also provide useful design guidelines for next-generation plasmonic biosensors operating in the near-infrared region.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究设计并分析一种近红外 Kretschmann 构型 SPR 生物传感器，由 SF10 棱镜、70 nm 银膜和石墨烯/TMDC 混合层组成，用于基于折射率区分健康与疟疾感染红细胞。作者比较 MoS₂、MoSe₂、WS₂ 和 WSe₂ 等过渡金属二硫族化物在多种激发波长下的响应，并采用 ABCD 传输矩阵计算反射谱。优化后的石墨烯–MoS₂ 结构在 1100 nm 下对 0.005 和 0.007 RIU 折射率变化分别达到 198.08 和 201.52 Deg/RIU 的角灵敏度，FWHM 为 7.43°，可产生可区分的红细胞反射响应。

articles.title: Can Octopus maya win the climate change fight through resilience to maternal heat stress?
articles.title_zh: Octopus maya 能否通过对母体热应激的韧性赢得气候变化挑战？
articles.abstract: Embryonic development in cephalopods is a critical phase characterized by high energy demands, high metabolic production of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and limited aerobic flexibility. As postulated in Octopus maya, maternal heat stress transfers ROS and oxidative damage to offspring, potentially compromising their ability to cope with ocean warming scenarios. The present study evaluated whether embryos and early juveniles from females subjected to heat stress (30°C) regulate their respiratory metabolism, activate antioxidant mechanisms, and modulate oxidative balance throughout development. Routine, maximum and standard metabolic rates, aerobic capacity, antioxidant enzyme activity, superoxide dismutase (SOD), catalase (CAT), and glutathione S-transferase (GST), oxidative damage (lipid peroxidation and protein oxidation), total glutathione levels, and esterase activity were measured in embryos and juveniles maintained at 24, 26, and 30°C. Embryos were found receiving a high ROS load, which in addition were produced by the embryos during development. This double ROS load caused deformities and high embryonic mortality, associated with the inability of this life cycle phase to neutralize the oxidative damage produced by ROS. In the juvenile stage, animals maintained at 24°C showed metabolic and morphological recovery, while those incubated at 30°C showed smaller body size, accelerated yolk depletion, and antioxidant system disruption. Intermediate values were observed in juveniles maintained at 26°C. The results suggest that maternal heat stress profoundly affects the embryonic stage of O. maya. However, juveniles hatching in a suitable thermal environment (24°C) showed physiological mechanisms to neutralize the negative maternal stress effects, suggesting that populations may persist under these conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察母体热应激是否会影响 Octopus maya 胚胎和早期幼体在升温情景下的呼吸代谢、抗氧化防御和氧化平衡。作者让亲代雌性经历 30°C 热应激，并在 24、26 和 30°C 条件下测定后代的常规、最大和标准代谢率，有氧能力，SOD、CAT、GST 等抗氧化酶活性，氧化损伤、总谷胱甘肽和酯酶活性。结果表明，胚胎既承受来自母体的高 ROS 负荷，又在发育中产生 ROS，双重氧化压力与畸形和高胚胎死亡率相关，提示该生命周期阶段中和氧化压力的能力有限。

articles.title: Structured Semantic Supervision for Annotation-Scarce Composed Image Retrieval
articles.title_zh: 面向标注稀缺组合图像检索的结构化语义监督
articles.abstract: Objectives: Composed image retrieval (CIR) identifies a target image by combining a reference image with a textual modification, enabling fine-grained visual search such as preserving an object while changing its attributes. Existing methods often rely on manually annotated triplets or unconstrained generated descriptions, limiting adaptation to target domains where labelled composed queries are scarce.  Methods: This paper investigates zero-shot target-domain adaptation for CIR through structured semantic supervision. The proposed framework uses an offline vision-language and language-model agent to convert unlabeled images into structured semantic anchors containing global descriptions, attributes, and entities. These anchors replace free-form caption supervision with a low-entropy, field-constrained interface for edit-related semantics. The framework then infers target-side anchors from reference anchors and modification texts, and learns a query-slot-driven multi-vector representation that separates subject preservation from attribute variation. A multi-view masked learning strategy aligns gallery indexing, attribute-aware supervision, and online query modeling under different information-visibility conditions.  Results: Experiments on FashionIQ and CIRR show that the approach improves zero-shot retrieval performance in fine-grained fashion scenarios while maintaining competitive open-domain retrieval ability. On FashionIQ, it achieves Avg R@10 = 31.81 and Avg R@50 = 53.07, outperforming the strongest compared zero-shot baseline by 2.42 and 2.19 percentage points, respectively. On CIRR, it obtains R@1 = 24.20, R@5 = 55.18, R@10 = 66.71, and R@50 = 90.30.  Conclusion: The results suggest that structured semantic supervision offers a controllable route for adapting CIR models without manually annotated triplets, while revealing remaining challenges in relational reasoning, viewpoint change, and reproducible generated supervision.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究组合图像检索在目标域缺少标注三元组时的零样本适应问题，即通过参考图像和文本修改共同定位目标图像。作者提出结构化语义监督框架，利用离线视觉语言模型和语言模型智能体将未标注图像转换为包含全局描述、属性和实体的结构化语义锚点，以替代自由文本描述监督。框架进一步根据参考锚点和修改文本推断目标侧锚点，并学习查询槽驱动的多向量表示，以区分主体保持与属性变化，同时通过多视图掩码学习对齐图库索引、属性监督和在线查询建模。

articles.title: Upconversion luminescence and photothermal properties of the NaGdF4 :Er3+ /Yb3+/Al3+ nanoparticles in the hybrid films
articles.title_zh: 杂化薄膜中 NaGdF4:Er3+/Yb3+/Al3+ 纳米颗粒的上转换发光与光热性能
articles.abstract: Upconversion nanoparticles (NPs) play an important role in photothermal therapies, imaging techniques and photothermal sensing. However, simultaneous improvement of the fluorescence intensity, thermometric sensitivity is still a challenge. The coupling of Ag NPs and gold nanorods (GNR), photonic crystals (PCs) and single-walled carbon nanotubes (SWCNT) may be an effective way to improve their photothermal performance, the upconversion luminescence (UCL) and thermometry sensitivity. In this work, based on NaGdF4:Er3+/Yb3+/Al3+ NPs (UC), the hybrid films of PCs/Ag/UC, PCs/Ag/SWCNT/UC and PCs/Ag/GNR/UC were fabricated, the effect of the GNR and  SWCNT on the UCL and the temperature sensing behavior has been investigated based on the fluorescence intensity ratio (FIR) technique. The results indicate that the PCs/Ag/UC and PCs/Ag/SWCNT/UC samples exhibit the strongest and weakest UCL intensities, respectively. The local electromagnetic field caused by the PCs eﬀect and plasmonics not only can enhance the UCL intensity, but dramatically create the thermal self-amplification eﬀect. Overlapping of the strong absorption band for the GNR and SWCNT with the excitation band of the upconversion NaGdF4:Er3+/Yb3+/Al3+ NPs is responsible for the decrease of the UCL intensity compared with the PCs/Ag/UC sample, and the mechanisms of fluorescence quenching is clarified. However, the photothermal conversion performance and absolute sensitivity (SA) are improved after adding the SWCNT and GNR in the PCs/Ag/UC, respectively. The PCs/Ag/GNR/UC sample exhibits the optimal comprehensive performance of upconversion luminescence and photothermal properties. This work presents a route for enhancing the comprehensive performance of upconversion thermometers through multiphysics coupling.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作以 NaGdF4:Er3+/Yb3+/Al3+ 上转换纳米颗粒为基础，制备了 PCs/Ag/UC、PCs/Ag/SWCNT/UC 和 PCs/Ag/GNR/UC 等杂化薄膜，研究金纳米棒和单壁碳纳米管对上转换发光及基于荧光强度比的温度传感行为的影响。结果表明，PCs/Ag/UC 的上转换发光最强，而 PCs/Ag/SWCNT/UC 最弱。光子晶体效应与等离激元诱导的局域电磁场可增强发光并产生显著的热自放大效应；金纳米棒和单壁碳纳米管吸收带与激发带的重叠被认为是调控光热响应的重要因素。

articles.title: Magnetophoretic modulation of BaSO4 scaling: laboratory investigation and industrial case study
articles.title_zh: BaSO4 结垢的磁泳调控：实验室研究与工业案例
articles.abstract: Scale formation in supersaturated BaSO4-bearing �uids poses a persistent challenge in domestic and industrial settings due to the scalant's extremely low solubility, high mechanical strength, and resistance to removal. We revisit the long-standing question of whether magnetic fields can mitigate such a scaling. Under our current experimental conditions, our analysis shows that magnetic-field effects on BaSO4-bearing �uids are negligible in magnetically clean �uids. In �uids containing ferromagnetic or ferrimagnetic particulates, which are common in practical settings, strong field gradients can induce particle polarization and magnetophoretic drift, promoting the coalescence of nanoscale particles into larger agglomerates. These agglomerates can act as heterogeneous  nucleation templates, thereby modifying crystallization kinetics and deposit morphology. As a result, precipitation may be partially redirected from undesirable surface-bound fouling toward volume-bound suspended particulates that remain entrained in the �ow and can be more readily removed. This shift toward heterogeneous nucleation and growth provides a possible �eld- and contamination-mediated mechanism for rationalizing many disparate reports on magnetic anti-scale treatment across laboratory, domestic, and industrial settings, including hydrocarbon oil and gas environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究重新考察磁场是否能够缓解含 BaSO4 过饱和流体中的结垢问题。实验分析表明，在磁性洁净流体中，磁场对 BaSO4 结垢的影响可忽略；但当流体含有铁磁或亚铁磁颗粒时，强磁场梯度可诱导颗粒极化和磁泳迁移，促进纳米颗粒聚并。形成的团聚体可作为非均相成核模板，使沉淀从表面附着污垢部分转向流体中悬浮颗粒上的成核与生长，从而改变结晶动力学和沉积形貌。

articles.title: Accurate predictions of mechanical properties using active learning on local chemical configurations: A case study of WC–Co composites
articles.title_zh: 基于局域化学构型主动学习的力学性能准确预测：WC–Co 复合材料案例研究
articles.abstract: Publication date: 25 August 2026 Source: Computational Materials Science, Volume 273 Author(s): Faridun N. Jalolov, Viktor S. Baidyshev, Alexander G. Kvashnin
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作发表于 Computational Materials Science，围绕 WC–Co 复合材料的力学性能预测展开，核心是将主动学习与局域化学构型描述相结合。由于给定摘要主要为出版元数据，具体模型、数据集、精度和材料结论需查阅原文。根据题名可判断，该研究旨在提高复杂复合材料力学性质计算预测的效率与可靠性。

articles.title: Levitating sensor for magnetic fields could detect ultrafaint brain activity
articles.title_zh: 可悬浮磁场传感器有望探测极微弱脑活动
articles.abstract: Nature, Published online: 06 August 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02458-9 The device’s simple design could rival much more complex alternatives in biophysics research — and could even be used to search for dark matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 该新闻介绍一种用于磁场探测的悬浮式传感器，其结构相对简单，但可能在生物物理研究中与更复杂的磁测量方案竞争。报道指出，该器件有望用于探测极微弱脑活动产生的磁信号，并可能扩展到暗物质搜寻等基础物理应用。具体灵敏度、工作机制和实验验证细节需查阅原文。

articles.title: Author Correction: Small-voltage multiferroic control of two-dimensional magnetic insulators

articles.title: Sunlight-powered setup generates quantum entanglement
articles.title_zh: 利用太阳光产生量子纠缠的实验装置
articles.abstract: Today's quantum technologies rely on energy-intensive lasers, raising concerns that scaling them up could further increase energy demands. In new work, researchers have demonstrated that quantum entanglement between photons can be generated directly from sunlight, offering a potential alternative.
articles.abstract_zh: 该新闻报道研究人员展示了可直接利用太阳光在光子之间产生量子纠缠的实验方案。当前量子技术通常依赖能耗较高的激光系统，因此该结果为降低量子光源能耗、探索可持续量子技术提供了潜在替代路径。具体纠缠产生机制、效率和可扩展性仍需参考原文。

articles.title: Quantized topological invariant of symmetry-projected Gibbs states
articles.title_zh: 对称投影Gibbs态的量子化拓扑不变量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.04350v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study Gibbs states projected onto the symmetric sector of contractible one-form symmetries. In a three-dimensional cluster-model interpolation, this projection stabilizes symmetry-protected topological and projected-paramagnetic phases, both sharply distinct from thermal disorder. A flux-twisted membrane invariant distinguishes these three phases by the values -1,+1,0, respectively. These values are exact on the endpoint, self-dual, zero-temperature, and infinite-temperature lines; elsewhere their quantization requires positive spatial-sheet, winding-line, and interface tensions. Quantum Monte Carlo supports the quantization through tension diagnostics and direct finite-size estimates.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者研究了投影到可收缩一形式对称性对称扇区的Gibbs态，并在三维簇模型插值中发现该投影可稳定对称保护拓扑相和投影顺磁相，使其与热无序相清晰区分。文中提出的通量扭曲膜不变量分别以−1、+1、0表征这三类相。其量子化在若干特殊线处严格成立，在一般区域则依赖正的空间片、缠绕线和界面张力，量子蒙特卡洛结果支持这一图像。
