We bridge Su{} formalism to ours and this requires two fixes: reinserting a sign/phase factor that depends on each state's radial-quantum number and handling the trivial (0,0) representation analytically. The package reproduces, bracket for bracket to machine precision (sim!10⁻¹³), the general Talmi--Moshinsky bracket code of Kamuntavičius et al. , and demonstrates that a self-contained SU(3)-scheme HOB code can be built on top of a general-purpose SU(3) Clebsch--Gordan library.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文介绍Fortran 2008程序包SU3HOB-cgvcs，用于计算任意质量比参数下的一般Talmi–Moshinsky谐振子变换括号。程序在SU(3)基中实现Kalinauskas等人的方法，将变换化为含反射Talmi–Moshinsky矩阵的Wigner d函数单和，并以SU(3)⊃SO(3)等因子乘积加权。等因子由外部Clebsch–Gordan库提供，作者处理了相位因子恢复和(0,0)平凡表示的解析处理；结果与Kamuntavičius等人的通用代码逐括号达到约10⁻¹³量级一致。
authors: Augustinas Stepšys, Saulius Mickevičius, Darius Germanas

articles.title: ScoreField: Neural Inverse Scattering with Score-Based Generative Priors
articles.title_zh: ScoreField：结合基于得分生成先验的神经逆散射方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02937v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Designing an effective electromagnetic inverse-scattering solver requires faithful enforcement of nonlinear full-wave physics together with an expressive prior on the unknown permittivity contrast. We propose ScoreField, a neural inverse scattering framework that integrates coupled implicit neural representations (INRs) with a pretrained score-based generative prior. ScoreField employs two INRs to parameterize the permittivity contrast and the induced current fields, and jointly optimize them under the Lippmann-Schwinger equations. In addition to the implicit regularization by the INR architecture, the score model provides a learned prior gradient on the contrast, which is propagated to the contrast INR through the chain rule. This formulation enables ScoreField to effectively handle strong multiple scattering, where nonlinear wave interactions require accurate modeling of the coupled full-wave physics. We evaluate ScoreField on simulated weak- and strong-scattering benchmarks, the canonical Austria phantom, and experimental Fresnel measurements. We note that ScoreField significantly improves reconstruction fidelity and suppresses artifacts relative to classical full-wave methods and deep learning baselines, achieving an average PSNR improvement of 1.8 , dB over the best competing method on real Fresnel data.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出ScoreField电磁逆散射框架，将耦合隐式神经表示与预训练的基于得分生成先验相结合，以同时满足非线性全波物理约束和介电常数反差的先验建模。方法用两个隐式神经网络分别参数化介电反差和感应电流场，并在Lippmann–Schwinger方程约束下联合优化；得分模型提供学习到的先验梯度并通过链式法则传递至反差网络。模拟弱/强散射基准、Austria phantom和实验Fresnel数据表明，该方法可更好处理强多重散射，提高重建保真度并抑制伪影。
authors: Wenhan Guo, Yuan Gao, Yu Sun

articles.title: A study on the contribution of the interplanetary medium in radio occultation experiments
articles.title_zh: 行星际介质对无线电掩星实验贡献的研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03435v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Irregularities in electron density within the interplanetary medium (IPM) can cause fluctuations in the Doppler frequency of spacecraft radio signals. The amplitude of these fluctuations depends on factors such as the carrier frequency, propagation geometry, and link configuration. However, quantitative characterization of these effects across different frequencies in various occultation experiments is currently limited. We analyze five complementary datasets: two-way S-band observations from Chandrayaan-3 outside the lunar ionosphere, two-way S-band data from Chandrayaan-2 during lunar occultation, one-way S/X band measurements from the Venus Express Radio Science (VeRa)/Akatsuki Radio Science (Akatsuki) under IPM-only conditions, and one-way X-band Akatsuki data during solar occultation. The Chandrayaan-3 and Akatsuki IPM observations isolate IPM effects by excluding contributions from planetary atmospheres, the lunar ionosphere, and, except during solar occultation, the solar corona. Chandrayaan-3 data sample dynamically evolving Earth-Moon geometries and exhibit weak, mHz-level Doppler fluctuations, while Chandrayaan-2 observations provide near-lunar plasma benchmarks with higher amplitudes, during quiet time solar and geomagnetic conditions. Akatsuki and VeRa's IPM-only measurements capture long-path interplanetary effects, whereas Akatsuki solar occultation data reveal strong coronal signatures. Power spectral density analysis indicates Kolmogorov-like turbulence for lunar occultation and solar occultation cases, while IPM-only spectra show low-amplitude fluctuations. These results quantify the IPM contribution to Doppler noise, demonstrate the enhanced plasma sensitivity of two-way coherent links, and provide constraints relevant to turbulence modelling, precision spacecraft tracking, and the interpretation of radio occultation experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察行星际介质电子密度不规则性引起的航天器无线电信号多普勒频率起伏，并比较不同频段、传播几何和链路配置下的影响。作者分析了Chandrayaan-3月球电离层外双程S波段、Chandrayaan-2月球掩星双程S波段、Venus Express/Akatsuki在仅含行星际介质条件下的一程S/X波段，以及Akatsuki太阳掩星一程X波段数据。结果用于分离行星际介质、行星大气、月球电离层和太阳日冕等贡献；其中Chandrayaan-3等数据表现出毫赫兹量级的弱多普勒起伏，为无线电掩星误差预算和频率依赖性评估提供约束。
authors: Keshav Aggarwal, R. K. Choudhary, Abhirup Datta, Soumyaneal Banerjee, R. Manikantan, Anshuman Sharma, Takeshi Imamura

articles.title: Generation and Enhancement of Bipartite and Tripartite Entanglement in an Electro-Optomechanical Ring Cavity
articles.title_zh: 电-光机械环形腔中二体与三体纠缠的产生和增强
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03578v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This study investigates the generation and enhancement of quantum entanglement in an electro-optomechanical ring cavity system. The setup integrates two Coulomb-coupled mechanical resonators, which serve as the fundamental mechanism for the generation of bipartite and tripartite entanglement via charge mediated coupling. We then demonstrate the significant enhancement of this entanglement via a nonlinear parametric drive (an optical parametric amplifier, OPA), which injects a controllable nonlinearity into the cavity. We derive the system's Hamiltonian and the corresponding quantum Langevin equations, which are linearized around steady-state solutions to analyze Gaussian quantum fluctuations. Employing the covariance matrix formalism, we quantify bipartite entanglement via logarithmic negativity and tripartite entanglement via the minimum residual contangle. Our results unequivocally show that while the Coulomb interaction is indispensable for creating entanglement, the OPA acts as a powerful control tool, dramatically amplifying the degree of quantum correlations for all subsystems. We find that the strength of entanglement is highly sensitive to several parameters and can be optimized through the strategic selection of the OPA's gain and phase, the laser detuning, and the input power. A key finding is the existence of a trade-off, where parameters that maximize entanglement also constrain the stable operating regime of the system. Furthermore, thermal noise is shown to progressively degrade all quantum correlations, underscoring the necessity for low-temperature operation. These findings provide comprehensive guidance for parameter optimization, outlining a clear path from generation to enhancement, and highlight the potential of such hybrid systems as versatile platforms for controlling multipartite entanglement in quantum technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究讨论电-光机械环形腔系统中的量子纠缠产生与增强，系统包含两个库仑耦合机械谐振子，其电荷介导耦合用于生成二体和三体纠缠。作者进一步引入光学参量放大器作为非线性参量驱动，作为可控非线性资源增强腔内量子关联。通过哈密顿量、线性化量子Langevin方程和协方差矩阵形式，研究以对数负性和最小残余contangle量化纠缠，结果表明库仑相互作用负责产生纠缠，而OPA可显著放大各子系统间的量子关联。
authors: Fouad Essaadi, Yassine Oussarhan, Mohamed Ouhammou, Said Mouslih, Mohamed Jakha, Bouzid Manaut, Souad Taj

articles.title: Refraction laws in spatio-temporal media
articles.title_zh: 时空介质中的折射定律
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03995v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the time-dependent Maxwell system, formulated in the sense of distributions, for electromagnetic waves propagating through media with temporal and spatial material interfaces. Under explicit trace and regularity assumptions on the permittivity and permeability, we derive the jump conditions produced by temporal discontinuities and by subsequent spatial interfaces. These conditions are used to obtain generalized Snell laws for the wave vectors generated by temporal splitting, reflection, and transmission. We also derive the associated amplitude equations and organize them as a finite-dimensional linear system for a space-time slab geometry. Finally, we provide an explicit oblique-incidence example. Our approach does not impose a smooth-field ansatz and allows material parameters that need not be constant away from the interfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究含时间和空间材料界面的时变Maxwell系统，并在分布意义下处理电磁波在时空介质中的传播。在对介电常数和磁导率作出明确迹与正则性假设后，作者推导了时间不连续性及后续空间界面产生的跳跃条件。基于这些条件，文章得到时间分裂、反射和透射产生波矢的广义Snell定律及相应振幅方程，并将其组织为空间-时间板几何中的有限维线性系统，同时给出斜入射显式例子。

articles.title: Reduced-order modeling for electromagnetic inverse problems: a layered medium benchmark
articles.title_zh: 电磁逆问题的降阶建模：分层介质基准问题
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03996v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study reduced-order modeling for inverse problems in layered media, focusing on the recovery of impedance profiles from time-domain measurements. Using the Goupillaud structure, we formulate the forward problem as a discrete dynamical system and introduce a ROM-based objective defined at the level of reduced operators. Through numerical experiments on a 5-layer medium under various structured perturbations, we compare the ROM-based objective with a classical data misfit. The results show that the ROM-based inversion provides a more favorable reconstruction in the clean setting and in certain structured perturbation regimes, while remaining consistently competitive with the classical approach across all cases considered.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究分层介质逆问题中的降阶建模，目标是从时域测量恢复阻抗剖面。作者利用Goupillaud结构将正问题写成离散动力系统，并在降阶算子层面构造ROM目标函数。针对五层介质及多种结构化扰动的数值实验显示，相比传统数据失配目标，ROM反演在无噪声情形和部分结构化扰动条件下给出更有利的重建，并在所有测试情形中保持竞争力。

articles.title: Small-Angle Scattering
articles.title_zh: 小角散射
articles.abstract: arXiv:1901.07353v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Small-Angle Scattering (SAS) investigates structures in samples that generally range from approximately 0.5 nm to a few 100 nm. This can both be done for isotropic samples such as blends and liquids, as well as anisotropic samples such as quasi-crystals. In order to obtain data about that size regime scattered intensity, mostly of x-rays or neutrons, is investigated at angles from close to zero, still in the region of the primary beam up to 10deg , depending on the wavelength of the incoming radiation. The two primary sources for SAS experiments are x-ray (small-angle x-ray scattering, SAXS) sources and neutron (small-angle neutron scattering, SANS) sources, which shall be the two cases discussed here. Also scattering with electrons or other particle waves is possible, but not the main use case for the purpose of this manuscript. For most small-angle scattering instruments, both SAXS and SANS, the science case covers the investigation of self-assembled polymeric and biological systems, multi-scale systems with large size distribution of the contained particles, solutions of (nano-)particles and soft-matter systems, protein solutions, and material science investigations. In the case of SANS this is augmented by the possibility to also investigate the spin state of the sample and hence perform investigations of the magnetic structure of the sample. In the following sections the general setup of both SAXS and SANS instruments shall be discussed, as well as data acquisition and evaluation and preparation of the sample and the experiment in general. The information contained herein should provide sufficient information for planning and performing a SAS experiment and evaluate the gathered data.
articles.abstract_zh: 该综述介绍小角散射用于表征约0.5 nm至数百纳米尺度结构的基本思想、实验形式和适用对象。小角X射线散射和小角中子散射是主要实现方式，通过测量接近直通束到约10度范围内的散射强度获取各向同性或各向异性样品的结构信息。文中覆盖自组装聚合物和生物体系、多尺度颗粒体系、纳米颗粒溶液、软物质和蛋白质溶液等典型应用场景。

articles.title: All molecules are entangled in the number of electrons following a general physical principle
articles.title_zh: 所有分子在电子数上遵循一般物理原理而相互纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2405.00203v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A physically motivated equation that determines the number of electrons of a molecule is proposed based on some generally accepted basic chemical knowledge. It permits a complete local definition of molecules and shows that all molecules are entangled in the number of electrons. It also results in the extensivity and convexity of molecular energy, which underpin molecular quantum mechanics. The proposed physical principle includes the molecular size consistency principle as a special case and reveals an intrinsic relationship between molecular locality, size consistency, and energy convexity. Application of wavefunction theory to the new principle shows that an individual molecule with a noninteger number of electrons is locally physical. The energy of a molecule is piecewise linear with respect to its number of electrons. The realness of the number of electrons allows the definition of the electronic chemical potential of a single molecule. A state function equivalent to the energy of a molecule can be defined using the chemical potential as a variable and used to express the physical principle as a simple additivity. The latter also shows that the quantum entanglement in the number of electrons can be viewed as all molecules sharing one chemical potential. When the energy of a molecule with a definite number of electrons is not convex with respect to the number of electrons, the state of the molecule is not always locally determinable even with a known number of electrons.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出一个由基本化学知识出发、用于确定分子电子数的物理方程，从而给出分子的完全局域定义，并指出所有分子在电子数意义上存在纠缠。该原则导出分子能量的广延性与凸性，包含分子尺寸一致性原则作为特例，并揭示分子局域性、尺寸一致性和能量凸性之间的内在联系。将波函数理论用于该原则表明，具有非整数电子数的单个分子在局域上是物理可定义的，其能量随电子数呈分段线性关系，并可定义单分子的电子化学势。

articles.title: Spin Fluctuations-induced Unconventional Transverse Spin Current in Spin Degenerate Antiferromagnet
articles.title_zh: 自旋简并反铁磁体中由自旋涨落诱导的非常规横向自旋流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.09964v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Modern magnetic memory technology requires unconventional transverse spin current to achieve deterministic switching of perpendicular magnetization. Spin current in antiferromagnets (AFMs) has been long thought to be trivial as nonmagnets. Recently, a class of spin-splitting AFMs has been shown to be able to generate unconventional spin current for spin-orbit torque (SOT) applications. However, such AFMs requires specific symmetry breaking, and have been largely restricted by the limited material candidates. Here, we reveal universal spin fluctuation-induced unconventional transverse spin current in conventional spin degenerate AFMs at finite temperature by taking collinear (AFM) L10-MnPt as an example. The field-free switching of perpendicular magnetization was achieved via out-of-plane anti-damping-like SOT, leveraging the spin current with both y- and z-spin polarizations in heterostructures with MnPt functioning as spin current source. Based on symmetry analyses and experimental characterizations of current-induced spin torques, we find that the spin current generated by L10-MnPt exhibits anisotropy that varies with the current direction, enforced by the low symmetry magnetic point group when its Néel vector is along [110]. From a fundamental perspective, it would be intriguing to uncover a mechanism underlying the emergence of unconventional spin currents in spin degenerate antiferromagnets, which is highly desirable for spintronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作指出，传统自旋简并反铁磁体在有限温度下可由自旋涨落普遍地产生非常规横向自旋流，并以共线 L10-MnPt 为例进行验证。作者在 MnPt 异质结构中利用同时具有 y 与 z 自旋极化的自旋流，实现了垂直磁化的无外场翻转，其机制对应面外反阻尼型自旋轨道矩。结合对称性分析和电流诱导自旋矩表征，研究表明 L10-MnPt 产生的自旋流具有随电流方向变化的各向异性，为不依赖特殊自旋劈裂反铁磁体的自旋电子器件提供了材料途径。
authors: Cuimei Cao, Meng Zhu, Shiwei Chen, Yizhuo Song, Xiaoyu Feng, Zhenzhong Yang, Yihan Wang, Shiheng Liang, Qingfeng Zhan, Jia Zhang, Long You

articles.title: Multi-dimensional parameter space of higher-order exceptional points induced by Brillouin optoacoustics
articles.title_zh: 布里渊光声作用诱导的高阶例外点多维参数空间
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.05064v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Exceptional points (EPs) are degeneracies in the spectrum of non-Hermitian systems, where both the eigenvalues and eigenvectors coalesce. In the vicinity of an n-th order EP, the eigenvalues generally show n-th-root dependence on the system parameters, making EPs potentially promising candidates for ultra-sensitive measurements. Usually EPs are implemented in precisely fabricated nano- and microstructures. In this work, we instead show the experimental implementation of a third-order EP (EP3) using the synthetic dimension in a single-mode optical fiber, leveraging multi-frequency Brillouin scattering. We perform a multi-dimensional scan of the parameter space revealing not only an EP3 but also additional topological structures connected to it. Our work paves the way toward fabrication-free realizations of exceptional points of arbitrary order.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在单模光纤中利用合成维度和多频布里渊散射，实验实现了三阶非厄米例外点。作者通过多维参数扫描不仅识别出 EP3，还观察到与其相连的额外拓扑结构。该方案无需精密制备纳米或微结构，为任意阶例外点的免加工实现及其在高灵敏测量中的应用提供了新平台。
authors: Grigorii Slinkov, Anton Montag, Julius T. Gohsrich, Quentin Levoy, Paulina Fuentes Rivera, Flore K. Kunst, Birgit Stiller

articles.title: Enhancing ground-state cooling of center-of-mass motions via quantum squeezing from magnon nonlinearity
articles.title_zh: 利用磁振子非线性产生的量子压缩增强质心运动基态冷却
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.06484v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Cooling massive oscillators to quantum ground state is an essential prerequisite for their precise control, quantum memory, and quantum ultrasensitive measurement, etc. In a cavity-magnomechanical system, the magnon-mechanical coupling, enhanced by microwave cavity driving, can be utilized to cool the center-of-mass motion of a levitated magnetic sphere. In this work, we report that the cooling performance can be further improved by exploiting quantum squeezing stemming from magnonic self-Kerr nonlinearity inherent to the ferrimagnetic yttrium-iron-garnet (YIG) sphere. By means of suitable pump driving, the Kerr nonlinearity is converted into quantum squeezing, yielding considerable enhancement of the center-of-mass cooling with properly chosen optimal parameters. Moreover, we demonstrate that this improvement mechanism for cooling the massive magnetic sphere still works even in the unresolved-sideband regime where the mechanical frequency is smaller than the magnon decay rate. Eventually, we quantify the powers of the driving pumps for practical implementation of our scheme in a typical system. Our findings may provide a novel way to quantum fundamental researches and technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究腔-磁-机械系统中悬浮磁性微球质心运动的量子基态冷却，并提出利用 YIG 微球固有磁振子自 Kerr 非线性产生的量子压缩来提升冷却性能。通过合适泵浦驱动，Kerr 非线性可转化为有效压缩，从而在优化参数下显著增强质心冷却。作者还表明该机制在未分辨边带区仍然有效，并估算了典型实验系统所需泵浦功率。
authors: Jiate Xu, Xinqian Cui, Guolong Li

articles.title: Quantization Effects of Artificial Neural Networks for Embedded Edge-Computing Applications
articles.title_zh: 面向嵌入式边缘计算应用的人工神经网络量化效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.05479v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This paper examines the use of Quantized Neural Networks (QNNs) for two resource-constrained scientific applications: automated calibration of semi-conductor quantum bits (qubits) and scientific particle detectors. We evaluate the trade-offs between Post-Training Quantization (PTQ), Quantization-Aware Training (QAT), and ultra-low-bit Binary Neural Networks (BNNs) with respect to latency and resource usage. Our results demonstrate that PTQ achieves a four-fold reduction in memory usage for U-shaped CNN (U-Net) architectures. For the training of non-differentiable custom BNNs , we propose a novel, hardware-constrained learning approach using Genetic Algorithms (GAs). We showcase a LUT-based BNN architecture suitable for direct conversion to VHDL via the HCL4BNN framework. This method achieves nanosecond-scale inference latencies (10-15 ns) without requiring specialized DSP or BRAM resources.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文评估量化神经网络在两类资源受限科学应用中的表现：半导体量子比特自动校准和科学粒子探测器。作者比较后训练量化、量化感知训练和超低比特二值神经网络在延迟与资源占用上的权衡，发现后训练量化可使 U-Net 架构内存用量降低约四倍。针对不可微自定义 BNN，研究提出基于遗传算法的硬件约束学习方法，并展示可通过 HCL4BNN 直接转为 VHDL 的 LUT 型 BNN，实现约 10–15 ns 推理延迟且无需专用 DSP 或 BRAM。
authors: Alperen Aksoy, Ilja Bekman, Vesselin Dimitrov, Qader Dorosti, Chimezie Eguzo, Sarah Fleitmann, Christian Grewing, Fabian Hader, Andre Zambanini, Stefan van Waasen

articles.title: Physics-Informed Neural Quantum Control for Rovibrational Photoassociation in a Morse Molecular System
articles.title_zh: 用于 Morse 分子体系转振动光缔合的物理信息神经量子控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.29610v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We present a Physics-Informed Neural Quantum Control (PINQC) framework for rovibrational photoassociation in a Morse molecular system. The proposed method combines neural-network-based laser-field generation with differentiable quantum propagation, allowing optimized laser pulses to be obtained directly from the underlying quantum dynamics without requiring external training data. The optimized control fields efficiently transfer an initially continuum-like Gaussian wave packet into the vibrational ground-state level, promoting continuum-to-bound population transfer through coherent rovibrational dynamics. The resulting photoassociation process involves both vibrational stabilization and rotational redistribution arising naturally from dipole-induced couplings between neighboring rotational channels. A central result of the present work is the successful application of the PINQC framework to extended rovibrational models containing larger rotational levels than those previously accessible in our conventional photoassociation calculations. The optimization remains numerically stable despite the increased complexity of the molecular system, demonstrating that differentiable optimization provides an effective strategy for treating rovibrational models of increased dimensionality. These results establish the PINQC framework as a promising computational tool for molecular photoassociation and motivate future investigations of increasingly complex rovibrational quantum-control problems.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出物理信息神经量子控制框架，用于 Morse 分子体系中的转振动光缔合。该方法将神经网络生成激光场与可微量子传播结合，无需外部训练数据即可基于量子动力学直接优化脉冲。优化场可将初始类连续 Gaussian 波包有效转移到振动基态，并通过相干转振动动力学实现连续态到束缚态的布居转移；该框架还能稳定处理包含更多转动能级的扩展模型。
authors: Murilo D. Forlevesi, Emanuel Fernandes de Lima, Edson Denis Leonel

articles.title: GeoID-PINN: Identifiability-Aware Regional Epidemic Inference with Geographic Coupling
articles.title_zh: GeoID-PINN：考虑可辨识性的地理耦合区域流行病推断
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02633v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Regional surveillance data reflect local transmission, reporting, seeding, and external infection pressure, which are difficult to identify separately. We introduce GeoID-PINN, a physics-informed neural network (PINN) for susceptible-infectious-recovered-deceased (SIRD) dynamics. The model represents spatial dependence with a row-stochastic source-composition matrix whose rows assign nonnegative source weights that sum to one. We regularize this matrix toward a spatial prior constructed from distance, adjacency, commuting, or lead-lag information. In a four-region simulation with known truth, a compatible distance prior gives source-composition error 0.099. The error rises to 0.159 without regularization and 0.577 under a strongly misspecified prior, while trajectory fit and transmission-scale estimates remain similar. Accurate trajectories therefore do not guarantee recovery of the regional dependence structure. We also evaluate GeoID-PINN retrospectively using COVID-19 data from 64 Louisiana counties. Relative to an autoregressive negative-binomial baseline, Forecast-Trained Geo-PINN reduces mean squared error (MSE) from 32,957 to 11,468 and mean absolute error (MAE) from 70.60 to 57.73. The baseline has lower negative log likelihood (NLL), 5.158 versus 5.346, indicating better distributional fit but worse point accuracy. In a controlled 15-county comparison, county adjacency reduces MSE by 6.85 percent and MAE by 3.1 percent. Similar performance across plausible priors supports structured regularization but not unique edge recovery. These results require prior-sensitivity and observation-model checks before interpretation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出 GeoID-PINN，用于具有地理耦合的 SIRD 区域流行病动力学推断，重点处理本地传播、报告、输入感染和外部感染压力之间难以分离的问题。模型以行随机源组成矩阵表示空间依赖，并用由距离、邻接、通勤或时滞信息构造的空间先验进行正则化。四区域仿真显示，合适先验可显著改善源组成恢复，而轨迹拟合准确并不保证区域依赖结构可被正确识别；在路易斯安那州 64 个县 COVID-19 数据上的回顾评估中，该方法相对自回归负二项基线降低了预测误差。

articles.title: Verifier-Guided Model Discovery for Physical Dynamical Systems with Pretrained Symbolic Transformers
articles.title_zh: 面向物理动力系统的验证器引导模型发现与预训练符号 Transformer
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02662v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reliable forecasting of nonlinear physical systems underpins scientific discovery and engineering decision-making. Yet high-fidelity simulations are prohibitively costly, and machine-learning surrogates can be opaque and encode assumptions about system dynamics, limiting generalizability. Pretrained transformers mapping synthetic ODE trajectories to equations offer interpretable alternatives, promising transfer without system-specific equation knowledge. Transferring them reliably to high-dimensional physical data, however, remains an open challenge. We develop a verifier-guided (VG) workflow around ODEFormer as a symbolic backbone, using dynamical and physical-admissibility criteria to select from a multi-trajectory candidate equation pool, enabling transfer. On canonical Van der Pol oscillators, VG outperforms the original ODEFormer workflow across held-out initial conditions. We then address vortex shedding, a phenomenon occurring in atmospheric and plasma systems of societal relevance, through coordinate reduction and symbolic discovery at fixed and varying Reynolds numbers. VG discovers fixed-parameter reduced-order equations that recover the fundamental shedding oscillator and higher harmonics without a wake-specific candidate library or prescribed Navier-Stokes structure, while the cross-parameter model generalizes to withheld regimes. Reconstruction fidelity alone did not determine symbolic discoverability, highlighting the importance of compatibility between latent dynamics and the backbone's pretraining distribution. This work establishes a verifier-guided neural-to-symbolic methodology for interpretable and physically auditable forecasting in the natural sciences.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者围绕预训练符号 Transformer ODEFormer 构建验证器引导流程，用动力学与物理可接受性准则从多轨迹候选方程池中筛选模型，以提升向真实高维物理数据迁移的可靠性。在 Van der Pol 振子基准上，该流程在未见初始条件下优于原始 ODEFormer 工作流。研究进一步通过坐标降维和符号发现处理固定及变化 Reynolds 数下的涡脱落问题，目标是在保持可解释性的同时获得可泛化的降阶动力学方程。

articles.title: Topological Simplification in Predictive Coding Networks
articles.title_zh: 预测编码网络中的拓扑简化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02816v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the topology of learned representations in predictive coding networks (PCNs), a neuro-inspired bidirectional architecture, using a quantitative layer-wise persistent homology analysis. We train well-performing PCNs on a synthetic classification dataset (≥ 99.9% test accuracy) and on MNIST (≥ 95% test accuracy), and measure how topological features change across layers for different architectures and activation functions. We find that smaller PCNs collapse connected components across layers earlier than larger models (Spearman n̆icodex1D70C in [0.72, 0.79] across activations), with model size measured as the sum of hidden-layer widths. We also observe a strong negative correlation (n̆icodex1D70C = -0.58) between the depth at which simplification occurs and reconstruction error; i.e., architectures that simplify later reconstruct better. Finally, a seed-level bootstrap comparison across architectures and activations shows that PCNs consistently collapse connected components later than matched MLPs, with an average difference of 3.6 layers. These results suggest that persistent homology offers a useful quantitative lens on the compression--reconstruction tradeoff in PCNs, and that both model capacity and the recurrent, bidirectional dynamics of predictive coding inference shape when this tradeoff is resolved across layers.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究使用逐层持久同调定量分析预测编码网络中学习表征的拓扑变化，并在合成分类数据和 MNIST 上训练高精度模型。结果显示，小型 PCN 比大型模型更早在层间塌缩连通分支，且表征简化发生得越晚，重构误差通常越低。跨随机种子、架构和激活函数的比较还表明，PCN 相比匹配的 MLP 更晚发生连通分支塌缩，说明持久同调可作为分析预测编码表征形成过程的有效工具。
authors: Adam Shaw, Jiayu Li, Michael Sperling, Michael Kim, Alvin Jin

articles.title: ED-DiT: Physics-Guided Diffusion Pretraining for Transferable Molecular Representations from Electron Density
articles.title_zh: ED-DiT：基于电子密度的物理引导扩散预训练以获得可迁移分子表征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03260v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pretraining has shown strong potential for learning transferable representations, yet it remains underexplored for electron-density-based molecular learning. Electron density provides a continuous three-dimensional description of molecular electronic structure, capturing both local spatial patterns and global physical quantities. This raises a key question: can electron-density fields be used for self-supervised pretraining to learn a shared representation that transfers across diverse electronic-structure-related tasks? We propose ED-DiT, a physics-guided Diffusion Transformer for self-supervised pretraining on electron-density point clouds. ED-DiT learns reusable representations by reconstructing corrupted and partially masked log-density fields across diffusion noise levels. An electron-number consistency constraint is further introduced to preserve the total electronic mass. The pretrained encoder can be adapted to property prediction, open-/closed-shell classification, molecule-electron-density retrieval, and molecule-conditioned electron-density prediction. Experiments on six EDBench tasks show that ED-DiT consistently outperforms the same architecture trained from scratch, especially under limited supervision. For molecule-conditioned electron-density prediction, it reduces RMSE from 2.2474 to 1.3753 and surpasses the available baseline. With only 10% labels, it improves orbital energy prediction RMSE from 0.0293 to 0.0138. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of physics-guided electron-density pretraining for learning transferable molecular representations.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出 ED-DiT，一种面向电子密度点云的物理引导扩散 Transformer 自监督预训练方法，用于学习可迁移的分子表征。模型通过在不同扩散噪声水平下重建被扰动和部分遮蔽的对数电子密度场来学习表示，并加入电子数一致性约束以保持总电子质量。预训练编码器可迁移到性质预测、开壳层/闭壳层分类、分子-电子密度检索和分子条件电子密度预测等任务，在 EDBench 多项任务上表现优于对比方法。
authors: Liang Shuang, Haocheng Wang, Jiayi Song, Shuquan Ye, Ben Fei

articles.title: AS-FedBridge: Pseudo-Spike Bridge Distillation for Heterogeneous ANN-SNN Federated Learning
articles.title_zh: AS-FedBridge：用于异构 ANN-SNN 联邦学习的伪脉冲桥接蒸馏
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03324v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Federated learning enables collaborative model training across distributed edge devices while strictly preserving data privacy. To facilitate practical deployment on resource-constrained edge devices, Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have emerged as a promising alternative to traditional Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) due to their sparse computing mechanisms and high energy efficiency. However, jointly training ANNs and SNNs exposes a challenge of representational misalignment, which is intrinsically caused by differences in information representation, specifically the semantic gap between continuous real-valued activations in ANNs and discrete spatio-temporal spikes in SNNs. To overcome this barrier, we propose AS-FedBridge, a novel federated learning framework tailored for mixed ANN-SNN clients. AS-FedBridge features a lightweight Bridge equipped with a Pseudo-Spike Interface, which effectively projects continuous signals into a spike-compatible space to facilitate ANN-SNN alignment. Given the absence of existing mixed ANN-SNN federated frameworks, we establish a comprehensive benchmark to evaluate against multiple advanced heterogeneous FL methods. Our empirical analysis demonstrates a positive correlation between the degree of ANN-SNN alignment and the collaborative FL performance. Across four datasets, AS-FedBridge consistently demonstrates advanced accuracy while mitigating extreme scale, architecture, and client heterogeneity challenge. Furthermore, our framework enables a highly controllable trade-off between model performance and resource efficiency. AS-FedBridge accomplishes these robust performance gains while introducing only marginal computational overhead, establishing a robust and practical foundation for mixed ANN-SNN federated learning systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文面向混合人工神经网络与脉冲神经网络客户端的联邦学习，解决连续实值激活与离散时空脉冲之间的表征错位问题。作者提出 AS-FedBridge 框架，其中轻量级 Bridge 与伪脉冲接口将连续信号投影到脉冲兼容空间，以促进 ANN-SNN 对齐。鉴于此前缺少混合 ANN-SNN 联邦框架，研究还建立了系统基准，并与多种先进异构联邦方法进行评估比较。
authors: Shengyang Li, Yiting Dong, Liuyang Song, Ximing Wang, Luyuan Xie, Cong Li, Qingni Shen, Zhaofei Yu

articles.title: Beyond the Gegenbauer Paradigm: q-Orthogonal Kernels for Machine Learning
articles.title_zh: 超越 Gegenbauer 范式：面向机器学习的 q-正交核
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03482v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The performance of Support Vector Machines (SVMs) critically depends on the kernel function choice, which enables implicit mapping of data into high-dimensional feature spaces. While classical kernels like Radial Basis Function (RBF) remain popular, orthogonal polynomial kernels offer mathematically interpretable alternatives that can incorporate structured prior knowledge. This work extends the orthogonal polynomial kernel paradigm by introducing a novel family based on discrete q-Hermite I polynomials, a class of q-orthogonal polynomials that generalize classical Hermite polynomials through a deformation parameter q. We formally define the q-Hermite kernel and establish its validity under Mercer's theorem. The kernel's inherent boundedness properties naturally prevent annihilation and explosion effects without requiring explicit scaling mechanisms. Extensive experiments across 20 benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed kernel achieves competitive performance compared to both classical kernels and other orthogonal polynomial kernels, while offering advantages in numerical stability and computational simplicity. Our results confirm that q-orthogonal polynomials constitute a promising direction for kernel design, bridging mathematical elegance with practical machine learning applications, that provides conceptual and algorithmic resources that may be further extended to emerging quantum computing paradigms. To facilitate full reproducibility, we provide the complete implementation and experimental pipeline in an open-access GitHub repository at https://github.com/Kokechacho/SVMs-QSVMs.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一类基于离散 q-Hermite I 多项式的支持向量机核函数，将经典 Hermite 正交多项式核推广到含形变参数 q 的 q-正交框架。作者形式化定义 q-Hermite 核并证明其满足 Mercer 条件，其有界性有助于避免数值湮灭和爆炸而无需额外缩放。20 个基准数据集实验表明，该核相较经典核和其他正交多项式核具有竞争性性能，并在数值稳定性与计算简洁性方面具备优势。
authors: Álvaro Sánchez-Paniagua Ríos, Juan P. Llerena, Alberto Lastra, Nuria Torrado, Edmundo J. Huertas

articles.title: Omega-S: A Functional Resilience Index for LLM Fine-Tuning
articles.title_zh: Omega-S：用于大语言模型微调的功能韧性指标
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03887v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fine-tuning a large language model on new data degrades what it previously learned. We present Omega-S, a drop-in penalty computed from the weight matrix alone: it needs no previous-task data, no Fisher matrix and no stored copy of the old weights. It is three lines in an existing training loop and adds under 4% to the cost of a step. Retention. On Llama-3-8B with LoRA, fine-tuned from code to prose and measured by HumanEval over ten seeds, Omega-S retains more of the original capability than no regularisation on 9 of 10 seeds (0.173 -> 0.238 absolute pass@1; sign test one-sided p=0.011, Wilcoxon p=0.006), as a retention ratio, 62.9% -> 84.1%. It also beats tuned weight decay on 10 of 10 seeds (p=0.002) and tuned EWC on 8 of 10 (p=0.014), every arm re-measured in the same session. Mechanism, measured rather than asserted. Omega-S is topological by construction, its objective built from Tr(A³⁾, but we measured which of its four factors actually moves and three do not: their elasticity with respect to the weights is at or below 1e-4, against 9e-3 for the degree-variance term. As implemented, the composite reduces to a penalty on the variance of node degrees, which means row magnitude in square modules and directional alignment in non-square ones. We report this because a method whose name promises one thing and whose gradient does another should say so. We also enumerate the open design choices, including a contrast-preserving construction that does what it was designed to do and makes retention worse on all ten seeds. Repeating an identical configuration, same seed and same hardware, gives a standard deviation of 0.104 in retention ratio. We have not found this quantified for low-rank fine-tuning of language models, and it bounds every seed-paired comparison in this literature, ours included. Code, per-seed results and the full record of negative results are available.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 Omega-S，一种仅由权重矩阵计算的微调正则项，用于缓解大语言模型在新任务微调时的遗忘，无需旧任务数据、Fisher 矩阵或旧权重副本。Llama-3-8B LoRA 从代码到散文的微调实验显示，Omega-S 在多数随机种子下比无正则、调参权重衰减和 EWC 更好地保留 HumanEval 能力，且单步开销增加低于 4%。机制分析表明，实际起主要作用的是度方差相关项，而非所有拓扑因子共同变化。

articles.title: Improved Quantum Algorithms for Reinforcement Learning Under a Generative Model
articles.title_zh: 生成模型下强化学习的改进量子算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02826v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reinforcement learning is a subfield of machine learning that studies how an agent interacts with an environment in order to extract as large a reward as possible. A standard approach to study such interaction is through Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) and the task of choosing an optimal policy --- a function that tells the agent which action to take. In this work, we study two types of MDPs --- finite-horizon and infinite-horizon discounted --- and propose new quantum algorithms for computing approximate optimal policies. Our quantum algorithms are based on a new combination of standard value iteration and quantum subroutines like quantum mean estimation and quantum maximum finding, overall enhanced with techniques from sample-optimal classical algorithms. Our resulting query complexities improve upon previous works, thus approaching already established quantum lower bounds.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向有限时域和无限时域折扣马尔可夫决策过程，提出用于近似最优策略计算的新量子算法。算法结合经典值迭代、量子均值估计、量子最大值搜索以及样本最优经典算法中的技术。所得查询复杂度优于已有量子强化学习算法，并更接近已知量子下界。

articles.title: Task-Oriented Candidate-Latent Feedback for Coarse-to-Fine Sensing in Distributed OFDM-ISAC Networks
articles.title_zh: 分布式 OFDM-ISAC 网络中面向任务的候选潜变量反馈粗到细感知
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03319v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Future integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) architectures separate the sensing entity (SE) that acquires measurements from the sensing function (SF) that performs inference, creating a need for compact, task-oriented feedback on the SE-SF interface. Forwarding the raw channel frequency response or full per-link delay-Doppler-azimuth-elevation (DDAE) tensor is prohibitively expensive, while peak-only reporting discards target-discriminative structure under clutter. We propose a learning-based coarse-to-fine sensing pipeline with candidate-latent feedback for single-target estimation. At the SE, a lightweight convolutional scorer produces a dense delay-Doppler proposal map from pilot-based OFDM channel estimates, and a learned encoder constructs K compact C-dimensional candidate tokens by fusing per-candidate azimuth-elevation patches, normalized position, and confidence cues. The latents are uniformly quantized post-training to b bits and transmitted under a finite budget B_fb = bKC + 18K + 16 bits to the SF, which performs cross-candidate refinement, reranking, and joint four-parameter estimation. On a ray-traced urban scene with static and dynamic clutter, three operating points in the (K, C, b) design space achieve 96.33-98.88% detection at 107-806 bytes per coherent processing interval, compression ratios of 1.2-9.2 x 10⁴ over the 8-bit DDAE magnitude tensor, reducing the SE-SF interface from multi-Gbit/s to sub-Mbit/s rates. Cross-scene evaluation on an independent campus-scale environment achieves 98.79-99.50% detection and at-or-better angular accuracy without retraining, indicating that the learned representation captures target-relevant structure that transports across scenes of comparable or lower clutter density.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对集成感知通信系统中感知实体与感知功能分离导致的反馈开销问题，提出一种候选潜变量反馈的学习式粗到细单目标估计流程。感知实体从 OFDM 导频信道估计生成延迟-多普勒候选图，并将每个候选的角度局部块、位置和置信度编码为紧凑 token，经量化后在有限反馈预算内传输。感知功能端再进行跨候选细化、重排序和四参数联合估计，以在避免传输完整 DDAE 张量的同时保留目标判别信息。
authors: Shiv Shankar, Radha Krishna Ganti, J Klutto Milleth

articles.title: Information-Geometric Forward Policy Training in GFlowNets
articles.title_zh: GFlowNets 中基于信息几何的前向策略训练
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03967v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) have emerged as a flexible framework for amortised inference over discrete and mixed discrete-continuous objects, requiring only an unnormalised target density specified through a reward. In this work, we formulate forward-policy training in GFlowNets through the information geometry of the induced trajectory sampler. Treating the forward policy as an induced trajectory sampler, we show that its intrinsic first-order geometry is given by the Fisher-Rao metric of the trajectory family, and that the associated natural gradient provides the canonical local update whenever the corresponding Fisher information is computable or accurately approximable. We derive an exact decomposition of the trajectory Fisher into per-step conditional second moments, which clarifies when temporal score interactions vanish and when dense couplings remain under shared parameterisation. This leads to three computational regimes: settings with tractable exact Fisher information, settings where Monte Carlo estimators of the expected Fisher are sufficient, and structure-exploitable settings in which target locality or factorisation yields accurate approximations of the Fisher expectation. In the latter case, graphical-model tools such as exact marginalisation, separator methods, and belief propagation provide principled surrogates for natural-gradient updates. The resulting framework turns target structure into optimisation geometry and yields a tractable route to structure-aware forward-policy training in GFlowNets. We illustrate the framework empirically through examples comparing convergence and exploration behaviour under Riemannian and Euclidean optimisation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作从诱导轨迹采样器的信息几何角度重新表述 GFlowNets 的前向策略训练，指出其内禀一阶几何由轨迹族的 Fisher-Rao 度量给出。作者推导了轨迹 Fisher 信息到逐步条件二阶矩的精确分解，阐明时间 score 相互作用何时消失、共享参数化下何时产生密集耦合。由此区分出精确 Fisher 可计算、蒙特卡罗期望 Fisher 足够、以及可利用目标局域性或因子结构的三类计算情形。

articles.title: Bi-Lipschitz Ansatz for Anti-Symmetric Functions
articles.title_zh: 反对称函数的双 Lipschitz 拟设
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.04263v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Motivated by applications to the simulation of quantum many-body systems by neural networks, researchers have suggested several models which are antisymmetric by construction, and can approximate all antisymmetric functions. However, these works either require very high computational complexity to attain universal approximation, or suffer from discontinuities. In this paper, we introduce two antisymmetric ansatzes which do not suffer from these disadvantages. The first is based on a bi-Lipschitz embedding with respect to a naturally defined metric. The second is a modular anti-symmetrizing projection framework based on the frame-averaging methodology. Both approaches yield continuous antisymmetric models which attain universal approximation guarantees with a polynomial complexity in problem size. Moreover, for both approaches, we obtain quantitative approximation results that bound the number of parameters required to approximate Lipschitz antisymmetric functions to a given accuracy ϵ. We also provide preliminary experimental evidence suggesting improved performance in learning antisymmetric functions.
articles.abstract_zh: 受神经网络模拟量子多体系统的需求驱动，该文提出两种连续反对称函数拟设，以避免现有通用反对称模型计算复杂度过高或存在不连续性的问题。第一种方法基于相对于自然度量的双 Lipschitz 嵌入，第二种为基于 frame-averaging 思想的模块化反对称化投影框架。两者均以问题规模的多项式复杂度实现通用逼近，并给出逼近 Lipschitz 反对称函数所需参数量的定量误差界，同时提供初步实验支持。
authors: Nadav Dym, Jianfeng Lu, Matan Mizrachi

articles.title: Efficient quantum-enhanced classical simulation for patches of quantum landscapes
articles.title_zh: 量子景观局部区域的高效量子增强经典模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2411.19896v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Understanding the capabilities of classical simulation methods is key to identifying where quantum computers are advantageous. Not only does this ensure that quantum computers are used only where necessary, but also one can potentially identify subroutines that can be offloaded onto a classical device. In this work, we show that it is always possible to generate a classical surrogate of a sub-region (dubbed a "patch") of an expectation landscape produced by a parameterized quantum circuit. That is, we provide a quantum-enhanced classical algorithm which, after simple measurements on a quantum device, allows one to classically simulate approximate expectation values of a subregion of a landscape. We provide time and sample complexity guarantees for a range of families of circuits of interest, and further numerically demonstrate our simulation algorithms on an exactly verifiable simulation of a Hamiltonian variational ansatz and long-time dynamics simulation on a 127-qubit heavy-hex topology.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究表明，对于参数化量子线路产生的期望值景观，总可以在某个局部子区域构造经典替代模型。算法通过在量子设备上进行简单测量，随后在经典设备上近似模拟该“patch”内的期望值。作者给出多类重要线路族的时间与样本复杂度保证，并在哈密顿量变分拟设和 127 比特 heavy-hex 拓扑长时间动力学模拟中进行了数值验证。
authors: Sacha Lerch, Ricard Puig, Manuel S. Rudolph, Armando Angrisani, Tyson Jones, M. Cerezo, Supanut Thanasilp, Zoë Holmes

articles.title: PRISMA: Improving the Accuracy-Latency Frontier of Diffusion-based PDE Solvers Using Physics-Informed Spectral Attention
articles.title_zh: PRISMA：用物理约束谱注意力改善扩散型 PDE 求解器的精度-延迟边界
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.01370v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Diffusion-based solvers for partial differential equations (PDEs) are often bottle-necked by slow gradient-based test-time optimization routines that use PDE residuals for loss guidance. They additionally suffer from optimization instabilities and are unable to dynamically adapt their inference scheme in the presence of noisy PDE residuals. To address these limitations, we introduce PRISMA (PDE Residual Informed Spectral Modulation with Attention), a conditional diffusion neural operator that embeds PDE residuals directly into the model's architecture via an attention-inspired modulation mechanism in the spectral domain, enabling gradient-descent free inference. In contrast to previous methods that use PDE loss solely as external optimization targets, PRISMA integrates PDE residuals as integral architectural features, making it inherently fast, robust, accurate, and free from sensitive hyperparameter tuning. We show that PRISMA has competitive accuracy, at substantially lower inference costs, compared to previous methods across five benchmark PDEs especially with noisy observations, while using 10x to 100x fewer denoising steps, leading to 15x to 250x faster inference.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 PRISMA，一种将 PDE 残差直接嵌入谱域注意力调制机制的条件扩散神经算子，用于避免测试时基于梯度的慢速残差优化。与仅把 PDE 损失作为外部优化目标的方法不同，PRISMA 将残差作为模型结构特征，从而实现无需梯度下降的快速、稳健推断。五个 PDE 基准上的结果显示，尤其在含噪观测下，PRISMA 以显著更低推断成本和更少去噪步数达到有竞争力的精度。
authors: Medha Sawhney, Abhilash Neog, Mridul Khurana, Anuj Karpatne

articles.title: Hydrogen Peroxide Modified Acetylene Black Improves Desalination of Circulating Water
articles.title_zh: 过氧化氢改性乙炔黑提升循环水脱盐性能
articles.abstract: To alleviate freshwater shortage and water pollution in power plant circulating water treatment, flow-electrode capacitive deionization serves as a promising desalination technique. Activated carbon applied alone displays unsatisfactory conductivity in electrode slurries, hence acetylene black is introduced to construct conductive pathways. Nevertheless, intrinsic strong hydrophobicity makes acetylene black prone to severe agglomeration and undermines the optimized conductive networks. In this work, liquid-phase oxidation using 30% hydrogen peroxide is performed to graft oxygen-containing functional groups onto acetylene black, and the modified filler is blended with activated carbon to prepare flow electrodes targeting saline power plant circulating water. Characterizations reveal that the water contact angle of acetylene black decreases from 137.8°to 64.3°, bringing remarkable hydrophilic improvement alongside tuned pore structure and reduced charge transfer resistance, while the underlying conductive skeleton remains intact. Desalination tests under optimal parameters indicate that flow electrodes containing 10% modified acetylene black reach a salt removal efficiency of 40.29%, 48% higher than electrodes made of pure activated carbon, with decreased energy consumption. Hydrogen peroxide modification mitigates particle agglomeration, thereby improving both the desalination performance and energy utilization efficiency of the electrode system for circulating water desalination in power plants.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对流动电极电容去离子中活性炭浆料导电性不足、乙炔黑疏水团聚破坏导电网络的问题，采用 30% 过氧化氢液相氧化在乙炔黑表面引入含氧官能团。改性后乙炔黑水接触角由 137.8° 降至 64.3°，亲水性显著增强，同时孔结构得到调节、电荷转移电阻降低且导电骨架基本保持。优化条件下，含 10% 改性乙炔黑的流动电极用于电厂含盐循环水时盐去除效率达到 40.29%。

articles.title: Non-Hermitian Singularities in Colloidal Plasmon–Exciton Interactions
articles.title_zh: 胶体等离激元-激子相互作用中的非厄米奇异点
articles.abstract: Losses critically govern the interaction between electromagnetic modes (photons or plasmons) and material excitations (excitons or phonons). By tailoring dissipation, systems can be tuned from the weak-coupling regime where light and matter evolve independently to the strong-coupling regime, characterized by Rabi splitting and coherent oscillations. Between these regimes lies an intermediate regime featuring splitting with strongly damped oscillations, reflecting underlying non-Hermitian dynamics. The crossover from weak to strong coupling proceeds through this intermediate regime and takes place at an exceptional point (EP)—spectral singularity unique to non-Hermitian systems where eigenvalues and eigenmodes coalesce. Here we report the first observation of an EP in the interaction between localized plasmon resonances of colloidally synthesized Au@Ag core–shell nanocuboids and excitons of a J-aggregate dye. By independently tuning plasmonic losses and plasmon–exciton coupling strength, we access the EP and establish its role in mediating the crossover between coupling regimes, accompanied by the emergence of Fano-like spectral lineshapes. We further demonstrate a refractive index sensor operating across distinct response regimes, exhibiting linear, square-root and quadratic responsivities, when tuned away from the EP, at the EP and in the strong-coupling regime, respectively. These results establish the emergence of EPs in colloidal systems and open new opportunities for colloidal non-Hermitian nanophotonic devices, including ultra-responsive sensors, plasmonic components, and colloidal polariton lasers.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作报道了胶体合成 Au@Ag 核壳纳米长方体局域等离激元与 J-聚集染料激子相互作用中异常点的观测。通过独立调控等离激元损耗和等离激元-激子耦合强度，作者进入弱耦合与强耦合之间的中间区域，并确定异常点在耦合跨越过程中的作用。该过程伴随类 Fano 谱线形的出现，并展示了其在折射率相关光谱响应中的潜在意义。

articles.title: Quantum Diffusion with Attentive Twin-Stream Sparse Spatiotemporal for Cyberattack Detection in Smart Grids
articles.title_zh: 用于智能电网网络攻击检测的注意力双流稀疏时空量子扩散方法
articles.abstract: Modern power systems face escalating cyber threats that simultaneously target digital communication protocols and physical infrastructure, making real-time detection essential for secure grid operation. Current data-driven cyber attack detections rely on deterministic temporal data encoding and struggle with high sample complexity, overfitting. This paper proposes the Deep Twin-Stream Sparse Spatiotemporal Quantum Diffusion (STQD) framework for cyber attack detection in smart grid systems. The proposed STQD model proposes a sparse twin-stream spatiotemporal transformer autoencoder compresses high-dimensional sensor inputs into a lower dimensional latent representation using sparse spatiotemporal attention, adaptive gating fusion, and supervised contrastive learning. The extracted spatiotemporal representation are mapped to quantum Hilbert space via quantum encoding circuits. A quantum diffusion model learns the latent spatiotemporal embeddings probability distribution function through a quantum-native denoising process on density matrices, learning the class-conditional probability distribution of the encoded quantum states. Finally, a Quantum Support Vector Machine (QSVM) classifies the quantum spatiotemporal representations using a fidelity-based quantum kernel across three encoding strategies, including angle, amplitude, and instantaneous quantum polynomial. The proposed STQD framework is evaluated on two distinct publicly available smart grid benchmarks including Mississippi State University and Oak Ridge National Laboratory (MSU-ORNL) and the Smart Digital Substation (SDS) dataset, achieving weighted F1-scores of 0.95 and 0.90, respectively. Consistent performance across two architecturally diverse grid environments demonstrates the superior generalization capacity of STQD compared to state-of-the-art approaches.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出深度双流稀疏时空量子扩散框架 STQD，用于智能电网中同时影响通信与物理基础设施的网络攻击检测。模型先用稀疏双流时空 Transformer 自编码器、门控融合和监督对比学习将高维传感器数据压缩为低维时空潜表示，再通过量子编码线路映射到 Hilbert 空间。随后量子扩散模型在密度矩阵上学习类别条件的潜表示分布，最终由量子支持向量机完成分类。

articles.title: Weaponized supply: a synthetic-control evaluation of the 2025 rare- earth export controls on importer prices, manufacturing, and substitution
articles.title_zh: 供应武器化：2025年稀土出口管制对进口国价格、制造业与替代的合成控制评估
articles.abstract: China imposed export licensing controls on a group of heavy rare earth elements in early spring, disrupting supply chains that manufacturers outside China depend on for permanent magnets, catalysts, and specialty alloys. Whether this shock produced a uniform price effect across importer countries and product categories, or a heterogeneous one, remains unexamined in the existing literature on critical mineral export restrictions. This paper evaluates the causal effect of the controls on import prices and the share of imports sourced from China, using an augmented synthetic control design applied to a monthly panel of product-country pairs spanning several years before and after the shock. The estimated price effect is heterogeneous rather than uniform, differing in direction between rare earth metals and rare earth compounds, and a formal test confirms this dispersion reflects a genuine feature of the shock rather than estimation noise. Pre-treatment exposure to Chinese supply does not systematically predict the size of the price response, pointing toward substitution availability and technological adaptation rather than exposure intensity as the likelier explanation for which country and product pairs are affected. Policymakers and manufacturers should treat critical mineral export controls as a shock whose consequences depend on where a product sits in the value chain, rather than assuming a single, predictable price outcome. JEL classification: F13; F14; Q37; C21
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文评估中国2025年春季对部分重稀土元素实施出口许可管制后，对进口价格和中国来源进口份额的因果影响。作者采用增强合成控制方法分析冲击前后多年产品—国家月度面板数据，发现价格效应并非一致，而是在稀土金属和稀土化合物之间方向和幅度均存在异质性。结果还显示，对中国供应的事前暴露程度不能系统预测价格响应，提示替代可得性和技术适应能力可能更关键。

articles.title: Effects of Walnut Shell Addition Ratio on the Properties of Wood Particleboard and Analysis of the Critical High-Addition Range
articles.title_zh: 核桃壳添加比例对木质刨花板性能的影响及高添加量临界区间分析
articles.abstract: Walnut shell (WS) is a lignocellulosic residue with potential for partial substitution of wood particles in particleboard production. This study investigated the effects of WS addition on the properties and stable addition range of wood particleboards. Based on a WS particle size of 20–35 mesh and hot-pressing conditions of 160 °C, 4 MPa, 6 min, and 14% resin content, two-stage experiments were conducted within the 30%–50% WS addition range. The modulus of rupture (MOR), modulus of elasticity (MOE), internal bond strength (IB), and 2 h thickness swelling (2hTS) were evaluated. Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR) were used to analyze interfacial morphology and structural characteristics. In the first-stage experiment, MOR and MOE generally decreased with increasing WS content, while the 30% group showed better overall mechanical performance and stability. Although the 42% group met the requirements for P2-type particleboard, the MOE values of the 46% and 50% groups were below the standard requirement. In the second-stage experiment, the 42%–50% range showed significant fluctuations in MOE, IB, and 2hTS, and all 2hTS values exceeded 8.0%. Overall, 30% WS addition is recommended as a stable addition ratio under the present processing conditions, whereas 42%–50% represents a critical fluctuation zone for high-ratio WS utilization.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察核桃壳作为木质刨花板部分替代原料时的性能影响和稳定添加范围，实验采用20–35目核桃壳、160°C热压、4 MPa、6 min和14%树脂含量条件。30%–50%添加范围内的两阶段实验表明，随核桃壳含量增加，静曲强度和弹性模量总体下降，其中30%组综合力学性能和稳定性较好；42%组虽可满足P2型刨花板要求，但46%和50%组弹性模量低于标准。42%–50%高添加区间中弹性模量、内结合强度和2小时吸水厚度膨胀率波动明显，说明该范围接近或超过稳定添加临界区。

articles.title: Integrated Landsat-8 Remote Sensing and Aeromagnetic Data for Structural Lineament Characterization and Basement-Depth Estimation in a Precambrian Basement Complex Terrain, Southwestern Nigeria
articles.title_zh: 融合 Landsat-8 遥感与航磁数据的尼日利亚西南部前寒武纪基底杂岩区构造线性体表征与基底深度估算
articles.abstract: Structural discontinuities in Precambrian basement complex terrains — faults, joints and shear zones — exert a first-order control on weathering depth, fracture connectivity and, by extension, groundwater occurrence and engineering-site suitability, yet they are frequently concealed by thin regolith cover, dense vegetation and limited outcrop. This study integrates Landsat-8 Operational Land Imager/Thermal Infrared Sensor (OLI/TIRS) multispectral imagery with aeromagnetic total-field data to characterize near-surface and deep-seated structural lineaments across the Adekunle Ajasin University campus, Akungba-Akoko, southwestern Nigeria, an area underlain by migmatite-gneiss and biotite-granite basement lithologies and affected by a documented history of low-yield and failed boreholes. Field geological mapping identified two dominant lithological units and their contact relationships. Surface lineaments were extracted from false-colour composites (bands 7-5-2 and 7-6-4), Crosta-technique principal component analysis, band-ratio imagery (6/4, 7/5, 6/7) and a hill-shaded Shuttle Radar Topography Mission digital elevation model. Total magnetic intensity (TMI) data, ranging from − 63.0 to 20.9 nT, were reduced to the equator (24.9–73.6 nT), separated into regional and residual components (− 11.3 to 18.8 nT), and enhanced using total horizontal derivative, tilt-angle derivative and analytic-signal filters (0.02–0.19 nT gradient) to delineate magnetic contacts and fracture zones; depth to magnetic sources was estimated at 80–158 m using three-dimensional Euler deconvolution at a structural index of 0.5. Surface lineaments trend dominantly NW–SE and E–W, whereas sub-surface magnetic lineaments trend NE–SW, revealing a two-tier fracture architecture in which shallow, regolith-hosted discontinuities are not everywhere collinear with deeper basement fabric. Composite lineament-density mapping delineates a high-density corridor across the southeastern and eastern campus, interpreted as the most structurally favourable zone for fracture-hosted groundwater accumulation, flanked by lower-density, more structurally competent zones better suited to heavier civil-engineering loading. Benchmarked against recent basement-complex studies in Nigeria and emerging deep-learning-assisted lineament-extraction approaches, the results demonstrate that combining independently acquired, differently penetrating remote sensing and potential-field datasets can meaningfully de-risk both groundwater-siting decisions and future ground-truthing campaigns in data-scarce basement complex terrains, without recourse to invasive drilling.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向尼日利亚西南部 Akungba-Akoko 的前寒武纪基底杂岩区，结合 Landsat-8 OLI/TIRS 多光谱影像、SRTM 地形数据与航磁总场数据，识别近地表及深部断裂、节理和剪切带等构造线性体。研究通过假彩色合成、Crosta 主成分分析、波段比值和地形阴影提取地表线性体，并结合地质填图约束花岗质片麻岩、混合岩和黑云母花岗岩等岩性关系。其目标是厘清隐伏构造对风化深度、裂隙连通性、地下水赋存及工程场地适宜性的控制，并为低产或失效钻孔问题提供地质解释。

articles.title: S-Shaped Bifurcation Cascades and Loop Proliferation in an Active Magnetic Bearing Rotor with Cubic Shaft Stiffness and Nonlinear Aerodynamic Drag
articles.title_zh: 含三次轴刚度与非线性气动阻力的主动磁轴承转子中的 S 形分岔级联与回环增殖
articles.abstract: This paper investigates the nonlinear dynamic response of a flexible rotor supported by active magnetic bearings (AMBs), incorporating cubic shaft stiffness and nonlinear aerodynamic drag, using the Harmonic Quadrature Method (HQM) combined with pseudo-arc-length continuation and Floquet stability analysis. The governing equations, derived via Lagrange formalism and nondimensionalized, yield a coupled four-degree-of-freedom system in which disk and journal dynamics interact through nonlinear shaft forces and nonlinear electromagnetic forces governed by proportional-derivative (PD) feedback. Four key parameters are systematically investigated. Increasing the proportional gain P drives a progressive bifurcation cascade through four regimes, linear, 1S-, 2S-, and 3S-shaped, each transition accompanied by an increasing number of Floquet-verified saddle-node bifurcations and a widening multi-stable frequency band, with the primary resonance amplitude rising from 0.2328 to 0.3839 as P increases from 2 to 4. The derivative gain D produces an exact inverse cascade, destroying the S-shaped multi-stability and restoring quasi-linear behavior for D ≥ 1.23, revealing complementary and nearly symmetric roles between the two gains. Increasing the nonlinear stiffness coefficient ηNL at fixed P introduces a hardening mechanical nonlinearity that competes with the softening magnetic nonlinearity, generating a connected closed-loop branch with more than 36 saddle-node bifurcations spanning Ω ∈ [0.2466, 0.2922], confirmed by force comparison showing the cubic-to-magnetic force ratio rising from 0.002% to 8.6% at loop onset. Finally, an amplitude-dependent aerodynamic damping transition is identified, nonlinear turbulent damping governs the primary resonance while linear viscous damping controls superharmonic peaks. These findings characterize the nonlinear bifurcation topology of AMB-rotor systems under combined nonlinearities, with direct implications for PD controller tuning and rotor dynamic prediction.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究柔性转子—主动磁轴承系统在三次轴刚度、非线性气动阻力和 PD 电磁控制共同作用下的非线性动力学响应，采用谐波求积法、伪弧长延拓和 Floquet 稳定性分析。结果表明，比例增益 P 增大可诱导由线性到 1S、2S、3S 形响应的分岔级联，并伴随鞍结分岔数增加、多稳态频带加宽和主共振幅值升高。微分增益 D 则产生相反作用，可破坏 S 形多稳态并在较高 D 下恢复近线性行为，显示两类控制增益对转子稳定性具有互补调控作用。

articles.title: Self-Evolving Digital Twin for Zero-Defect Manufacturing Using Physics-Informed Reinforcement Learning and Multi-Agent Artificial Intelligence: A Case Study on Five-Axis Milling of Ti-6Al-4V.
articles.title_zh: 面向零缺陷制造的自演化数字孪生：基于物理信息强化学习与多智能体人工智能的 Ti-6Al-4V 五轴铣削案例
articles.abstract: Achieving zero-defect production in five-axis machining of aerospace titanium alloys remains difficult because process dynamics change continuously as tools wear, thermal fields evolve, and vibration modes shift with tool orientation. Conventional digital twins, built once from calibrated physics models or offline-trained data models, degrade in fidelity as these conditions drift away from the calibration point, and by the time a defect appears in the finished part it is too late to intervene. This paper proposes a self-evolving digital twin architecture that unifies physics-informed machine learning, deep reinforcement learning, and multi-agent coordination into a single closed-loop system capable of predicting defects before they occur and adjusting machining parameters in real time. The digital twin embeds governing equations of cutting mechanics, heat conduction, and tool wear directly into the loss function of a graph-structured neural network, so that the surrogate model remains physically consistent even when sensor coverage is sparse. A Bayesian model-updating layer continuously re-estimates uncertain physical parameters (friction coefficient, thermal softening exponent, wear rate constant) from streaming force, vibration, acoustic emission, and temperature signals, allowing the twin to evolve its internal representation without full retraining. On top of this twin, a soft actor-critic reinforcement learning agent, constrained by physics-derived safety filters, searches the feasible space of feed rate, spindle speed, depth of cut, and tool axis inclination to jointly minimize surface roughness deviation, tool wear rate, specific cutting energy, and cycle time. A three-agent coordination layer (quality agent, energy agent, and productivity agent) negotiates a Pareto-consistent operating point at each control interval using a weighted Nash bargaining rule, resolving conflicts that a single scalarized objective cannot represent. The framework is evaluated on a numerical case study of five-axis ball-end milling of Ti-6Al-4V, calibrated against published cutting-force, temperature, and tool-wear data for this alloy. Compared against five baseline strategies (fixed Taguchi-optimized parameters, classical model predictive control, a pure data-driven LSTM predictor, single-agent deep Q-network control, and a physics-only finite element digital twin without learning), the proposed framework reduces surface roughness variance by 41.3%, cuts tool wear rate by 27.8%, lowers specific cutting energy by 19.6%, and reduces defect escape rate from 6.4% to 0.7% over a simulated 500-part production campaign, with all improvements significant at the 0.01 level under paired t-tests and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests. The paper details the mathematical formulation, algorithmic implementation, simulation protocol across ANSYS, MATLAB, Python, and Siemens NX, and discusses industrial deployment implications, limitations, and directions for experimental validation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种用于航空钛合金五轴加工的自演化数字孪生框架，以应对刀具磨损、热场演化和姿态相关振动导致的过程漂移。方法将切削力学、热传导和刀具磨损方程嵌入图神经网络损失函数，并通过贝叶斯更新持续校正摩擦系数、热软化指数等不确定物理参数。结合深度强化学习和多智能体协调，该系统旨在缺陷形成前进行预测，并实时调整加工参数，实现闭环零缺陷制造。

articles.title: Confinement of Pd⁰ in Fluorinated UiO-66 for Hydrogen-Activated Sludge-Minimized Fenton Oxidation
articles.title_zh: 氟化 UiO-66 中 Pd⁰ 限域用于氢活化、低污泥芬顿氧化
articles.abstract: A [H]-acceleration catalytic Fenton system based on the catalyst Pd@UiO-66(Zr)-F4 was constructed under normal temperature and pressure. The FeII could be regenerated. As the carrier of electron, the evolution of the two reactive species could also be promoted by the [H]. Using trace levels of total Fe, both of the •OH and 1O2 could be continuous produced to be used to rapidly degrade 84% of the target pollutant carbamazepine which initial concentration of 20 mg·L− 1 in the initial condition of 25 µM of ferrous, 0.2 g·L− 1 (Pd content 0.52% (WPd:WPd@UiO−66(Zr)−F4)) of Pd@UiO-66(Zr)-F4, 60 mL·min− 1 of H2 (precursor of [H]), 20 mM of H2O2 and pH 3. The activity of the Pd@UiO-66(Zr)-F4 gradually decreased from 84% to about 59% after 6 reaction cycles. It could be attributed to the structural damage and the surface area reduction of this catalyst caused by the hydrogen spillover effect.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究构建了以 Pd@UiO-66(Zr)-F4 为催化剂的常温常压氢加速芬顿体系，利用氢产生的活性氢促进 FeII 再生及羟基自由基和单线态氧等活性物种的持续生成。在低铁投加条件下，该体系可快速降解初始浓度 20 mg·L−1 的卡马西平，报道初始条件下去除率约为 84%。循环实验显示催化活性逐步下降至约 59%，主要归因于氢溢流导致的结构破坏和比表面积降低。

articles.title: Interactions between single cellulose chain and water molecules and their temperature dependences: I. Pristine cellulose chain
articles.title_zh: 单根纤维素链与水分子的相互作用及其温度依赖性 I：本征纤维素链
articles.abstract: Cellulose nano fibril(CNF), isolated from plant cell walls, contains much water molecules by nature, and because of its high surface area, effects of water molecules on CNF are larger those on cellulose fibers. Therefore, applications based on CNF and their performance must be designed with water molecules as an intrinsic component. In the present paper, taking a single cellulose chain as a model of a surface of CNF, interactions between the single cellulose chain and water molecules are investigated by using first principles calculations. First, we make a map of adsorbed water molecules, that is, we show the binding energies and the optimized configurations of a water molecule on almost all available adsorbed or bound sites of the single cellulose chain (32 sites in total). The binding energy clearly classifies the O/H sites on the cellulose chain into three categories, the OH groups (-0.3((sim))-0.5 eV), O atoms on/between the glucose rings (-0.2((sim))-0.3 eV), and CH groups (-0.1((sim))-0.2 eV). Second,we show the potential surfaces of the water molecules along the cellulose chain. Third, we demonstrate behaviors of the water molecules by using molecular dynamics simulations at the temperature (200, 300, 400K). The potential surfaces and the dynamics of water molecules indicate that the water molecules with weak binding energies (((>))-0.2 eV) easily leave their bound positions and move to more stable sites even at room temperature. Finally, we compare the electronic states of the cellulose chain binding six water molecules occupying all the hydrophilic OH sites with those of the bare chain and show that the electronic states of O atom between the glucose rings (C1-O-C4) appear at the top of the valence levels and may become more reactive after the six water molecules are adsorbed while those of the hydrophilic OH sites are stabilized by the water molecules.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文以单根纤维素链作为纤维素纳米纤维表面的模型，采用第一性原理计算系统考察水分子在不同吸附位点上的构型与结合能。研究绘制了 32 个可用吸附/结合位点的水吸附图谱，发现纤维素链上的羟基、环上或环间氧原子以及 C–H 基团对应不同强度的结合能区间。进一步通过沿链方向的势能面和分子动力学模拟分析水分子迁移与温度相关行为，为将水作为 CNF 固有组分来设计材料性能提供微观依据。

articles.title: Unlocking Ghana’s Kaolin Potential: Enhancing the Adsorption Capacity of Kaolin through Acid Activation for Environmentally Friendly Remediation of Used Automotive Oil
articles.title_zh: 释放加纳高岭土潜力：通过酸活化提升高岭土吸附能力以绿色修复废汽车油
articles.abstract: This study investigated the potential of acid-activated kaolin obtained from one of the commercial markets in Ghana as a low-cost adsorbent for the recycling of used automotive oil. The kaolin was chemically modified using sulphuric acid under varying conditions to enhance its adsorption properties. The effects of key operational parameters, including contact time, adsorbent dosage, and initial analyte concentration, were systematically evaluated to determine the optimum adsorption performance. The results showed that acid activation significantly improved the adsorption capacity of the raw kaolin, with optimum performance (approximately 80%) observed at a concentration of 3 M, indicating a balance between structural modification and the preservation of active sites. Adsorption efficiency was found to depend on both contact time and adsorbent dosage, whilst increasing initial analyte concentration generally resulted in reduced removal efficiency due to saturation of the available adsorption sites. Isotherm analysis revealed that the adsorption process followed the Langmuir model, suggesting monolayer adsorption. The enhanced performance of the activated kaolin is attributed to physicochemical changes induced by acid treatment, including the removal of metal ions and increased surface reactivity. From an economic perspective, the use of abundant locally available kaolin, combined with a relatively simple activation process, highlights the potential of the material as a cost-effective alternative to conventional adsorbents. Overall, this study provides new insights into the structure-performance relationship of acid-activated kaolin and supports its application as a sustainable adsorbent for environmental remediation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察加纳商业来源高岭土经硫酸酸活化后作为低成本吸附剂用于废汽车油再生/净化的可行性。实验系统评估接触时间、吸附剂用量和初始污染物浓度等参数，发现 3 M 酸活化条件下吸附性能较优，去除效率约为 80%。等温吸附分析表明过程符合 Langmuir 模型，说明以单层吸附为主；性能提升归因于酸处理引发的结构调控和有效吸附位点增加。

articles.title: Ab Initio Investigation of Structural, Elastic, and Optoelectronic Properties of Oxide Double Perovskites
articles.title_zh: 氧化物双钙钛矿结构、弹性与光电性质的从头算研究
articles.abstract: Background This thesis presents a comprehensive ab-initio investigation. Here I have explored the structural, elastic, electronic, and optoelectronic properties of the two antimony-based double perovskite oxides which are Sr2PrSbO6 and Sr2CeSbO6 via DFT study by using WIEN2K computational package through full-potential linearized augmented plane-wave (FP-LAPW).Methods The structural optimization has been performed using the Birch-Murnaghan equation of state, the Tran-Blaha modified Becke-Johnson (TB-mBJ) potential has been used for finding of band-gap, the elastic properties have been investigated by calculating the three independent elastic constants and the optical properties including the dielectric function, refractive index, extinction coefficient, absorption coefficient, optical conductivity, reflectivity, and electron energy loss function have been computed over the photon energy range of 0–14 eV.Results equilibrium lattice constants of 8.60 Å for Sr2PrSbO6 and 8.58 Å for Sr2CeSbO6 and both compounds crystallize in the monoclinic space group P21/n, consistent with experimental reports on the Sr2RESbO6 family and the Goldschmidt tolerance factor computed for Sr2PrSbO6 is 0.915 and for Sr2CeSbO6 is 0.941which confirm assures the structural stability range. And direct band gaps of approximately 3.49 eV for Sr2PrSbO6 and 3.52 eV for Sr2CeSbO6 at the Gamma point while the density of states analysis indicates dominant contributions from O 2p orbitals in the valence band and Sb 5d states in the conduction band, with Pr 4f and Ce 4f states. Both of the compounds demonstrate strong ultraviolet (UV) absorption, high refractive indices in the 5–8 eV range.Conclusions Several important directions for future research work emerge from this research work and the experimental synthesis and characterization of Sr2PrSbO6 and Sr2CeSbO6 thin-films would provide crucial validation of the predicted properties and enable assessment of practical device performance.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文采用 WIEN2K 中的全势线性缀加平面波方法，对锑基氧化物双钙钛矿 Sr2PrSbO6 和 Sr2CeSbO6 的结构、弹性、电子和光学性质进行密度泛函理论研究。结构优化基于 Birch–Murnaghan 状态方程，带隙采用 TB-mBJ 势处理，并计算介电函数、折射率、消光系数、吸收系数、光电导率、反射率和能量损失函数等光学量。结果显示两种化合物为 P21/n 单斜结构，平衡晶格常数约为 8.60 Å 和 8.58 Å，并通过弹性常数与容差因子等指标评估其稳定性和潜在光电应用价值。

articles.title: Chiral superconductivity mediated by quantized magnetic flux
articles.title_zh: 由量子化磁通介导的手性超导
articles.abstract: The emerging field of cavity quantum materials seeks to control electronic phases using the quantum fluctuations of confined electromagnetic fields. Most existing approaches rely on electric-dipole, density-like couplings, for which strong equilibrium effects in solids remain difficult to obtain. Here we propose a different route, in which the ground state of an electron system is controlled or modified via coupling to the vacuum fluctuations of the quantized magnetic flux of a superconducting LC circuit. The resulting long-range attractive interactions between electron angular momentum states induce unconventional chiral superconductivity in a broad class of materials, with critical temperatures of a few Kelvin or even higher, depending on the area covered by the field. The magnetic flux of an LC circuit remains in the ground state, and all of its parameters can be controlled to optimize a particular pairing regime. The results identify circuit quantum magnetostatics as a highly tunable platform for engineering electron interactions and creating new quantum phases of matter.

articles.title: Predictive Set Theory: A Generative Framework for Cognitive Architecture with Operationalized Core Mechanisms
articles.title_zh: 预测集合论：具有可操作化核心机制的认知架构生成框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02704v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predictive processing theories portray the brain as a hierarchical prediction engine that minimizes prediction error, yet they lack operational definitions for the structure of a "prediction," the standardized response to a prediction error, and the mechanism that maintains consistency across successive updates. Bayesian cognitive science attempts to subsume all uncertainty under probabilistic belief updating, but it presupposes a closed hypothesis space and provides no generative account of how the objects over which probabilities are distributed become discrete, identifiable referents in the first place. This paper introduces Predictive Set Theory (PST), a formal generative framework that reconstructs cognitive architecture from first principles. PST anchors cognition in a minimal set of operations---a sensor formalized as an identity function, set-theoretic state refresh, and three fundamental forms of reference chains (reference, counter-reference, and semi-reference)---and rigorously derives core cognitive functions including state sequences, demand, comparison, efficiency, and finite-horizon probabilistic planning. Rather than modeling neural mechanisms, PST constitutes a design specification for any system that must maintain internal consistency while acting under incomplete information and irreversible risk. The framework offers novel resolutions to classical problems such as Russell's paradox, the cognitive status of Gödelian incompleteness, the grounding of negative feedback, and the comprehension of film editing. The primary purpose of this paper is to establish, through the public academic record, the originality and completeness of the Predictive Set Theory framework.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出预测集合论 PST，试图从第一性原理重构认知架构，以弥补预测加工理论和贝叶斯认知科学在“预测”结构、预测误差响应及连续更新一致性机制上的操作化不足。PST 将认知锚定在最小操作集合上，包括形式化为恒等函数的传感器、集合论状态刷新，以及引用、反引用和半引用三类基本引用链。作者据此推导状态序列、需求、比较、效率和有限时域概率规划等核心认知功能，强调离散可识别对象本身的生成机制。

articles.title: DiffImaginE: Imagine to Verify Entity Types with Diffusio
articles.title_zh: DiffImaginE：用扩散想象验证实体类型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03025v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multimodal named entity recognition (MNER) determines whether each candidate span and entity-type hypothesis is supported by joint textual and visual evidence. Existing imagine-and-compare verifiers map each (span, type) pair to one predicted visual feature, compressing diverse visual realisations into a single prototype and providing a compatibility score without explicit probabilistic semantics. We introduce DiffImaginE, which formulates MNER type verification as conditional latent diffusion inference. Given span-localised visual evidence, a type-conditioned denoiser predicts noise injected into its standardised latent. The resulting denoising error provides an ELBO-consistent surrogate for type-conditional negative log-likelihood, allowing competing type hypotheses to be ranked by how well they explain the observation. DiffImaginE retains a standard multimodal encoder stack and replaces the deterministic verifier with a classifier-free-guided diffusion scorer trained using Min-SNR weighting.
