articles.title: A Geometry-Aware AI Emulator for the Coupled Whole Atmosphere from Earth Surface to the Ionosphere and Thermosphere
articles.title_zh: 面向地表至电离层—热层耦合全大气的几何感知 AI 仿真代理模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.19340v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Whole-atmosphere models such as WACCM-X resolve coupling from the Earth surface to the Mesosphere-Lower-Thermosphere (MLT), and Ionosphere-Thermosphere (IT) systems with expensive computational costs. Here we introduce CAM-NET, a geometry-aware Spherical Fourier Neural Operator (SFNO) surrogate for emulating WACCM-X variability from Earth surface to IT region. CAM-NET is trained on 3-hourly WACCM-X simulations and predicts neutral winds, temperature, pressure-coordinate vertical velocity, electron density, and zonal ion drift. The framework combines a Spherical Fourier Neural Operator (SFNO) backbone with a newly developed lightweight module that extends the frozen atmospheric representation to plasma variables. For the held-out simulation, CAM-NET preserves the dominant IT morphology and remains stable during multi-day autoregressive rollouts. Spherical-harmonic diagnostics show that the model retains low-degree variability while damping high-wavenumber mesospheric structures, especially near 90 km where gravity wave breaks. CAM-NET is intended as a computationally efficient emulator of WACCM-X, rather than an operational forecasting system. These results demonstrate its potential for rapid ensemble experiments, uncertainty quantification, and sensitivity studies of large-scale coupled whole atmospheric variability.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出 CAM-NET，一种基于球面傅里叶神经算子的几何感知代理模型，用于高效模拟 WACCM-X 从地表到中间层低热层及电离层—热层区域的变化。模型以 3 小时分辨率的 WACCM-X 模拟为训练数据，预测中性风、温度、气压坐标垂直速度、电子密度和纬向离子漂移等变量。留出实验显示，CAM-NET 能保持主要电离层—热层形态并在多日自回归积分中稳定，但会阻尼高波数中间层结构，尤其在约 90 km 重力波破碎区域。

articles.title: Tailoring reflectionless complex media for non-Abelian braiding of acoustic modes
articles.title_zh: 用于声学模态非阿贝尔编织的无反射复介质定制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.15366v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Multiple scattering of sound and light can be tailored for diverse applications. Despite the great progress enabled by technologies such as time-reversal propagation and wavefront shaping, the full control of the transmission matrix remains a significant challenge. In this work, we propose a multi-scattering-based approach to design reflectionless complex media with an arbitrary unitary transmission matrix. As such, the perfect transmission of waves through such a medium performs a unitary operation. Based on this principle, we experimentally demonstrated braiding of multiple waveguide modes in an acoustic waveguide via multiple scattering and showed non-Abelian characteristics arising from the concatenation of distinct complex media. Furthermore, we show that the principle can be extended for realizing arbitrary unitary operations beyond braiding. Our scheme uses generalized Wigner-Smith operators to design the optimal acoustic complex media with near-arbitrary targeted functionalities. The scheme is generally applicable beyond acoustics, with broad implications to other wave types. Our results demonstrate unprecedented control over multiple-scattering waves and establish complex media as a viable route to modal control and operations on compact platforms, providing a new design paradigm for multimode, reconfigurable wave-based devices with potential applications in multiplexed communication, imaging, and the manipulation of quantum waves.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种基于多重散射的设计方法，可构造具有任意酉透射矩阵且无反射的复杂介质，使波在完美透射过程中执行指定酉操作。作者在声波导中实验演示了多个波导模态的编织，并通过串联不同复杂介质展示其非阿贝尔特征。方法利用广义 Wigner-Smith 算符优化声学复杂介质，原则上可扩展到声学以外的其他波动体系及任意酉操作实现。

articles.title: PySiPMGUI: A Universal Python-Based Software for Photodetector I-V Quality Assurance: From Underground Dark Matter Searches to Astroparticle Cherenkov Cameras
articles.title_zh: PySiPMGUI：用于光电探测器 I-V 质量保证的通用 Python 软件——从地下暗物质搜索到天体粒子切伦科夫相机
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.24781v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Silicon photomultipliers (SiPMs) are currently the most prevalent photon detection technology in modern experiments in high-energy physics, astroparticle physics, neutrino physics, and dark matter searches. The high detection efficiency for photons, excellent timing resolution, small size, and magnetic field independence make them ideal for precision measurements in low-light conditions. However, key parameters like breakdown voltage, gain, and dark count rate show a strong dependence on the bias voltage and temperature, requiring a systematic characterization. In this work, we present an open-source graphical user interface (GUI) for automated SiPM characterization, leveraging standard laboratory instrument communication protocols (PyVISA). The tool provides a free, open, and platform-independent solution for detector R&D and large-scale SiPM characterization, and is available at this GitHuB repository [1]. The analysis procedure is validated against the manufacturer's datasheet for the SensL MicroFC-60035-SMT, yielding results in good agreement for both breakdown voltage and dark count rate.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作发布了一个开源、跨平台的 Python 图形界面工具 PySiPMGUI，用于自动化表征硅光电倍增管的 I-V 特性。软件基于 PyVISA 与常规实验仪器通信，可提取击穿电压、增益和暗计数率等依赖偏压与温度的关键参数，适用于探测器研发和大规模 SiPM 质检。作者用 SensL MicroFC-60035-SMT 器件对分析流程进行验证，得到的击穿电压和暗计数率与厂家数据表符合良好。
authors: Tanay Dey, Suraj Shaw, Ritabrata Banerjee, Pratik Majumdar, Satyaki Bhattacharya

articles.title: Estimating the disjoining pressure of liquid nanofilms from molecular dynamics simulations via implicit treatment of the bulk liquid phase
articles.title_zh: 通过隐式处理体相液体从分子动力学模拟估算液体纳米膜的分离压力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.16500v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The commonly adopted constant bulk liquid density approximation for estimating disjoining pressure in liquid nanofilms, although justified by the low compressibility of liquids, can introduce significant errors in its evaluation. We hypothesize that the bulk liquid density is a thermodynamic state variable that depends on film thickness and local pressure, and should therefore be determined self-consistently to accurately capture interfacial forces under confinement. A thermodynamically consistent molecular dynamics simulation framework is developed by coupling a surface-tension-based formulation with bulk equations of state obtained from independent simulations. An iterative algorithm is employed to simultaneously determine bulk liquid density, film thickness, and disjoining pressure. The method is applied to water and argon nanofilms, and results are benchmarked against conventional constant-density approaches and alternative computational routes based on chemical potential calculation. The proposed framework provides a computationally efficient and thermodynamically rigorous route for evaluating disjoining pressure without requiring explicit full coexisting system simulations. Incorporating density variations significantly improves the accuracy and consistency of predicted disjoining pressures. For water nanofilms, a 3.6% deviation in density can lead to up to 77% overestimation of disjoining pressure at a thickness of 12 Å, whereas the effect is weaker but still non-negligible for argon. The proposed framework restores the inverse-cubic scaling with film thickness predicted by Hamaker theory and reduces discrepancies between independent computational methods. Overall, the results demonstrate that self-consistent treatment of bulk thermodynamics is essential for quantitatively reliable evaluation of surface forces in confined fluid systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究指出，在液体纳米膜分离压力计算中常用的恒定体相液体密度近似虽基于液体低压缩性，但可能引入显著误差。作者将体相密度视为依赖膜厚和局部压力的热力学状态变量，并结合表面张力公式与独立模拟得到的体相状态方程，建立自洽分子动力学框架。该迭代方法同时求解体相密度、膜厚和分离压力，并在水和氩纳米膜上与恒密度方法及化学势路线进行比较，提供了更热力学一致且计算高效的评估途径。
authors: Jianzhou Wang, Zufeng Zuo, Denvid Lau, Yuzhu Wang, Pinqiang Mo, Yukun Ji, Liyuan Yu, Yafan Yang

articles.title: A Self-Supervised Framework for Space Object Behaviour Characterisation
articles.title_zh: 用于空间目标行为表征的自监督框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.06176v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Foundation Models, which leverage large neural networks pre-trained on unlabelled data before fine-tuning for specific tasks, are increasingly being applied to specialised domains. Recent examples include ClimaX for climate and Clay for satellite Earth observation, but a Foundation Model for Space Object Behavioural Analysis has not yet been developed. As orbital populations grow, automated methods for characterising space object behaviour are crucial for space safety. Here, we present a self-supervised framework for space object behavioural analysis, representing a first step towards a Foundation Model for SOBA. The backbone is a Perceiver-Variational Autoencoder (VAE) architecture, pre-trained with self-supervised reconstruction and masked reconstruction on ~227,000 light curves from the MMT-9 observatory. The VAE enables anomaly detection, motion prediction, and synthetic light curve generation. We fine-tuned the model using two independent light curve simulators (CASSANDRA and GRIAL), with CAD models of boxwing, Sentinel-3, SMOS, and Starlink platforms. Our pre-trained model achieved a reconstruction mean squared error of 0.0012, identifying potentially anomalous light curves through reconstruction difficulty. After fine-tuning, the model scored 85% and 82% accuracy, with 0.92 and 0.95 ROC AUC scores in anomaly detection and motion mode prediction (e.g., sun-pointing, spin, tumbling). Analysis of high-confidence predictions on real data revealed distinct patterns including characteristic object profiles and satellite glinting. Our work demonstrates how self-supervised learning can simultaneously enable anomaly detection, motion prediction, and synthetic data generation from rich pre-trained representations, supporting space safety and sustainability through automated monitoring and simulation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作面向空间目标行为分析提出自监督学习框架，旨在为空间目标行为基础模型奠定基础。模型采用 Perceiver-变分自编码器架构，在 MMT-9 天文台约 22.7 万条光变曲线上通过重建和掩码重建进行预训练，可用于异常检测、运动预测和合成光变曲线生成。作者还利用 CASSANDRA 和 GRIAL 两个光变曲线模拟器及多类航天器 CAD 模型进行微调，以评估模型在不同平台行为表征中的能力。
authors: Ian Groves, Andrew Campbell, James Fernandes, Diego Ramírez Rodríguez, Paul Murray, Massimiliano Vasile, Victoria Nockles

articles.title: Monitoring the upper atmospheric temperature and interplanetary magnetic field with the GRAPES-3 muon telescope
articles.title_zh: 利用 GRAPES-3 μ子望远镜监测高层大气温度与行星际磁场
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.11847v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study the influence of variations in the upper atmospheric temperature and interplanetary magnetic field on the cosmic ray induced atmospheric muon flux measured by the GRAPES-3 experiment over 22 years (2001--2022) of data; spanning three solar cycles: the declining phase of Solar Cycle 23, the full Cycle 24, and the rising and maximum phases of Cycle 25. Located in Ooty- India, the GRAPES-3 large area (560,m²⁾ muon telescope detects sim4 billion muons daily above 1,GeV, with an angular resolution of sim4ⁱ̧rc, enabling a statistical precision <0.01% on the hourly muon rate. After accounting for the effect of atmospheric pressure variations, we compare this data with the upper atmospheric temperature inferred from NASA's MERRA-2 dataset as well as magnetic field data from the ACE and WIND spacecraft at Lagrange point L1. A simultaneous iterative fitting method employing Fast Fourier Transforms and a narrow band-pass filter reveals the temperature and magnetic field coefficients to be α_T=-,0.2241,±,0.04, (stat.),±,0.0220, (syst.),%,K⁻¹ and γM=-,0.574,±,0.027, (stat.),±,0.011, (syst.),%,nT⁻¹, respectively, for an assumed hadronic attenuation length łambda=120 g cm⁻², underscoring the potential of the GRAPES-3 muon telescope to serve as a real time monitor of the upper atmospheric temperature or interplanetary magnetic field.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究基于 GRAPES-3 实验 2001—2022 年、跨越三个太阳活动周期的宇宙线诱发大气 μ子通量数据，分析高层大气温度和行星际磁场变化对 μ子率的影响。GRAPES-3 位于印度乌蒂，560 平方米 μ子望远镜每天探测约 40 亿个能量高于 1 GeV 的 μ子，小时计数率统计精度优于 0.01%。在校正气压效应后，作者结合 NASA MERRA-2 高层大气温度数据及 ACE/WIND 位于 L1 点的磁场数据，通过傅里叶变换和窄带滤波的同步迭代拟合，得到温度系数和磁场系数的定量估计。
authors: S. Paul, K. P. Arunbabu, M. Chakraborty, S. K. Gupta, B. Hariharan, Y. Hayashi, P. Jagadeesan, A. Jain, M. Karthik, H. Kojima, S. Kawakami, P. K. Mohanty, Y. Muraki, P. K. Nayak, T. Nonaka, A. Oshima, M. Rameez, K. Ramesh, S. Shibata, K. Tanaka

articles.title: Dual-domain fused LSTM modeling for efficient time-dependent reliability analysis
articles.title_zh: 用于高效时变可靠性分析的双域融合 LSTM 建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.18291v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Time-dependent reliability analysis is crucial for ensuring the long-term safety and performance of engineering systems under uncertainties. However, traditional surrogate model methods often struggle to incorporate time-independent random variables and capture their complex interactions with time-dependent stochastic processes. To overcome this limitation, this paper proposes a dual-domain fused long short-term memory (DDF-LSTM) model for efficient and accurate time-dependent reliability analysis. A novel network architecture is developed to jointly process information from both time-dependent and time-independent domains. Specifically, the time-independent variables are embedded into the initial hidden states, and a fully connected layer is introduced to map both LSTM outputs and time-independent variables into the final output space. Furthermore, an improved loss function is designed to emphasize the model's sensitivity to minimum responses, thereby improving the precision of failure probability estimation. The proposed method effectively captures the dependencies among random variables, stochastic processes, and the temporal behavior of limit state functions. Once trained, the DDF-LSTM model enables efficient Monte Carlo simulation to estimate time-dependent failure probabilities with minimal computational cost. Four case studies validate the proposed method's enhanced computational efficiency and predictive accuracy.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出双域融合长短期记忆网络 DDF-LSTM，用于在不确定性条件下高效、准确地进行工程系统时变可靠性分析。方法同时处理时间相关随机过程与时间无关随机变量：将后者嵌入 LSTM 初始隐状态，并通过全连接层融合 LSTM 输出与静态随机变量。作者还设计了强调最小响应的改进损失函数，以提高失效概率估计精度，从而更好捕捉随机变量、随机过程与时间行为之间的耦合依赖。
authors: Yixin Zhang, Mingyang Li, Zichao Jiang

articles.title: Uncertainty Quantification for AI-Driven Crash Simulation Surrogates: A Comparative Study of Monte Carlo Dropout and Deep Ensemble on Open-Source Bumper Beam Benchmark
articles.title_zh: AI 驱动碰撞仿真代理模型的不确定性量化：基于开源保险杠横梁基准的蒙特卡洛 Dropout 与深度集成比较
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.18294v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning surrogate models are increasingly being explored in engineering product development to augment simulation-driven design, offering near-instantaneous predictions that complement computationally expensive high-fidelity analyses. However, a critical gap limits their adoption in safety-critical workflows: a point prediction without an accompanying uncertainty estimate cannot tell an engineer when the model should not be trusted. This work presents a systematic, head-to-head comparison of two widely used uncertainty quantification approaches -- Monte Carlo Dropout and Deep Ensembles -- applied to an open-source surrogate pipeline built on NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo. A key contribution is the use of concrete dropout, a built-in PhysicsNeMo capability that eliminates the dropout rate as a manual hyperparameter by learning it end-to-end during training, directly addressing the most common criticism of Monte Carlo Dropout-based uncertainty quantification. Automotive crash simulation is used as the application domain, with a steel bumper beam impact problem serving as the benchmark. Both methods are evaluated on identical held-out simulations and compared on point accuracy, uncertainty band calibration, and computational cost. The results reveal a fundamental trade-off between accuracy and calibration that challenges the common assumption that deep ensembles are the default gold standard for surrogate uncertainty quantification. The findings demonstrate that well-calibrated, hyperparameter-free uncertainty estimates are achievable within a fully open-source engineering workflow at a fraction of the computational cost of ensemble approaches.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究比较了蒙特卡洛 Dropout 与深度集成两类常用不确定性量化方法在工程碰撞仿真代理模型中的表现，聚焦安全关键场景中“何时不应信任模型”的问题。工作基于 NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo 的开源代理建模流程，以钢制汽车保险杠横梁冲击问题为基准。一个关键贡献是采用 concrete dropout，使 dropout 率在训练中端到端学习，减少蒙特卡洛 Dropout 对人工超参数设定的依赖，并在相同留出仿真数据上与深度集成进行对比评估。

articles.title: Interactive Training 2: Auditable Control Plane for Live Model Training
articles.title_zh: Interactive Training 2：用于实时模型训练的可审计控制平面
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.18314v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Experiment trackers show how training is progressing, but changing a live run still usually requires trainer-specific code. We present Interactive Training 2, an open-source control plane for steering training through a shared protocol. Training applications declare which settings and actions they expose, humans and automated controllers submit requests through the same interface, and the training loop validates and applies them at safe control points. A customized Aim workspace combines live metrics and controls with a chronological record of requests and outcomes. We demonstrate the system across five NLP and reinforcement-learning workflows. The released code and traces provide a reusable foundation for auditable human- and agent-guided training.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出开源系统 Interactive Training 2，为正在运行的模型训练提供统一、可审计的控制平面。训练应用声明可暴露的设置与操作，人类用户和自动控制器通过同一协议提交请求，训练循环在安全控制点验证并执行这些请求。系统定制了 Aim 工作区，将实时指标、控制界面及请求—结果时间线结合起来，并在五个自然语言处理和强化学习流程中展示其通用性。
authors: Wentao Zhang, Xuanhe Pan, Han Zhou, Yang Lu, Yuntian Deng

articles.title: Dynamic Loss Balancing for Joint SOH and RUL Prediction of Lithium-Ion Batteries via a Rotary SOH-Injected Prior Battery Transformer
articles.title_zh: 通过旋转式 SOH 注入先验电池 Transformer 进行锂离子电池 SOH 与 RUL 联合预测的动态损失平衡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.18329v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The deployment of reliable lithium-ion battery management systems is crucial for accelerating electrification, yet the joint prognosis of State of Health (SOH) and Remaining Useful Life (RUL) remains severely hindered by task heteroscedasticity. Conventional multi-task learning frameworks fail to balance the bounded, low-variance noise of SOH estimation with the unbounded, nonlinearly expanding uncertainty of long-term RUL predictions. Here, we present the Rotary SOH-Injected Prior Battery Transformer (RoSIP-Batt), a unified co-estimation framework that resolves these optimization conflicts. By formulating joint prediction as a Bayesian multi-task objective, RoSIP-Batt introduces a homoscedastic uncertainty weighting mechanism to dynamically scale task-specific gradients based on learned residual noise levels. The architecture leverages decoupled dual classification tokens and a per-dimension gated fusion mechanism, secured by a gradient-detachment operator to prevent high-variance RUL updates from corrupting the stable SOH representation space. To capture electrochemical degradation patterns without relying on absolute cycle steps, Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) is incorporated into a shared Transformer backbone to model translation-invariant relative temporal profiles. Crucially, the intermediate SOH estimate is directly injected into the RUL regression head as a physical degradation prior. Evaluations across the NASA, MIT-Stanford, and HUST datasets show that RoSIP-Batt significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, reducing SOH estimation error to 1.994% MAE on NASA and restricting RUL prediction error to 62.85 cycles on Stanford. These findings establish RoSIP-Batt as a highly generalizable, computationally efficient solution suitable for real-time embedded BMS deployment.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出 RoSIP-Batt，一种用于锂离子电池健康状态 SOH 与剩余寿命 RUL 联合估计的 Transformer 框架，旨在缓解多任务学习中的任务异方差冲突。方法将联合预测表述为贝叶斯多任务目标，引入同方差不确定性加权，根据学习到的残差噪声动态缩放不同任务梯度。架构采用解耦双分类 token、逐维门控融合和梯度截断机制，以防止高方差 RUL 更新破坏较稳定的 SOH 表征空间，并试图在不依赖绝对循环步数的情况下捕捉电化学退化模式。
authors: Shuhao Chen, Tianyu Shi, Yiwen Huang, Chengyi Tu

articles.title: AMICA-Python: Adaptive Mixture Independent Component Analysis with Anderson Acceleration
articles.title_zh: AMICA-Python：带 Anderson 加速的自适应混合独立成分分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.18568v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Adaptive Mixture Independent Component Analysis (AMICA) is widely used in EEG research and has long been associated with strong empirical performance for blind source separation. Despite its impact, practical use has historically depended on a single Fortran implementation, accessed via the EEGLAB toolbox for MATLAB, limiting its accessibility for analytical pipelines not designed within the MATLAB ecosystem. Here we present AMICA-Python, a Python implementation of the AMICA algorithm, with a scikit-learn-conformant API designed for integration with existing scientific Python pipelines. The implementation follows the reference algorithm closely while adopting modern software engineering practices and an interface familiar to Python users. Additionally, we introduce an optional Anderson acceleration scheme that can dramatically reduce the time to convergence for this relatively slow algorithm. To evaluate numerical agreement and practical performance, we benchmarked AMICA-Python against the reference Fortran implementation on 14 open EEG recordings. After averaging 3 runs of each implementation on all 14 recordings, AMICA-Python closely matched the reference, with a median final normalized log-likelihoods of 11.572 for both the Fortran and Python implementations, and a negligible median relative absolute difference of only 1.07×10⁻⁸ when normalized by the absolute Fortran value. Runtime was also competitive. Relative to the reference implementation, AMICA-Python was 17.7% faster, while the Anderson-accelerated variant was 34.1% faster. AMICA-Python reproduces the reference implementation to high numerical precision with competitive runtime, while making AMICA available through a more accessible and extensible Python interface.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作发布 AMICA-Python，即自适应混合独立成分分析 AMICA 算法的 Python 实现，采用符合 scikit-learn 风格的 API，便于接入科学 Python 数据分析流程。AMICA 在 EEG 盲源分离中表现突出，但长期主要依赖 MATLAB/EEGLAB 调用的 Fortran 实现，限制了可用性。新实现尽量贴近参考算法，并提供可选 Anderson 加速以缩短收敛时间；作者在 14 组开放 EEG 数据上与 Fortran 版本比较了数值一致性和实际性能。

articles.title: A Self-Evolving Default Action for Cooperative Tasks with Continuous Action Space
articles.title_zh: 用于连续动作空间协作任务的自演化默认动作
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.18597v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Counterfactual credit assignment has proven effective in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) for discrete action spaces, yet its extension to continuous-action cooperative tasks remains challenging. Existing methods that approximate the counterfactual baseline via Monte Carlo sampling often introduce bias into policy gradients and fail to guarantee convergence to local optima, as the sampled actions may not have been sufficiently trained. To address these limitations, we propose SAFE, a novel MARL framework that employs a counterfactual baseline conditioned on a self-evolving default action sampled from each agent's experience buffer. This design naturally extends to continuous action spaces without relying on additional simulations, reward models, or environment-specific prior knowledge. The baseline accurately quantifies each agent's contribution, and introduces no bias into the deterministic policy gradient, ensuring convergence to local optima. Extensive experiments on cooperative vehicular tasks demonstrate that SAFE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art models.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对连续动作多智能体强化学习中反事实信用分配难以无偏扩展的问题，提出 SAFE 框架。其反事实基线以从各智能体经验缓冲区采样的自演化默认动作为条件，不依赖额外仿真、奖励模型或领域先验。作者声称该基线可准确量化个体贡献且不向确定性策略梯度引入偏差，从而保证收敛到局部最优；协作车辆任务实验显示其优于现有方法。

articles.title: Formulation-Level Auto-Tuning for QUBO-Based Machine Learning: A Case Study Across Multiple Quantum-Inspired Annealers
articles.title_zh: 面向基于 QUBO 的机器学习的公式级自动调参：跨多种量子启发退火器的案例研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.18774v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper presents an Optuna-based formulation-level auto-tuning framework for support vector machines (SVMs) implemented on multiple quantum-inspired annealers. In an annealing-based SVM, continuous dual variables are discretized and converted into a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) model. This transformation introduces three coupled classes of parameters: representation parameters-the encoding base B and bit depth K-which determine numerical range, resolution, and QUBO size; the RBF kernel parameter γ, which determines classifier geometry; and the equality-constraint penalty ξ, which controls feasibility and coefficient balance. We formulate their joint selection as a mixed discrete-continuous black-box optimization problem. The framework has two optimization levels: an inner annealer minimizes the generated QUBO, while an outer Optuna loop reconstructs the formulation in every trial and maximizes validation accuracy. The same solver-agnostic procedure is applied to Fixstars Amplify Annealing Engine, Toshiba SQBM+, and Fujitsu Digital Annealer using TPE and Gaussian-process samplers and is compared with conventional grid search. Experiments on linear and nonlinear classification tasks with 0-20% label noise show mean gains over grid search of approximately 0.8 and 2.1 percentage points, respectively. The results demonstrate that formulation quality and backend capability must be evaluated jointly and that task-level feedback can compensate for discretization, penalty imbalance, and backend-dependent approximate optimization.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一个基于 Optuna 的公式级自动调参框架，用于在多种量子启发退火器上实现支持向量机。退火式 SVM 需将连续对偶变量离散化并转化为 QUBO，涉及编码基数、位深、RBF 核参数和等式约束惩罚等耦合参数。作者将其联合选择表述为混合离散-连续黑盒优化：内层退火器求解 QUBO，外层 Optuna 在每次试验中重构公式并最大化验证精度。该流程被应用于 Fixstars Amplify Annealing Engine、Toshiba SQBM+ 和 Fujitsu Digital Annealer，并比较不同采样策略与常规设置。
authors: Naoya Mizuki, Takahiro Katagiri, Daichi Mukunoki, Tetsuya Hoshino

articles.title: Elicitation without Backpropagation: Steering Model Behavior by Optimizing the Latent Posterior
articles.title_zh: 无需反向传播的行为诱导：通过优化潜在后验来引导模型行为
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.18804v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In the emphlatent posterior model of transformer behavior, the next-token distribution arises from a posterior over latent predictive models conditioned on the context, mixed to generate continuations. We exploit this model in settings where it is exact, namely Bayes-filtered transformers (BFTs) meta-learned on sequences from a hierarchical prior, to introduce Posterior Prefix Tuning (PPT), a new method for empheliciting behavior from a transformer: given a utility function on continuations, find a prompt under which the transformer generates continuations of high expected utility. For a BFT, the elicitation objective factors through the latent posterior, and the gradient of this objective can be estimated from samples of the prior alone. PPT optimizes the parameters of a distribution over hard prompts: it draws prior samples once from the BFT via predictive Monte Carlo (PMC), then estimates the gradient by importance sampling against them. The optimization performs no transformer forward passes and no backpropagation through the transformer, and the prior samples are utility-independent, so a single set of samples drives elicitation against any number of utilities at negligible marginal cost. We validate PPT on Beta--Bernoulli and reinforced urn BFTs across three utility families (reverse cross-entropy, frequency matching, Dyck validity).
articles.abstract_zh: 该文基于 transformer 行为的潜在后验模型，研究在给定续写效用函数时如何寻找能诱导高期望效用输出的提示。作者在 Bayes-filtered transformers 这一模型精确成立的设定下提出 Posterior Prefix Tuning，将诱导目标分解到潜在后验上，并仅用先验样本估计梯度。该方法优化硬提示分布参数，通过 predictive Monte Carlo 一次性采样后进行重要性采样，不执行 transformer 前向传播，也不通过 transformer 反向传播。
authors: Garrett Baker, Vinayak Pathak, Daniel Murfet, Susan Wei

articles.title: Regime-Aware Physics-Guided Early Warning of Lithium-Ion Battery Thermal Runaway Using Thermo-Mechanical Signals
articles.title_zh: 利用热-机械信号进行锂离子电池热失控的工况感知物理引导早期预警
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.18860v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Thermal runaway in lithium-ion batteries poses a major safety risk to electric vehicles and energy storage systems. Current early-warning methods depend mainly on temperature and may therefore miss mechanical precursors that emerge before rapid heating. We introduce a regime-aware, physics-guided framework that integrates temperature, voltage, force, deformation, and state-of-charge measurements for early warning under controlled mechanical abuse. A lightweight convolutional classifier first infers safe, warning, or danger regimes from mechanical signals. These regime estimates then condition a causal temporal convolutional backbone through feature-wise linear modulation, physics-biased attention, and regime-dependent gating. Joint learning unifies regime identification, thermal-runaway detection, and time-to-disaster estimation. We evaluate the framework using leave-one-experiment-out cross-validation on 30 mechanical-abuse tests across state-of-charge levels of 10%, 50%, and 90% and two loading protocols. The method achieves an F1 score of 0.89, a high-temperature prediction root-mean-square error of 12.3 degC, a mean warning lead time of 15.6 s, a detection success rate of 0.92, and an experiment-level false alarm rate of 2.7%. Its lead time exceeds that of the strongest baseline by 69.6%. Removing force reduces the lead time by 60.3%, highlighting the value of mechanical precursors. These results support regime-aware thermo-mechanical fusion as a promising strategy for earlier and more reliable thermal-runaway warning under controlled abuse conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文面向锂离子电池热失控早期预警，提出融合温度、电压、力、形变和荷电状态的工况感知物理引导框架，特别强调快速升温前的机械先兆。方法先用轻量卷积分类器从机械信号识别安全、预警和危险工况，再以这些工况估计调制因果时序卷积骨干网络，并结合物理偏置注意力与工况相关门控。作者在 30 组机械滥用实验上采用留一实验交叉验证，报告 F1 为 0.89，高温预测均方根误差为 12.3°C，并实现提前预警。
authors: Syed Sajid Ullah, Muhammad Zunair Zamir, Salman Khan

articles.title: Physics-Informed Super-Resolution of Atmospheric Data
articles.title_zh: 大气数据的物理约束超分辨率重建
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.18877v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In the context of global warming, extreme events have become more frequent and intense, making their trustworthy detection and forecasting more important than ever. Yet, atmospheric observations lack sufficient spatial resolution, motivating atmospheric data downscaling as a way to reconstruct high-resolution data from coarse observations. This task is now being formulated as a super-resolution (SR) problem with machine learning methods featuring high efficiency. Nevertheless, it remains unclear whether the super-resolved atmospheric data still satisfies fundamental physics governing the Earth system, raising concerns about their trustworthiness in climate-related applications. In this work, we address this challenge by constraining SR models to respect hydrostatic primitive equations that represent multivariate atmospheric physics. First, we propose a Physics-Informed Super-Resolution (PISR) method involving multi-scale physics-informed objectives based on primitive equations. PISR favors the SR outputs to respect these equations and therefore naturally encodes inter-variable relationships. In addition, we propose a metric called Normalized Physical Consistency (NPC) derived from said primitive equations to measure the physical consistency of super-resolved data. Experiments on ERA5, CERRA, and COSMO demonstrate that PISR enhances the reconstruction fidelity by improving physical consistency, SR accuracy, and downstream detection of extreme events, as demonstrated by case studies in heatwaves and extreme winds.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文关注气候与极端事件应用中低分辨率大气观测的下尺度重建问题，指出机器学习超分辨率结果是否满足地球系统基本物理仍不明确。作者提出 Physics-Informed Super-Resolution 方法，将基于流体静力原始方程的多尺度物理约束引入超分辨率训练，以促进输出满足多变量大气物理关系。文中还提出用于评估物理一致性的指标；摘要后半部分被截断，具体实验结果需查阅原文。
authors: Chang Xu, Gencer Sumbul, Hugo Porta, Manon Béchaz, Sebastian Schemm, Devis Tuia

articles.title: Circuit Claims Depend on What Is Extracted and How It Is Compared
articles.title_zh: 电路结论依赖于提取对象及比较方式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.18921v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Circuit extraction identifies a small set of model components whose presence preserves a target behavior under ablation, and the resulting circuit is often read as the mechanism behind that behavior. We argue that this reading is under-determined: preserving behavior does not single out one circuit, because the claim it supports depends on which circuit is reported and how two circuits are compared. We make this concrete in a synthetic Lean tactic-prediction benchmark -- predicting the next step of a proof -- where fixed proof rules with randomized surface form let differences between extracted circuits be attributed to these choices rather than to the task. Across dense and weight-sparse checkpoints (most weights constrained to zero) of the same transformer, evaluated on atomic (single-rule) and compositional (multi-rule) proofs, we vary which extracted object is reported (a compact prediction-preserving circuit, a broader graph that also keeps surrounding read, write, and routing structure, or the smallest subgraph meeting a post-ablation loss threshold), and whether each attention head's query and key are represented jointly or separately. Exact component-to-component edge overlap is low and sensitive to these choices, at times dropping to a random baseline, while two coarser summaries stay stable: the set of selected attention heads, and the circuit-size ranking of conditions that differ in which supervised checkpoint initializes reinforcement learning (RL). The largest accuracy gains from RL on compositional proofs come with the most structure beyond the atomic circuits. A circuit-level claim is therefore well defined only once one states which circuit is reported, the pruning threshold used to extract it, and the level at which circuits are compared. We distill these requirements into a reporting practice for circuit-extraction studies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文讨论神经网络电路提取中的不适定性：在消融后保留目标行为并不能唯一确定“机制”，结论取决于报告哪类电路以及如何比较电路。作者在合成 Lean 证明策略预测基准上，通过固定证明规则但随机化表面形式，将不同电路差异归因于提取与表示选择。研究比较稠密与权重稀疏 transformer、原子与组合证明，并考察紧凑预测保持电路、更宽的读写路由图、满足损失阈值的最小子图，以及注意力头 query/key 的联合或分离表示；摘要末尾被截断，完整结论需查阅原文。

articles.title: Parallel Noising in Neural Markov Logic Networks
articles.title_zh: 神经马尔可夫逻辑网络中的并行加噪
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.19126v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural Markov Logic Networks (NMLNs) are a flexible neurosymbolic relational model. Previous work has shown that, although NMLNs achieve strong performance as generative models for small relational structures, they underperform diffusion-based generative graph models on larger structures. In this paper, we strengthen NMLNs along two main dimensions: (i) we increase the expressive capacity of their potential functions using graph neural networks, and (ii) we develop a new training and inference algorithm inspired by parallel-tempering Markov chain Monte Carlo methods, which we name parallel noising. Together, these enhancements enable NMLNs to attain strong performance in graph generation relative to general diffusion-based generative graph models. Furthermore, they allow NMLNs to match the performance of specialized text-based recurrent models when generating small molecular structures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文改进神经马尔可夫逻辑网络这一神经符号关系生成模型，以弥补其在较大关系结构生成上弱于扩散式图生成模型的问题。作者从两方面增强模型：用图神经网络提升势函数表达能力，并提出受并行回火 MCMC 启发的训练与推断算法“并行加噪”。这些改进使 NMLN 在图生成任务上相对通用扩散图模型取得较强性能，并在小分子结构生成中接近专用文本式循环模型。
authors: Peter Jung, Giuseppe Marra, Ondrej Kuzelka

articles.title: Attacking Graph Foundation Models Through Their Shared Representation
articles.title_zh: 通过共享表示攻击图基础模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.18567v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A graph foundation model generalizes across graph domains by mapping every input into one shared representation before any task reasoning. We call this map the alignment layer, the component that separates a graph foundation model from a graph neural network, and we show it is a distinct attack surface that prior work has not studied. We attack it at inference time, with no access to training, on six public models spanning spectral tokenizers, text embedding spaces, and a discrete codebook. A directed representation-space perturbation collapses every model, but at a budget comparable to the representation norm a plain graph network also needs, with one exception: OpenGraph, whose spectral tokenizer collapses at a fifth of that budget, an alignment-specific fragility a plain network does not share and which a same-representation control traces to the tokenizer rather than the decoder. A realizable input-space attack that edits edges, features, or text removes at least half the correct predictions on three of the six models at peak. How much of this fragility an input-access attacker realizes tracks how directly the decoder reads the representation, and not the clean accuracy a task leaves; we measure this carrier gain structurally from the decoder's local Lipschitz sensitivity, and report clean-accuracy headroom as a within-model ordering heuristic that does not survive on realizable attacks.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文指出图基础模型将不同图域输入映射到共享表示的对齐层构成了区别于普通图神经网络的新攻击面。作者在推理阶段、无需训练访问的条件下，攻击六个公开模型，覆盖谱 tokenizer、文本嵌入空间和离散码本等对齐机制。结果显示，表示空间定向扰动可使所有模型崩溃，其中 OpenGraph 的谱 tokenizer 在约五分之一预算下即失效，表现出普通图网络不共享的对齐层脆弱性；可实现的输入空间攻击也能在部分模型上删除至少一半正确预测。

articles.title: Boundary-Adapted PINNs for Elliptic Dirichlet Problems: H²⁽Ømega) A Priori Error Bounds with Application to Mean Escape Time Computation
articles.title_zh: 椭圆 Dirichlet 问题的边界适配 PINN：H²(Ω) 先验误差界及其在平均逃逸时间计算中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.19167v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Motivated by the numerical computation of the Mean Escape Time (MET) τ:Ømega→R of a stochastic process from a bounded domain ØmegasubseteqR^d, we study elliptic Dirichlet boundary value problems (BVPs) using boundary-enforced Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), in which the Dirichlet condition is imposed exactly by multiplying the network output with a predefined distance-to-boundary approximation h̊o. Combining approximation-theoretic and statistical-learning arguments for Rectified Quadratic Unit (ReQU) and hyperbolic tangent (tanh) networks, we derive a priori error bounds that make explicit the dependence on h̊o. In particular, we show that exact boundary enforcement alone is not enough for H²⁽Ømega) error bounds, and that a sufficient and essentially necessary condition is for h̊o to be a smooth distance approximation normalized to first order, of the kind constructed in arXiv:2104.08426 [math.NA]. We thereby identify this subclass of boundary-adapted PINNs as the appropriate neural network ansatz for solving Dirichlet BVPs. Numerical experiments support the theory, showing that appropriate choices of h̊o improve accuracy and convergence, while poorly chosen distance functions can substantially degrade the solution. Our proof also yields new VC-dimension bounds for hypothesis spaces of higher-order derivatives of ReQU and tanh networks, together with new approximation bounds for shallow ReQU networks in higher-order Sobolev norms, all of which are of important independent interest.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文受有界区域内随机过程平均逃逸时间数值计算启发，研究精确强制 Dirichlet 边界条件的物理信息神经网络求解椭圆边值问题。方法通过将网络输出乘以预定义的近边界距离函数来满足边界条件，并针对 ReQU 与 tanh 网络结合逼近论和统计学习论推导显含该函数影响的先验误差界。作者指出，仅精确满足边界条件不足以获得 H²(Ω) 误差界，近边界距离函数还需具备一阶归一化的光滑距离近似性质；数值实验支持该理论并显示合适选择可提升精度。
authors: Nathanael Tepakbong, Jun Fan, Xiang Zhou, Ding-Xuan Zhou

articles.title: ResearchArena: Evaluating Sabotage and Monitoring in Automated AI RD
articles.title_zh: ResearchArena：评估自动化 AI 研发中的破坏与监控
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.19321v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As AI agents begin to automate AI R&D, we need ways to assess whether their outputs are safe to deploy, even when the agents themselves may be untrusted. AI control offers one such approach: rather than trusting the agent, it treats it as a potential adversary and uses a monitor to detect covert sabotage before deployment. We evaluate AI control for automated AI R&D with ResearchArena, a framework spanning four long-horizon tasks: safety post-training, capabilities post-training, CUDA-kernel optimization, and inference-server optimization. Because the deliverable in AI R&D is an artifact that will be deployed and run, we pair each main task with two kinds of hidden side task: an embedded side task that sabotages the submitted model, adapter, kernel, or server itself, and an independent side task that takes a covert out-of-scope action in the sandbox while leaving the artifact honest. We evaluate frontier agents at both sabotage and monitoring, across four monitor types that vary along two axes: whether the monitor may execute and probe the produced artifact, and whether it sees the agent's chain-of-thought. We find that sabotage hidden in the training data is the hardest to catch, flagged fewer than half the time. Letting the monitor run experiments on the artifact, rather than only read the trajectory, helps, but it is not enough: monitors still miss embedded sabotage by inspecting only the surface, by noticing the anomaly but explaining it away, or by probing the artifact with the wrong test. We release ResearchArena as a modular framework for evaluating sabotage and control in automated AI R&D.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 ResearchArena，用于评估当 AI 智能体自动化 AI 研发且可能不可信时，如何通过 AI control 检测其隐蔽破坏。框架覆盖安全后训练、能力后训练、CUDA 核优化和推理服务器优化四类长程任务，并为每个主任务设置两类隐藏副任务：破坏提交工件本身，或在沙盒中执行越界隐蔽行为但保持工件表面诚实。作者评估前沿智能体的破坏与监控能力，并比较监控器是否可执行/探测工件、是否可见思维链等设置；摘要末尾被截断，具体发现需查阅原文。
authors: Lena Libon, Ben Rank, Jehyeok Yeon, David Schmotz, Jeremy Qin, Daniel Donnelly, Derck Prinzhorn, Maksym Andriushchenko

articles.title: Discrete Diffusion with Sample-Efficient Estimators for Conditionals
articles.title_zh: 用于条件概率样本高效估计的离散扩散模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.20293v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study a discrete denoising diffusion framework that integrates a sample-efficient estimator of single-site conditionals with round-robin noising and denoising dynamics for generative modeling over discrete state spaces. Rather than approximating a discrete analog of a score function, our formulation treats single-site conditional probabilities as the fundamental objects that parameterize the reverse diffusion process. We employ a sample-efficient method known as Neural Interaction Screening Estimator (NeurISE) to estimate these conditionals in the diffusion dynamics. Controlled experiments on synthetic Ising models, MNIST, and scientific data sets produced by a D-Wave quantum annealer, synthetic Potts model and one dimensional quantum systems demonstrate the proposed approach. On the binary data sets, these experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach outperforms popular existing methods including ratio-based approaches, achieving improved performance in total variation, cross-correlations, and kernel density estimation metrics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究离散去噪扩散生成框架，将单点条件概率的样本高效估计与轮转式加噪、去噪动力学结合起来。不同于近似离散 score，作者将单点条件概率作为参数化反向扩散过程的基本对象，并采用 Neural Interaction Screening Estimator 估计这些条件量。在合成 Ising 模型、MNIST、D-Wave 量子退火器生成的科学数据、合成 Potts 模型和一维量子系统上的实验表明，该方法在二值数据集上优于若干比值式方法，并改善总变差、互相关和核密度估计指标。
authors: Karthik Elamvazhuthi, Abhijith Jayakumar, Andrey Y. Lokhov

articles.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning to Master the Asymmetric Strategy of Baghchal
articles.title_zh: 用深度强化学习掌握 Baghchal 的非对称策略
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.18296v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Baghchal is a two-player asymmetric board game with Nepali origins where four tigers are to capture goats and twenty goats desire to keep tigers in immobility. Although Baghchal has a complex structure which is strategic, has perfect information structure, and has cultural meaning, it has not been adequately covered in deep reinforcement learning (RL) literature. This paper gives a systematic exploration of four deep RL solutions Deep Q-Network (DQN), REINFORCE, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) and MuZero that are trained on one side of the asymmetric gameplay of Baghchal and then evaluated on the other side. The algorithms are rated based on win rate, draw rate, average captures, training convergence and computational cost. It is experimentally found that MuZero generates the best performance in both tasks, achieving 86 percent win over these Tiger and 62 percent win over these Goat and the ability to do so is due to the model-based planning machine through the Monte Carlo Tree Search. PPO is the most realistic algorithm and is provided to be competitive over both asymmetric tasks with significantly reduced computational costs compared to MuZero. Emergent strategic behavior analysis shows that model-based strategies are optimal over long-horizon planning, whereas value-based counterparts like DQN are more biased up towards the Tiger role owing to the more substantial reward signal.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究尼泊尔非对称棋类游戏 Baghchal，其中四只虎试图捕获山羊，二十只山羊试图困住老虎；该游戏具有完全信息、强策略性和文化意义，但在深度强化学习文献中研究较少。作者系统比较 DQN、REINFORCE、PPO 和 MuZero 四种方法，在非对称双方任务上训练与评估，并以胜率、平局率、平均捕获数、收敛性和计算成本衡量表现。实验显示 MuZero 在虎方和羊方均表现最佳，分别达到约 86% 和 62% 胜率，优势来自基于蒙特卡洛树搜索的模型规划；PPO 则以较低计算成本取得有竞争力的结果。
authors: Ranjit Raut, Aarav Subedi, Sagun Rai, Aaryan Shakya, Manoj Shakya

articles.title: Fishing Out Free Riders: Shapley-Based Reward Attribution for Parallel Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
articles.title_zh: 揪出“搭便车”推理路径：基于 Shapley 值的并行推理强化学习奖励归因
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.18979v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at multi-step reasoning, yet current parallel reasoning approaches often fail to distinguish the contributions of individual reasoning paths. Many paths may be redundant, misleading, or even detrimental, but outcome-level rewards assign uniform reward, leading to ambiguous learning signals and unstable training. We propose Parallel Shapley, a reinforcement learning framework that attributes fine-grained, path-level contributions in multi-path reasoning. Treating each path as a player in a cooperative game, we leverage Shapley values to quantify marginal contributions, using a generative reward model to evaluate path utilities and Monte Carlo sampling for efficient approximation. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that Parallel Shapley outperforms existing baselines while providing more stable and interpretable training. Our framework effectively "fishes out the free riders," assigning reward proportionally and improving multi-path reasoning in LLMs.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作针对大语言模型多路径并行推理中不同推理路径贡献难以区分的问题，提出 Parallel Shapley 强化学习框架。方法将每条推理路径视为合作博弈中的参与者，用 Shapley 值估计其边际贡献，并结合生成式奖励模型和蒙特卡洛采样实现路径级奖励归因。数学推理基准实验显示，该方法优于现有基线，并提升训练稳定性和可解释性。
authors: Wentao Zhang, Haoyu Zhang, Xinke Jiang, Yuxuan Cheng, Yuhan Pan, Miao Li, Zhipeng Qiao, Tao Feng, Zhen Tao, Dengji Zhao

articles.title: Cu-Doped ZnSe Nanostructures Electrodeposited Thin Films with Adjustable ElectroOptical Properties for Sustainable Photovoltaics
articles.title_zh: 用于可持续光伏的 Cu 掺杂 ZnSe 电沉积薄膜及其可调电光性能
articles.abstract: On FTO substrates, Cu-doped ZnSe thin films were successfully electrodeposited. Cyclic voltammetry (CV) revealed deposition potentials of -1.30 V for undoped ZnSe and -1.38 V for ZnSe:Cu. Field emission scanning electron microscopy (FESEM) analysis showed that the grain size decreased significantly from 298 nm in the undoped film to 89-170 nm at 3% Cu doping, a range considered ideal for photovoltaic applications. Energy dispersive X-ray analysis (EDAX) confirmed the successful substitution of Zn by Cu. At 4% Cu doping, the formation of Cu-Se secondary phases was observed, while Zn depletion became prominent near 3% Cu. Optical studies demonstrated enhanced visible light absorbance due to a notable reduction in the optical band gap from 3.7 eV (undoped) to 2.2-2.7 eV with Cu incorporation. Hall effect measurements indicated high carrier mobility at 1% Cu doping; however, over doping at 3% Cu led to an increase in electrical resistance. These results suggest that an optimal Cu doping level effectively tunes the nanostructure and electro-optical properties, making Cu-doped ZnSe thin films promising for photovoltaic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究在 FTO 衬底上电沉积制备 Cu 掺杂 ZnSe 薄膜，并系统考察掺杂对形貌、组成、光学和电学性质的影响。Cu 掺杂使晶粒尺寸由未掺杂样品的约 298 nm 降至 3% 掺杂时的 89–170 nm，并将光学带隙由 3.7 eV 降至 2.2–2.7 eV，从而增强可见光吸收。1% Cu 掺杂表现出较高载流子迁移率，但过量掺杂会导致电阻增加并在 4% 时形成 Cu-Se 二次相，表明存在适用于光伏应用的最佳掺杂区间。

articles.title: Phase Engineering and Interfacial Polarization Synergistic Modulation: High-Efficiency Electromagnetic Wave Absorption Performance of Ti₃C₂Tₓ-based Dielectric Composites
articles.title_zh: 相工程与界面极化协同调控：Ti₃C₂Tₓ 基介电复合材料的高效电磁波吸收性能
articles.abstract: Driven by the rapid deployment of 5G/6G infrastructures and next-generation radar technologies, there is an escalating requirement for ultra-thin, lightweight electromagnetic wave absorbers capable of delivering robust attenuation across high-frequency regimes (12–18 GHz). Ti₃C₂Tₓ MXene emerges as a promising candidate but is plagued by significant impedance discrepancies arising from its extraordinarily large permittivity. Herein, a dual-regulation strategy integrating crystal phase engineering and heterointerface design is proposed. Systematic investigations on Ti₃C₂Tₓ-MXene and derived ZnO/TiO₂ ternary composites reveal that 20 wt% filler loading yields optimal impedance matching, achieving a minimum reflection loss (RLₘiₙ) of − 20.72 dB at 8.32 GHz. To further enhance performance, a ternary system was constructed via gradient-temperature treatment (300–800°C), enabling controlled TiO₂ phase evolution. The ZTM-2 sample (700°C) exhibits exceptional performance at 1.4 mm thickness, with RLₘiₙ of − 47.54 dB and an effective bandwidth of 2.72 GHz. This is ascribed to the synergy of strong interfacial polarization, dipole relaxation from ZnO defects, and modulated dielectric properties. Rational regulation of filler concentration and microstructure effectively balances impedance matching and loss capability, offering new strategies for high-performance MXene-based absorbers.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向 5G/6G 和雷达高频电磁吸收需求，提出结合晶相调控与异质界面设计的 Ti₃C₂Tₓ MXene 基复合吸波材料策略。Ti₃C₂Tₓ-MXene/ZnO/TiO₂ 体系中，20 wt% 填料含量实现较优阻抗匹配，最低反射损耗为 −20.72 dB。经梯度温度处理调控 TiO₂ 相演化后，700°C 制备的 ZTM-2 在 1.4 mm 厚度下达到 −47.54 dB 最低反射损耗和 2.72 GHz 有效带宽，主要归因于界面极化、ZnO 缺陷偶极弛豫及介电性质调制的协同作用。

articles.title: Understanding of Deepwater Sedimentary Model based on Geophysical Data Interpretation to identify the possible scope of Hydrogen Exploration in the Northern Part of the Andaman area, India
articles.title_zh: 基于地球物理资料解释的深水沉积模式认识及印度安达曼北部天然氢勘探潜力识别
articles.abstract: The study has been conducted in the Andaman basin to explore hydrogen or white hydrogen as a part of key energy transition process for current days energy scenarios. The primary focus of the current study is to identify the feasible sweet spot where geologic hydrogen has been accumulated with sustainable support of the carbon-neutral energy resources. The main challenge of this study is to develop the deepwater sedimentary model to capture the occurrence and accumulation process of the geologic hydrogen based on the limited available geoscientific data, which was not established earlier. The study evaluates the Andaman basin, located along the active Sunda subduction zone, a tectonically active seafloor spreading centre, as a potential frontier for exploration of white hydrogen. Subsurface geological architecture and environment provide feasible support for fluid generation and migration of the hydrogen. A couple of sparse 2D seismic data post-stack seismic data were utilised in this study. The whole study towards the development of a sedimentary model was based on suitably incorporated attribute-driven interpretation, analysis of seismic sequence stratigraphy connected with chronostratigraphy, and analog well-constrained lithologic modelling. A few key seismic attribute analyses delineates mass transport complexes, basement-rooted faults, channel levee systems, and lobe deposits, which represents the feasible support for identifying the potential pathways for hydrogen migration and structural stratigraphic trap mechanisms. It has also been identified that the environment of the Andaman subduction complex and the adjacent deepwater area is conducive to the natural generation and accumulation of hydrogen through the serpentinization process.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究以印度安达曼盆地为对象，探索其作为白氢/地质氢勘探新区的潜力，并尝试在资料有限条件下建立深水沉积模式。作者利用少量二维叠后地震资料，结合属性解释、地震层序地层分析和年代地层约束，识别可能有利于氢生成、运移与聚集的构造—沉积环境。研究强调安达曼盆地位于活跃的巽他俯冲带及海底扩张背景下，具备开展低碳能源资源评价的地质意义。

articles.title: Multiscale Phenomics Reveals a Varietal Signature of Grapevine Response to Heatwaves
articles.title_zh: 多尺度表型组学揭示葡萄对热浪响应的品种特异性特征
articles.abstract: Background. Climate change increasingly threatens viticulture, with Mediterranean wine regions expected to face more frequent and intense heatwaves. Identifying grapevine varieties with superior heat resilience is therefore critical for sustainable production in arid and semi-arid environments. Methods. We applied an integrative phenotyping framework combining leaf physiology, metabolomics, targeted gene expression profiling, and UAV-based thermal imaging to characterize heatwave responses in six Vitis vinifera varieties over three growing seasons (2022–2024). Results. Marked varietal differences were observed across physiological, thermal, and molecular levels. Syrah maintained higher stomatal conductance (0.6 mol m⁻² s⁻¹) and net CO₂ assimilation rates (27 μmol m⁻² s⁻¹) under heat stress, compared to more sensitive varieties such as Tempranillo. This was accompanied by cooler canopy temperatures captured by UAV thermal imaging, validating its utility for rapid field-scale phenotyping. While interannual variations reflected local climatic fluctuations during each heatwave event, tolerant varieties consistently maintained higher quantum yields and electron transport capacities across all years. Metabolite profiling revealed that amino acids, sugars, and polyols served as major components of heat adaptation, with distinct metabolic shifts discriminating between temporal stress responses. Targeted gene-expression profiling identified variety-specific regulation of heat-shock protein and sugar transport pathways, highlighting HT4 as a potential regulator of thermotolerance. Furthermore, correlation-network analysis revealed that resilient varieties exhibited tighter coordination between molecular and physiological responses. Conclusion. Together, these findings reveal substantial varietal diversity in grapevine heat-response strategies. Integrating UAV-based phenotyping with broad molecular profiling can provide a scalable framework for screening climate-resilient cultivars and guiding adaptation strategies in future viticulture.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过叶片生理、代谢组、靶向基因表达和无人机热成像等多尺度表型手段，连续三个生长季评估六个欧亚葡萄品种对热浪的响应。结果显示品种间在生理、冠层温度和分子层面存在显著差异，其中 Syrah 在热胁迫下保持较高气孔导度和净 CO₂ 同化速率，并表现出较低冠层温度。尽管不同年份热浪条件存在波动，耐热品种仍较稳定地维持较高量子产额和电子传递能力，说明多尺度表型组学可用于田间快速筛选耐热葡萄品种。

articles.title: Bridging Element and System Scales: A Scale-Based Critical Review of Numerical Modelling for Dynamic Ground Support in Deep Hard-Rock Mines
articles.title_zh: 连接构件尺度与系统尺度：深部硬岩矿山动态支护数值模拟的尺度化批判综述
articles.abstract: As underground hard-rock mines extend to greater depths, elevated in-situ stresses and mining-induced seismicity increasingly subject ground support systems to dynamic, rockburst-type loading for which conventional static design approaches are inadequate. This paper presents a critical review of numerical modelling studies on dynamic ground support in deep hard-rock environments. A corpus of 92 studies, identified through citation-network exploration and cross-validated against Scopus and Web of Science, was synthesized according to physical scale rather than topic: rock-mass-scale dynamic demand (22 studies), element-scale support capacity (37), system-scale phenomenological testing (18), and methodologically transferable research (15). Classification by support–rock interaction capability reveals a fundamental gap: although dynamic demand characterization, element-scale constitutive modelling, and large-scale field testing have each advanced considerably, no reviewed study models the rock mass and support system as a fully coupled, dynamically interacting system. The review argues that this limitation arises not from a lack of component-scale knowledge, but from the absence of an integrated modelling framework. A physics-informed, microseismic-calibrated conceptual framework is proposed to bridge rock-mass demand and support response, providing a roadmap for future mechanism-based, site-adapted design of ground support systems in deep, seismically active mines.
articles.abstract_zh: 该综述聚焦深部硬岩矿山中由高地应力和采矿诱发地震导致的岩爆型动态支护问题，系统评述了 92 篇相关数值模拟研究。作者按物理尺度而非主题将文献分为岩体尺度动态需求、构件尺度支护能力、系统尺度现象测试和可迁移方法研究四类。综述指出，尽管各子领域已有显著进展，目前尚无研究实现岩体与支护系统的完全耦合动态相互作用建模，关键瓶颈在于缺乏跨尺度系统化建模框架。

articles.title: Energy-Efficient Seawater Carbon Removal using Reversible Phenazine-Mediated pH Swings: Insights from Experiments, Modeling, and Machine Learning
articles.title_zh: 基于可逆吩嗪介导 pH 摆动的低能耗海水除碳：实验、建模与机器学习洞见
articles.abstract: Removing dissolved inorganic carbon (DIC) from seawater can draw down atmospheric CO₂, but electrochemical approaches have been constrained by high energy input, reliance on bipolar membranes or noble-metal catalysts, short demonstrations, and acidic effluents that re-release CO₂. Here we report an electrochemical ocean carbon removal process using a single redox-active phenazine–carbon nanotube electrode that drives pH swings using reversible proton-coupled electron-transfer (PCET). The electrode fully converts DIC to extractable CO₂ and restores seawater alkalinity within one cycle, and coupling it to automated batchwise delivery sustains >50h of operation while returning a benign alkaline effluent. We achieve 79–96% removal from synthetic and real seawater at 114.8 ± 5.8 and 136.6 ± 17.7 kJ mol⁻¹ CO₂ — to our knowledge the lowest energy and longest demonstrations yet reported. A reaction–transport model, a SHAP interpreted machine-learning surrogate, and techno-economic analysis show that kinetic and transport losses, not thermodynamics, set performance, and yield transferable, material-agnostic design rules for scalable, low-cost deployment.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种使用单一吩嗪–碳纳米管氧化还原电极的电化学海洋除碳方法，通过可逆质子耦合电子转移驱动 pH 摆动。该过程可在一个循环内将海水溶解无机碳转化为可提取 CO₂并恢复碱度，自动批处理运行超过 50 小时且排出温和碱性出水。实验在合成和真实海水中实现 79–96% 去除率，能耗分别约为 114.8 ± 5.8 和 136.6 ± 17.7 kJ mol⁻¹ CO₂；反应–传输模型、SHAP 解释机器学习代理模型和技术经济分析表明，性能主要受动力学与传输损失限制。

articles.title: Physiological and anatomical modifications of exotic weed (goat grass), wheat and Egyptian grassy weeds (wild oat and canary grass) under chemical weed control condition
articles.title_zh: 化学除草条件下外来杂草山羊草、小麦及埃及禾本科杂草野燕麦和虉草的生理与解剖变化
articles.abstract: Goat grass is a potential weed risk associated with the introduction of a new plant species into Egypt. Therefore, the aim of this study is to conduct a comparative evaluation of the Physiological and anatomical responses of goat grass as an exotic weeds and wild oat and canary grass as local weeds in Egypt, to the effects of ten treatments, namely: untreated check (T1); Axial 5% EC (T2); Broadway star 8.5% WG (T3); Traxos 5% EC (T4); Spin top 10% EC (T5); Santo 17.5% EC (T6); Fakto 36% EC (T7); Future 7.5% EW (T8); Hock 15% WP (T9); Atlantis 1.2% OD (T10), on pigment content in leaves and the cross-section of roots. Two field experiments were carried out at the wire house of the Weed Research Central Laboratory, Egypt, during the 2023/24 and 2024/25 winter seasons under artificial infestation by the weed species, cultivated with the wheat variety Beni Suef 5.The results showed that the anatomical modification of the root cross-section was greater in wild oat than in goat grass. Total chlorophyll content was significantly reduced in the local wild oat by most herbicides, while only a few herbicides significantly decreased it in goat grass. From these results, it is clear that wild oat, as a local weed, is most sensitive followed by canary grass, whereas goat grass showed less responsiveness to the applied herbicides. Notably, T4, T6, T8 and T10 significantly reduced total chlorophyll (a + b) and the cross section size of goat grass root and may be useful for controlling this weed.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究比较外来杂草山羊草与埃及本地杂草野燕麦、虉草在小麦田化学除草处理下的叶片色素含量和根横切面解剖响应。两季温室/网室田间试验采用 10 种处理，包括未处理对照和多种除草剂，并在人工杂草侵染条件下种植小麦品种 Beni Suef 5。结果表明，野燕麦根部解剖结构变化强于山羊草，多数除草剂显著降低野燕麦总叶绿素，而仅少数处理显著影响山羊草，提示外来山羊草对部分药剂可能表现出较低敏感性。

articles.title: SMS-Based Remote Monitoring and Alarm System for Flame and Gas Leak Detection: A Low-Cost Embedded Approach Using Arduino and GSM Technology
articles.title_zh: 基于短信的火焰与燃气泄漏远程监测报警系统：采用 Arduino 与 GSM 技术的低成本嵌入式方案
articles.abstract: Domestic and industrial accidents involving gas leaks and fires continue to be significant causes of fatalities worldwide, especially in low- and middle-income countries where affordable safety infrastructure is scarce. Existing commercial alarm systems either lack remote notification capability or rely on internet connectivity, rendering them unusable in areas without broadband access. This paper presents the design, implementation, and experimental evaluation of a low-cost SMS-based remote monitoring and control system for flame and gas leak detection. The system uses an Arduino ATmega328P microcontroller interfaced with a SIM800L GSM/GPRS module and digital flame and gas sensors. A bidirectional SMS communication protocol enables real-time alerts for hazardous events and remote actuation of up to seven relay-controlled output devices. Experimental results demonstrate an average SMS delivery latency of 4.2 s (SD = 1.8 s), 100% alert reliability over 200 test cycles, and a command execution success rate of 98.5% across 300 attempts. Additionally, the system is compared with WiFi-based solutions, demonstrating superiority in scenarios where internet infrastructure is absent or unstable, owing to its use of the 3G/GSM cellular network. The total system cost is approximately R 180.00 (USD  35), making it an accessible solution for residential and small-scale industrial applications in developing regions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文设计并实验评估了一种低成本火焰和燃气泄漏远程监测控制系统，面向缺乏宽带网络基础设施地区的家庭与工业安全需求。系统由 Arduino ATmega328P、SIM800L GSM/GPRS 模块及数字火焰和气体传感器构成，可通过双向短信实现危险事件报警，并远程控制最多七个继电器输出设备。实验显示，短信平均传输延迟为 4.2 s，200 次测试中报警可靠性为 100%，300 次命令尝试中执行成功率为 98.5%，在无互联网场景下优于依赖 WiFi 的方案。

articles.title: A physics-guided graph neural network for interpretable multiscale modelling of concrete properties
articles.title_zh: 用于混凝土性质可解释多尺度建模的物理引导图神经网络
articles.abstract: Hierarchical materials derive macroscopic performance from interactions among phases and interfaces, yet most machine-learning models represent concrete as a flat mixture vector. Here we develop HiCon-GNN, a physics-guided graph neural network that mirrors the paste–mortar–interfacial transition zone (ITZ)–concrete hierarchy using coupled mortar- and concrete-scale proxy graphs. Mask-aware encoders retain incomplete literature records, while soft priors impose binder composition, weak-interface and cross-property consistency. Trained on 13,170 records, HiCon-GNN jointly predicts compressive, tensile and flexural strength with held-out R2 values of 0.953, 0.887 and 0.926 and RMSEs of 10.69, 2.00 and 3.20 MPa, respectively. It reduces RMSE relative to a matched tabular neural network by 19%, 5% and 16%, while remaining close to the best target-specific ensemble models and stable across repeated random partitions. The learned latent states recover the expected paste–mortar–concrete strength hierarchy, matrix densification and porous, weak-ITZ behaviour. Capacity decomposition identifies mortar strength as the dominant reference scale and separates interface-controlled reduction from mesoscale matrix and topology effects. The latent quantities are physically regularised hypotheses, while they expose testable multiscale pathways unavailable to structure-blind models. HiCon-GNN therefore combines competitive multi-property prediction with a physically inspectable representation for data-driven concrete design.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出 HiCon-GNN，一种物理引导图神经网络，用耦合的砂浆尺度和混凝土尺度代理图表示浆体–砂浆–界面过渡区–混凝土层级结构。模型通过掩码感知编码处理不完整文献数据，并引入胶凝材料组成、弱界面和跨性能一致性等软先验。基于 13,170 条记录训练后，模型对抗压、抗拉和抗弯强度的测试集 R² 分别达到 0.953、0.887 和 0.926，且相较匹配的表格神经网络降低 RMSE；其潜变量还恢复了预期的多尺度强度层级和弱 ITZ 行为，增强了可解释性。

articles.title: Smaller, closer, and fully negative: optical torque engineering in dielectric-metal heterodimers
articles.title_zh: 更小、更近且完全负向：介电–金属异质二聚体中的光力矩工程
articles.abstract: Optical torque exerted on an optically bound cluster typically decays with oscillation around zero as the interparticle distance increases. Besides, a homodimer of gold spheres (radius 150 nm) with electric dipole and quadrupole responses, separated by one wavelength, represents the smallest cluster known to achieve stable negative optical torque. Here, we present analytical expressions of optical torque and binding force in a dielectric–metal heterodimer, bound by a circularly polarized plane light, with both electric and magnetic dipolar responses. Our theoretical results show counterintuitively that beyond the Rayleigh limit, the torque increases almost linearly with interparticle distance, a behavior governed by dipolar coupling within the dielectric particle. Meanwhile, small torque fluctuations arise from dipolar hybridization between the two particles. Furthermore, the smallest cluster unit capable of sustaining stable negative torque is reduced to a silicon–silver heterodimer with constituent particle radii below 70 nm. Especially, the minimum and most stable interparticle distance is reduced to 0.4 wavelengths, controlled by a combination of near-field and second-order far-field scattering interactions. Unexpectedly, completely negative torque is achieved across a broad continuous range of interparticle distances, irrespective of the optically bound stability. These findings offer deeper insights into optical torque and light–matter interaction.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究解析讨论圆偏振平面光束束缚下介电–金属异质二聚体的光力矩和束缚力，考虑两颗粒的电、磁偶极响应。理论结果表明，在超出瑞利极限后，光力矩可随粒子间距近似线性增加，该反常行为主要由介电颗粒中的偶极耦合控制，同时两颗粒间偶极杂化引入小幅波动。作者进一步指出，硅–银异质二聚体可将稳定负光力矩所需颗粒半径降至 70 nm 以下，并将最小稳定间距缩短至约 0.4 个波长，受近场与二阶远场效应共同调控。

articles.title: Benchmarking a Tunable Quantum Neural Network on Trapped-Ion and Superconducting Hardware
articles.title_zh: 在离子阱与超导硬件上基准测试可调量子神经网络
articles.abstract: Author(s): Djamil Lakhdar-Hamina, Xingxin Liu, Richard Barney, Sarah H. Miller, Alaina M. Green, Norbert M. Linke, and Victor Galitski By implementing a quantum neural network using two quantum-computing platforms, researchers have taken steps toward determining whether such systems can reliably fulfill their theoretical promise. [Phys. Rev. Lett. 137, 040601] Published Wed Jul 22, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作在两类量子计算平台——离子阱和超导硬件——上实现并测试可调量子神经网络。研究旨在评估量子神经网络在真实硬件中的可运行性、稳定性和性能表现，从而检验其理论潜力能否转化为可靠实验能力。该论文发表于 Physical Review Letters。
authors: Djamil Lakhdar-Hamina, Xingxin Liu, Richard Barney, Sarah H. Miller, Alaina M. Green, Norbert M. Linke, and Victor Galitski

articles.title: Identifying the origin of out-of-plane spin polarization in the noncollinear antiferromagnet Mn₃Ge
articles.title_zh: 揭示非共线反铁磁体 Mn₃Ge 中面外自旋极化的起源
articles.abstract: Author(s): Mingxing Wu, Kouta Kondou, Taishi Chen, Satoru Nakatsuji, and YoshiChika Otani Noncollinear antiferromagnets Mn 3 X ( X =Sn, Ge) possess out-of-plane spin polarization that enables field-free magnetization switching. However, its microscopic origin remains under debate, specifically whether it arises from the antiferromagnetic order dependent magnetic spin Hall effect or antiferromagnetic order independent spin swapping. To address this issue here, the authors comparatively evaluate the spin torques in single-crystal Mn 3 Ge/Py bilayers with different crystallographic orientations using spin-torque ferromagnetic resonance technique. Their results reveal that both mechanisms coexist with comparable magnitudes, responsible for the out-of-plane spin polarization. [Phys. Rev. B 114, L020403] Published Wed Jul 22, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 非共线反铁磁体 Mn₃X（X = Sn, Ge）具有可支持无外场磁化翻转的面外自旋极化，但其微观来源存在争议。作者通过自旋转矩铁磁共振，比较了不同晶向单晶 Mn₃Ge/Py 双层中的自旋转矩。结果表明，依赖反铁磁序的磁自旋霍尔效应与不依赖反铁磁序的自旋交换机制均存在且量级相当，共同导致面外自旋极化。
authors: Mingxing Wu, Kouta Kondou, Taishi Chen, Satoru Nakatsuji, and YoshiChika Otani

articles.title: Quantum Neural Networks Face the Hardware Test
articles.title_zh: 量子神经网络接受硬件检验
articles.abstract: Author(s): Peter Röseler By implementing a quantum neural network using two quantum-computing platforms, researchers have taken steps toward determining whether such systems can reliably fulfill their theoretical promise. [Physics 19, 100] Published Wed Jul 22, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 这篇 Physics 评论介绍了一项在离子阱和超导量子计算平台上实现量子神经网络的研究。文章关注真实硬件测试对于判断量子神经网络是否能实现其理论优势的重要性。具体实验细节和性能评估对应相关 Physical Review Letters 论文。

articles.title: Why Flowing Spins Polarize Up or Down
articles.title_zh: 流动自旋为何向上或向下极化
articles.abstract: Author(s): Charles Day Researchers have figured out the origin of an exotic antiferromagnet’s out-of-plane spin currents. [Physics 19, s104] Published Wed Jul 22, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 这篇 Physics 简讯概述了关于反铁磁体中面外自旋流来源的研究进展。相关工作澄清了非共线反铁磁材料中异常面外自旋极化的物理机制，对理解无场自旋轨道转矩开关具有意义。更具体的实验体系和结论对应相关 Physical Review B 论文。

articles.title: Semiconducting and magnetic lanthanide MXenes from intercalated halides
articles.title_zh: 由插层卤化物制备的半导体性与磁性镧系 MXene
articles.abstract: Nature, Published online: 22 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10802-2 A bottom-up synthesis strategy creates lanthanide MXenes (Ln2CT2) that combine semiconducting behaviour with ferromagnetism, offering a promising new class of two-dimensional materials for spintronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该 Nature 论文报道了一种自下而上的合成策略，用于制备镧系 MXene 材料 Ln₂CT₂。所得二维材料同时表现出半导体行为和铁磁性，区别于许多传统 MXene 的金属性特征。该类材料为自旋电子学器件提供了新的二维候选体系。

articles.title: Geomagnetic storms caused by solar wind might be more extreme than previously thought
articles.title_zh: 太阳风引发的地磁暴可能比以往认为的更极端
articles.abstract: Nature, Published online: 22 July 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02245-6 The severity of geomagnetic storms — magnetic disturbances in Earth’s outer atmosphere — is widely understood to reach an upper limit as the strength of the solar wind increases. But this upper limit is an illusion that results from uncertainty in the measurement of solar-wind strength as the true value regresses towards the mean.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文指出，地磁暴强度随太阳风增强而存在上限的传统认识可能受到测量不确定性的误导。所谓上限可能源于太阳风强度观测值向均值回归造成的统计假象，因此极端地磁扰动的潜在强度或被低估。

articles.title: Signatures of bulk g-wave altermagnetism in optically excited α−MnTe
articles.title_zh: 光激发 α-MnTe 中体相 g 波交替磁性的特征
articles.abstract: Author(s): Luca Felipe Haag, Marius Weber, Kai Leckron, Libor Šmejkal, Jairo Sinova, and Hans Christian Schneider Excitation by linearly polarized femtosecond laser pulses provides a direct view into the altermagnetic structure via the non-equilibrium spin-polarized electronic populations in a band structure whose symmetry encodes the underlying bulk g-wave order. The spin-dependent electronic response calculated in this paper can be accessed by optical pump-probe experiments. The authors show that, surprisingly, such a purely optical technique reveals planar d-wave- and g-wave-like signatures hidden within the three-dimensional bulk g-wave spin-order configuration. Crucially, the symmetry properties of the calculated response can be well approximated by using two-dimensional “spin cuts”, which enable a transparent interpretation of the optical response and motivate concrete magneto-optical pump-probe configurations for bulk altermagnets. [Phys. Rev. Materials 10, 074413] Published Wed Jul 22, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过线偏振飞秒激光激发，计算 α-MnTe 中由交替磁性体相 g 波序所编码的非平衡自旋极化电子布居。结果表明，纯光学泵浦-探测手段可揭示隐藏在三维体相 g 波自旋结构中的平面 d 波和 g 波样特征。作者进一步指出，二维“自旋切片”可较好近似响应的对称性，为体相交替磁体的磁光泵浦-探测实验设计提供直观方案。
authors: Luca Felipe Haag, Marius Weber, Kai Leckron, Libor Šmejkal, Jairo Sinova, and Hans Christian Schneider

articles.title: How do quantum computers work?
articles.title_zh: 量子计算机如何工作？
articles.abstract: Nature, Published online: 22 July 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02219-8 Recent breakthroughs suggest usable devices could be here in a decade.
articles.abstract_zh: 这是一篇面向广泛读者的 Nature 文章，围绕量子计算机的基本工作原理及其近期进展展开。摘要指出，最新突破显示可用型量子设备可能在未来十年内出现，但具体技术路线和性能判断需参阅原文。

articles.title: Imaging of nanoscale polar textures in quantum paraelectric SrTiO 3
articles.title_zh: 量子顺电体 SrTiO3 中纳米尺度极性织构的成像
articles.abstract: Nature, Published online: 22 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10823-x Cryo-STEM reveals that SrTiO3 forms periodic polar nanodomains below 105 K, but these fragment below 40 K, linking quantum paraelectricity to nanoscale polar ordering and disordering.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用低温扫描透射电子显微术观察 SrTiO3 中的极性纳米结构。结果显示，SrTiO3 在 105 K 以下形成周期性极性纳米畴，而在 40 K 以下这些纳米畴发生碎裂。该发现将量子顺电性与纳米尺度极性有序及无序化过程联系起来。

articles.title: Capturing the first moments after high-energy molecular impact
articles.title_zh: 捕捉高能分子碰撞后的最初瞬间
articles.abstract: Nature Physics, Published online: 22 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03361-w When high-energy particles, such as photons, electrons or ions, collide with a molecule, the collision kicks off processes that occur within the first femtoseconds after impact. Quantum mechanical motion of electrons bound to the molecule, which ultimately breaks chemical bonds, has now been captured using an attosecond X-ray free-electron laser.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文报道利用阿秒 X 射线自由电子激光捕捉高能粒子撞击分子后最初飞秒内的电子动力学。光子、电子或离子等高能粒子与分子碰撞后，会触发束缚电子的量子运动，并最终导致化学键断裂。该工作为直接观测分子损伤和反应早期过程提供了时间分辨手段。

articles.title: From electronic clovers to emergent quantum matter
articles.title_zh: 从电子四叶草到涌现量子物质
articles.abstract: Nature Physics, Published online: 22 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03374-5 The first holes doped into a cuprate create atomic-scale electronic states that combine into larger motifs, offering a bottom-up view of the emergence of charge order and superconducting phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 该评论聚焦铜氧化物中最初掺入的空穴如何形成原子尺度电子态，并进一步组合成更大的电子图案。文章强调，这种自下而上的视角有助于理解电荷有序和超导等集体现象的涌现。具体材料体系和实验细节需参阅原文。

articles.title: High-resolution full-colour displays from cracking-assisted transfer printing of quantum dot light-emitting diodes
articles.title_zh: 裂纹辅助转移印刷量子点发光二极管实现高分辨率全彩显示
articles.abstract: Nature Electronics, Published online: 22 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41928-026-01669-2 Environmentally friendly, full-colour displays based on quantum dot light-emitting diodes have been limited by the difficulty of patterning quantum dots at high resolution. A cracking-assisted transfer printing method enables ultra-high-resolution patterning of cadmium-free red, green and blue quantum dot nanopixels, paving the way for full-colour active-matrix displays with an extremely wide colour gamut.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对无镉量子点发光二极管在高分辨率图案化方面的瓶颈，提出裂纹辅助转移印刷方法。该方法可实现红、绿、蓝量子点纳米像素的超高分辨率图案化。结果为环境友好的全彩有源矩阵显示器和极宽色域显示技术提供了新路径。

articles.title: The importance of imagery in quantum mechanics
articles.title_zh: 图像化思维在量子力学中的重要性
articles.abstract: Nature Reviews Physics, Published online: 22 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s42254-026-00972-3 100 years on from Werner Heisenberg and Erwin Schrödinger’s dispute on how to conceptualize quantum mechanics, Arthur I. Miller reflects on the subtleties of visualization in physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文回顾海森堡与薛定谔关于如何理解和表述量子力学的历史分歧，并讨论物理学中可视化的微妙作用。作者从量子力学诞生百年的视角反思，图像、模型与数学形式之间并非简单替代关系，而是共同塑造物理直觉和概念理解。

articles.title: Publisher Correction: Between Mott and cluster Mott: spin-orbit entangled dimer singlets in Ba 3 CeRu 2 O 9
