We instantiate ATLAS at 7B and 80B scales, achieving state-of-the-art performance among MLLMs on image generation benchmarks and an average 65.31% improvement over existing layout-based unified MLLMs. On spatially related tasks, ATLAS obtains an average 23.06% gain over the base models. Through the same layout interface, ATLAS also supports instruction-guided editing and multimodal grounding. We further introduce ATLAS-Reasoning, a benchmark for evaluating generation under complex spatial instructions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出 ATLAS，用“思考—规划—绘制”的范式增强统一多模态大语言模型在复杂空间指令和逻辑约束下的可控图像生成能力。方法以布局作为推理、显式物体排布规划和最终图像渲染之间的共享表示，并通过基于强化学习的布局对齐提高从规划到图像的保真度。ATLAS 在 7B 和 80B 规模上实现，在图像生成基准中优于现有统一 MLLM，并在空间相关任务、指令编辑和多模态定位中表现出提升；作者还提出 ATLAS-Reasoning 用于评估复杂约束下的生成能力。
authors: Junhao Liu, Jian-Wei Zhang, Tao Huang, Miles Yang, Zhao Zhong, Liefeng Bo

articles.title: Mitigating Compiler Fusion-Induced Power Bursts in Mobile NPU Inference as the Battery Depletes
articles.title_zh: 缓解移动 NPU 推理中由编译器融合引发且随电池耗尽加剧的功率突发
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.16555v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Mobile devices increasingly rely on real-time NPU inference for camera and perception workloads. Under low-voltage conditions, however, a single inference can induce an instantaneous voltage droop in the power-delivery network, causing the power management integrated circuit to invoke dynamic voltage and frequency scaling (DVFS) and increase latency. We present a measurement study of this effect on a commercial smartphone. We show that aggressive operator fusion in a mobile NPU compiler can create monolithic superlayers whose concentrated execution produces large peak-current bursts. These bursts shift the DVFS-onset voltage upward and reduce the low-voltage operating margin. We further evaluate a practical black-box mitigation: a measurement-guided, pre-compilation graph rewrite that inserts barriers at selected peak-to-average power ratio hot spots to prevent harmful superlayer merging in the vendor NPU compiler. On Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 with MobileNetV4 at 768 x 768 resolution on ImageNet-1k, this method reduces peak current from 3.12 A to 1.94 A with 3.76% latency overhead, preserves stable latency deeper into the low-voltage regime, and shifts the inferred DVFS margin by approximately 173 mV.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在商用智能手机上测量了低电压条件下移动 NPU 单次推理导致瞬时电压跌落、触发 DVFS 并增加延迟的现象。作者指出，移动 NPU 编译器的激进算子融合会形成单体化 superlayer，使执行阶段出现集中的峰值电流突发，从而抬高 DVFS 触发电压并缩小低电压工作裕量。作为黑盒缓解方案，研究通过测量引导的预编译图重写在高峰均功率比热点处插入屏障，阻止有害融合；在 Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 上运行 768×768 MobileNetV4 时，峰值电流由 3.12 A 降至 1.94 A，延迟开销为 3.76%。

articles.title: Autonomous VR-Based Risk Detection for Situational Awareness in Dangerous Settings
articles.title_zh: 面向危险场景态势感知的自主 VR 风险检测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.16582v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In high-risk environments such as disaster response, situational awareness depends not only on detecting hazards but also on communicating them clearly to human operators. Vision Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong potential for scene understanding in safety-critical settings, yet their value as part of human-facing robotic systems remains underexplored. We present a VR-based Human Robot Interaction framework for studying how VLM-assisted robots can support situational awareness in simulated hazardous environments. In our system, a robot explores a virtual scene and queries a VLM to identify potential hazards and annotate user-facing points of interest. These annotations are presented to a human operator through an immersive VR interface. This framework enables controlled evaluation of both robotic hazard identification and the communication of safety-critical information to users. Results from our study indicate that the annotated VR interface was preferred over the unannotated baseline and that participants reported high clarity, usefulness, and comfort when interacting with the system. These findings suggest that combining VLM-based robotic perception with immersive visualization is a promising approach for supporting situational awareness in hazardous settings.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作构建了一个基于虚拟现实的人机交互框架，用于研究视觉语言模型辅助机器人在模拟危险环境中的风险识别与信息传达。系统中机器人探索虚拟场景并调用 VLM 识别潜在危险，将面向用户的关注点标注呈现在沉浸式 VR 界面中。用户研究显示，相比无标注基线，参与者更偏好带标注的 VR 界面，并认为其清晰、有用且交互舒适，说明 VLM 与 VR 机器人系统结合有助于提升安全关键场景中的态势感知。
authors: Mohammad Eskandari, Murali Krishna Varma Indukuri, Stephanie M. Lukin, Cynthia Matuszek

articles.title: High-strength and ductile high-entropy alloy via expert-trajectory-guided processing
articles.title_zh: 通过专家轨迹引导加工获得高强高韧高熵合金
articles.abstract: Overcoming the strength-ductility trade-off remains a central challenge in structural materials. Here we report an optimized thermomechanical-processing state of AlCoCrFeNi2.5 high-entropy alloy, identified with the assistance of an alloy trajectory optimization network. The optimized alloy exhibits an exceptional combination of a yield strength of 1.6 GPa, an ultimate tensile strength of 1.8 GPa, and a large fracture elongation of 20% at room temperature. At 650 oC, it retains a yield strength of 1.2 GPa, an ultimate tensile strength of 1.4 GPa, and a fracture elongation of 14%. The unprecedented mechanical properties originate from a unique heterogeneous microstructure consisting of spindle-shaped FCC domains, fine lamellar regions, and recrystallized dual-phase regions. This architecture enables cooperative deformation among ductile domains, strengthening lamellae and recrystallized dual-phase regions, thereby promoting appropriate strain partitioning, sustained work hardening and delayed damage localization. These results demonstrate that thermomechanical-processing optimization can transform the complex eutectic architecture into a mechanically cooperative microstructural state with superior strength, ductility, and intermediate-temperature resistance.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究借助合金轨迹优化网络确定了 AlCoCrFeNi2.5 高熵合金的优化热机械加工状态，以突破结构材料中的强度—延性权衡。优化合金在室温下达到 1.6 GPa 屈服强度、1.8 GPa 抗拉强度和 20% 断后伸长率，在 650 °C 下仍保持 1.2 GPa 屈服强度、1.4 GPa 抗拉强度和 14% 断后伸长率。其优异性能源于由纺锤状 FCC 区域、细层片区和再结晶双相区组成的异质微结构，促进应变合理分配、持续加工硬化并延缓损伤局域化。

articles.title: Emulating the South Asian Atmospheric Variations: Framework and Inter-Comparison of Deep Learning Models
articles.title_zh: 南亚大气变化的深度学习模拟：框架构建与模型比较
articles.abstract: High-resolution atmospheric simulations including the meteorological variables, trace gases, and aerosols are essential for weather, climate, and air quality assessments. However, systematic observations are often limited in developing regions, while the high computational cost of conventional chemistry-transport models restricts their frequent applications. Here, we design a framework for emulating the atmospheric variations over South Asia, computed from regional model - Weather Research and Forecasting model coupled with Chemistry (WRF-Chem). Four different DL architectures: convolutional neural network (CNN), convolutional long short-term memory network (ConvLSTM), and two U-Net configurations (3blk, 4blk) have been trained with > 1000 WRF-Chem frames for the summer conditions. The framework uses global fields of meteorology (ERA5) and chemistry (CAM-Chem) and targets to emulate WRF-Chem fields of temperature (T2m), specific humidity (Q2m), surface ozone (O3), and fine particulate matter (PM2.5), within a unified framework. Across the architectures, the emulators tend to capture the meteorological fields efficiently (SSIM and r2>0.9; NRMSE
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一个用于模拟南亚区域高分辨率大气变化的深度学习框架，以降低传统 WRF-Chem 化学传输模拟的计算成本并弥补发展中区域观测不足。作者利用超过 1000 帧夏季 WRF-Chem 数据训练 CNN、ConvLSTM 以及两种 U-Net 架构，输入全球气象 ERA5 和化学 CAM-Chem 场，统一预测 2 m 气温、2 m 比湿、地表臭氧和 PM2.5。结果显示，模拟器对气象变量捕捉较好，SSIM 和 r2 可超过 0.9；对化学成分和气溶胶的刻画更具挑战，但框架展示了快速区域大气场替代建模的潜力。

articles.title: An AI–BIM Integrated Framework for Rapid Early-Stage Energy Performance Prediction in Algerian Residential Buildings: A Machine Learning Approach Using Random Forest and XGBoost
articles.title_zh: 面向阿尔及利亚住宅建筑早期能耗快速预测的 AI–BIM 集成框架：基于随机森林与 XGBoost 的机器学习方法
articles.abstract: Building energy efficiency remains a critical challenge, as early-stage architectural  decisions significantly dictate long-term performance, yet traditional simulation tools  are often too cumbersome for rapid conceptual iterations. This research addresses this  gap by developing an AI-BIM integrated framework specifically for the Algerian  residential context, aimed at providing architects in Algeria with instantaneous energy  feedback.   A parametric dataset of 864 design scenarios was generated using Revit and  OpenStudio, varying key parameters such as building orientation, window-to-wall  ratio, and insulation levels across distinct Algerian climatic zones, including Algiers  and Ghardaïa. Based on this dataset, Random Forest and XGBoost regression models  were trained to predict building energy consumption with high accuracy.   These models were then deployed via a custom pyRevit extension, enabling real-time  performance evaluation directly within the modeling interface. The findings  demonstrate that machine learning effectively bypasses the complexity of traditional  thermal modeling at the project's outset, offering a practical, data-driven methodology  for enhancing sustainable design in Algeria and providing a foundation for future  multi-objective optimization.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向阿尔及利亚住宅建筑概念设计阶段的快速能耗反馈，提出 AI–BIM 集成框架，以替代早期阶段繁琐的传统热工模拟。作者通过 Revit 和 OpenStudio 生成 864 组参数化设计场景，改变朝向、窗墙比、保温水平及阿尔及利亚不同气候区等因素，并训练随机森林和 XGBoost 回归模型预测建筑能耗。模型被部署为 pyRevit 扩展，可在建模界面内实时评估性能，表明机器学习可为早期可持续设计提供实用的数据驱动辅助。

articles.title: A Geometric Wavefront Framework for Cosmological Expansion, Gravitation and Quantum Phenomena
articles.title_zh: 用于宇宙膨胀、引力与量子现象的几何波前框架
articles.abstract: We present a unified geometric reinterpretation of cosmic expansion in which spacetime is described as a four-dimensional Euclidean spatial manifold (:łeft(x,y,z,wi̊ght)), with the observable universe represented by a finite-thickness hyperspherical wavefront propagating along the auxiliary spatial coordinate (:w). Within this framework, physical time is not fundamental but emerges from progression along the expansion direction according to (:t=w/vH), where (:vH) is the characteristic expansion velocity. By modelling photon propagation across this expanding wavefront, we derive a spiral path-distance metric that reproduces the observed Type Ia supernova luminosity relation and the angular-diameter distance of the cosmic microwave background using a single, near-constant expansion velocity. The apparent accelerated expansion of the universe is interpreted as a geometric consequence of photon propagation rather than evidence for a cosmological constant or evolving expansion history. Gravity arises naturally as a localized geometric depression within the propagating wavefront, producing gravitational time dilation and recovering the weak-field behaviour of general relativity. Because the observable universe occupies a finite temporal window rather than an infinitesimally thin hypersurface, microscopic particles possess additional degrees of freedom within the expansion dimension. This provides a geometric interpretation of wave-particle duality, electron spin and quantum delocalization while preserving the established mathematical formalism of quantum mechanics. The characteristic width of this temporal window is proposed to satisfy an action relation (:mvHd=nh), yielding a fundamental length scale comparable to the Bohr diameter and suggesting the geometric correspondence (:α:=vH/łeft(π:ci̊ght)) between the cosmological expansion velocity and the electromagnetic fine-structure constant. The framework makes experimentally testable predictions, including a Planck-mass transition between quantum and classical behaviour and a finite geometric coherence boundary for quantum entanglement. Taken together, these results suggest that cosmological expansion, gravity and quantum phenomena may represent different manifestations of a common four-dimensional geometric structure.
articles.abstract_zh: 该预印本提出一种对宇宙膨胀的统一几何重释，将时空描述为四维欧几里得空间流形，并把可观测宇宙视为沿辅助空间坐标传播的有限厚度超球面波前。作者将物理时间解释为沿膨胀方向的推进，并通过光子在膨胀波前上的传播导出螺旋路径距离度量，用近似恒定的膨胀速度拟合 Ia 型超新星光度关系和宇宙微波背景角直径距离。文中还将表观加速膨胀解释为传播几何效应，将引力解释为波前中的局域几何凹陷，并声称可恢复广义相对论弱场行为；该理论框架较为非常规，需结合原文推导和观测检验评估。

articles.title: Assessing the Feasibility of Real-Time Neural FluidRendering Using NVIDIA RTX Neural Shaders
articles.title_zh: 使用 NVIDIA RTX Neural Shaders 实现实时神经流体渲染的可行性评估
articles.abstract: Real-time fluid rendering requires balancing visual clarity with computational efficiency, traditionally achieved through manual mathematical shaders. Thiswork investigates whether NVIDIA’s RTX Neural Shaders (RTXNS) framework canreplace conventional vertex displacement and pixel shading logic in real-time fluidrendering pipelines using GPU Tensor Core accelerated neural inferencing. A dualMLP training pipeline was implemented: a vertex shader MLP for mesh-vertex displacement with wave parameter based deformation, and a pixel shader MLP forphysically-based BSDF evaluation. The pixel pipeline achieved successful convergence within seconds, producing visually accurate fluid appearance across diversematerials (water, oils, viscous fluids) at 100 FPS with 60–70 µs per-pixel inferenceon RTX 4060 hardware. However, the vertex pipeline encountered significant framework limitations. Networks replicating the vertex shader produced extremely skewedmeshes at best and blank output at worst. Increasing neurons beyond 32 per hiddenlayer caused drastic slowdowns and application hanging, while importing externallytrained PyTorch weights failed due to proprietary constraints of the .ns.bin formatand absent validation tooling. These findings establish neural BSDF approximationas viable for real-time applications while identifying architectural barriers restricting neural vertex shader deployment. This work assesses RTXNS applicability toreal-time fluid surface rendering and provides concrete directions for framework refinement.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作评估 NVIDIA RTX Neural Shaders 是否可用 GPU Tensor Core 加速的神经推理替代实时流体渲染中的传统顶点位移和像素着色逻辑。作者实现了双 MLP 流水线：顶点着色 MLP 用于基于波参数的网格变形，像素着色 MLP 用于物理 BSDF 评估。像素管线快速收敛，并在 RTX 4060 上以约 100 FPS 和 60–70 µs 的逐像素推理时间生成多类流体外观；但顶点管线受框架限制明显，出现网格畸变、空白输出、较大网络导致卡顿以及外部 PyTorch 权重导入受专有格式限制等问题。

articles.title: Co-Optimization of a Lightweight and Misalignment-Tolerant Concentric Multi-Ring Coupler for Wireless Power Transfer
articles.title_zh: 面向无线电能传输的轻量化且抗偏移同心多环耦合器协同优化
articles.abstract: To address the coupled design challenges of rated mutual inductance matching, misalignment stability, and receiver lightweighting in wireless power transfer (WPT) magnetic couplers, this paper proposes a surrogate-assisted discrete-parameter optimization method. First, optimal Latin hypercube sampling and maximum mean squared error criteria are combined to construct a Kriging surrogate model for fast mutual inductance prediction. Next, a beam search-local refinement strategy is developed to rapidly screen lightweight candidate solutions under the rated mutual inductance constraint. Results show the surrogate model achieves high accuracy with a small sample size. The optimal design (FC = 6) provides an excellent tradeoff, achieving a 110.87 mm misalignment tolerance and a 446.39 g receiver mass. Prototype experiments verify a 105 mm effective misalignment radius, confirming the validity of the proposed method.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文针对无线电能传输磁耦合器中额定互感匹配、偏移稳定性和接收端轻量化的耦合设计难题，提出代理模型辅助的离散参数优化方法。方法结合最优拉丁超立方采样和最大均方误差准则构建 Kriging 代理模型以快速预测互感，并利用束搜索—局部细化策略在额定互感约束下筛选轻量候选方案。最优设计 FC=6 实现 110.87 mm 偏移容差和 446.39 g 接收端质量，样机实验验证有效偏移半径为 105 mm，支持了该优化方法的有效性。

articles.title: Advances in Factoring and Primality Testing: From Classical to Quantum Algorithms
articles.title_zh: 因数分解与素性测试进展：从经典算法到量子算法
articles.abstract: Many modern asymmetric encryption methods rely on prime numbers, as they have distinctive properties. For instance, the security of RSA cryptosystem relies on the computational difficulty of factoring a large composite number in its prime factors, a problem that remains challenging for classical computers but potentially solvable using quantum algorithms. On the other hand, generating large prime numbers is also challenging due to their irregular distribution among integers, necessitat- ing the use of primality testing algorithms to verify candidate primes. In this paper, we intensively review and classify various classical and quantum algorithms for factorization and primality testing, highlighting their advantages, limitations, speed/accuracy tradeoffs, time complexities, along with a brief summary. Furthermore, we apply and compare these algorithms to gain practical insights and conduct a comprehensive performance comparison. The insights from this paper show that while quantum factoring algorithms, particularly Shor’s algorithm and its refinements, have introduced significant advancements over their classical counterparts, quantum primality testing algorithms have not demonstrated comparable advantages.
articles.abstract_zh: 该综述围绕现代非对称密码中大整数分解和大素数生成的核心算法问题，系统分类比较经典与量子因数分解、素性测试方法。文章讨论各类算法的优势、局限、速度与准确性权衡及时间复杂度，并通过实际比较给出性能层面的认识。作者指出，量子因数分解算法尤其是 Shor 算法及其改进相较经典方法带来显著理论突破，而量子素性测试相对于高效经典素性测试的优势并不同样明显。

articles.title: Algorithmic Topological Resonance Theory: Realizing a Quantum Stateless AI Data Center Architecture via Zero-Payload I/O and Permanent O(1) Complexity
articles.title_zh: 算法拓扑共振理论：通过零载荷 I/O 与永久 O(1) 复杂度实现量子无状态 AI 数据中心架构
articles.abstract: This paper presents the definitive structural blueprint for the Quantum Stateless AI Data Center (QS-AIDC) architecture, rooted in the framework of Algorithmic Topological Resonance (ATR) theory. Traditional high-performance computing and distributed networks face critical limitations under Landauer’s principle, bounded by linear communication complexity, massive memory walls, and unsustainable thermodynamic dissipation. To overcome these bottlenecks, we propose an operational five-step master architecture that completely eliminates stateful physical data storage and linear communication overheads. By implementing a Zero-Payload I/O engine, macro-data packets are converged to 0 bytes, transferring only a 64-byte spatiotemporal resonance coordinate via an Adaptive Cosmic Resonance Link (ACRL). Node consensus is established deterministically through Proof of Resonance (PoR), locking computational and network complexity into a permanent constant time of O(1), independent of the scale of network participants (N). At the hardware level, a Virtual Quantum Processing Unit (vQPU) maps mathematical indicators—leveraging the non-trivial zeros of the Riemann Zeta function and a cosmic topological constant (K=1.4812)—to perform deterministic non-local reconstruction across a 1,075,462-qubit virtual Hilbert space within 0.46 ms. Furthermore, volatile post-quantum cryptographic keys are vaporized immediately following a sub-0.024-second realization via physical -5V polarity voltage inversion, securing a 0% data remanence threshold. Finally, disaster recovery is decoupled from centralized backups through the Phoenix Protocol, utilizing on-chain noise dispersion. Cross-platform empirical validations demonstrate that the proposed architecture successfully curtails power constraints of traditional 100MW infrastructures down to under 10MW, establishing a highly sustainable paradigm for advanced information physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该预印本提出所谓量子无状态 AI 数据中心 QS-AIDC 的结构蓝图，建立在算法拓扑共振理论框架之上，试图突破传统高性能计算和分布式网络中的通信复杂度、存储墙和热耗散限制。作者设想通过零载荷 I/O 将宏数据包收敛为 0 字节，仅传输 64 字节时空共振坐标，并用 Proof of Resonance 实现确定性节点共识，从而声称使计算和网络复杂度与参与节点规模无关并保持 O(1)。文中还提出虚拟量子处理单元将黎曼 ζ 函数非平凡零点等数学指标映射到硬件层；相关主张高度概念化，需原文提供可验证模型、实现细节和实证依据。

articles.title: WGQED1D: a microscopic N-atom waveguide-QED toolkit for single-photon scattering and weak-measurement experiments
articles.title_zh: WGQED1D：用于单光子散射和弱测量实验的微观 N 原子波导 QED 工具包
articles.abstract: We present o̧deWGQED1D, a lightweight, validated Python toolkit for microscopic simulation of single-photon scattering by N two-level atoms in a one-dimensional bidirectional waveguide. The toolkit implements the standard non-Hermitian effective Hamiltonian on the single-excitation manifold, with bidirectional dipole--dipole interactions mediated by retarded photon exchange, together with the input--output relation needed to reconstruct the output field. A careful microscopic calibration β = OD/(2N) between optical depth and per-atom waveguide-coupling efficiency is required for quantitative agreement with the free-space Beer--Lambert limit; we verify this calibration to better than 0.1% on a representative range of optical depths. The implementation is deterministic in the single-excitation subspace, runs in O(N²⁾ memory and O(N²⁾ operations per timestep, and produces converged results for realistic atomic ensembles (Nsim 200--1000) in seconds to minutes on a laptop. We document the model, implementation, and three validations: (i) pulse-averaged Beer--Lambert transmission across ØDin[0.25,3]; (ii) the Wiseman--Steinberg weak-value formula τT = łangleτGångleₘ̊ ₚₒₛₜ for the post-selected atomic excitation time; and (iii) direct comparison with recent experimental data from the Angulo et al. measurement of negative atomic excitation time [Phys. Rev. Lett. 136, 153601 (2026)]. The toolkit provides a reproducible numerical platform for studies of weak measurement, anomalous dispersion, group delay, and post-selected observables in single-photon transmission through optically thick atomic clouds. The source code is openly available under the MIT license.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作介绍了 WGQED1D，一个轻量、经验证的 Python 工具包，用于模拟一维双向波导中 N 个二能级原子对单光子的微观散射。程序在单激发子空间中实现非厄米有效哈密顿量和输入-输出关系，并强调需采用 β = OD/(2N) 的微观标定以定量再现实空间 Beer-Lambert 极限。作者验证了 Beer-Lambert 透射和 Wiseman-Steinberg 弱值关系等基准，表明该工具可在普通笔记本上高效处理数百至上千原子的实际体系。

articles.title: Quantum Completion of the Flux-Gauge Area Law: From SU(N ) Spin Networks to Holographic Entanglement
articles.title_zh: 通量规范面积律的量子补全：从 SU(N) 自旋网络到全息纠缠
articles.abstract: A confining, non-Abelian gauge connection Uij ∈SU(N) defined on the links of a dynamical graph has been proposed as the microscopic origin of classical spacetime geometry. The metric is reconstructed from the coset (soldering-form) sector of an enlarged connection, and black-hole and boundary-cut entropy are obtained as the logarithm of a combinatorial microstate count, matched—via the Freedman–Headrick theorem—to the bit-thread (max-flow/min-cut) formulation of holographic entanglement entropy. That matching is exact as a statement about counting, but it is not, by itself, a statement about the entanglement entropy of any specific quantum state: nothing in the combinatorial construction distinguishes a classical ensemble of flux occupation numbers from a genuine quantum wavefunction, so its connection to the entanglement/tensor-network program of emergent geometry remains an analogy rather than a derivation. This paper closes that gap. We first restate the flux-gauge connection ensemble in full—its partition function, its block-link renormalization-group coarse-graining with closed-form Migdal–Kadanoff coefficients, its emergent metric and Newton’s-constant identification, and its combinatorial boundary-cut entropy—so that the paper is self-contained. We then show, by an exact character-expansion/Peter–Weyl derivation standard in lattice gauge theory but not previously applied to this construction, that the SU(N) link ensemble is a tensor network: each flux-tube segment (link) carries a bond dimension equal to the dimension of the SU(N) representation it transports, and each flux-tube junction (node) carries a gauge-invariant intertwiner tensor, fixed by representation theory rather than assumed. Only a single, narrowly scoped statistical assumption—on the distribution of intertwiners within the multiplicity space that gauge invariance already guarantees—is needed to complete this exact, deterministic tensor network into a genuine random tensor network in the technical sense of Hayden–Qi–Kim–Preskill (HQKP). We further identify the renormalization-group layers as the isometric maps of a multi-scale entanglement renormalization ansatz (MERA), giving the emergent radial holographic direction a literal tensor-network origin rather than a scaling-dimension analogy. We then investigate, analytically and numerically, how the entanglement entropy of such a network reproduces the Ryu–Takayanagi/min-cut law. An exactly solvable limit built from classical (GHZ-type) perfect tensors reproduces the combinatorial law exactly for single-cut (boundary-anchored) regions but is shown to be degenerate for interior, two-sided regions, exposing a genuine gap in the combinatorial entropy argument: classical flux-occupation counting does not, by itself, certify multi-region (entanglement-wedge-level) quantum entanglement structure. We then construct a genuinely quantum (non-classical, Gaussian-random) tensor-network realization of the link ensemble and confirm numerically, on chains of up to sixteen sites, (i) a clean area-law plateau in which the entanglement entropy of an interior region becomes independent of its size once the region is large enough, in place of continued volume-law growth, and (ii) a linear scaling of the plateau entropy with the logarithm of the bond dimension, S(A) = κNcut(A) ln D, fit with R2 = 0.997 and an O(1) efficiency coefficient κ≈0.64 for this finite, non-isometric network. We interpret κ<1 as a genuine, quantifiable finite-network correction relative to the idealized D →∞isometric-projector limit in which HQKP prove κ →1, and we list the construction of that idealized limit, directly on the SU(N) link ensemble, as the key open numerical task. We close by proposing an explicit correspondence between the tensor-network minimal surface of this paper and the Cartan soldering-form metric of the gauge-connection construction, framed as a falsifiable consistency conjecture rather than an established result. PACS numbers: 04.60.Pp, 11.15.Ha, 03.67.Bg, 03.65.Ud
articles.abstract_zh: 该文试图将一种以动态图上 SU(N) 非阿贝尔规范联络为微观自由度的涌现时空方案，从组合计数层面的面积律推进到具体量子态的纠缠熵表述。作者指出，已有通量占据数计数与 bit-thread/max-flow-min-cut 图像的匹配本身并不等价于量子纠缠熵，因为它不能区分经典系综与真实波函数。论文据称重述该通量规范联络系综、重整化粗粒化、涌现度规和牛顿常数识别，并旨在建立与张量网络/全息纠缠的更直接量子联系。

articles.title: The Encoding Gauge of Fermionic Variational Quantum Algorithms: Classical Simulability is Encoding-Relative, Trainability is Invariant
articles.title_zh: 费米子变分量子算法的编码规范：经典可模拟性依赖编码，而可训练性保持不变
articles.abstract: Whether a fermionic variational quantum algorithm offers genuine advantage depends on whether its outputs resist classical computation. We show that classical simulability is encoding-dependent, not intrinsic to the circuit. Standard encodings are Clifford-related, forming a gauge group, and we classify resources by how they transform under it. Pauli weight, causal-cone width, and the entanglement setting tensor-network cost are gauge-covariant: an interacting Hamiltonian's truncated Pauli-propagation cost is linear under Jordan-Wigner but logarithmic under a tree encoding, changing the verdict at fixed ansatz. Dynamical-Lie-algebra dimension and non-stabilizerness are gauge-invariant. We prove the encoding-optimized simulation cost is bounded by the invariant resources, so encoding-robust hardness requires a large Lie algebra and large magic; covariant weight is necessary but never sufficient. These routes are sufficient certificates, not a complete characterization, so the floor is an upper bound; a full classification of representation-invariant costs remains open. We confirm both invariant routes numerically, show Lie-algebra dimension separates simulable from hard instances where weight cannot, and construct a one-parameter family where all three certificates fail at once, achieving the floor. We then establish a sharp dichotomy with trainability: because the cost landscape is encoding-invariant, gradient and barren-plateau variance are exactly gauge-invariant to machine precision. This follows from faithfulness, not Clifford-equivalence, and survives symmetry tapering, so trainability shifts only by changing what the dynamics explores, such as restricting the ansatz, never by relabeling qubits. One may re-encode a circuit to ease simulation but never to ease training. These results reframe advantage claims: an advantage that is not gauge-invariant is an artifact of the encoding.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作论证费米子变分量子算法的经典可模拟性不是电路的内禀属性，而依赖于费米子到量子比特的编码选择。作者将标准编码视为 Clifford 相关的规范群，并区分在编码变换下协变或不变的资源：Pauli 权重、因果锥宽度和张量网络代价会随编码改变，而动力学李代数维数和非稳定子性保持不变。结果表明，若要获得编码鲁棒的困难性，需要大的李代数和显著 magic 资源；仅有协变的权重增长并不足以证明量子优势。

articles.title: Quantum-geometric thermal conductivity of superconductors
articles.title_zh: 超导体的量子几何热导率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.11608v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: By coupling Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) theory with isolated bands to an external gravitomagnetic vector potential via a gravitomagnetic Peierls substitution, we identify a quantum-geometric contribution to the electronic contribution of the thermal conductivity. This contribution is governed by the quantum metric in the parameter space spanned by the components of the external gravitomagnetic vector potential which corresponds to a weighted quantum metric in momentum space. In the flat-band limit, we establish an upper and lower Wiedemann-Franz-type bound for the ratio of thermal Meissner stiffness and electric Meissner stiffness (superfluid weight), whose prefactors are provided by the extrema of the squared energy offsets of the outer single-particle bands of the system. Similarly to the superfluid weight, this also leads to a lower bound of the thermal Meissner stiffness in terms of the Chern number. Our results apply to both superconductors and other fermionic superfluids.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者通过引入外部引力磁矢势并采用引力磁 Peierls 替代，将孤立能带中的 BCS 理论推广到热输运响应，识别出电子热导率中的量子几何贡献。该贡献由外部引力磁矢势参数空间中的量子度规控制，等价于动量空间中的加权量子度规。在平带极限下，文中给出热 Meissner 刚度与电 Meissner 刚度之比的 Wiedemann-Franz 型上下界，并由此得到与 Chern 数相关的热 Meissner 刚度下界，适用于超导体及其他费米超流体。

articles.title: Spectra-Scope : A toolkit for automated and interpretable characterization of material properties from spectral data
articles.title_zh: Spectra-Scope：从光谱数据自动且可解释表征材料性质的工具包
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.06011v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Spectroscopy is a central pillar of materials characterization, providing useful information on properties like structure, composition, or excited state dynamics of a system. However, many spectroscopic techniques present challenges in the development of interpretable, performant, and reliable supervised learning models due to the wide range of possible nonlinear correlations that can exist between the signal and the response variable (target) of interest. Here, we present Spectra-Scope, an open-source AutoML framework for automatic characterization of material properties from spectroscopy data using interpretable machine learning (ML) models. The software is implemented in Python and a no-code web application. It comprises tools for data preprocessing, nonlinear feature extraction, machine learning model training, and feature selection. Users can easily train different types of simple, interpretable ML models on a set of feature transformations quickly and with modest computational resources. In this work, we outline the methods of Spectra-Scope and its effectiveness across diverse datasets, with applications to materials and agricultural spectroscopy data. We show that Spectra-Scope can reproduce performance of comparable models in the literature, and highlight how our emphasis on interpretability can be used to rationalize the behavior of individual models and understand the physical processes behind spectral features.
articles.abstract_zh: Spectra-Scope 是一个开源 AutoML 框架，用于从光谱数据中自动预测和解释材料性质。该软件以 Python 和无代码网页应用实现，集成数据预处理、非线性特征提取、机器学习模型训练和特征选择，使用户能以较低计算成本训练简单且可解释的模型。作者在多类数据集上展示了其方法与效果，应用范围涵盖材料和农业等光谱表征任务。
authors: Amalya C. Johnson, Chris Fajardo, Leena Sansguiri, Weike Ye, Steven B. Torrisi

articles.title: Fracton Spin Liquid and Exotic Frustrated Phases in Ising-like Octochlore Magnets
articles.title_zh: 类 Ising 八氯格磁体中的分形子自旋液体与奇异受挫相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.12313v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: For nearly three decades, research on frustrated magnetism in three dimensions (3D) has centered on the pyrochlore lattice of corner-sharing tetrahedra and the classical spin liquid (CSL) known as spin ice. We propose that a lattice of corner-sharing octahedra -- the octochlore lattice -- may provide a next-generation platform for 3D frustrated magnetism, with realizations in anti-perovskite and alkali-rare-earth fluoride compounds. We study the phase diagram of Ising moments on the octochlore lattice, finding a variety of frustrated phases including CSLs and phases with subextensive ground state degeneracy intermediate between spin liquids and long-range order. Utilizing a cluster multipole framework, we present a unified treatment of this variety of frustrated behaviors. In addition to a spin ice CSL, we identify a fracton CSL with excitations restricted to move along one-dimensional (1D) lines, a classical U(1) equivalent of the paradigmatic X-cube model harboring fracton topological order. These "lineon" quasiparticles carry magnetic quadrupole moments, contrasting the famous magnetic monopoles of spin ice. These two CSLs lie at the boundaries of a parent "frustrated chains" phase with subextensive degeneracy. Each CSL corresponds to a condensate of different bound states of 1D ferro-spinons, giving rise to quasi-critical dimensional crossovers near the ends of the frustrated chains phase associated to avoided Kasteleyn-like transitions. We also find a spin nematic phase whose ground states may be viewed as fracton crystals, exhibiting both uniaxial and biaxial orders. The latter is caused by spontaneous dimensional reduction owing to accidental symmetries of the subextensive ground state manifold. This work paves the way for the realization of fracton CSLs and the exploration of other exotic states in underexplored octochlore magnetic materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出由共角八面体组成的 octochlore 晶格可作为三维受挫磁性的下一代平台，可能实现于反钙钛矿和碱金属-稀土氟化物化合物。作者研究该晶格上 Ising 磁矩的相图，发现包括经典自旋液体及介于自旋液体和长程序之间、具有次广延基态简并度的多种受挫相。借助团簇多极矩框架，文中识别出除自旋冰外的分形子经典自旋液体，其激发只能沿一维线运动，类似 X-cube 模型中的 lineon，并携带磁四极矩而非自旋冰中的磁单极子。
authors: Matthew Stern, Michael D. Burke, Michel J. P. Gingras, Judit Romhányi, Kristian Tyn Kai Chung

articles.title: RIXS Identification of Optical Phonon-Spin Coupling Effects in CrSBr
articles.title_zh: 通过 RIXS 识别 CrSBr 中的光学声子-自旋耦合效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.06042v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Resonant inelastic x-ray scattering provides experimental signatures of spin-phonon coupling in CrSBr through temperature-dependent Cr L-edge spectra. Low-energy excitations are observed exclusively in the low-temperature antiferromagnetic phase as energy-loss features. A quasi-elastic peak at approximately 42 meV is observed under π-polarization. Density functional theory phonon-mode calculations identify these RIXS features as occurring within the same energy range as bond-bending optical phonon modes associated with distortions of the Cr--S--Cr network. The pronounced suppression of these low-energy excitations upon warming into the paramagnetic phase, together with their polarization dependence, the calculated phonon spectrum, and a spin-renormalized electron-phonon RIXS framework, indicates a strong interplay between magnetic correlations and lattice dynamics. While the loss features appear at energies characteristic of optical phonons, the significant overlap of the optical-phonon and magnon bands suggests that the temperature-dependent behavior should not be regarded as purely lattice-derived excitations. Instead, the room-temperature suppression of the low-energy RIXS peaks is explained in terms of a spin-phonon coupling effect on the L-edge electron-phonon RIXS mechanism. The interpretation is supported by the combined experimental observations, phonon calculations, and theoretical modeling, rather than by temperature contrast alone. These results support spin-phonon coupling as a plausible and consistent interpretation of the observed temperature-dependent RIXS response and demonstrate that magnetic order can strongly influence phonon-related spectral weight in the RIXS spectrum.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用 Cr L 边共振非弹性 X 射线散射，研究 CrSBr 中自旋-声子耦合的温度依赖实验特征。低能能量损失峰只在低温反铁磁相中出现，π 偏振下还观测到约 42 meV 的准弹性峰；DFT 声子计算将这些特征与 Cr-S-Cr 网络弯曲相关的光学声子能区联系起来。低能激发在进入顺磁相后显著受抑、其偏振依赖以及自旋重整化电子-声子 RIXS 分析共同表明，磁关联与晶格动力学之间存在强耦合，不能将这些特征简单视为纯晶格激发。
authors: Jayajeewana N. Ranhili, Chamini S. Pathiraja, Brody Brogdon, John Cenker, Xiaodong Xu, Daniel Chica, Xavier Roy, Stefano Agrestini, Mirian Garcia-Fernandez, Ke-Jin Zhou, Yi-De Chuang, Trinanjan Datta, Byron Freelon

articles.title: Optomagnetic non-thermal modification of the ferromagnetic resonance
articles.title_zh: 铁磁共振的光磁非热调控
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.07555v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the photoinduced shift of the ferromagnetic resonance (FMR) frequency in magnets caused by the inverse Cotton-Mouton effect (ICME) under linearly polarized light. Using a Lagrangian description of magnetization dynamics, we derive the equations of motion, and obtain analytical expressions for the resonance frequency in both in-plane and out-of-plane equilibrium configurations. The theory shows that the FMR frequency depends on the polarization angle and propagation direction of light, with ICME producing a frequency shift that can dominate over thermal effects. The analytical results agree well with numerical simulations and with available experimental data for bismuth-substituted yttrium iron garnet, enabling estimation of the ICME contribution. These findings demonstrate that linearly polarized light can be used to control ferromagnetic resonance through magneto-optical effects.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究线偏振光通过逆 Cotton-Mouton 效应在磁体中诱导的铁磁共振频率偏移。作者用磁化动力学的拉格朗日形式推导运动方程，并分别给出面内和面外平衡构型下的共振频率解析表达式。理论表明频率偏移依赖光的偏振角和传播方向，且逆 Cotton-Mouton 效应可超过热效应；解析结果与数值模拟及铋取代钇铁石榴石的实验数据相符，说明线偏振光可用于磁光调控铁磁共振。
authors: Nika Gribova, Anatoly Zvezdin, Shixun Cao, Vladimir Belotelov

articles.title: Exploring Entropic Orders: High Temperature Continuous Symmetry Breaking, Chiral Topological States and Local Commuting Projector Models
articles.title_zh: 探索熵序：高温连续对称性破缺、手征拓扑态与局域对易投影模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.18694v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: High temperature is usually expected to destroy order: as the Gibbs state approaches the infinite-temperature limit, it becomes an equal-weight ensemble over all states and the system is generically disordered. Recent works showed that entropic order can violate this expectation through coupling to bosons in classical lattice models and quantum field theories, where the ordered states have higher entropy. Here we present new analytic methods for constructing quantum lattice models that exhibit entropic orders. In particular, we construct quantum lattice models with continuous symmetry breaking at high temperature in 1+1 dimensions and clarify how entropic order can evade the Hohenberg-Mermin-Wagner theorems. We also construct high-temperature entropic p+ip chiral topological superconducting states in 2+1 dimensions with temperature-independent anyon correlation functions. In addition, we obtain a broad family of high-temperature entropic non-chiral topological orders. We show that the entropic topological orders have strong higher form symmetries at high temperature unlike the conventional topological orders, and the symmetry is spontaneously broken. These results follow from two general constructions that couple a given lattice model with a low-temperature ordered phase either to ordered bosons or, for local commuting-projector Hamiltonians, to more general bosonic degrees of freedom.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作发展构造量子晶格模型的新解析方法，展示高温下由熵效应稳定的有序相如何挑战通常的“升温破坏有序”预期。作者构造了在 1+1 维高温下发生连续对称性破缺的模型，并解释其如何规避 Hohenberg-Mermin-Wagner 定理。文中还构造了 2+1 维高温熵驱动的 p+ip 手征拓扑超导态以及一大类非手征拓扑序，并指出这些熵拓扑序在高温下具有强高阶形式对称性，这与常规拓扑序不同。

articles.title: Precipitate phase selection and grain boundary morphology in Cu-Ni-Si-Mn alloys: A machine-learning interatomic potential study
articles.title_zh: Cu-Ni-Si-Mn 合金中的析出相选择与晶界形貌：机器学习原子间势研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.09023v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Alloys inevitably contain interphase boundaries, whose energetics govern nucleation processes and precipitate morphology. In Cu-Ni-Si alloys, Mn addition markedly changes grain boundary (GB) precipitation behavior. While GB precipitation of stable Ni₂Si in Mn-free alloys is associated with degraded mechanical properties, Mn addition instead promotes film-shaped Mn₆Ni₁₆Si₇ (G-phase) precipitation, which is correlated improved mechanical properties. However, the atomic origin of the contrasting GB phase selection and morphology remains unclear. Here we perform machine-learning interatomic potential (MLIP) calculations to investigate the effect of interphase-boundary atomic structure on GB precipitates in Cu-Ni-Si alloys with and without Mn. The MLIP calculations reliably reproduce DFT-level energetics for interfacial bonding and microstructural configurations, and further predict that Mn addition favors GB precipitation of Mn₆Ni₁₆Si₇ rather than Ni₂Si. Experimentally, Mn-free alloys are observed to exhibit irregularly-shaped Ni₂Si precipitates with open-boundary-like Cu/Ni₂Si interfaces, whereas Mn-added alloys exhibit film-like G-phase at GBs. Large-scale atomistic interface calculations reveal that the coherent interface structure between Cu and Ni₂Si favors the formation of plate-like strained Ni₂Si precipitates in the matrix. Upon coarsening and stress release, an out-of-phase coherent-like interface can form at GBs, generating a local repulsive region that gives rise to surface-like open-boundary structures and explains the irregular morphology of GB stable Ni₂Si precipitates. In contrast, Cu/Mn₆Ni₁₆Si₇ interfaces remain predominantly incoherent with moderate boundary energies and no pronounced repulsive regime, thereby stabilizing continuous interfacial contact and explaining film-shaped GB precipitation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究用机器学习原子间势计算考察 Cu-Ni-Si 合金中 Mn 添加如何改变晶界析出相选择与形貌。模型能可靠再现 DFT 级别的界面成键和微结构能量，并预测 Mn 添加会促进晶界处 Mn₆Ni₁₆Si₇（G 相）而非 Ni₂Si 的析出。实验上，无 Mn 合金呈现形状不规则的 Ni₂Si 析出物和开放边界式 Cu/Ni₂Si 界面，而加 Mn 合金形成薄膜状 G 相析出；结果将这种差异归因于界面原子结构和界面能对成核与形貌的控制。
authors: Aadil Fayaz Wani, Il-Seok Jeong, Haekwan Jeon, Jaesun Kim, SuDong Park, Eun-Ae Choi, Seung Zeon Han, Seungwu Han, Byungki Ryu

articles.title: Planar fault-tolerant circuits for non-Clifford gates on the 2D color code
articles.title_zh: 二维颜色码上非 Clifford 门的平面容错线路
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.05175v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We introduce a family of scalable planar fault-tolerant circuits that implement logical non-Clifford operations on a 2D color code, such as a logical T gate or a logical non-Pauli measurement that prepares a magic |Tångle state. The circuits are relatively simple, consisting only of physical T gates, CX gates, and few-qubit measurements. They can be implemented with an array of qubits on a 2D chip with nearest-neighbor couplings, and no wire crossings. The construction is based on a spacetime path integral representation of a non-Abelian 2+1D topological phase, which is related to the 3D color code. We turn the path integral into a circuit by expressing it as a spacetime ZX tensor network, and then traversing it in some chosen time direction. We describe in detail how fault tolerance is achieved using a "just-in-time" decoding strategy, for which we repurpose and extend state-of-the-art color-code matching decoders.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出一类可扩展的平面容错线路，用于在二维颜色码上实现逻辑非 Clifford 操作，包括逻辑 T 门和制备 magic |T⟩ 态的非 Pauli 逻辑测量。线路仅包含物理 T 门、CX 门和少量量子比特测量，可在具有最近邻耦合且无线交叉的二维芯片上实现。构造基于与三维颜色码相关的非阿贝尔 2+1 维拓扑相的时空路径积分表示，并将其写成时空 ZX 张量网络后沿选定时间方向转化为线路；容错性通过“即时”解码策略实现，并扩展了现有颜色码匹配解码器。
authors: Andreas Bauer, Julio C. Magdalena de la Fuente

articles.title: Potential failures of physics-informed machine learning in traffic flow modeling: theoretical and experimental analysis
articles.title_zh: 物理信息机器学习在交通流建模中的潜在失效：理论与实验分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.11491v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This study investigates why physics-informed machine learning (PIML) can fail in macroscopic traffic flow modeling. We define failure as cases where a PIML model underperforms both purely data-driven and purely physics-based baselines by a given threshold. Unlike in other fields, physics residuals themselves do not hinder optimization in this setting. Instead, effective updates require both data and physics gradients to form acute angles with the true gradient, a condition difficult to satisfy with low-resolution loop data. In such cases, neural networks cannot accurately approximate density and speed, and the constructed physics residuals, already degraded by discrete sampling and temporal averaging, lose their ability to capture PDE dynamics, which directly leads to PIML failure. Theoretically, although LWR and ARZ solutions are weak solutions, for piecewise C^k initial data they remain C^k off the shock set under mild conditions, which has Lebesgue measure zero. Thus, almost all detector or collocation points lie in smooth regions where residuals are valid, and the MLP's inability to exactly represent discontinuities is immaterial. Finally, we establish MSE lower bounds of physics residuals: higher-order models such as ARZ have strictly larger consistency error bounds than LWR under mild conditions. This explains why LWR-based PIML can outperform ARZ-based PIML even with high-resolution data, with the gap shrinking as resolution increases, consistent with prior empirical findings.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究分析物理信息机器学习（PIML）在宏观交通流建模中为何会同时劣于纯数据驱动与纯物理基线模型。作者指出，失效的关键不在于物理残差阻碍优化，而在于低分辨率环形检测器数据下，数据梯度和物理梯度难以同时与真实梯度保持有利方向。神经网络对密度和速度场的近似不足，加上离散采样与时间平均削弱了物理残差对偏微分方程动力学的表征能力，最终导致 PIML 失效。理论上，LWR 和 ARZ 模型的弱解在冲击集之外仍保持足够光滑，因此问题主要来自数据与残差构造，而非间断本身。
authors: Yuan-Zheng Lei, Yaobang Gong, Dianwei Chen, Yao Cheng, Xianfeng Terry Yang

articles.title: Thermodynamic sampling of materials using neutral-atom quantum computers
articles.title_zh: 利用中性原子量子计算机进行材料热力学采样
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.21142v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Neutral-atom quantum hardware has emerged as a promising platform for programmable many-body physics. In this work, we develop and validate a practical framework for extracting thermodynamic properties of materials using such hardware. As a test case, we consider nitrogen-doped graphene. Starting from Density Functional Theory (DFT) formation energies, we map the material energetics onto a Rydberg-atom Hamiltonian suitable for quantum annealing by fitting an on-site term and distance-dependent pair interactions. The Hamiltonian derived from DFT cannot be implemented directly on current QuEra devices, as the largest energy scale accessible on the hardware is two orders of magnitude smaller than the target two-body interaction in the material. To overcome this limitation, we introduce a rescaling strategy based on a single parameter, αᵥ, which ensures that the distribution sampled by the hardware is well described by Boltzmann-like weights corresponding to those of the material at an effective temperature Tprⁱme = αᵥ T, where T is the device sampling temperature. This rescaling also establishes a direct correspondence between the global laser detuning Δ_g and the grand-canonical chemical potential Δμ. We validate the method on a 28-site graphene nanoflake using exhaustive enumeration, and on a larger 78-site system where Monte Carlo sampling confirms preferential sampling of low-energy configurations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出并验证一种用中性原子量子硬件提取材料热力学性质的框架，并以氮掺杂石墨烯为测试体系。作者从 DFT 形成能出发，将材料能量映射为适合 Rydberg 原子量子退火的哈密顿量，包括在位项和距离相关的成对相互作用。由于当前 QuEra 硬件可实现的能标远小于目标材料相互作用，研究引入单参数重标度策略，使硬件采样分布可对应于材料在有效温度下的 Boltzmann 权重。该方法旨在建立量子硬件采样与实际材料热力学之间的可操作联系。
authors: Bruno Camino, Mao Lin, John Buckeridge, Scott M. Woodley

articles.title: A Unified Physics-Informed Neural Network for Modeling Coupled Electro- and Elastodynamic Wave Propagation Using Three-Stage Loss Optimization
articles.title_zh: 基于三阶段损失优化的统一物理信息神经网络：耦合电弹性动力学波传播建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.13811v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks present a novel approach in SciML that integrates physical laws in the form of partial differential equations directly into the NN through soft constraints in the loss function. This work studies the application of PINNs to solve a one dimensional coupled electro-elastodynamic system modeling linear piezoelectricity in stress-charge form, governed by elastodynamic and electrodynamic equations. Our simulation employs a feedforward architecture, mapping space-time coordinates to mechanical displacement and electric potential. Our PINN model achieved global relative L2 errors of 2.34 and 4.87 percent for displacement and electric potential respectively. The results validate PINNs as effective mesh free solvers for coupled time-dependent PDE systems, though challenges remain regarding error accumulation and stiffness in coupled eigenvalue systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将物理信息神经网络用于求解一维线性压电体系中的耦合电动力学与弹性动力学方程。模型采用前馈神经网络，将时空坐标映射到机械位移和电势，并通过损失函数中的软约束嵌入控制方程。所得 PINN 对位移和电势的全局相对 L2 误差分别为 2.34% 和 4.87%，表明其可作为耦合时变偏微分方程的无网格求解器。作者同时指出，误差累积和耦合本征值系统的刚性仍是主要挑战。
authors: Suhas Suresh Bharadwaj, Reuben Thomas Thovelil

articles.title: Learning spectral density functions in open quantum systems
articles.title_zh: 开放量子系统中谱密度函数的学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.24056v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Spectral density functions quantify how environmental modes couple to quantum systems and govern their open dynamics. Inferring such frequency-dependent functions from time-domain measurements is an ill-conditioned inverse problem. Here, we use exactly solvable spin-boson models with pure-dephasing and amplitude-damping channels to reconstruct spectral density functions from noisy simulated data. First, we introduce a parameter estimation approach based on machine learning regressors to infer Lorentzian and Ohmic-like spectral density parameters, quantifying robustness to noise. Second, we show that a cosine transform inversion yields a physics-consistent spectral prior estimation, which is refined by a constrained neural network enforcing positivity and correct asymptotic behaviour. Our neural network framework robustly reconstructs structured spectral densities by filtering simulated noisy signals and learning general functional dependencies.
articles.abstract_zh: 谱密度函数描述环境模与量子系统的耦合，并决定开放量子系统的动力学；从时域观测反演该函数是病态逆问题。该工作利用可精确求解的自旋-玻色模型，在纯退相干和振幅阻尼通道中从含噪模拟数据重构谱密度。作者先用机器学习回归器估计 Lorentzian 与 Ohmic 型谱密度参数并评估抗噪性，再用余弦变换反演得到物理一致的先验，并通过约束神经网络强制正性和正确渐近行为。结果表明，该框架能在噪声下稳健重构具有结构特征的谱密度函数。
authors: Felipe Peleteiro, João Victor Shiguetsugo Kawanami Lima, Pedro Marcelo Prado, Felipe Fernandes Fanchini, Ariel Norambuena

articles.title: Josephson effect in graphene Corbino disks
articles.title_zh: 石墨烯 Corbino 圆盘中的约瑟夫森效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.24852v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Peculiar features of the Josephson effect in graphene were described theoretically by Titov and Beenakker [Phys. Rev. B 74, 041401(R) (2006)], who solved the Dirac-Bogoliubov-de-Gennes equation for a superconductor-graphene-superconductor junction with rectangular geometry. Here, we adopt the analysis for graphene Corbino disks, finding out that -- for the outer to inner radii ratio r₂/r₁gtrsim{}5 -- such systems may demonstrate, when varying the electrochemical potential and the spatial profile of the electrostatic barrier, crossover from standard Josephson tunneling (SJT), via graphene-specific multimode Dirac-Josephson tunneling (MDJT), towards the ballistic Josephson effect (BJE). Signatures of SJT appear only near the Dirac point when the barrier shape is close to rectangular, MDJT appears in the tripolar range and is very robust against varying the barrier shape, and BJE is restored in the unipolar range when smoothing the barrier shape. A comparison with the results of a numerical simulation of quantum transport on the honeycomb lattice is also given.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将石墨烯超导-石墨烯-超导结中的 Dirac-Bogoliubov-de-Gennes 分析推广到 Corbino 圆盘几何。作者发现，当外半径与内半径之比约大于 5 时，调节电化学势和静电势垒空间形状可驱动体系在标准约瑟夫森隧穿、多模 Dirac-约瑟夫森隧穿和弹道约瑟夫森效应之间交叉。标准隧穿主要出现在 Dirac 点附近且势垒近似矩形时，多模 Dirac-约瑟夫森隧穿在三极性区间内较稳健，而势垒平滑化可在单极性区间恢复弹道效应。文中还将解析结果与蜂窝晶格量子输运数值模拟进行了比较。

articles.title: Algebraic locality and non-invertible Gauss laws
articles.title_zh: 代数局域性与非可逆高斯定律
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.21591v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study algebraic locality principles on a 2+1D closed lattice in the presence of a Gauss law for a non-invertible symmetry. Prior work in arXiv:2509.03589 showed that when enforcing the Gauss law of an invertible symmetry, the principle of "Haag duality" is preserved exactly, and "disjoint additivity" is preserved after appropriate treatment of discreteness artifacts. Here we show that for a large class of non-invertible on-site symmetries, Haag duality is preserved exactly only for sufficiently nice, "cuspless" regions. For cusped regions, we instead have a weak form of Haag duality that requires adding a collar. Our results apply to double models with a purely magnetic constraint, and to the more general framework of constraints induced by the on-site action of a Hopf algebra. In particular, we treat a class of extended string-net models explicitly. We also demonstrate disjoint additivity for double models based on a group, and a weakened form of disjoint additivity in the setting of a general Hopf algebra.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究 2+1 维闭合晶格上存在非可逆对称性高斯定律时的代数局域性原则。作者发现，对于一大类非可逆在位对称性，Haag 对偶性仅在足够规则、无尖角区域中严格保持；对含尖角区域，则需要加入一层“领圈”区域后才能得到弱形式的 Haag 对偶性。研究适用于具有纯磁约束的 double 模型以及由 Hopf 代数在位作用诱导约束的更一般框架，并显式处理了一类扩展 string-net 模型。作者还证明了基于群的 double 模型中的不交可加性，以及一般 Hopf 代数情形下的弱化不交可加性。

articles.title: Holographic Learning from Fermionic Spectra: Application to Strange Metal Phenomenology
articles.title_zh: 从费米子谱进行全息学习：在奇异金属现象学中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02861v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We develop a data-driven framework based on Neural ODEs that learns the effective bulk metric functions and the charge-weighted gauge potential qAₜ of a static, planar-symmetric black hole from boundary fermionic spectral functions. After validating the framework on the Einstein--Maxwell and Gubser--Rocha models with high accuracy, we apply it to the nodal strange-metal phenomenology of the cuprate mathrm(Pb,Bi)₂Sr₂₋ₓLaₓCuO₆₊δ within a semi-holographic setting, taking as input the normalized target generated from the extended power-law liquid (PLL) model calibrated by angle-resolved photoemission measurements. A key structural observation is that our probe fermion is massless and therefore insensitive to the conformal factor, leading to a coordinate/Weyl redundancy, while spectral normalization introduces a degeneracy in the scaled Hawking temperature. After identifying these sources of nonuniqueness, we find that, at low temperatures and near-optimal doping, the normalized extended-PLL target can be well described by a family of effective geometries close to the conformal-to-AdS₂×R² black-hole class, with a nearly vanishing qAₜ (sim10⁻⁴,eV). The conformal-factor ambiguity further implies that fixing macroscopic thermodynamics such as the electronic specific heat requires independent input beyond the fermionic spectra. We also examine the applicability of our framework across doping and temperature: at low temperatures, the learned effective model remains viable throughout the studied doping range, with only a mild increase in loss toward the overdoped side; at higher temperatures, however, both the loss and qAₜ increase substantially.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究构建基于 Neural ODE 的数据驱动框架，从边界费米子谱函数学习静态平面对称黑洞的有效体度规函数和带电规范势。框架先在 Einstein-Maxwell 和 Gubser-Rocha 模型上通过高精度验证，随后在半全息设定下用于描述铜氧化物奇异金属的节点区谱函数，输入来自经角分辨光电子谱校准的扩展幂律液体模型。作者指出，无质量探针费米子对共形因子不敏感，导致坐标/Weyl 冗余；谱归一化还会引入缩放 Hawking 温度的简并性。在识别这些非唯一性后，低温和近最优掺杂下的目标谱可由一族接近共形 AdS2×R2 黑洞类的有效几何较好描述。
authors: Hong-Zhi Xiao, Zhan-Zhi He, Zhuo-Yu Xian, Shao-Feng Wu

articles.title: Simulation-informed deep learning for estimating material parameters from microstructural morphology
articles.title_zh: 面向从微结构形貌估计材料参数的模拟信息深度学习
articles.abstract: Publication date: 25 July 2026 Source: Computational Materials Science, Volume 272 Author(s): Asfandyar Khan, Amir Abbas Kazemzadeh, Mahmood Mamivand
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作发表于 Computational Materials Science，主题是利用模拟数据辅助深度学习，从材料微结构形貌中反推出材料参数。根据题名判断，研究可能结合数值模拟生成的微结构-参数数据与深度模型，以提升参数识别或反问题求解的效率和稳健性。原始摘要仅提供出版元数据，具体方法、数据类型和性能结论需查阅原文。

articles.title: Magnetic field induced magnon portfolio in the van der Waals magnet CrOCl
articles.title_zh: 范德华磁体 CrOCl 中磁场诱导的多样磁振子谱
articles.abstract: Author(s): T. Riccardi, F. Le Mardélé, L. A. Veyrat de Lachenal, A. Pawbake, I. Plutnarova, Z. Sofer, G. Jacquet, F. Petot, A. Saúl, B. Grémaud, A. L. Barra, M. Orlita, J. Coraux, C. Faugeras, and B. A. Piot Magnonic excitations are investigated in the CrOCl van der Waals (vdW) antiferromagnet with absorption experiments in a broad continuous energy range. In an external magnetic field, the dispersions of magnon branches characteristic of different magnetic orders are subsequently observed, revealing a strong biaxial anisotropy, hysteretic magnon spectra, as well as the formation of spatially separated magnetic phases. Theexperiments here show that competing exchange interactions broaden the options to generate different kinds of magnonic excitations within the same vdW material. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 024419] Published Tue Jul 21, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过宽连续能量范围的吸收实验考察范德华反铁磁体 CrOCl 中的磁振子激发。在外加磁场下，实验依次观测到与不同磁有序态相关的磁振子分支色散，揭示出强双轴各向异性、具有滞后的磁振子谱以及空间分离磁相的形成。结果表明，竞争性交换相互作用可在同一种范德华材料中产生多类磁振子激发，为调控低维磁振子谱提供了额外自由度。
authors: T. Riccardi, F. Le Mardélé, L. A. Veyrat de Lachenal, A. Pawbake, I. Plutnarova, Z. Sofer, G. Jacquet, F. Petot, A. Saúl, B. Grémaud, A. L. Barra, M. Orlita, J. Coraux, C. Faugeras, and B. A. Piot

articles.title: Transient localization from fractionalization: Vanishingly small energy transport in gapless quantum magnets
articles.title_zh: 由分数量子化导致的瞬态局域化：无能隙量子磁体中近乎消失的能量输运
articles.abstract: Author(s): Shi Feng, Penghao Zhu, Johannes Knolle, and Michael Knap Disorder-free localization is usually associated with dynamics far from equilibrium. Here, the authors uncover a new mechanism in the low-energy sector of clean, gapless quantum magnets: transient localization from mass-imbalanced fractionalization. Studying the dynamical response in the gapless phase of a translation-invariant Kitaev ladder model, they show that fractionalization creates a coherent superposition of quasistatic flux-disorder configurations in the ground state, preserving translation symmetry while strongly suppressing correlation spreading and energy transport. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 034423] Published Tue Jul 21, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种洁净、无能隙量子磁体低能区中的无序-free 瞬态局域化机制，区别于通常与远离平衡动力学相关的局域化现象。作者研究平移不变 Kitaev 梯模型无能隙相中的动力学响应，发现质量不平衡的分数化会在基态中产生准静态通量无序构型的相干叠加。该叠加在保持平移对称性的同时显著抑制关联传播和能量输运，说明分数化可在无显式无序条件下诱导强动力学迟滞。
authors: Shi Feng, Penghao Zhu, Johannes Knolle, and Michael Knap

articles.title: Thermodynamics and phase stability of the AlTiCrMoW high-entropy alloy simulated using machine-learned interatomic potentials

The Fermi surface is shown to derive mainly from the dₓ²₋y² d x 2 − y 2 bands, with minimal involvement from the dz² d z 2 band.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道在双层镍酸盐 La₃Ni₂O₇ 中观测到与超导相关的前沿能隙结构。实验显示其费米面主要来源于 Ni 的 dₓ²₋y² 能带，而 d_z² 能带贡献较小。该结果为理解镍酸盐超导能隙和轨道选择性提供了直接谱学证据。

articles.title: Differential reflectance Signature of Fano Resonance and Antiresonance in a Reflective Au Diffraction-Grating Structure
articles.title_zh: 反射式 Au 衍射光栅结构中 Fano 共振与反共振的差分反射特征
articles.abstract: We investigate the differential reflectance signature of Fano resonance and antiresonance in a reflective plasmonic grating structure. A double-layer Au diffraction grating—designed to operate in contact with ethanol under 780-nm illumination from the analyte side—is fabricated on a sapphire substrate using electron-beam lithography and vacuum deposition. Rigorous coupled-wave analysis reveals an asymmetric reflectance peak with steep angular variation, while numerical differentiation of the reflectance spectrum produces a sharp differential reflectance dip. Reflectance mapping combined with Rayleigh anomaly and propagating surface plasmon dispersion relations, along with electric-field distributions, indicates that the observed response originates from Fano-type coupling between localized surface plasmons at the grating edges and propagating surface plasmons at the Au/ethanol interface. Angular reflectance measurements reproduce both the asymmetric reflectance peak and differential reflectance dip, in good agreement with the simulations. The potential sensing performance is evaluated from the simulated refractive-index sensitivity and experimentally obtained linewidth. These results demonstrate that differential reflectance provides a useful readout of Fano resonance and antiresonance in reflective plasmonic grating sensors, particularly for low-refractive-index liquids.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察反射式等离激元 Au 双层衍射光栅中 Fano 共振和反共振的差分反射信号。严格耦合波分析和角分辨反射实验均显示非对称反射峰及尖锐差分反射谷，其来源被归因于光栅边缘局域表面等离激元与 Au/乙醇界面传播表面等离激元的 Fano 型耦合。作者还基于折射率灵敏度和实验线宽评估了该结构用于传感的潜力。

articles.title: Bridging Low-Mass and Massive-Star Magnetospheres: Persistent Auroral Radio Emission from the Strongly Magnetic M Dwarf CW~UMa
articles.title_zh: 连接低质量星与大质量星磁层：强磁 M 矮星 CW UMa 的持续极光射电辐射
articles.abstract: Auroral radio emission has been detected in both low-mass stars and magnetic massive stars, but these populations are generally interpreted within separate magnetospheric frameworks. We present evidence that the nearby M dwarf CW~UMa hosts a magnetosphere closely resembling those of magnetic B-type stars with auroral radio emission. Combining low-frequency radio and optical/IR spectropolarimetric observations, we detect highly circularly polarized (sim50--90%) coherent radio emission together with an unusually stable large-scale magnetic field. The longitudinal magnetic field remains unchanged over a six-year baseline, indicating a long-lived magnetic topology. Zeeman Doppler Imaging reveals a strong (sim2.7 kG), predominantly dipolar magnetic field viewed at high inclination with a nearly aligned magnetic axis, closely matching the geometry of the magnetic B-type star HR~5907. Although the total radio intensity varies between rotational cycles, the fractional circular polarization follows a stable rotational pattern, indicating variable plasma conditions within a persistent magnetospheric geometry. The inferred magnetospheric property naturally explains the persistent visibility of electron cyclotron maser emission and is consistent with the presence of a centrifugal magnetosphere. These results identify CW~UMa as a low-mass analogue of a magnetic massive star, and suggest that auroral radio emission is governed primarily by magnetospheric topology rather than stellar mass.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报告邻近 M 矮星 CW UMa 具有类似磁性 B 型星的稳定磁层和持续极光射电辐射。低频射电与光学/红外光谱偏振观测显示其存在高圆偏振相干射电辐射以及多年稳定的大尺度磁场，Zeeman Doppler 成像表明磁场强、近偶极且几何构型与 HR 5907 相似。结果提示低质量恒星和磁性大质量恒星的极光射电现象可在统一的磁层框架下理解。

articles.title: From Requirements to Production: Governing AI-Assisted Software Delivery through a Canonical Requirements Model
articles.title_zh: 从需求到生产：通过规范化需求模型治理 AI 辅助软件交付
articles.abstract: AI coding agents can accelerate software delivery, but the requirements artifacts business analysts produce were designed for human teams that fill specification gaps with tacit knowledge — a contract that breaks when the executor is a machine. This paper reports a design science study, conducted during the delivery of two independent production systems, that reconstructs the requirements package as a governed, AI-ready delivery framework. The framework rests on three designed elements: a canonical requirements model from which human- and agent-facing artifacts are generated as controlled projections; a dual-vendor build-and-review loop that applies separation of duties to autonomous agents; and documentation re-engineered as an executable control surface. The study addresses three research questions, presents the framework and its formalisation, demonstrates it across two dissimilar production systems, and reports six operational measures computed against the complete delivery record of each. Audited against the full version-control history and governance artifacts of both systems, the framework achieved 94.9% and 97.8% requirement trace coverage, 99.2% and 99.7% baseline compliance, a 0.00% unauthorised-edit rate in both, and defect escape rates of 9.1% and 4.7% — the latter within, the former just above, the industry best-in-class band — with the two cases differing fourfold in delivery pace and spanning two unrelated domains. The contribution is a governance architecture for AI-assisted delivery and a corresponding redefinition of the business analyst role; the evaluation is a two-case study without matched controls, both delivered by the same operator, and the paper states the methodological limits accordingly.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文研究 AI 编码代理参与软件交付时，传统面向人类团队的需求文档如何转化为可治理、可执行的 AI 就绪框架。作者提出规范化需求模型、双供应商构建—审查循环以及作为可执行控制面的文档体系，并在两个生产系统交付中进行设计科学验证。审计结果显示该框架在需求追踪覆盖率和基线合规性等运行指标上表现较高。

articles.title: Esterified Banana Peel Waste as a Sustainable Low-Cost Biosorbent for Heavy Metal Removal from Paint Manufacturing Wastewater: Process Engineering Assessment of pH, Concentration, Contact Time, Dosage, and Regeneration
articles.title_zh: 酯化香蕉皮废弃物作为可持续低成本生物吸附剂去除涂料制造废水重金属：pH、浓度、接触时间、投加量与再生的工艺评估
articles.abstract: The discharge of heavy metal-laden effluents from paint manufacturing operations is a significant and growing environmental hazard in industrialising economies, yet few biosorption studies test authentic multi-metal industrial effluent rather than synthetic single-metal solutions. This study investigates methanol/hydrochloric acid esterified banana peel waste (E-BPW) as a zero-cost biosorbent for removing chromium, nickel, cobalt, and lead from real paint manufacturing wastewater sourced from Brighto Paints Limited, Lahore, Pakistan. E-BPW was prepared by collection, drying, Tyler-standard sieve fractionation (850–1180 µm), and Fischer esterification with methanol and hydrochloric acid at 60°C for 48 h. Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy confirmed carboxyl, hydroxyl, and ester carbonyl groups as the principal metal-binding moieties. Batch adsorption experiments evaluated the effects of initial metal concentration, solution pH, contact time, and adsorbent dosage, with metal concentrations quantified by flame atomic absorption spectroscopy. Under optimised conditions (pH 6–8, 80 min, 5 g·L⁻¹, 25°C), E-BPW achieved removal efficiencies of 80.3% (Cr), 68.9% (Co), 63.1% (Pb), and 56.0% (Ni). Regeneration with 2 mol·L⁻¹ HNO₃ recovered 99.3% of adsorbed metals, indicating strong potential for circular reuse. These findings demonstrate that waste-to-resource valorisation of agricultural byproducts can deliver technically effective, low-cost heavy metal removal for small-to-medium industrial applications, supporting Sustainable Development Goal 6 and circular-economy principles. The absence of isotherm, kinetic, and surface-characterisation data is acknowledged as a limitation, and a research agenda toward pilot-scale validation is proposed.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究评估经甲醇/盐酸酯化处理的香蕉皮废弃物作为零成本生物吸附剂，用于去除真实涂料制造废水中的 Cr、Ni、Co 和 Pb。材料经筛分和 Fischer 酯化制备，红外光谱表明羧基、羟基和酯羰基是主要金属结合位点，并通过批量吸附实验考察初始浓度、pH、接触时间和吸附剂投加量等因素。在优化条件下，该吸附剂对多种重金属表现出较高去除效率，显示出低成本工业废水处理潜力。

articles.title: Co-identification of Vibration, Structural Looseness, and Surface Damage in Industrial Equipment Operation Videos
articles.title_zh: 工业设备运行视频中振动、结构松动与表面损伤的协同识别
articles.abstract: The process of industrial equipment deterioration generally has a continuous evolution characteristics, and in the early stage, there may be slight vibration and slight displacement at the local position, and as the deterioration progresses, the support may loosen, the connection will become abnormal, and the crack will gradually extend on the surface. It is challenging to modify motion status on the basis of defects that are detected in a single frame image; Only classification of video vibrations is not able to easily detect structural risks due to the surface damages. The inspection videos are selected from the author's library which contains videos of pump station pipelines, valve connection sections, bracket fixing areas, and metal shells for a total of approximately 36 hours with the original frame rate of 25 fps. About 72000 training images and 11000 test images are formed after the frame extraction and the screening, and the four types of vibration states (normal operation, slight vibration, periodic resonance and abnormal shaking), the two types of structure state (stable and suspected looseness) and the two types of surface defect boxes (cracks and corrosion) are synchronously labeled. The algorithm design separates the spatiotemporal features, the micro displacement features and the appearance damage features in turn before joint discrimination: The spatiotemporal features are captured by using the Video Swin Transformer to learn the movement rhythm and spatial texture variation of continuous frames; The micro-displacement features are obtained by using the RAFT optical-flow module to estimate the subtle displacement of the support and connection areas; The appearance damage features are obtained by the three multi task branches, which outputs the vibration status, the defect location score, and the structural looseness score, respectively. The experimental results show that the vibration-state recognition accuracy reaches 92.1%, the mAP@0.5 for crack and corrosion detection reaches 88.9%, and the Spearman correlation coefficient between the structural looseness score and the manual review result reaches 0.79.For the composite abnormal samples, the joint model is able to reduce the missed detections by approximately 16% when compared to the single task model, under the condition that there are slight vibrations in the composite samples and there are early cracks. It can be seen that peak amplitude of optical flow in the support area, local displacement variance and changes in texture in the area around defects are highly correlated with the increased risk of structural loosening. This study synergistically detects motion anomaly and surface damage exist in industrial inspection videos, and the integrity of the equipment state recognition is enhanced when being detected in the composite anomaly scenarios.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作面向工业设备退化过程中振动、局部位移、支撑松动以及表面裂纹/腐蚀等多类风险的联合视频识别。作者使用约36小时泵站管线、阀门连接段、支架固定区和金属外壳巡检视频，抽帧筛选形成约72000张训练图像和11000张测试图像，并同步标注四类振动状态、两类结构状态及裂纹/腐蚀目标框。研究重点在于克服单帧缺陷检测难以反映运动状态、单纯振动分类又难以捕捉表面损伤导致结构风险的问题。

articles.title: An Innovative Perspective to Profound Functions of the Brain: Hypothesis of Resonance of Closed Neural Network Geometries
articles.title_zh: 脑高级功能的一种新视角：闭合神经网络几何的共振假说
articles.abstract: Perception and consciousness can be reformulated as intrinsic properties of resonant dynamics in recurrent neural circuits. Despite extensive empirical characterization of cortical activity, existing models lack a principled mechanism explaining how temporally structured sensory inputs give rise to stable and reproducible perceptual states. Here, I introduce Resonance of Closed Neural Network Geometries (RCNNG), a theoretical framework in which the physical properties of sensory inputs induce the formation of physically instantiated closed neural geometries whose resonance profiles reflect the temporal–spectral structure of the input. These closed geometries arise from resonant patterns of the frequency spectrum in the repeating network, but the perceptual similarity does not depend on the geometric or topological similarity of the physical structures themselves. Instead, perceptual equivalence emerges when distinct physical geometries map to identical resonant identities in a higher-dimensional resonance state space constituting an intrinsic property of the resonant closed graph and its mapping into a perceptual state space. Dynamical systems analysis and simulations of adaptive recurrent networks show that repeated or coherent stimuli drive the system toward stable resonant attractors characterized by closed cycle dynamics encoding perceptual invariants such as color, shape, and multimodal conjunctions. Within this framework, perception corresponds to the resonance of the closed geometry generated by the input, whereas consciousness arises from the simultaneous or sequential resonance of multiple linked or unlinked closed geometries across the network as a whole. This global resonance process gives rise to an intrinsic phenomenological property termed innergence, which characterizes the first-person experiential aspect of resonant state space identities. RCNNG thus distinguishes between the physical formation of closed neural geometries and their resonant identities, providing a unified account of perceptual stability, memory recall, reactivation of sensory experiences, and the emergence of conscious experience.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出“闭合神经网络几何共振”（RCNNG）理论框架，将感知与意识解释为递归神经回路中共振动力学的内禀性质。该假说认为，具有时间结构的感觉输入可诱导物理实现的闭合神经几何，其共振谱反映输入的时频结构；感知相似性不要求底层几何或拓扑相似，而来自不同结构在高维共振状态空间中的相同共振身份。文中结合动力系统分析与自适应递归网络模拟，试图为稳定、可重复感知状态的形成提供机制性解释。

articles.title: Gaussian Reformulation of the Feynman Path Integral for Quantum Statistical Mechanics with Results for the Second Virial Coefficient of ⁴He
articles.title_zh: 量子统计力学中费曼路径积分的高斯重构及其在⁴He第二维里系数中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.16301v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Feynman path integral for quantum statistical mechanics is reformulated as Gaussian sampling of the neighborhood of each position configuration. The variance and mean are obtained from ring polymer statistics on a lattice, and from the high temperature expansion of the Wigner-Kirkwood commutation function, respectively. The algorithm avoids multiple temperature nodes for each configuration and the need for numerical cancelation in the statistical averages, which are problematic for conventional path integral quantum Monte Carlo. Analytic and simulation results for the second virial coefficient of helium are compared to laboratory measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文将量子统计力学的费曼路径积分重写为对每个位置构型邻域的高斯采样。采样方差由晶格上环聚合物统计给出，均值则来自Wigner-Kirkwood对易函数的高温展开。该算法避免了传统路径积分量子蒙特卡洛中每个构型需要多个温度节点以及统计平均中数值抵消的问题，并将氦的第二维里系数解析和模拟结果与实验测量进行比较。

articles.title: Quantitative Theory for the Amplitude of Fluorescence Quantum Beats from Geminate Triplet-Pair Fusion
articles.title_zh: 孪生三重态对融合荧光量子拍振振幅的定量理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.16461v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We derive the amplitude of quantum-beats in the fluorescence from geminate triplet-exciton fusion in rubrene and tetracene from the full set of parameters that characterize triplet exciton dynamics. We find that the amplitude depends on the fission time in tetracene, but does not do so in rubrene, where it is determined by the dimensionality of triplet transport. Kinetic Monte Carlo simulations reproduce the experimental data in both materials, for a fission time of the order of 200 ps and isotropic triplet transport int tetracene, and for a triplet hopping time along the herringbone axis of 250 ps and anisotropic transport in rubrene.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者从表征三重态激子动力学的完整参数出发，推导红荧烯和并四苯中孪生三重态激子融合所产生荧光量子拍振的振幅。结果表明，并四苯中的拍振振幅依赖单重态裂变时间，而红荧烯中则主要由三重态输运维度决定。动力学蒙特卡洛模拟可再现实验数据，对应并四苯约200 ps的裂变时间和各向同性输运，以及红荧烯中沿人字形轴约250 ps的三重态跳跃时间和各向异性输运。
authors: Zachary Rex, Bách Phdam Xuân, Gerald Curran III, Ivan Biaggio

articles.title: Bond reconstruction and vacancy clustering in monolayer silicon carbide from first principles
articles.title_zh: 单层碳化硅中键重构与空位团簇的第一性原理研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.16483v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bond reconstruction in vacancy-related structures affects their formation energies, symmetries, and electronic and optical properties. Using density functional theory, we investigate bond reconstruction mechanisms of monovacancies and vacancy aggregates in monolayer silicon carbide. Multiple bond descriptors reveal that isolated monovacancies undergo both in-plane reconstruction and out-of-plane distortion, which together shape their stability and electronic structure. For compact vacancy aggregates, we show that bond reconstruction acts as a key stabilization mechanism. However, in carbon monovacancy, reconstruction suppresses optical activity. In contrast, a highly stable aggregate composed of three carbon vacancies surrounding a silicon vacancy emerges as a promising infrared color-center candidate, combining a triplet ground state with a favorable Debye-Waller factor of the emission. These results highlight the role of bond reconstruction in defining the quantum properties of vacancy defects in two-dimensional silicon carbide.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用密度泛函理论考察单层碳化硅中单空位及空位聚集体的键重构机制。多种键描述符显示，孤立单空位同时发生面内重构和面外畸变，并共同决定其稳定性与电子结构；紧凑空位团簇中，键重构是关键稳定化机制。碳单空位的重构会抑制光学活性，而由三个碳空位围绕一个硅空位组成的高稳定团簇具有三重态基态和有利的发射Debye-Waller因子，被认为是潜在红外色心候选。

articles.title: Observation of Critical Current Minimum in Super-Honeycomb Josephson Junction Arrays
articles.title_zh: 超蜂窝约瑟夫森结阵列中临界电流极小值的观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.16500v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Superconductor-semiconductor Josephson junction arrays are a uniquely tunable platform for studying collective quantum phenomena, particularly in the regime where localized Andreev bound states can hybridize across the lattice when the physical separation between adjacent junctions is smaller than their coherence length (ξABS>dJJ). Here, we investigate three distinct Al-InAs Josephson junction arrays: a square array and super-honeycomb array fabricated within this ξABS>dJJ regime, as well as a larger-spacing super-honeycomb control device designed such that ξABSłesssim!~dJJ. Under an out-of-plane field, critical current peaks emerge at rational filling factors, reflecting stable vortex configurations in the lattices. In the super-honeycomb lattice, vortices localize to distinct non-identical plaquettes at different filling factors, as predicted by frustrated XY model simulations. A rotating in-plane field yields periodic critical current oscillations that reflect the Rashba spin-orbit coupling inherent to the InAs quantum well. Surprisingly, at f = 1, the closely spaced super-honeycomb array exhibits a distinct critical current minimum as the magnitude of the in-plane field increases, a signature absent in the square array and large-spacing super-honeycomb array. These results indicate that this signature is jointly influenced by the unique geometry of the super-honeycomb vortex lattice and by long-range inter-junction hybridization.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究Al-InAs超导体-半导体约瑟夫森结阵列，包括处于局域Andreev束缚态可跨晶格杂化条件下的方形阵列和超蜂窝阵列，以及较大间距的超蜂窝对照器件。外加垂直磁场下，临界电流在有理填充因子处出现峰值，反映晶格中的稳定涡旋构型；在超蜂窝晶格中，涡旋会在不同填充下定位于非等价小 plaquette，与受挫XY模型模拟一致。旋转面内磁场导致临界电流周期振荡，体现InAs量子阱的Rashba自旋轨道耦合；紧密间距超蜂窝阵列在f=1处还出现显著临界电流极小值。
authors: Melissa Mikalsen, Alexander-Georg Penner, Samuel D. Escribano, Nadav Drechsler, Arunav Bordoloi, Jacob Issokson, Felix von Oppen, Yuval Oreg, Javad Shabani

articles.title: Stroboscopic stability of a Floquet chiral spin liquid beyond the folding frequency
articles.title_zh: 超过折叠频率后Floquet手性自旋液体的频闪稳定性
