articles.title_zh: 铈氢化物的化学计量依赖性质：基于主动学习原子间势的研究

However, precise stoichiometric control is not experimentally straightforward and ab initio approaches are not computationally feasible for many propertie… [Phys. Rev. Materials 10, 073603] Published Mon Jul 20, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对铈氢化物随氢含量变化表现出的晶格收缩、致密化等性质，构建主动学习得到的原子间势以突破实验化学计量控制困难和从头算成本过高的限制。该方法用于在不同化学计量下考察铈氢化物的结构与材料性质，为大尺度或多组分氢含量模拟提供可行路径。

Rev. Materials 10, 074004] Published Mon Jul 20, 2026

A set of witnesses to certify the nonlinear-optical evolution is provided.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种自适应玻色采样架构，通过基于测量的反馈实现超出传统量子线性光学装置范围的光学演化。作者还给出一组见证量，用于认证所实现的非线性光学演化特征。

Here, the authors observe a giant nonlinear Hall conductivity in dual-gated Bernal bilayer graphene that manifests strongly in a field-driven isospin polarized phase.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察自发同位旋对称性破缺对量子非线性输运的影响。作者在双栅 Bernal 堆垛双层石墨烯中观测到巨大的非线性霍尔电导，该效应在场驱动的同位旋极化相中尤为显著。

articles.title: Transversal fault tolerant distributed quantum computing operations
articles.title_zh: 横向容错的分布式量子计算操作
articles.abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 20 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75693-3 Scalable quantum computers may be built by linking smaller modules, but errors on the connections pose a challenge. Here, authors simulate fault-tolerant operations across noisy links, showing distributed quantum computing can achieve very low error rates and guiding future hardware design.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作围绕由小型量子模块互连构建可扩展量子计算机的问题，重点处理模块间噪声链路带来的误差挑战。作者通过模拟跨噪声连接的容错操作，表明分布式量子计算有望实现很低的逻辑错误率，并为未来硬件连接设计提供参考。

articles.title: CADAQUES: A Cost-Aware Dual Architecture for Query-Efficient Autonomous Discovery
articles.title_zh: CADAQUES：面向查询高效自主发现的成本感知双架构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.16127v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Autonomous discovery systems couple a resource that answers queries (a simulator, instrument, or analytic model) to an algorithm that selects what to query next. Most software frameworks for this loop inherit the control structure of numerical optimization: campaigns run for a fixed number of iterations, query costs are absent from the programming interface, and decision-making is treated as free. In practice, queries may differ in cost by orders of magnitude, and planners built on large language models or expensive surrogates consume resources of their own. Here we present CADAQUES, an open-source Python framework built on one architectural principle: cost is a first-class primitive of the discovery loop. CADAQUES separates the loop into two structural protocols, an Oracle that answers queries and a Driver that proposes them, and charges both evaluations and decisions against a common vector-valued budget spanning wall time, CPU hours, monetary cost, and language model tokens. An append-only ledger records, for each transaction, the cost declared before execution and the cost settled afterwards, making their discrepancy an observable property of the campaign. We evaluate the architecture by locating the critical temperature of the two-dimensional Ising model from noisy finite-size estimates against the exact thermodynamic-limit reference. In this noisy setting, strategies that concentrate around the best observed result can be misled by noise-induced peaks, whereas a schedule that explores with cheap low-fidelity queries and refines with higher-fidelity ones yields lower and less variable errors than high fidelity throughout, at the studied budget scale. Metering adds tens of microseconds per iteration, three orders of magnitude below the cheapest oracle query. The framework is MIT-licensed and archived at Zenodo (doi:10.5281/zenodo.21293589).
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出开源 Python 框架 CADAQUES，将成本作为自主发现循环中的一等要素，而非仅按固定迭代次数运行。框架将系统划分为回答查询的 Oracle 与提出查询的 Driver，并把实验/仿真评估成本和决策成本统一计入包含时间、CPU 小时、货币成本和语言模型 token 的向量预算。其追加式账本记录执行前声明成本与执行后结算成本，使成本偏差本身成为可观测量。

articles.title: Surrogate modeling of drift-reduced Braginskii turbulence with resistivity-conditioned Koopman neural operators
articles.title_zh: 用电阻率条件化 Koopman 神经算子替代建模漂移约化 Braginskii 湍流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.15857v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learning-driven surrogate operators are developed for three-dimensional, nonlinear, flux-driven simulations of boundary plasma turbulence based on the two-fluid drift-reduced Braginskii model. Resistivity-conditioned Koopman neural operators (KNOs) are trained on Global Braginskii Solver (GBS) simulations, spanning low- to high-resistivity regimes. Separate fieldwise models are constructed for plasma density, electron temperature, electric potential, and vorticity. Evaluation at a held-out resistivity shows that the surrogates reproduce key short-horizon statistical features, including strong one-step agreement, spectral trends, and reduced pressure-gradient diagnostics. Field-dependent limitations remain, with vorticity showing the largest discrepancies and autoregressive rollout progressively departing from the reference simulation. The results demonstrate that resistivity-conditioned fieldwise neural operators provide useful fast emulators for selected boundary-plasma turbulence diagnostics, while stable long-horizon dynamical closure remains unresolved.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作为三维非线性通量驱动边界等离子体湍流构建机器学习替代算子，物理模型基于双流体漂移约化 Braginskii 方程。作者在不同电阻率区间的 Global Braginskii Solver 数据上训练电阻率条件化 Koopman 神经算子，并分别建立密度、电子温度、电势和涡量模型。测试表明模型可较好再现短时统计特征和谱趋势，但涡量误差较大，长时间自回归推进仍会偏离参考模拟。
authors: Ameir Shaa, Kyungtak Lim, Long Shan Chan, Claude Guet

articles.title: Quantum entanglement without transport: Leaky qubits offer route around noisy channels
articles.title_zh: 无需传输的量子纠缠：泄漏量子比特为绕开噪声信道提供路径
articles.abstract: The inevitable leakage of energy and information from a quantum system into its surrounding environment is the enemy of quantum technology. Now, researchers have demonstrated that it can be exploited to generate entanglement—the "resource" that quantum technologies use to perform tasks inaccessible to standard classical technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道介绍了一种利用量子系统与环境之间不可避免的能量和信息泄漏来产生纠缠的实验进展。传统上，泄漏和退相干被视为量子技术的主要敌人；该结果表明，在适当设计下，环境耦合反而可作为生成量子纠缠资源的工具，从而为规避有噪声传输信道提供新思路。

articles.title: Long range spatial correlations in the periodically driven transverse field Ising model
articles.title_zh: 周期驱动横场伊辛模型中的长程空间关联
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.15665v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We consider a periodically driven transverse field Ising model and study the long-time behavior of the correlations between the excitations in the spin chain. We show that the longest correlation length is defined by the interference between the topological defects induced by the analog of the Kibble-Zurek mechanism and those induced by the Floquet resonance. We show that although the correlations always have a finite correlation length since the system is integrable, the correlation length can be made arbitrarily large by tuning the drive period.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究周期驱动横场伊辛链中激发关联的长时间行为。作者指出，最长关联长度由类 Kibble-Zurek 机制诱导的拓扑缺陷与 Floquet 共振诱导缺陷之间的干涉决定。尽管由于模型可积性关联长度始终有限，但通过调节驱动周期可使其任意增大。

articles.title: Strong intervalley mixing between copropagating quantum Hall edge channels in a silicon MOSFET
articles.title_zh: 硅 MOSFET 中同向传播量子霍尔边缘通道之间的强谷间混合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.15675v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Copropagating quantum Hall edge channels provide a promising platform for compact electron interferometry and flying quantum states. In silicon, the valley degree of freedom offers a natural alternative to spin-resolved edge channels because spin-flip scattering is strongly suppressed by the weak spin-orbit interaction. Here, we investigate interchannel transitions between copropagating valley edge channels in a double-layer-gated silicon metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistor. With the bulk filling factor set to ν=2, two spin-polarized valley edge channels are brought into close proximity near a depleted side gate. We observe strong intervalley mixing, with a transition probability close to 1/2, indicating nearly complete equilibration between the two valley edge channels. In contrast, interchannel transport between edge channels with different spin orientations shows negligible transition probability, consistent with suppressed spin-flip scattering in silicon. These results demonstrate that intervalley coupling at a Si/SiO₂ interface can provide a beam-splitter-like operation for copropagating valley edge channels, establishing a key building block toward compact silicon quantum Hall interferometers.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在双层栅控硅 MOSFET 中考察体填充因子 ν=2 时两条自旋极化、谷分辨的同向量子霍尔边缘通道之间的通道跃迁。实验观察到接近 1/2 的谷间跃迁概率，表明两条谷边缘通道几乎完全平衡；相比之下，不同自旋取向边缘通道之间的跃迁几乎可忽略，符合硅中自旋翻转散射受抑制的预期。结果说明 Si/SiO₂ 界面处的谷间耦合可为同向传播谷边缘通道实现类似分束器的操作。

articles.title: Absence of Spin-Glass Order on Migdal--Kadanoff Hierarchical Lattices near Three Dimensions
articles.title_zh: 近三维 Migdal–Kadanoff 层级晶格上自旋玻璃有序的缺失
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.15676v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We derive a rigorous sufficient condition for the absence of spin-glass order in the Ising spin glass with symmetric binary couplings on Migdal--Kadanoff (MK) hierarchical lattices with even branching number. The key observation is that a single exact renormalization-group step creates zero effective bonds with positive probability, thereby reducing the problem to bond percolation on the corresponding hierarchical lattice. When the induced dilution exceeds the percolation threshold, both spin-glass order and stiffness are absent at all temperatures, including zero temperature. As a consequence, our criterion gives a rigorous proof that the Ising spin glass on the square lattice does not exhibit a spin-glass phase within the MK approximation. More unexpectedly, by choosing sufficiently large scale factors and branching numbers, we construct MK hierarchical lattices whose fractal dimensions are arbitrarily close to three from below but still exhibit no spin-glass order. This sharply contrasts with numerical estimates obtained for MK hierarchical lattices with relatively small scale factors and branching numbers, which placed the lower critical dimension near (2.52).
articles.abstract_zh: 作者为具有对称二元耦合、偶数分支数的 Migdal–Kadanoff 层级晶格上伊辛自旋玻璃不存在自旋玻璃有序给出了严格充分条件。核心在于一次精确重整化群变换会以正概率产生零有效键，从而将问题约化为相应层级晶格上的键渗流；当诱导稀释超过渗流阈值时，任意温度包括零温下均无自旋玻璃有序和刚度。该判据严格证明了 MK 近似下平方晶格不存在自旋玻璃相，并构造出分形维数可从下方任意接近三但仍无自旋玻璃有序的 MK 晶格。

articles.title: Fermion parity of an Andreev molecule probed by nonlocal Josephson effect
articles.title_zh: 通过非局域约瑟夫森效应探测 Andreev 分子的费米子宇称
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.15786v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fermion parity is a fundamental property of superconducting many-body states. Here, we show that the global fermion parity of a delocalized superconducting state can be detected locally by exploiting the nonlocal Josephson effect. Using a carbon nanotube-based Andreev molecule formed by two coupled quantum-dot Josephson junctions, we observe a pronounced nonlocal Josephson response and demonstrate the formation of delocalized Andreev molecular states extending across both junctions. We further show that changes in the molecular ground-state parity manifest as characteristic π-phase shifts in the nonlocal response. Supported by a minimal theoretical model, these results identify global fermion parity as an experimentally accessible degree of freedom in hybrid superconducting circuits that can be readily revealed through the nonlocal Josephson effect.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文展示了可利用非局域约瑟夫森效应在局域测量中探测离域超导态的全局费米子宇称。作者在由两个耦合量子点约瑟夫森结构成的碳纳米管 Andreev 分子中观测到显著非局域约瑟夫森响应，并证明 Andreev 分子态跨越两个结而离域。分子基态宇称变化表现为非局域响应中的特征 π 相移，表明全局费米子宇称可作为混合超导电路中的可实验读取自由度。
authors: S. Annabi, H. Riechert, K. Watanabe, T. Taniguchi, J. Griesmar, E. Arrighi, L. Bretheau, J. -D. Pillet

articles.title: Quantum and classical entropic complexity of the thermal state: coherence, decoherence, and the ergodic-to-localized crossover in random-matrix and many-body models
articles.title_zh: 热态的量子与经典熵复杂度：随机矩阵和多体模型中的相干、退相干及遍历—局域化交叉
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.15798v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Does thermal averaging preserve signatures of eigenstate complexity? We study the entropic complexity C = S₁ - S₂ (Shannon minus second-order Renyi entropy) across the ergodic-to-localized crossover of three disordered models: the Rosenzweig-Porter (RP) ensemble, the power-law banded random matrix (PLBRM) ensemble, and the random-field Heisenberg chain. We compare a wavefunction-level quantity Cₑᵢg to the complexity of the thermal (Gibbs) state before and after pointer-basis dephasing, via the trace (Cₜᵣ₎ and diagonal (C_diag) complexities. The answer is mostly no: thermal averaging strongly suppresses, but does not eliminate, eigenstate-complexity signatures. Cₑᵢg develops a pronounced mid-phase maximum in RP and, at matching fractal dimension, in the structurally independent PLBRM model; a high-statistics scan resolves a weak (about 10%) but reproducible thermal shadow of this peak in the thermal diagonal complexity. This feature is confined to the two random-matrix models; in the Heisenberg chain the eigenstate complexity instead peaks at the many-body localization transition. A second, genuinely thermal feature, an edge just inside the ergodic phase, has no eigenstate counterpart and, in PLBRM, recedes with system size. Both features are tracked by scale-invariant crossover indicators: the log-ratio of the trace and diagonal crossover temperatures, which vanishes upon localization, and the relative entropy of coherence. Entropic complexity thus cleanly separates thermal-state and eigenstate physics: a sharp wavefunction-level feature, reproducible across unrelated random-matrix constructions, leaves only a faint, structurally distinct imprint on thermal observables.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察热平均是否保留本征态复杂度的特征，比较了 Rosenzweig-Porter 系综、幂律带状随机矩阵和随机场 Heisenberg 链中遍历—局域化交叉处的熵复杂度 C=S₁−S₂。作者将波函数层面的本征态复杂度与 Gibbs 热态在退相干前后的迹复杂度和对角复杂度进行比较，发现热平均显著压低但并未完全抹去本征态复杂度信号。在两个随机矩阵模型中，本征态复杂度出现中间相峰值，热态对角复杂度中仍有约 10% 的可重复弱残影；而 Heisenberg 链中复杂度峰值出现在多体局域化转变附近。

articles.title: Photoelectrical readout and Ramsey interferometry of single shallowly implanted NV centers in diamond
articles.title_zh: 金刚石中单个浅层注入 NV 中心的光电读出与 Ramsey 干涉测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.15869v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Photoelectrical readout of the electronic spin state of the nitrogen-vacancy (NV) center in diamond is attracting significant interest due to the numerous advantages it possesses compared with conventional fluorescence readout. The higher charge carrier rate compared to the photon rate and the integration of the detection scheme on a chip can significantly advance quantum sensing and computing with color centers in diamond. Until now, photoelectric readout has been performed on ensembles of NV centers or single NV centers deep in ultrapure diamond substrates. However, many applications require the artificial creation and precise placement of shallow NV centers, and photoelectric detection of such centers has been challenging. Here we demonstrate photoelectrical readout and coherent control of the electronic spin of implanted shallow (sim10 nm) NV centers buried by diamond overgrowth. The photoelectrically measured Ramsey T₂^* agrees with conventional fluorescence readout and shows no measurable dependence on the readout photocurrent, for both shallow implanted and deep ingrown NV centers. We further find that overgrowth improves photoelectric readout by suppressing the background photocurrent. These results establish photoelectric readout as a viable route to chip-integrated, electrically detected nanoscale sensing and to spin registers based on engineered shallow NV centers.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文实现了经人工注入、深度约 10 nm 且经金刚石外延覆盖的浅层单 NV 中心电子自旋的光电读出和相干控制。光电测得的 Ramsey T₂* 与传统荧光读出一致，并且对读出光电流无可测依赖，这一结论同时适用于浅层注入和深层内生 NV 中心。结果表明，浅层精确定位 NV 中心也可与片上光电探测兼容，有利于金刚石色心量子传感和量子信息器件集成。
authors: Ilia Chuprina, Christoph Findler, Johannes Lang, Petr Siyushev, Fedor Jelezko

articles.title: Phase-controlled quasi-bound states in the continuum and thermoelectric enhancement in Majorana-quantum-dot nanostructures
articles.title_zh: Majorana–量子点纳米结构中相位可控的准连续谱束缚态与热电增强
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.15990v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate how the interplay between Majorana zero modes (MZMs) and bound states in the continuum (BICs) governs the electronic thermoelectric response of a crossbar-shaped quantum dot (QD) coupled to two topological-superconductor nanowires. Using the Green-function formalism, exact linear-response energy integrals, and their low-temperature Sommerfeld expansion, we analyze the spectral and thermoelectric properties of the system. We show that symmetry breaking converts BICs into quasi-BICs, allowing them to contribute to electrical and thermal transport and thereby generate a finite thermoelectric response. While unequal nanowire lengths, reflected in different intra-Majorana coupling strengths, produce only a modest enhancement of ZTₑₗ, detuning the QD level increases ZTₑₗ by approximately one order of magnitude. Superconducting-phase control produces a much stronger enhancement, reaching ZTₑₗ simeq 0.75 through a quadratic transmission zero and a pronounced violation of the Wiedemann-Franz law. The low-temperature values ZTmaxₑₗ simeq 0.755 and mathscrL /mathscrL₀ = 21/5 are universal consequences of this quadratic antiresonance. Our results establish phase-tunable thermoelectric signatures of the Majorana-coupled interference structure and identify superconducting-phase control as an efficient means of engineering the electronic response of topological hybrid nanostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者研究交叉结构量子点与两根拓扑超导纳米线耦合时，Majorana 零模和连续谱束缚态对电子热电响应的共同影响。格林函数和线性响应分析表明，对称性破缺可将 BIC 转化为准 BIC，使其参与电荷和热输运并产生有限热电响应。量子点能级失谐可使电子热电优值 ZTₑₗ 提高约一个数量级，而超导相位调控带来更强增强，ZTₑₗ 可达约 0.75，并伴随二次透射零点和明显违反 Wiedemann-Franz 定律的行为。
authors: Alejandro Garrido, David Zambrano, Hishan Farfán-Bachiloglu, Juan Pablo Ramos-Andrade, Vladimir Juričić, Pedro Orellana

articles.title: Drosophila of phonon-mediated superconductivity: Full Eliashberg theory of the jellium model
articles.title_zh: 声子介导超导的“果蝇”模型：均匀电子气模型的完整 Eliashberg 理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.15996v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a full numerical solution of the Migdal--Eliashberg equations for the jellium model of phonon-mediated superconductivity. We find very low critical temperatures below 1~K, in contrast to earlier claims that the jellium model for hydrogen solids might reach room-temperature superconductivity. Our results suggest that full momentum and frequency dependence of the gap function and normal self-energy should be taken into account for accurate T_c estimates.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文对声子介导超导的均匀电子气模型进行了 Migdal–Eliashberg 方程的完整数值求解。结果显示其临界温度很低，低于 1 K，与早期关于氢固体均匀电子气模型可能达到室温超导的说法相矛盾。作者强调，为可靠估算 Tc，需要保留能隙函数和正常自能的完整动量与频率依赖。
authors: Christophe Berthod, Louk Rademaker, Dirk van der Marel

articles.title: Negative quantum friction in nanoscale water flows: the Wigner picture
articles.title_zh: 纳米尺度水流中的负量子摩擦：Wigner 图像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.16011v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We explore the phenomenon of "quantum" friction based on a single-particle model patterned after the Wigner equation describing electrons flow in a solid wall confining nanoscale water flows. The numerical simulations show a clear signature of negative quantum friction, namely a net momentum transfer from the electrons in the solid wall to the flowing water molecules. Such net momentum transfer results into a sizeable reduction of the water friction, up to forty percent, depending on the strength of the coupling between classical and quantum fluctuations. Our results offer the prospect of a theoretical framework bridging classical and quantum description by using continuum kinetic theories and particle-based simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究基于类似 Wigner 方程的单粒子模型，描述限制纳米水流的固体壁中电子流动，并探索所谓量子摩擦效应。数值模拟显示出负量子摩擦的特征，即固体壁电子向流动水分子净转移动量。该动量转移可显著降低水的摩擦，降幅最高约 40%，具体取决于经典涨落与量子涨落耦合强度；该框架有望连接连续动理论和粒子模拟中的经典—量子描述。
authors: Adriano Tiribocchi, Marco Lauricella, Efthimios Kaxiras, Sauro Succi

articles.title: Magnons reveal topology and dynamics of a skyrmion crystal
articles.title_zh: 磁振子揭示斯格明子晶体的拓扑与动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.16023v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Although individual skyrmions are topologically protected objects, their cooperative crystalline order is fragile, easily disrupted by thermal fluctuations or other external perturbations. Probing the internal dynamics of such a crystal is both compelling and challenging, as its intricate and delicate spin texture must remain stable during measurement. Here, we engineer a nanoscale graphene junction hosting a skyrmion Wigner crystal, embedded between magnon emitters and detectors. The skyrmion crystal geometry leaves a striking imprint on magnon transport: as the gate voltage is varied, near-periodic windows of sharp fluctuations in magnon count are detected across the entire sample. We develop an interpretation that this results from skyrmions being added one by one to a quasi-one-dimensional array. Each burst of the fluctuations thus corresponds to the entry of an additional skyrmion, during which the lattice stiffness reduces. The impinging magnons induce and act as a probe of non-equilibrium collective dynamics of the crystal. These results establish a real-space probe of topological spin textures in quantum Hall-type insulating ground states via magnon transport and open opportunities to explore correlated, topologically ordered phases in moire and multilayer graphene systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作构筑了一个纳米尺度石墨烯结，在磁振子发射器和探测器之间容纳斯格明子 Wigner 晶体，用磁振子输运探测其内部动力学。实验发现，随栅压变化，整个样品中出现近周期性的磁振子计数尖锐涨落窗口，作者将其解释为斯格明子逐个进入准一维阵列所致。每次涨落爆发对应新增一个斯格明子并伴随晶格刚度降低，说明入射磁振子既能激发也能探测斯格明子晶体的非平衡集体动力学。
authors: Raphael Ayache, Nilotpal Chakraborty, Manabendra Kuiri, Quentin Benichou, Antonio Lacerda-Santos, Lilian Seyve, Himadri Chakraborti, Leo Pugliese, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Cosimo Gorini, Roderich Moessner, Benoit Doucot, Preden Roulleau

articles.title: Coherent driving of displacive Higgs fluctuations in superconductors
articles.title_zh: 超导体中位移型 Higgs 涨落的相干驱动
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.16055v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Intense phase-stable terahertz (THz) laser pulses can drive collective modes coherently via multi-photon excitation pathways in a manner different than the standard resonant mechanism operative in linear response. Here we show that in superconductors the nonlinear optical response can be enhanced when excited quasiparticles activate a (non-resonant) static displacement of the superconducting order parameter, in full analogy with the displacive excitation of coherent phonons in opaque materials. By combining numerical simulations with analytical results we demonstrate that the displacive mechanism to excite the Higgs mode is operative in both s-wave and d-wave superconductors. We validate this prediction experimentally by the temperature dependence of the phase of the nonlinear first harmonic in superconducting s-wave NbN. We also discuss how the order-parameter relaxation at large times, which can be experimentally accessed via pump-probe protocols is connected to energy-dissipative processes. Our results offer a novel perspective on the ability of intense THz fields to measure, and eventually control, the parametric dependence of the optical response on collective degrees of freedom.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究强相位稳定太赫兹脉冲如何通过非线性多光子过程相干激发超导集体模。作者提出，光激发准粒子可诱导超导序参量的非共振静态位移，从而以类似不透明材料中位移型相干声子的机制增强 Higgs 模响应；数值与解析结果表明该机制适用于 s 波和 d 波超导体。NbN 中非线性一阶谐波相位的温度依赖实验验证了这一图像，并进一步讨论了长时间序参量弛豫与耗能过程的关系。
authors: Jacopo Fiore, Irene Zanotti, Kota Katsumi, N. P. Armitage, Claudio Castellani, Goetz Seibold, Lara Benfatto

articles.title: Excitonic structure in CsPbBr₃ nanocubes, nanorods and nanoplatelets: the effect of dimensionality
articles.title_zh: CsPbBr₃ 纳米立方体、纳米棒与纳米片中的激子结构：维度效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.16142v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a theoretical study comparing the excitonic ground state properties of CsPbBr₃ nanocrystals with different dimensionality: nanorods (1D), nanoplatelets (2D) and nanocubes (3D). All three systems are described on equal footing, by means of a general variational effective mass model, which captures the influence of quantum confinement, dielectric confinement, electron-hole correlations and polaronic effects (within a Haken model). The strongly confined directions squeeze the exciton (X) wavefunction and enhance Coulomb attractions along the weakly confined directions. This stimulates superradiance, thus making radiative recombination rates speed up from cubes to platelets and to rods, in line with recent experiments. The anisotropic local field factor is a secondary, yet non-negligible, mechanism further enhancing radiative rates. X binding energies are also determined primarily by the directions of strong confinenement, which is also consistent with experiments. Weakly confined directions become however influential for small aspect ratios. Dielectric confinement plays a major role in determining the binding energies, and less so in the interparticle-distances. For all dimensionalities, the biexciton (XX) geometry is that of a distorted tetrahedron, rather than squared or linear distributions that would result in Coulomb-governed 2D and 1D structures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文用统一的变分有效质量模型比较了 1D 纳米棒、2D 纳米片和 3D 纳米立方体 CsPbBr₃ 纳米晶的激子基态性质，模型同时考虑量子限域、介电限域、电子-空穴关联以及 Haken 模型下的极化子效应。强限域方向压缩激子波函数，并增强弱限域方向上的库仑吸引，从而促进超辐射，使辐射复合速率由立方体到纳米片再到纳米棒逐步加快。激子束缚能主要由强限域方向决定，介电限域起关键作用；在小长宽比时，弱限域方向也会明显影响束缚能。
authors: Jose L. Movilla, Josep Planelles, Juan I. Climente

articles.title: Enhanced Third-Harmonic Generation in Diamond Photonic Crystal Slabs via Doubly Resonant Quasi-Bound States in the Continuum
articles.title_zh: 利用双共振准连续谱束缚态增强金刚石光子晶体板中的三次谐波产生
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.15526v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We propose and numerically demonstrate doubly resonant third-harmonic generation (THG) in a diamond photonic crystal (PhC) slab, in which the fundamental harmonic (FH) and the third harmonic (TH) modes are simultaneously resonant within the same membrane. A hexagonal-lattice slab with triangular air holes is designed so that a K-point band-edge FH mode and a Γ-point quasi-bound-state-in-the-continuum (quasi-BIC) TH mode satisfy the frequency-tripling condition 3ømega₁approxømega₃. Modifying the hole shape from circular to equilateral triangular breaks the in-plane symmetry that otherwise forces the nonlinear coupling to vanish, thereby converting a TH mode with negligible overlap into one with finite while simultaneously reducing the required slab thickness. Guided by a closed-form expression for THG efficiency derived from coupled-mode theory, we design the unit cell and a PhC heterostructure cavity. Three-dimensional simulations of the designed cavity yield a normalized THG efficiency η=2.7×10⁻⁷~W⁻² under moderate quality factors, which is projected to reach ~0.034~W⁻² at the fabrication-limited quality factor (Q = 200,000). Because the operating wavelength is set by the lattice constant, this design, combined with the ultra-wide transparency window of diamond, can map a single geometry across various fabricable wavelengths, spanning from telecommunication bands to color-center-resonant visible and deep-UV outputs. These results establish a robust route toward efficient, monolithic on-chip frequency conversion in an all-diamond platform for quantum and nonlinear photonics.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出并数值验证了一种金刚石光子晶体薄板中的双共振三次谐波产生方案，使基频模与三倍频模在同一膜结构内同时共振并满足近似三倍频条件。通过将空气孔由圆形改为等边三角形，结构打破面内对称性，避免非线性耦合因对称性而消失，同时降低所需板厚。基于耦合模理论的效率公式，作者设计了单胞和异质结构腔，三维模拟得到中等品质因子下的归一化三次谐波效率为 2.7×10⁻⁷ W⁻²，并预测在加工受限品质因子 Q=200000 时可达约 0.034 W⁻²。
authors: Sangmin Ji, Satoshi Iwamoto, Hideki Gotoh

articles.title: Reconstruction of the noise correlation spectral density from the cavity emission in a two-qubit system
articles.title_zh: 由双量子比特系统的腔发射重构噪声关联谱密度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.15909v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A significant challenge in the field of large-scale fault-tolerant quantum computation is the influence of noise. In addition to the influence of noise on individual qubits, the smaller additional effect of noise correlations is also of high significance because correlated errors pose a challenge for quantum error correction. We describe the dynamics of two cavity-coupled qubits that are subject to correlated noise, assuming that the qubits are affected by longitudinal noise and not coupled directly. We find that the cavity emission enables the characterization of the noise correlations and describe the cases of white noise, quasi-static noise, and Ornstein-Uhlenbeck noise. For a known frequency spectrum, the reconstruction of the noise correlation spectral density from the cavity emission is possible by averaging over many different noise realizations. We demonstrate that, in the case of white noise, the noise correlation effects scale with the fifth order of the cavity-qubit coupling constant and are thus strongly suppressed compared with the case of quasi-static noise, where they scale with the third order. Furthermore, we present a method for extracting the noise correlation spectral density from the cavity emission in the case where the underlying noise type remains unidentified. This can be achieved by applying the convolution theorem.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究两个腔耦合量子比特在纵向相关噪声作用下的动力学，并假设量子比特之间无直接耦合。作者表明，腔发射可用于表征噪声关联，并分析了白噪声、准静态噪声和 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 噪声情形；若频谱形式已知，可通过对大量噪声实现取平均从腔发射重构噪声关联谱密度。结果显示，白噪声关联效应随腔-量子比特耦合常数的五阶缩放，显著弱于准静态噪声中的三阶缩放。

articles.title: Interactions and Reconnections of Four-Dimensional Quantum Vortices
articles.title_zh: 四维量子涡旋的相互作用与重联
articles.abstract: arXiv:2411.07943v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Interactions and reconnections of vortices are fundamental in many areas of physics, including classical and quantum fluids where they are central to understanding phenomena such as turbulence. In three-dimensional (3D) superfluids, quantum vortices are one-dimensional (1D) filaments that can intersect, reconnect, and recoil with irreversible dynamics described by near-universal scaling laws. We explore quantum-vortex reconnections in a four-dimensional (4D) superfluid, where a vortex is a two-dimensional (2D) surface. Using real-time numerical simulations, we find much richer behaviour than in 3D, including stable intersecting vortex surfaces which do not reconnect, and unusual vortex reconnections which occur without significant energy dissipation, which may indicate quasi-reversible dynamics. Our work raises many interesting questions about vortex physics in extradimensional systems, and may be further extended to look at vortex dynamics and turbulence in higher-dimensional spaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究四维超流体中量子涡旋的相互作用与重联，其中涡旋不再是三维中的一维线，而是二维曲面。实时数值模拟显示，四维涡旋动力学比三维更丰富，包括可稳定相交而不重联的涡旋面，以及几乎无显著能量耗散的异常重联过程。后者可能指向准可逆动力学，并为更高维空间中的涡旋物理和湍流研究提出新的问题。
authors: H. A. J. Middleton-Spencer, B. McCanna, D. Proment, H. M. Price

articles.title: Imaginary Time Formalism for Causal Nonlinear Response Functions
articles.title_zh: 因果非线性响应函数的虚时形式主义
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.21428v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: It is well established that causal linear response functions can be found by computing the much simpler imaginary time-ordered Matsubara functions and performing an analytic continuation. This principle is the basis for much of our understanding of linear response for interacting and disordered systems, via diagrammatic perturbation theory. Similar imaginary-time approaches have recently been introduced for computing nonlinear response functions as well, for example in [Annalen der Physik 536, 2300504 (2024); Physical Review X 11, 041006 (2021)], where the authors analytically continue the Matsubara functions to obtain the Keldysh response functions. In this work, we provide a proof of this connection to all orders in perturbation theory using an equation of motion based approach. We show by induction that causal nonlinear response functions at every order can be obtained from an analytic continuation of an appropriate time-ordered Matsubara function. We demonstrate this connection explicitly for second order response functions in the Lehmann representation. As a byproduct of our approach, we derive an explicit expression for the Lehmann representation of n-th order response functions by solving the equations of motion. We also use our result to find an analytic spectral density representation for both causal response functions and Matsubara functions. As an example, we apply our method to derive the non-linear A³ term in the SU(2) spin Hall response of an insulator with spin rotation symmetry. Finally, we show how our results lead to a family of generalized sum rules, focusing explicitly on the asymptotic expression for n-th harmonic generation rate. Our work opens the door to using imaginary time approaches to study nonlinear response functions in general condensed matter systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文证明，因果非线性响应函数可由适当的虚时时序 Matsubara 函数经解析延拓得到，从而将线性响应中成熟的虚时方法推广到任意阶非线性响应。作者采用基于运动方程的归纳证明，表明这一联系在微扰论各阶均成立。文中还在 Lehmann 表象下显式展示了二阶响应的对应关系，并由此得到相关响应函数的显式表达。

articles.title: The Post-Silicon Semiconductor Era: A Review of Physics, Synthesis, and Architectural Integration of Carbon Nanotube Field-Effect Transistors
articles.title_zh: 后硅半导体时代：碳纳米管场效应晶体管的物理、合成与架构集成综述
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.00947v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Silicon CMOS scaling is approaching a set of hard physical limits. Direct source-to-drain quantum tunneling, an unscalable subthreshold swing, and the thermal ceiling known as Dark Silicon motivate the search for a new channel material that can carry logic scaling forward. This review builds the case for single-walled carbon nanotubes (SWCNTs) as that material. We follow a continuous narrative from electronic-structure theory through synthesis to integration. The SWCNT bandgap and its near-ballistic transport limits are derived from the graphene zone-folding framework and the Landauer-Buttiker formalism. We benchmark these theoretical limits against ideal coaxial electrostatic bounds to evaluate how well the geometry suppresses short-channel effects before quantum tunneling takes over. Comparing this analytical framework against published 5 nm experimental data illustrates the aggressive subthreshold degradation driven by source-to-drain tunneling. Furthermore, we derive the exact areal-density equivalence between 1D and 2D quantum capacitance. This demonstrates that even close-packed arrays cannot fully close the dimensional gap to 2D materials, underscoring why superior carrier velocity and electrostatics must carry the CNTFET advantage. Next, we examine CoMoCAT growth and aqueous two-phase extraction against the semiconducting-purity demands of logic fabrication, alongside contact engineering and reversible chemical doping. A closing techno-economic analysis weighs this physics and process picture against IEEE IRDS roadmap projections and environmental health constraints. Taken together, the evidence points to materials purification, contact reliability, and bias temperature instability as the remaining practical barriers to commercial CNTFET adoption.
articles.abstract_zh: 这篇综述讨论硅 CMOS 缩放面临的源漏量子隧穿、亚阈值摆幅不可缩放和 Dark Silicon 热限制，并论证单壁碳纳米管可作为后硅逻辑沟道材料。文章从石墨烯区折叠能带理论和 Landauer-Büttiker 输运形式出发，梳理单壁碳纳米管带隙、近弹道输运极限及同轴静电控制能力，并与 5 nm 级实验数据对比，强调源漏隧穿导致的亚阈值退化。作者还讨论一维与二维量子电容的面积密度等价问题，指出即便紧密排布阵列也难完全弥合维度带来的差距。
authors: Suhas Suresh Bharadwaj, Reuben Thomas Thovelil, Rohith Chembattammal, Himnish Dave, Kabir Jaisinghani

articles.title: Shaping causality: programmable nonlocal signal generation in long-range spin systems
articles.title_zh: 塑造因果性：长程自旋系统中的可编程非局域信号生成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.22020v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Understanding how information spreads in non-relativistic many-body systems is a central issue for quantum information processing. While short-range interactions confine information within a local light cone, long-range interactions typically lead to uncontrolled nonlocal spread across the entire system. Here, we demonstrate that this apparent dichotomy is not fundamental and that nonlocality in systems with long-range interactions can be deterministically controlled. By mapping spin dynamics to a hard-core boson chain, we identify a regime in which the causal space-time landscape can be precisely shaped. We show that placing spin excitations in a polarized background allows a local perturbation to trigger nonlocal signals exactly at the positions of these excitations. These pre-selected sites act as seeds for new, effective light cones, allowing information to bypass the bulk and re-emerge at distant, programmable locations. This mechanism avoids uncontrollable global nonlocality while circumventing the speed limits associated with local transport. By engineering these nonlocal communication channels, our findings offer a versatile framework for information distribution relevant to quantum memories, error correction, and programmable platforms such as trapped ions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注非相对论多体系统中信息传播的可控性，特别是长程相互作用通常导致的非局域扩散。作者将自旋动力学映射到硬核玻色子链，识别出一种可精确塑造因果时空图景的机制：在极化背景中预先放置自旋激发，使局域扰动只在这些预选位置触发非局域信号。预选激发相当于新有效光锥的种子，使信息绕过体相并在远距离可编程地点重新出现，从而避免无控制的全局非局域性并突破局域输运速度限制。
authors: Shreyas Sadugol, Giuseppe Luca Celardo, Fausto Borgonovi, Lev Kaplan

articles.title: Thermodynamic Constraints on Perfect Equilibrium Superconducting Diodes
articles.title_zh: 完美平衡超导二极管的热力学约束
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.21384v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Superconducting diodes promise dissipationless rectification, yet equilibrium platforms without engineered junctions typically exhibit modest efficiencies. We identify a general thermodynamic origin of this behavior that is largely independent of microscopic details. Denoting ϵ = |I_c⁻/I_c⁺|, where I_c^± are critical currents in opposite directions with |I_c⁺|>|I_c⁻| by convention, we show that an exact perfect equilibrium diode (ϵ=0) is forbidden by continuity of the free energy. Asymptotically perfect behavior ϵ→0 is possible within a global equilibrium description, but requires free-energy singularities to enable softening of the unfavorable current-carrying branch. We demonstrate this explicitly in an exactly solvable Ising superconductor model. For smooth single-branch superconductors, standard finite-order polynomial Landau theory yields finite lower bounds on ϵ, while Josephson systems obey analogous bounds set by finite harmonic content of the current-phase relation. The high efficiencies often reported in Josephson platforms arise because such devices commonly operate under phase constraints, metastable switching, or external drive, thereby evading unconstrained equilibrium limits. Thus, our results provide a unified framework for interpreting diode efficiencies across superconducting platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文从热力学角度分析平衡超导二极管效率受限的普适原因，而不依赖具体微观模型。定义 ϵ=|I_c⁻/I_c⁺| 后，作者证明由于自由能连续性，严格完美的平衡二极管效应 ϵ=0 被禁止；若要实现渐近完美行为 ϵ→0，则需要自由能奇异性来软化不利方向的载流分支。可解 Ising 超导模型、有限阶 Landau 理论和有限谐波 Josephson 电流-相位关系均支持这一结论；许多 Josephson 平台中的高效率通常与相位约束、亚稳态开关或外部非平衡因素有关。

articles.title: Probing topological Floquet states in graphene with ultrafast terahertz scanning tunneling microscopy
articles.title_zh: 用超快太赫兹扫描隧道显微镜探测石墨烯中的拓扑 Floquet 态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.14875v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Floquet control of band topology is a central theme in ultrafast quantum materials science. Established experimental probes of light-induced topological states include ultrafast transport and time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, each with important strengths but also well-known limitations. Here we propose ultrafast terahertz scanning tunneling microscopy (THz-STM) as a real space energy-resolved probe of Floquet physics. We show that THz-STM enables direct local detection of bulk Floquet gaps and distinct Floquet edge state signatures. We derive a nonequilibrium Green's-function formalism for time-dependent tunneling that directly extends standard STM theory and provides an intuitive interpretation of rectified ultrafast tunneling currents. We apply the approach to bulk graphene and graphene nanoribbons of variable width. For the bulk, we show that THz-STM provides direct spectroscopic access to Floquet-induced gap openings, and we contrast pulsed pump-probe protocols with the continuous-wave Floquet steady-state limit. For finite ribbons, we demonstrate time- and space-resolved imaging of Floquet-induced topological edge states and identify the ribbon-width scale below which edge state protection breaks down. We further show how band structures of graphene nanoribbons and Floquet chiral edge modes can be reconstructed via Floquet quasiparticle interference. Finally we demonstrate that chiral impurities that break time-reversal symmetry induce characteristic spatial THz-STM signatures that can be used as a direct probe of Floquet edge state chirality.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出将超快太赫兹扫描隧道显微镜作为实空间、能量分辨的 Floquet 物理探针，用于局域探测光诱导拓扑态。作者建立了适用于时变隧穿的非平衡格林函数形式主义，将常规 STM 理论推广到超快整流隧穿电流情形。应用于体石墨烯和不同宽度石墨烯纳米带后，结果表明 THz-STM 可直接谱学探测 Floquet 诱导的体能隙，并可时空分辨成像有限条带中的 Floquet 拓扑边缘态特征。
authors: Nils Jacobsen, Michael Schüler, Angel Rubio, Martin Wolf, Melanie Müller, Michael A. Sentef

articles.title: Existence of a Phase Transition in the One-Dimensional Ising Spin Glass Model with Long-Range Interactions on the Nishimori Line
articles.title_zh: Nishimori 线上一维长程相互作用 Ising 自旋玻璃模型相变的存在性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.07130v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Dyson [Commun. Math. Phys. 12, 91 (1969)] rigorously proved the existence of a phase transition in the one-dimensional Ising model with long-range interactions of the form r⁻α for 1 < α < 2. In the present study, we extend this result to the Ising spin glass model with Gaussian disorder on the Nishimori line. Following Dyson's method, we first prove the existence of long-range order at finite low temperatures in the Dyson hierarchical Ising spin glass model on the Nishimori line, with power-law-like interactions J(r) sim r⁻α for 1 < α < 3/2. The key ingredients of the proof are the interpolation method developed in the rigorous analysis of mean-field spin glass models, the Gibbs--Bogoliubov inequality on the Nishimori line, and the Tsirelson--Ibragimov--Sudakov inequality (Gaussian concentration inequality). We then use the Griffiths inequality on the Nishimori line to rigorously establish the existence of a phase transition in the one-dimensional Ising spin glass model with long-range interactions on the Nishimori line for 1 < α < 3/2. For 3/2 łe α łe 2 , the existence of a phase transition remains an open problem.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将 Dyson 关于一维长程 Ising 模型在 1<α<2 存在相变的严格结果推广到 Nishimori 线上的高斯无序 Ising 自旋玻璃。作者首先沿用 Dyson 方法，证明具有类幂律相互作用 J(r)∼r⁻α 的 Dyson 层级 Ising 自旋玻璃在 1<α<3/2 的有限低温下存在长程序。关键工具包括平均场自旋玻璃严格分析中的插值方法、Nishimori 线上的 Gibbs-Bogoliubov 不等式以及 Gaussian concentration 不等式；随后借助 Nishimori 线上的 Griffiths 不等式证明对应一维长程模型存在相变，而 3/2≤α≤2 的情形仍未解决。

articles.title: Large CISS Polarization from the Hierarchy Between Transport and Geometrical Spin Currents
articles.title_zh: 输运自旋流与几何自旋流层级导致的大 CISS 极化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.30670v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large spin polarization observed in chiral-induced spin selectivity (CISS) remains difficult to explain quantitatively. Experimental polarizations measured in chiral molecular systems are often substantially larger than expected from weak microscopic spin-orbit interaction in organic materials. We revisit the geometrical spin current introduced previously for electrons constrained to curved paths and propose a scale argument relevant to transport through double-stranded DNA (dsDNA). Estimation of the intrinsic geometrical spin-current scale using representative dsDNA parameters yields current magnitudes substantially larger than measured transport currents in many CISS experiments. We suggest that this hierarchy allows transport to be interpreted as weak leakage from underlying curved spin-current states. Within this picture, large CISS polarization emerges as transport selection of pre-existing spin-current branches.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文试图解释手性诱导自旋选择性实验中常见的异常大自旋极化，其量级往往超过有机材料弱自旋-轨道耦合的直观预期。作者重新考察受限于弯曲路径电子的几何自旋流，并针对双链 DNA 输运给出尺度估算，发现内禀几何自旋流尺度可显著大于许多 CISS 实验中的测量输运电流。基于这一层级关系，文章提出输运可视为从底层弯曲自旋流态中的弱泄漏，而大 CISS 极化源于输运对预先存在的自旋流分支的选择。
authors: Zeev Vager (Weizmann Institute of Science, Rehovot, Israel)

articles.title: Electronic Structure Calculations from Occupation Numbers on Quantum Computers
articles.title_zh: 基于量子计算机上占据数的电子结构计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.15425v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a quantum-classical algorithm for electronic structure calculations that dramatically reduces the quantum measurement cost of variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) approaches. While conventional VQE methods require measurements scaling as O(M⁴⁾ with system size M, the proposed occupation-number VQE (ON-VQE) reduces this cost to O(M/2) by avoiding reduced density matrix (RDM) measurements and relying exclusively on ONs. The method exploits only the diagonal elements of the one-particle RDM in the natural orbital representation, where occupations are obtained directly from computational-basis measurement outcomes. By restricting the variational ansatz to double excitations within orbital subspaces associated with electron pairs, the required measurements can be grouped into a small number of qubit-wise commuting observables, yielding an efficient and scalable measurement strategy. The approach is validated through simulations and executions on quantum hardware for the cubic H₈ cluster, demonstrating the feasibility of extracting accurate ONs from quantum measurements and evaluating electronic energies within the natural orbital functional (NOF) framework. Across representative molecular systems, the extracted ONs enable accurate energy evaluation with state-of-the-art NOFs while maintaining a dramatically reduced measurement cost. These results establish a scalable route toward quantum simulation of strongly correlated electronic systems, demonstrating that accurate electronic energies can be obtained from quantum measurements of ONs alone.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种量子-经典混合的占据数 VQE（ON-VQE）电子结构算法，通过避免约化密度矩阵测量、仅依赖自然轨道表象下一粒子约化密度矩阵的对角占据数，将常规 VQE 中随体系规模约为 O(M⁴) 的测量开销降至 O(M/2)。方法将变分 Ansatz 限制为电子对相关轨道子空间内的双激发，使所需观测量可归并为少量逐量子比特对易组。作者以立方 H₈ 团簇的模拟和量子硬件实验验证了从计算基测量中提取占据数并据此评估自然轨道能量的可行性。
authors: Edison X. Salazar, Juan Felipe Huan Lew-Yee, and Mario Piris

articles.title: Three-dimensional three-photon Stark spectroscopy of a single Rb Rydberg atom in an ultrahigh-vacuum glass cell with eight electrodes
articles.title_zh: 八电极超高真空玻璃池中单个 Rb 里德堡原子的三维三光子斯塔克光谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.15764v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum computing and quantum simulation with ultracold neutral atoms require Rydberg excitation of individual atoms in atomic arrays. Rydberg states are extremely sensitive to external electric fields, therefore precise three-dimensional control of the electric field is essential. We performed a spectroscopic study of three-photon Rydberg excitation of a single Rb atom in an optical dipole trap in the presence of an external DC electric field. The field was generated by eight electrodes deposited on the inner surfaces of an ultrahigh-vacuum glass cell. The used three-photon scheme of laser excitation of Rydberg nP states allows the Stark shift and the splitting of the resonances to be observed simultaneously, which simplifies calibration of the electric field. In addition, in the commonly used two-photon Rydberg excitation schemes, the light shifts can complicate accurate determination of the DC Stark shift, particularly when the external electric field is scanned across different spatial directions, and different Stark components are excited. These shifts are absent in the three-photon excitation scheme used in our experiment. We demonstrated the ability to independently tune the electric field along all three spatial directions and to compensate for stray electric fields. The measured three-photon spectra exhibit Stark shifts and splittings of the three-photon resonance that are in good agreement with theoretical calculations. These results are also of interest for Rydberg electrometry.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究了光偶极阱中单个 Rb 原子在外加直流电场下的三光子里德堡激发光谱，电场由沉积在超高真空玻璃池内表面的八个电极产生。三光子方案激发里德堡 nP 态，可同时观测斯塔克位移与谱线分裂，从而简化三维电场标定。相较常用两光子方案，该方案避免了光移对直流斯塔克位移精确测定的干扰，尤其适用于扫描不同空间方向电场和不同斯塔克分量的情形。
authors: S. A. Spirin, E. A. Yakshina, A. K. Sologub, G. Suliman, A. M. Minnigaliev, V. V. Gromyko, P. I. Betleni, D. B. Tretyakov, V. M. Entin, N. N. Bezuglov, I. I. Beterov, I. I. Ryabtsev

articles.title: Reconfigurable Nonlocal Light-Emitting Metalens Nanolasers via Bound States in the Continuum
articles.title_zh: 基于连续谱束缚态的可重构非局域发光超透镜纳米激光器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.15852v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The development of on-chip, reconfigurable coherent light sources operating in the visible spectrum is critical for next-generation optical computing and high-speed data processing. Here, we demonstrate an all-optically tunable nanolaser based on a hybrid dielectric metasurface. The platform integrates a Rhodamine B (Rd B) dye gain medium with a Niobium Pentoxide (Nb2O5) metasurface supporting a high-Q Bound State in the Continuum (BIC) resonance. Active, non-volatile tuning is achieved by incorporating the low-loss phase change material (PCM) Antimony Trisulfide (Sb2S3). We demonstrate room-temperature lasing at 616 nm with Q-factor > 2050. A continuous-wave (CW) laser is utilized for the crystallization of the PCM, tuning the lasing emission to crystalline at 621 nm with Q-factor > 1454, while a near-infrared (NIR) ps-laser triggers its re-amorphization. This robust, thermally protected optical-only control scheme, combined with a phase-gradient metasurface design, realizes a coherent, nonlocal light-emitting metalens for simultaneous lasing wavelength tuning and wavefront control. This work provides a foundational demonstration of an all-optical tunable metalens-based nanolaser for applications in high-speed optical communication, neuromorphic photonics, dynamic holographic displays, and reconfigurable quantum light sources.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文展示了一种全光可调的可见光片上纳米激光器，基于含 Rhodamine B 增益介质的 Nb₂O₅ 混合介质超表面，并利用高 Q 连续谱束缚态共振实现室温激射。通过引入低损耗相变材料 Sb₂S₃，作者用连续波激光实现晶化调谐、用近红外皮秒激光实现再非晶化，激射波长由 616 nm 调至 621 nm，同时保持较高 Q 因子。结合相位梯度超表面设计，该平台实现了激射波长调谐与波前控制一体化的相干非局域发光超透镜。

articles.title: Nuclotron internal target polarimeter for the measurements of the deuteron and proton beam polarization
articles.title_zh: 用于测量氘核束和质子束极化的 Nuclotron 内靶偏振计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.15892v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Studies of spin-dependent effects at the Nuclotron/NICA accelerator complex at JINR require precise measurements of the deuteron and proton beam polarization. The vector polarization of the deuteron beam was measured at the energies of 200, 500, 550, and 650 MeV/nucleon by a detection system of scintillation counters placed at the Nuclotron internal target. Considering the deuteron beam as a beam of weakly bound protons and neutrons, the asymmetries of scattering of protons from deuterons on polyethylene and carbon targets were determined. The polarization of the polarized proton beam accelerated for the first time at the Nuclotron up to 500 MeV was also measured.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文报道了 JINR Nuclotron/NICA 加速器复合体中用于自旋相关效应研究的束流极化测量，重点是内靶闪烁计数器探测系统对氘核束和质子束偏振的表征。作者在 200、500、550 和 650 MeV/核子能量下测量了氘核束矢量极化，并在将氘核视为弱束缚质子-中子体系的近似下分析了聚乙烯和碳靶上质子-氘核散射不对称性。文中还给出了 Nuclotron 首次加速至 500 MeV 的极化质子束的偏振测量结果。
authors: I. S. Volkov, V. P. Ladygin, A. V. Averyanov, E. V. Chernykh, D. Enache, Yu. V. Gurchin, A. Yu. Isupov, M. Janek, J. -T. Karachuk, D. O. Krivenkov, P. K. Kurilkin, A. N. Livanov, S. M. Piyadin, S. G. Reznikov, Ya. T. Skhomenko, A. A. Terekhin, A. V. Tishevsky, T. Uesaka, I. E. Vnukov

articles.title: Cauchy-Paul wavelet transforms revisited: A framework for intermittent non-sinusoidal oscillations
articles.title_zh: 重新审视 Cauchy-Paul 小波变换：面向间歇性非正弦振荡的框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.15953v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper revisits the continuous wavelet transform framework by establishing a rigorous physical and dimensional formulation of the Cauchy-Paul mother wavelet, tailored specifically for intermittent, non-sinusoidal electrophysiological oscillations. Departing from conventional, purely mathematical definitions, we introduce a characteristic time scale τ into the frequency-domain formulation of the mother wavelet. This parameter ensures strict dimensional consistency by maintaining dimensionless functional arguments, thereby confining the physical dimension solely to the multiplicative normalization constant under both L¹⁽R) and L²⁽R) norms. A sharp dimensional and structural analysis of the resulting wavelet is conducted. We demonstrate that the spectral asymmetry inherent to the Cauchy-Paul wavelet dictates a strict mathematical hierarchy between three alternative reference frequencies: the peak (Lⁱⁿfty), the centroid (L¹⁾, and the energy-weighted (L²⁾ frequencies. Each frequency definition yields distinct quality factors (Q) and time-bandwidth characteristics that govern the time-frequency localization trade-off. To track multi-component EEG sleep pattern signals, a phase-based algebraic estimator is deployed alongside an advanced ridge-extraction method. The robust tracking performance and morphological adaptability of the proposed Cauchy-Paul framework are first numerically validated on synthetic transients, harmonics, and chirps, and subsequently applied to real, non-stationary EEG recordings to successfully isolate and decipher the non-sinusoidal signatures of sleep spindles.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文重新构建了 Cauchy-Paul 母小波的连续小波变换框架，面向间歇性、非正弦的电生理振荡信号，强调物理量纲一致性而非纯数学定义。作者在频域表达中引入特征时间尺度 τ，使函数自变量无量纲，并将物理量纲限制在 L¹ 和 L² 归一化常数中。文章进一步分析了该小波的谱不对称性，指出峰值频率、质心频率和能量加权频率之间存在严格层级，并给出相应品质因子与时频局域化权衡。
authors: P. Argoul, J. Taillard, F. Argoul

articles.title: Harnessing resonant dipolar interactions in a hybrid atom-molecule quantum system
articles.title_zh: 在混合原子-分子量子系统中利用共振偶极相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.15976v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hybrid quantum systems offer a route to combining the complementary strengths of distinct quantum platforms while mitigating their limitations. A particularly promising architecture combines neutral atoms and polar molecules: atoms provide fast, controllable interactions through excitation to Rydberg states, while molecules possess long-lived rotational states that are attractive for quantum memories and qudits. Although dipolar interactions between atoms and molecules have been observed in gas-phase and beam experiments, they have not previously been explored in a scalable optical tweezer platform that enables the controlled coherent interactions needed for quantum state transfer and entanglement. Here, we realise this goal, demonstrating coherent dipolar interactions between an individual Rydberg atom and an individual polar molecule. The separation of the particles is controlled using species-specific optical tweezers and their dipolar interactions are made strongly state-dependent by tuning two atom-molecule pair states into resonance. We exploit these interactions to demonstrate atom-mediated state readout of a molecular qubit, observe coherent spin exchange between the particles, and generate entanglement using a blockade-based controlled-NOT operation. Together, these results establish a coherent atom-molecule interface in which long-lived molecular quantum information can be rapidly mapped onto internal states of a Rydberg atom for readout or onward coherent transfer. This platform can be scaled to realise hybrid quantum processors utilising atom-mediated readout and entanglement of molecular qubits and mixed-species quantum simulators of dipolar systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作在光镊平台中实现了单个里德堡原子与单个极性分子之间的相干偶极相互作用，为中性原子和极性分子的混合量子体系提供了可扩展接口。实验通过物种选择性光镊控制粒子间距，并将两个原子-分子成对态调至共振，使偶极相互作用呈强烈态依赖性。作者进一步利用这种相互作用演示了由原子介导的分子量子比特态读出，体现了其在量子态转移和纠缠生成中的潜力。
authors: Daniel K. Ruttley, Tom R. Hepworth, Juan M. García-Garrido, Caleb J. H. Rich, Rosario González-Férez, Alexander Guttridge, Simon L. Cornish

articles.title: Quantum scanning synthetic optical holography
articles.title_zh: 量子扫描合成光学全息
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.16176v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Synthetic optical holography (SOH) introduced holographic reconstruction into scanning optical microscopy, enabling quantitative phase imaging with sequential acquisition and point detection. Here, we extend this concept to the quantum regime by implementing SOH within quantum imaging with undetected light (QIUL). By integrating a controlled synthetic phase carrier into a scanning QIUL implementation, we retrieve amplitude and phase images of objects probed by mid-infrared (MIR) photons while detecting only their visible partners. We demonstrate the method on binary, transparent, and biological samples, showing complex-field reconstruction in a scanning quantum imaging system. This approach decouples spatial resolution from photon-pair spatial correlations and establishes a route toward diffraction-limited, label-free MIR phase imaging with visible-wavelength detection.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文将合成光学全息引入未探测光量子成像，实现了扫描式量子成像中的复振幅重构。作者在扫描 QIUL 架构中加入受控合成相位载波，可用中红外光子探测样品、仅探测其可见光伙伴光子来恢复物体的幅度和相位图像。该方法在二值、透明和生物样品上得到演示，并将空间分辨率与光子对空间关联解耦，为可见探测的衍射极限、无标记中红外相位成像提供路径。
authors: Josué R. León-Torres, Byron Caiza, Nadia Baumann, Sebastian Töpfer, Anna Mühlig, Orlando Guntinas-Lichius, Karin Burger, Frank Setzpfandt, Markus Gräfe, Valerio Flavio Gili

articles.title: Deterministic atom-shuttle interconnects via ultrafast atom-ion entangling gate
articles.title_zh: 通过超快原子-离子纠缠门实现确定性原子穿梭互连
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.15597v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Neutral-atom arrays and trapped-ion crystals offer complementary strengths for fault-tolerant quantum computing but lack a fast way to deterministically interact. Here we propose a controlled-Z gate generated by the charge-induced-dipole (C₄₎ force between a Rydberg-excited atom and a trapped ion, balanced by a spin-dependent optical Magnus force on the ion that closes phase-space trajectories within a few microseconds. Toggling the Rydberg state extends the scheme to multi-ion crystals at negligible overhead. The resulting sim5,kHz atom shuttle accelerates short-distance QCCD links and enables hybrid qLDPC memories in which atom logical qubits are written onto an ion block treated as a passive storage zone. We perform circuit-level Monte Carlo simulations and find that the hybrid architecture supports orders of magnitude more operations than atom-only or ion-only architectures at fixed code distance and logical error rate.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种连接中性原子阵列与囚禁离子晶体的确定性受控 Z 门方案，利用里德堡激发原子与囚禁离子之间的电荷诱导偶极 C₄ 相互作用，并由离子的自旋依赖光学 Magnus 力闭合相空间轨迹。该门可在数微秒尺度完成，并可通过切换里德堡态扩展到多离子晶体而几乎不增加额外开销。作者进一步提出原子穿梭互连和混合 qLDPC 存储架构，并通过电路级蒙特卡罗模拟表明，在固定码距和逻辑错误率下其可支持的操作数显著超过纯原子或纯离子架构。

articles.title: Demonstration of deuterium's enhanced sensitivity to symmetry violations governed by the Standard-Model Extension
articles.title_zh: 氘对标准模型扩展所支配对称性破缺的增强敏感性演示
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.07473v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We have performed hyperfine spectroscopy of two transitions in ground-state deuterium and searched for violations of CPT and Lorentz symmetry that would manifest as sidereal variations of the observed transition frequencies. Several nonrelativistic proton coefficients of the Standard-Model Extension framework have been addressed. The spin-independent coefficients with momentum power k=2,4 are constrained for the first time. Bounds on spin-dependent coefficients are improved by exploiting a sensitivity enhancement originating from the relative momenta of the nucleons in the deuteron. The best previous constraints by hydrogen maser measurements are surpassed by 4 and 14 orders of magnitude for coefficients with k=2 and 4, respectively.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究对基态氘的两个超精细跃迁进行了光谱测量，寻找表现为跃迁频率恒星日变化的 CPT 和洛伦兹对称性破缺信号。分析在标准模型扩展框架下约束了若干非相对论质子系数，其中动量幂次 k=2 和 k=4 的自旋无关系数首次得到限制。借助氘核中核子相对动量带来的敏感性增强，作者改进了自旋相关系数约束，并在 k=2 和 k=4 情形下分别超过此前氢脉泽约束 4 和 14 个数量级。
authors: Amit Nanda, Daniel Comparat, Olivier Dulieu, Sebastian Lahs, Chloe Malbrunot, Lilian Nowak, Martin C. Simon, Eberhard Widmann

articles.title: Quantization of Polaritons Confined in Dielectric Structures
articles.title_zh: 介电结构中受限极化激元的量子化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.14566v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Light-matter interaction in the regime of strong quantum coupling is usually treated within the framework of the Hopfield model. However, the picture of coupling well-defined modes of light and matter is correct only as long as the shapes of these eigenmodes are not substantially modified by the interaction. Moreover, parameters of theoretical models are usually obtained by fitting to experimental data. To date, there is no straightforward method to determine a quantum master equation corresponding to a system with specific dielectric structure, which may lead to incompatibility of theoretical descriptions and physical realizations. In this work, a recipe for obtaining a quantum model in the polariton eigenmode basis is presented, based on Bogoliubov transformation in the conservative case and third quantization technique in the dissipative case. It is shown how this method can be used for boosting interaction strength and engineering nonlocal many-body interactions in carefully designed nanostructures, resulting in strongly nonclassical correlations of emitted light.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对强光-物质耦合体系中传统 Hopfield 模型依赖预设光场和物质本征模、且参数常由实验拟合获得的局限，提出从给定介电结构直接构建极化激元本征模量子模型的方法。保守体系中采用 Bogoliubov 变换，耗散体系中采用第三量子化技术，从而得到与具体物理结构相匹配的量子主方程。作者说明该框架可用于设计纳米结构以增强相互作用强度、工程化非局域多体相互作用，并产生强非经典的出射光关联。
authors: Amir Rahmani, Dogyun Ko, Maciej Dems, Andrzej Opala, Michał Matuszewski

articles.title: AI and Remote Sensing for Resilient and Sustainable Built Environments: A Review of Current Methods, Open Data and Future Directions
articles.title_zh: 用于韧性与可持续建成环境的人工智能和遥感：现有方法、开放数据与未来方向综述
articles.abstract: Critical infrastructures such as roads, bridges and buildings are increasingly exposed to damage from climate change, natural hazards and human-induced events, making rapid and reliable damage assessment essential for resilient infrastructure management. This review critically examines how artificial intelligence, combined with modern data acquisition technologies, is applied to damage assessment and monitoring across these three infrastructure classes. Following PRISMA 2020 guidelines, 244 peer-reviewed studies published between 2018 and 2026 are analysed for AI models, datasets, data sources and applications. Rather than cataloguing methods, the review interrogates why the field has converged on particular configurations. Three methodologically distinct ones emerge: detector-heavy pipelines on UAV road imagery, a split bridge literature between close-range visual inspection and InSAR-based long-term monitoring, and a satellite-based building literature focused on post-event change detection. The analysis shows that model choice is structurally constrained by sensing modality and data representation rather than architectural superiority, and that data availability is the binding constraint, not model capability: the literature remains concentrated on a small number of benchmark datasets, with limited cross-site validation and scarce satellite and SAR usage, despite their operational value. These same constraints help explain why operational adoption by the engineering sector remains limited. The review consolidates these findings into a conceptual taxonomy and a three-tier monitoring framework, and sets out a research agenda spanning foundation models, multimodal fusion, physics-informed AI, digital twins, edge AI, and explainable AI.
articles.abstract_zh: 该综述聚焦道路、桥梁和建筑等关键基础设施在气候变化、自然灾害和人为事件下的损伤评估与监测，系统分析人工智能与现代数据采集技术的结合方式。作者依据 PRISMA 2020 指南梳理了 2018—2026 年发表的 244 篇同行评议研究，比较 AI 模型、数据集、数据源和应用场景。文章指出领域已形成三类典型配置：面向无人机道路影像的检测器密集流程、桥梁近距离视觉检测与 InSAR 长期监测并行的路线，以及侧重灾后变化检测的卫星建筑研究；模型选择主要受传感模态和数据表示约束，而数据可得性是关键瓶颈。

articles.title: Improvements on quantum designated verifier signature based on Bell states
articles.title_zh: 基于Bell态的量子指定验证者签名方案的改进
articles.abstract: Quantum Designated Verifier Signature (QDVS) is a cryptographic scheme based on quantum mechanics in which a signature can be verified only by a specific designated verifier. Recently, Xin et al. (Quantum Information Processing, 2020, 19(3):79) proposed a QDVS scheme based on Bell states and claimed that it was secure. However, we demonstrate that their scheme is vulnerable to forgery attacks. To overcome this vulnerability, we propose an improved QDVS scheme utilizing single qubits and unitary operations. Compared with Xin et al.'s scheme, our scheme requires neither a trusted center (TC) nor quantum entanglement resources, thereby greatly reducing the implementation complexity. Our security analysis demonstrates that our scheme can resist common attacks, including inter-resending, forgery, and impersonation attacks.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子指定验证者签名是一类只有指定验证者才能验证签名有效性的量子密码方案。作者指出Xin等人2020年提出的基于Bell态的方案存在伪造攻击漏洞，并提出一种利用单量子比特和酉操作的改进方案。新方案不需要可信中心和量子纠缠资源，从而降低实现复杂度；安全性分析表明其可抵抗重发、伪造和冒充等常见攻击。

articles.title: Exact Fractionalized Ground States in an Extended Spin-1 Kitaev Chain

articles.abstract: Author(s): Alwyn Jose Raja and R. Ganesh Inspired by the Affleck-Kennedy-Lieb-Tasaki (AKLT) model, we present exact solutions for a spin-1 chain with Kitaev-like couplings. We consider an expanded Kitaev model with bilinear and biquadratic terms. At an exactly solvable point, the Hamiltonian can be reexpressed as a sum of projection operat… [Phys. Rev. Lett. 137, 046701] Published Mon Jul 20, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究受 AKLT 模型启发，提出一类具有 Kitaev 型耦合的自旋 1 链的精确解。作者考虑包含双线性和双二次项的扩展 Kitaev 模型，并在一个可精确求解点将哈密顿量重写为投影算符之和。该构造给出分数化基态的解析描述，有助于理解高自旋一维体系中的拓扑和分数化量子态。
authors: Alwyn Jose Raja and R. Ganesh

articles.title: Chiral Magnon Mixing by Symmetry-Breaking in Collinear Ferrimagnets
articles.title_zh: 共线亚铁磁体中由对称性破缺导致的手性磁振子混合
articles.abstract: Author(s): Dhurba R. Jaishi, Tyler J. Slade, S. X. M. Riberolles, Bing Li, Tianxiong Han, D. M. Pajerowski, D. L. Abernathy, Barry Winn, Melissa Graves-Brook, B. G. Ueland, and R. J. McQueeney Magnons in ferromagnets possess spin angular momentum defined by right-handed precession of the moment around the magnetization direction. In antiferromagnets with no net magnetization, left- and right-handed magnons are degenerate in the absence of an applied field. Ferrimagnets possess uncompensat… [Phys. Rev. Lett. 137, 046702] Published Mon Jul 20, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 铁磁体中的磁振子通常具有由磁矩绕磁化方向右旋进动定义的自旋角动量；而无净磁化的反铁磁体在零场下左右手性磁振子简并。该工作研究共线亚铁磁体中因未补偿磁矩及对称性破缺引起的手性磁振子混合，旨在揭示亚铁磁激发谱中手性、简并性与磁结构之间的关系。具体实验体系和定量结论需结合原文全文。
authors: Dhurba R. Jaishi, Tyler J. Slade, S. X. M. Riberolles, Bing Li, Tianxiong Han, D. M. Pajerowski, D. L. Abernathy, Barry Winn, Melissa Graves-Brook, B. G. Ueland, and R. J. McQueeney

articles.title: Twist-driven interlayer hybridization and multiple mobility edges in bilayer quasiperiodic lattices
articles.title_zh: 扭转驱动的层间杂化与双层准周期晶格中的多重迁移率边
articles.abstract: Author(s): Ankit Mishra and Kang Hao Cheong We investigate two coupled one-dimensional Aubry-André-Harper rings with N sites, where a site-dependent angular twist in the second ring generates a spatially varying mosaic of distance-modulated couplings. By varying the quasiperiodic potential strength V and twist periodicity k, we find mul… [Phys. Rev. Research 8, 033079] Published Mon Jul 20, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究两个耦合的一维 Aubry-André-Harper 环，其中第二个环的位点依赖角向扭转产生空间变化的、由距离调制的层间耦合图案。通过调节准周期势强度和扭转周期，作者考察扭转诱导的层间杂化及其对局域化转变的影响，发现体系可出现多重迁移率边。结果表明几何扭转可作为调控准周期双层体系谱与输运性质的有效自由度。
authors: Ankit Mishra and Kang Hao Cheong

articles.title: Including nanoparticle shape into macrospin models
articles.title_zh: 在宏自旋模型中纳入纳米颗粒形状效应
articles.abstract: Author(s): Iago López-Vázquez, Òscar Iglesias, and David Serantes We investigate the feasibility of the macrospin approximation to account for the actual shape of soft magnetic nanoparticles (MNPs) with realistic geometries. Specifically focusing on magnetite, we use the superellipsoidal parametrization to account for a variety of shapes, with a continuous interpo… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 014421] Published Mon Jul 20, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作评估宏自旋近似能否描述具有真实几何形状的软磁纳米颗粒，重点以磁铁矿纳米颗粒为对象。作者采用超椭球参数化方法连续表征不同颗粒形状，并将形状信息并入宏自旋建模框架。研究目标是提高简化磁动力学模型对实际纳米颗粒磁响应的适用性，同时保留宏自旋模型的计算效率。
authors: Iago López-Vázquez, Òscar Iglesias, and David Serantes

articles.title_zh: Co₃O₄ 中高磁场下线性到非线性磁电效应的交叉
articles.abstract: Author(s): S. Ghara, Y. Kinoshita, A. Miyake, Y. Ishii, L. Prodan, V. Tsurkan, Y. Skourski, J. Wosnitza, Y. H. Matsuda, S. Miyahara, M. Tokunaga, and I. Kézsmárki The A-site magnetic spinel Co₃O₄ exhibits a simple Néel-type collinear antiferromagnetic ordering below TN=30 K, accompanied by a strong linear magnetoelectric effect. Here, we report magnetization and electric polarization measurements on single crystals of {… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 024417] Published Mon Jul 20, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: A 位磁性尖晶石 Co₃O₄ 在 TN=30 K 以下形成简单的 Néel 型共线反铁磁序，并表现出强线性磁电效应。该文通过单晶磁化和电极化测量研究高磁场中 Co₃O₄ 的磁电响应演化。结果关注从线性磁电效应向非线性磁电行为的交叉，为理解共线反铁磁体中场诱导磁电耦合提供实验依据。
authors: S. Ghara, Y. Kinoshita, A. Miyake, Y. Ishii, L. Prodan, V. Tsurkan, Y. Skourski, J. Wosnitza, Y. H. Matsuda, S. Miyahara, M. Tokunaga, and I. Kézsmárki

articles.title: Sublattice polarization and filamentary superconductivity in strained graphene
articles.title_zh: 应变石墨烯中的子晶格极化与丝状超导
articles.abstract: Author(s): Tao Zhou Periodic strain engineering in monolayer graphene provides a versatile platform to generate colossal pseudomagnetic fields and flat pseudo-Landau levels directly in a single atomic sheet. While the electronic topology and transport properties of the normal state in these systems have been extensivel… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 024509] Published Mon Jul 20, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 周期性应变工程可在单层石墨烯中产生巨大的赝磁场和平坦赝朗道能级，为在单原子层中调控强关联态提供平台。该文研究应变石墨烯中与赝朗道能级相关的子晶格极化及其对超导态空间结构的影响。作者特别关注可能出现的丝状超导行为，拓展了对应变石墨烯电子拓扑、输运与配对态之间关系的理解。

articles.title: Room-temperature antiferromagnetic resonance in NaMnAs
articles.title_zh: NaMnAs 中的室温反铁磁共振
articles.abstract: Author(s): Jan Dzian, Stáňa Tázlarů, Ivan Mohelský, Florian Le Mardelé, Filip Chudoba, Jiří Volný, Jan Wyzula, Amit Pawbake, Simone Ritarossi, Riccardo Mazzarello, Philipp Ritzinger, Jakub Železný, Karel Výborný, Klára Uhlířová, Benoît Grémaud, Andrés Saúl, Clément Faugeras, Martin Veis, and Milan Orlita We report on antiferromagnetic resonance experiments in bulk tetragonal NaMnAs—a room-temperature antiferromagnetic semiconductor. Our results corroborate previous ab initio studies which propose that NaMnAs is an easy-axis antiferromagnet with the Néel vector oriented along the tetragonal axis. At … [Phys. Rev. B 114, 034420] Published Mon Jul 20, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该文报道了块体四方 NaMnAs 中的反铁磁共振实验，NaMnAs 是一种室温反铁磁半导体。实验结果支持此前第一性原理研究的判断，即 NaMnAs 为易轴反铁磁体，Néel 矢量沿四方晶轴取向。该研究为 NaMnAs 的磁各向异性、共振模式及其潜在反铁磁自旋电子学应用提供了实验表征。
authors: Jan Dzian, Stáňa Tázlarů, Ivan Mohelský, Florian Le Mardelé, Filip Chudoba, Jiří Volný, Jan Wyzula, Amit Pawbake, Simone Ritarossi, Riccardo Mazzarello, Philipp Ritzinger, Jakub Železný, Karel Výborný, Klára Uhlířová, Benoît Grémaud, Andrés Saúl, Clément Faugeras, Martin Veis, and Milan Orlita

articles.title: Effect of positional disorder on phase transitions in planar Josephson networks with two-band superconducting grains
articles.title_zh: 位置无序对含双带超导晶粒的平面 Josephson 网络相变的影响
articles.abstract: Author(s): Jie Li and Hai Huang The critical behavior of two-dimensional Josephson-junction network with the positional disorder is studied via Monte Carlo simulations. We consider a two-band model in which each superconducting grain is randomly displaced from its ideal position on a square lattice and the effective strength of th… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 034507] Published Mon Jul 20, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 作者利用蒙特卡罗模拟研究二维 Josephson 结网络在位置无序存在下的临界行为。模型中每个双带超导晶粒相对于理想方格点随机位移，从而改变有效 Josephson 耦合强度。该工作分析位置无序如何影响相位相干、相变特征及双带 Josephson 网络的临界性质。

articles.title: Current-induced spin-orbit torque on the surface of a transition metal dichalcogenide connected to the two-dimensional ferromagnet CrI₃: Effects of twisting and gating
articles.title_zh: 连接二维铁磁体 CrI₃ 的过渡金属硫族化物表面上的电流诱导自旋轨道力矩：扭转与栅压效应
articles.abstract: Author(s): Leyla Majidi, Azadeh Faridi, and Reza Asgari Motivated by recent progress in employing two key classes of two-dimensional materials—topological insulators and transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs)—as spin sources for generating spin-orbit torque (SOT), we investigate current-induced spin polarization and the resulting SOT in bilayers compos… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 045422] Published Mon Jul 20, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 受拓扑绝缘体和过渡金属二硫族化物作为自旋源产生自旋轨道力矩的研究进展启发，本文研究 TMDC/CrI₃ 双层中的电流诱导自旋极化及相应自旋轨道力矩。作者重点考察层间扭转角和栅压调控对界面自旋响应的影响。该研究面向二维异质结中可调自旋轨道力矩的设计，为低维磁存储和自旋电子器件提供理论依据。
authors: Leyla Majidi, Azadeh Faridi, and Reza Asgari

articles.title: Signatures of an enhanced valence bond solid transition in κ−(BEST)₂Cu₂(CN)₃ probed by nuclear magnetic and electron paramagnetic resonance
articles.title_zh: 核磁共振与电子顺磁共振探测 κ−(BEST)₂Cu₂(CN)₃ 中增强价键固体转变的迹象
articles.abstract: Author(s): Keiju Wakasugi, Atsushi Kawamoto, Rikumaru Saito, Hiromi Taniguchi, and Takuya Kobayashi We investigate the low-temperature magnetic properties of the organic Mott insulator κ−(BEST)₂Cu₂(CN)₃ using ¹³C nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) and electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR), where BEST denotes bis(ethylenediseleno)tetrat… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 065126] Published Mon Jul 20, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该文利用 ¹³C 核磁共振和电子顺磁共振研究有机 Mott 绝缘体 κ−(BEST)₂Cu₂(CN)₃ 的低温磁性质，其中 BEST 为含硒有机分子配体。研究旨在识别低温下自旋自由度、局域磁性和可能的价键固体转变特征。实验结果被用来讨论该材料中增强的价键固体转变迹象及其与有机量子磁体基态竞争的关系。
authors: Keiju Wakasugi, Atsushi Kawamoto, Rikumaru Saito, Hiromi Taniguchi, and Takuya Kobayashi

articles.title: Quasinormal modes enable coherent control of electromagnetic interactions
articles.title_zh: 准正规模实现电磁相互作用的相干控制
articles.abstract: Author(s): Jingwei Wang, Pengxiang Wang, Chaofan Zhang, Yuntian Chen, and Wei Liu Quasinormal modes (QNMs) and coherent control of light-matter interactions (through synchronized multiple coherent incident waves) are profound and pervasive concepts in and beyond photonics, making accessible photonic manipulations with extreme precision and efficiency. Though each has been playing… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 065419] Published Mon Jul 20, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 准正规模和多束相干入射光实现的光-物质相互作用相干控制，是光子学及相关领域中的重要概念。该文将准正规模理论与相干控制框架结合，探讨如何以高精度和高效率调控电磁相互作用。研究表明，从模式展开角度理解相干入射可为散射、吸收和近场增强等光学响应的设计提供统一工具。
authors: Jingwei Wang, Pengxiang Wang, Chaofan Zhang, Yuntian Chen, and Wei Liu

articles.title: Non-Abelian geometric quantum energy pump
articles.title_zh: 非阿贝尔几何量子能量泵
articles.abstract: Author(s): Yang Peng We introduce a non-Abelian geometric quantum energy pump realized by a transitionless geometric quantum drive—a time-dependent Hamiltonian supplemented by a counterdiabatic term generated by a prescribed trajectory on a smooth control manifold—that coherently transports states within a degenerate su… [Phys. Rev. B 114, L020304] Published Mon Jul 20, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种非阿贝尔几何量子能量泵，由无跃迁几何量子驱动实现：在随时间变化的哈密顿量中加入由控制流形上预设轨迹生成的反绝热项。该方案可在简并子空间内相干输运量子态，并通过非阿贝尔几何结构实现能量泵浦。研究为几何相、反绝热驱动和量子能量输运之间的联系提供了理论框架。

articles.title: Higher-order topological superconductivity and electrically tunable Majorana corner modes in monolayer MnXPb₂−Pb (X=Se, Te) heterostructure
articles.title_zh: 单层 MnXPb₂−Pb（X=Se, Te）异质结构中的高阶拓扑超导与电调控 Majorana 角模
articles.abstract: Author(s): Yongting Shi, Qing Wang, Zhen-Guo Fu, Ping Zhang, and Ning Hao Higher-order topological superconductors host Majorana zero modes localized at corners or hinges, providing a promising route toward scalable and controllable Majorana networks without vortices or magnetic flux. Here we propose a symmetry-enforced higher-order topological superconductivity based on … [Phys. Rev. B 114, L020506] Published Mon Jul 20, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 高阶拓扑超导体可在角或铰链处承载 Majorana 零模，为无需涡旋或磁通的可扩展 Majorana 网络提供路径。该文提出在单层 MnXPb₂−Pb（X=Se, Te）异质结构中实现由对称性保护的高阶拓扑超导。研究重点是 Majorana 角模的产生机制及其电场可调性，为二维材料平台中的可控拓扑超导提供候选方案。
authors: Yongting Shi, Qing Wang, Zhen-Guo Fu, Ping Zhang, and Ning Hao

articles.title: Robust and efficient quantum reservoir computing with a discrete time crystal
articles.title_zh: 基于离散时间晶体的鲁棒高效量子储备池计算
articles.abstract: Author(s): Da Zhang, Xin Li, Yibin Guo, Haifeng Yu, Yirong Jin, and Zhang-Qi Yin The rapid development of machine learning and quantum computing has placed quantum machine learning (QML) at the forefront of research. However, existing QML algorithms based on quantum variational algorithms face challenges in trainability and noise robustness. To address these challenges, we intro… [Phys. Rev. Applied 26, 014056] Published Mon Jul 20, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作针对变分量子机器学习中可训练性差和抗噪性不足的问题，引入以离散时间晶体为核心的量子储备池计算方案。离散时间晶体的非平衡有序动力学被用于提供稳定、可重复的量子特征映射，从而提升计算效率与鲁棒性。具体性能指标和实验/数值设置需查阅原文。
authors: Da Zhang, Xin Li, Yibin Guo, Haifeng Yu, Yirong Jin, and Zhang-Qi Yin

articles.title: Strong coupling between coherent ferrons and cavity acoustic phonons
articles.title_zh: 相干铁振子与腔声学声子的强耦合
