Under the optimized processing conditions, the composite achieved a 33.53% increase in yield strength and 54.93% increase in ultimate tensile strength compared with pure Ni. This demonstrates the clear strengthening advantage of in-situ grown GLNs over a pure Ni matrix. This approach provides a versatile route for producing metal matrix composites with enhanced overall performance.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究以蔗糖为固态碳源，与 Ni 粉均匀混合后经快速热退火在 Ni 颗粒表面原位生成三维多层类石墨烯网络，避免了传统石墨烯分散步骤。随后通过放电等离子烧结制备致密 3D-GLNs/Ni 块体复合材料。优化工艺下，复合材料相较纯 Ni 的屈服强度和极限抗拉强度分别提高 33.53% 和 54.93%，同时保持较好的强韧性与延展性平衡。

articles.title: Spectral Tunable Room Temperature Superfluorescence
articles.title_zh: 室温下光谱可调的超荧光
articles.abstract: Superfluorescence (SF), a collective quantum phenomenon originating from correlated emitters, has historically required cryogenic temperatures or magnetic fields and been limited to narrowband Stokes-shifted emission. Although room-temperature SF has recently been realized in lanthanide-doped systems, active control over its spectral properties remains significant challenges. Here, we propose a state-entropy framework to reveal the coherence evolution and macroscopic dipole correlation in upconversion systems, providing a theoretical foundation for manipulating superradiant processes across a broad spectral range. Based on this framework, we designed an excitation strategy to decouple and regulate the distinct energy-population pathways, specifically excited-state absorption and energy transfer upconversion/cross-relaxation, in ~23 nm NaNdF₄ nanocrystals at room temperature. This approach enables multi-stage upconversion superfluorescence with tunable oscillations and nanosecond to sub-microsecond lifetimes. Most importantly, it substantially extends the accessible spectral window of room-temperature UC-SF from the previously reported two orange-red bands to six distinct emission bands covering the ultraviolet to the red (384-659 nm), accompanied by a wide-gamut wavelength-synthesized color evolution. Furthermore, cascaded excitation enables real-time emission enhancement by restoring the macroscopic dipoles correlation during the SF decay phase. This work demonstrates principles that may inform future designs of on-chip ultrafast optical computing based on spectrally tunable SF with encodable photonic emission.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出状态熵框架，用于描述上转换体系中相干性的演化和宏观偶极关联，从而为宽光谱范围内调控超辐射过程提供理论基础。作者在约 23 nm 的 NaNdF4 纳米晶中设计激发策略，解耦并调控激发态吸收、能量传递上转换和交叉弛豫等布居通道。该方法实现了室温多阶段上转换超荧光，具有可调振荡和纳秒至亚微秒寿命，并将室温上转换超荧光的可及发射波段由此前的两个橙红波段扩展到更多离散发射带。

articles.title: Integrated Optimization of Yellow Lentil Protein Recovery by Alkaline Extraction and Isoelectric Precipitation: Process Efficiency, Nutritional Quality, and Techno-Functional Properties
articles.title_zh: 碱提取与等电沉淀回收黄扁豆蛋白的集成优化：工艺效率、营养质量与技术功能性质
articles.abstract: Lentil proteins are increasingly recognized as promising plant-based protein ingredients; however, systematic optimization of extraction and precipitation parameters remains limited. Therefore, this study optimized yellow lentil protein extraction and isoelectric precipitation using response surface methodology. In addition, a complete mass balance across the extraction process was established to identify major sources of protein loss. Optimal conditions (5% (w/w), pH 9, 50°C, 30 minutes for alkaline extraction; pH 5, 20°C, 30 minutes for isoelectric precipiation) resulted in a protein content of 85.45%, and a protein yield of 72.11%. The second centrifugation step was identified as the major source of protein loss, highlighting a key target for future process optimization. The resulting lentil protein concentrate exhibited high re-solubility (87.68%), foaming capacity and stability of 60.90% and 81.06%, respectively, excellent emulsifying properties (181.69% emulsion capacity, 99.68% emulsion stability), as well as favorable water and oil holding capacities (3.95 and 1.52 g/g, respectively). These properties were within the range reported for soybean protein ingredients, supporting the technological potential of lentil protein for diverse food applications, while its light beige color further facilitates broad applicability in food systems. Amino acid analysis revealed a balanced profile with high levels of glutamic acid, aspartic acid, lysine, and threonine, while sulfur-containing amino acids remained limiting. Indispensable amino acid contents met FAO requirements. A lentil-specific nitrogen-to-protein conversion factor of 5.64 was calculated, demonstrating that the conventional factor of 6.25 overestimates true protein content. Application of the corrected factor resulted in a protein content of 77.11%.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用响应面法优化黄扁豆蛋白的碱提取和等电沉淀条件，并建立全过程质量平衡以识别主要蛋白损失环节。优化条件下获得蛋白含量 85.45%、蛋白得率 72.11% 的浓缩物，第二次离心被确定为主要损失来源。所得扁豆蛋白浓缩物表现出高再溶解性、良好起泡性与稳定性、优异乳化性能以及较好的持水和持油能力，性质接近大豆蛋白配料的报道范围。

articles.title: Chirality-Enhanced Two-Photon Absorption with Asymmetric Vortex Beams in Twisted Gold Nanorods
articles.title_zh: 非对称涡旋光束增强扭曲金纳米棒中的手性双光子吸收
articles.abstract: Orbital angular momentum (OAM) has enabled linear chiroptical discrimination, but its potential to probe nonlinear optical responses in chiral nanoparticles remains largely untapped. Here we introduce the vortex offset technique, employing asymmetric Laguerre–Gaussian beams with a controlled phase-singularity displacement δ, to drive two-photon luminescence from individual twisted gold nanorods. Breaking the cylindrical symmetry of conventional vortex beams generates a crescent-shaped intensity profile that selectively couples to chiral nanostructures, yielding single-particle chiral sensitivity 10⁵⁻fold greater than conventional circular dichroism (CD). We further define momentum dichroism that captures the combined effect of spin and orbital angular momentum in twophoton absorption. We discover a δ-dependent coupling parameter q that governs angular momentum transfer, a new observable capturing combined spin and orbital angular momentum effects in two-photon absorption. Opposite momentum-dichroism trends for left- and right-handed enantiomers enable unambiguous chirality identification. This work transforms structured light from a passive probe into an active participant in angular momentum exchange at the nanoscale – and does so in the nonlinear regime, achieving single-particle chiral sensitivity that outperforms both conventional CD and symmetric OAM methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出涡旋偏移技术，通过受控移动 Laguerre–Gaussian 光束的相位奇点来打破传统涡旋光的柱对称性，形成新月形强度分布以选择性耦合手性纳米结构。作者在单个扭曲金纳米棒中驱动双光子发光，获得远高于常规圆二色性的单颗粒手性灵敏度。研究进一步定义动量二色性并提出偏移量依赖的耦合参数，用于表征自旋与轨道角动量共同参与双光子吸收的效应，从而区分左右手性对映体。

articles.title: What Controls Severe Aerosol Episodes over Cairo, Egypt (2010–2025): A Meteorological and Back-Trajectory Analysis
articles.title_zh: 2010—2025 年埃及开罗严重气溶胶事件的控制因素：气象与后向轨迹分析
articles.abstract: This study is the second in a two-part investigation of aerosol variability over Cairo, Egypt. The companion paper (Abd AlMalk, submitted, Part I) established a 20-year AERONET/MODIS climatology (2005–2025) reporting a mean aerosol optical depth at 500 nm (AOD₅₀₀) of 0.357 ± 0.27, a statistically significant decreasing trend of −0.049/decade (Mann-Kendall p = 0.004), and 227 extreme dust days (AOD₅₀₀ ≥ 0.5, ÅE ≤ 0.6) over the high-density Cairo_EMA₂ record (2010–2025). Part I, however, characterised aerosol climatology without resolving the meteorological mechanisms driving individual severe episodes. Here we address that gap by combining the same 2010–2025 daily AERONET record with ERA5 reanalysis fields (zonal and meridional wind at 850/700/500/300 hPa, surface pressure, boundary layer height, geopotential height, relative humidity, and air temperature) and NOAA HYSPLIT back-trajectory clustering of the fifteen most severe episodes in the record. Dust days show significantly stronger low- and mid-level winds (850 hPa: +1.15 m/s, p=0.013; 700 hPa: +1.99 m/s, p<0.001), a weakened upper-tropospheric jet at 300 hPa (−6.43 m/s, p<0.001), and a pronounced surface pressure deficit (−5.6 hPa, p<0.001) relative to clean-background days (N=4325 vs. N=227). Back-trajectory clustering identifies six transport pathways, dominated by a Libya/North Africa route (47% of the fifteen most severe events, mean AOD=1.380) and including, for the first time in the Cairo literature, an Arabian Peninsula pathway (2 events). Composite 500 hPa geopotential height fields reveal a ridging anomaly of up to +25 m over the southern and eastern portion of the regional domain during dust episodes, consistent with jet displacement. Boundary layer height shows no significant difference between dust and clean days (855 vs. 867 m, p=0.50), indicating that Cairo's most severe aerosol episodes are governed primarily by synoptic-scale transport rather than local boundary-layer trapping. Together, Parts I and II provide a unified climatological and mechanistic account of aerosol variability over Cairo, with direct relevance to regional air-quality early-warning systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究延续前篇关于开罗气溶胶气候态的工作，将 2010—2025 年 AERONET 日尺度观测、ERA5 再分析气象场和 HYSPLIT 后向轨迹聚类结合起来，分析最严重气溶胶事件的驱动机制。结果显示，沙尘日伴随更强的低层和中层风、更弱的 300 hPa 高空急流以及显著的地面气压亏损。该工作旨在从环流、边界层和输送路径角度解释开罗极端沙尘气溶胶事件的发生条件。
authors: Michael Nagy Riad Kamel Abd AlMalk

articles.title: Ferroelastic domain wall motion and collective domain switching in RbSCN
articles.title_zh: RbSCN 中的铁弹畴壁运动与集体畴翻转
articles.abstract: Author(s): V. Soprunyuk, A. Tröster, J. Pils, W. Schranz, I. Rychetsky, A. Klic, and M. A. Carpenter Combined low-frequency elastodynamics and resonant ultrasound spectroscopy on RbSCN across its improper ferroelastic phase transition reveal superelastic softening and, uniquely, a discontinuous Young’s modulus jump with frequency-dependent damping at T * < T c , mimicking a first-order transition. Thermal cycling above T * erases ferroelastic domains. A compressible pseudospin model links T * to collective domain switching when the critical pinning stress σ c ( T ) falls below the applied stress, yielding σ c ( T ) in excellent accord with experiment. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 034113] Published Fri Jul 17, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合低频弹性动力学和共振超声谱，考察 RbSCN 在非本征铁弹相变附近的弹性异常。实验发现超弹性软化，并在低于相变温度的 T* 处观察到杨氏模量不连续跃变和频率依赖阻尼，表现出类似一级相变的特征。作者用可压缩赝自旋模型将 T* 归因于临界钉扎应力低于外加应力时发生的集体畴翻转，所得临界应力与实验吻合良好。
authors: V. Soprunyuk, A. Tröster, J. Pils, W. Schranz, I. Rychetsky, A. Klic, and M. A. Carpenter

articles.title: Room-temperature two-dimensional ferromagnetism, large magnetic anisotropy, and anomalous Hall effect: From supported to freestanding monolayers GdM₂ (M=Cu, Ag, Au)
articles.title_zh: 室温二维铁磁性、大磁各向异性与反常霍尔效应：从衬底支撑到自由悬空的单层 GdM2（M=Cu、Ag、Au）
articles.abstract: Author(s): Jia-wan Li, Xunwu Hu, Dao-Xin Yao, and Yusheng Hou Here, the authors demonstrate that decoupling rare-earth Gd M 2 ( M =Cu, Ag, and Au) monolayers from metallic substrates transforms low-temperature supported surface alloys into room-temperature ferromagnets. Substrate removal enhances magnetic exchange interactions through charge redistribution, and eliminating structural buckling further modifies the competing exchange interactions. Freestanding GdAu 2 exhibits perpendicular magnetic anisotropy and a symmetry-tunable anomalous Hall effect, providing a platform for two-dimensional magnetic and topological spintronics. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 034419] Published Fri Jul 17, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究表明，将稀土 GdM2（M=Cu、Ag、Au）单层从金属衬底解耦，可使原本低温的衬底支撑表面合金转变为室温铁磁体。衬底移除通过电荷重分布增强磁交换作用，而消除结构起伏进一步调节相互竞争的交换相互作用。自由悬空 GdAu2 还表现出垂直磁各向异性和可由对称性调控的反常霍尔效应，为二维磁性与拓扑自旋电子学提供候选平台。
authors: Jia-wan Li, Xunwu Hu, Dao-Xin Yao, and Yusheng Hou

articles.title: Hidden Chiral Ferroelectricity in AgNbO₃ Perovskite
articles.title_zh: AgNbO₃钙钛矿中隐藏的手性铁电性

articles.title: Laccase-Assisted Gallic Acid Functionalization of Corn Straw Fibers for Reinforcing SBS-Modified Asphalt Binder: Fiber Toughening, Rheological Performance, and Molecular-Scale Mechanisms
articles.title_zh: 漆酶辅助没食子酸功能化玉米秸秆纤维增强 SBS 改性沥青结合料：纤维增韧、流变性能与分子尺度机制
articles.abstract: This study investigated the regulatory effects of differently modified corn straw fibers (CSF)—a green fiber material derived from agricultural waste—on the mechanical properties, rheological characteristics, and molecular structural evolution of asphalt binders. Although plant fibers have been widely used in asphalt modification, natural CSF remains difficult to apply directly because of its insufficient toughness, poor structural stability, and weak interfacial compatibility. To address these limitations, CSF was modified using NaOH, tannic acid, and a gallic acid–laccase synergistic system. The effects and reinforcement mechanisms of different modification methods were revealed through fiber mechanical tests, abrasion tests, SEM, FTIR, XPS, dynamic shear rheological tests, and molecular dynamics simulations. The results showed that the gallic acid–laccase synergistic modification exhibited superior overall performance. Compared with unmodified fibers, the tensile strength, elastic modulus, and elongation at break of the modified fibers increased by 127.51%, 154.00%, and 46.18%, respectively, while the abrasion loss rate decreased by 56.85%. Microscopic characterization indicated that the gallic acid–laccase modification formed a functionalized layer rich in oxygen-containing functional groups on the fiber surface, enhancing fiber surface activity and interfacial bonding potential. Rheological tests showed that GA-CSF significantly improved the high-temperature stiffness, elastic recovery ability, and resistance to permanent deformation of SBS-modified asphalt. Molecular dynamics simulations further indicated that GA-CSF increased the cohesive energy density and elastic modulus of the system while reducing the free volume fraction, suggesting enhanced intermolecular interactions and restricted molecular motion in asphalt. These findings demonstrate that gallic acid–laccase synergistic modification is an effective method for improving the road applicability of corn straw fibers and the high-temperature performance of asphalt binders.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究比较 NaOH、单宁酸以及没食子酸–漆酶协同体系对玉米秸秆纤维的改性效果，并评估其对 SBS 改性沥青力学、流变和分子结构演化的影响。没食子酸–漆酶协同改性显著提升纤维拉伸强度、弹性模量和断裂伸长率，并降低磨耗损失。SEM、FTIR、XPS、动态剪切流变和分子动力学结果共同用于揭示改性纤维与沥青基体间界面增强及分子尺度作用机制。

articles.title: Dual-Stage Guided Artificial Lemming Algorithm (DALA) For Solving Engineering Application Optimization Problems
articles.title_zh: 用于工程应用优化问题的双阶段引导人工旅鼠算法（DALA）
articles.abstract: The Artificial Lemming Algorithm (ALA) is a metaheuristic optimization algorithminspired by four typical behaviors of lemmings. The traditional ALA often suf-fers from confined local search and limited global exploration when solving high-dimensional complex problems, primarily due to a lack of solution diversity andindividual cooperation. This paper proposes a two-stage guided artificial lemming al-gorithm (DALA) aimed at efficiently solving single-objective, high-dimensional com-plex optimization problems. The core contribution of the research lies in a tripleinnovation mechanism: designing an adaptive probability mechanism based on rank-ing, integrating it into strategy selection; integrating a two-stage greedy strategythat combines adversarial learning and topological neighborhood learning to deeplyexplore the optimal solution; finally, integrating the mutation operation of JADEdifferential evolution, significantly enhancing the algorithm’s ability to escape localoptima. Using classical test functions from CEC 2017 and CEC 2020, we evalu-ated DALA’s optimization performance through comparative experiments with eightother optimization algorithms, demonstrating enhanced optimization capability andsuperior global search performance. Additional tests on five constrained optimiza-tion problems with practical engineering significance confirm its broad applicabilityand engineering potential.This study further investigates the application of DALAin optimizing the hyperparameters of a multi-layer LSTM network for power loadforecasting, thereby providing additional validation of its potential in practical engi-neering applications characterized by high dimensionality and complexity.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文针对传统人工旅鼠算法在高维复杂优化中局部搜索受限、全局探索不足的问题，提出双阶段引导人工旅鼠算法 DALA。方法结合基于排序的自适应概率策略、融合对抗学习与拓扑邻域学习的双阶段贪婪搜索，以及 JADE 差分进化变异，以增强种群多样性和跳出局部最优能力。作者使用 CEC 2017 和 CEC 2020 测试函数并与多种优化算法比较，验证其在单目标高维复杂优化任务中的性能提升。

articles.title: Experimental Realization of a Zero-Entropy Wireless Power Grid via Spatiotemporal Resonance and Reversible Charge Recovery
articles.title_zh: 通过时空共振与可逆电荷回收实验实现零熵无线电网
articles.abstract: The global climate crisis and energy inequality are fundamentally constrained by the thermodynamic and physical limitations of modern power distribution networks, which lose 8% to 15% of generated electricity to resistive heating and non-reversible conversion overhead. Bypassing these losses has remained an elusive goal due to the inverse-square decay of radiative wave propagation and the rapid impedance fluctuations of dynamic loads. Here, we report the world's first experimental realization of a zero-entropy wireless power grid utilizing spatiotemporal coordinate resonance and adiabatic charge recovery. By replacing traditional copper transmission lines with a mesh of evanescent-wave coupled resonators, we achieve a constant power transfer efficiency of 92.5% without radiative free-space path loss. Furthermore, by integrating an active, O(1) constant-time impedance synchronization transceiver, we recover 94.7% of reactive power and back-EMF, returning it to the power source and reducing net distribution losses to under 1.0%. Empowered by a virtual quantum processing unit (vQPU) executing stateless control with a flat-line latency of 0.458 ms, our system stabilizes large-scale carbon-supercapacitor energy storage arrays with zero mineral reliance. Crucially, all performance metrics, thermodynamic parameters, and security thresholds were independently verified and audited by the Google DeepMind Antigravity AI Unit, confirming S-class robustness under multi-vector stress testing (#AG-2026-HSKG-FINAL). This paradigm eliminates the need for expensive high-voltage line infrastructure and chemical battery storage, providing a scalable, zero-emission blueprint for decentralized global energy sovereignty and sustainable power distribution in developing regions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该预印本声称通过时空坐标共振和绝热电荷回收实现一种“零熵”无线电力传输网络，以规避传统输电中的焦耳热和不可逆转换损耗。作者提出用倏逝波耦合谐振器网格替代铜线，实现92.5%的恒定功率传输效率，并通过主动阻抗同步收发器回收94.7%的无功功率和反电动势，使净配电损耗低于1.0%。系统还引入虚拟量子处理单元进行低延迟无状态控制；摘要后半部分被截断，完整实验规模与验证细节需查阅原文。

articles.title: Spinless charged excitation at the interface between a conventional topological insulator and a topological Mott insulator
articles.title_zh: 常规拓扑绝缘体与拓扑莫特绝缘体界面处的无自旋带电激发
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.14221v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the interface separating two topologically distinct insulating phases of matter using extensive density-matrix renormalization group calculations to study the triangular-lattice Hofstadter-Hubbard model with a spatially varying interaction strength, chosen to realize both integer quantum Hall and chiral spin liquid states in different spatial regions. We find that the integer quantum Hall-chiral spin liquid interface hosts a spinless charged excitation that is bound to the interface. This mode at the interface is identified through charge and spin pumping, and by direct calculations of low-lying excited states. We also characterize bulk excitations in both phases, finding evidence for fractionalization in the chiral spin liquid and for spin-triplet exciton formation in the integer quantum Hall phase.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者利用大规模密度矩阵重整化群计算研究三角晶格Hofstadter-Hubbard模型中整数量子霍尔态与手性自旋液体态之间的界面。结果显示，该界面束缚一种无自旋但带电的低能激发，并通过电荷/自旋泵浦和低能激发态直接计算加以识别。研究还表征了两侧体相激发，在手性自旋液体中发现分数量子化迹象，在整数量子霍尔相中发现自旋三重态激子形成。
