articles.title: Reward Transport: Property Control in Flow Matching via Noise-Space Alignment
articles.title_zh: 奖励输运：通过噪声空间对齐实现流匹配中的性质控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08781v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The coupling in flow matching -- the rule pairing noise vectors with data points -- is typically treated as a computational choice. We show that this coupling can instead serve as an alignment interface: by matching noise and data according to a target molecular property, it embeds controllable structure directly into the learned flow field. Building on this view, we introduce Reward Transport, which uses optimal transport coupling at training time to align a scalar noise-space coordinate with molecular rewards; at inference, varying this coordinate steers the generated distribution without requiring an oracle, reward model, gradient guidance, or additional computation. In the coupling-preserving limit, thresholding this coordinate recovers the Cross-Entropy Method's truncated reward distribution, providing a principled, continuously adjustable distribution-level control knob. Empirically, on ZINC-250K and GuacaMol, sweeping the scalar induces monotone control of logP and consistent QED control over its operating range; most tellingly, the same knob produces opposite structural responses for different targets, growing molecules for logP but shrinking them for QED, which rules out a generic size bias. The interface is complementary to classifier-free guidance and conditional flow matching, while a negative result under epsilon-prediction diffusion clarifies where coupling-level alignment is structurally absent. Code: https://github.com/KehanGuo2/reward-transport
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作指出，流匹配中噪声向量与数据点的耦合不只是计算选择，也可作为控制生成性质的对齐接口。作者提出 Reward Transport，在训练时用最优输运耦合将噪声空间中的标量坐标与分子奖励对齐；推理时只需调节该坐标即可改变生成分布，无需额外 oracle、奖励模型、梯度引导或计算开销。理论上，在保持耦合的极限下，对该坐标阈值化可恢复交叉熵方法的截断奖励分布；实验在 ZINC-250K 和 GuacaMol 上展示了对 logP 和 QED 等性质的单调或稳定控制。
authors: Kehan Guo, Yili Shen, Yujun Zhou, Yue Huang, Chujie Gao, Shiyi Du, Xiangliang Zhang

articles.title: HERO: A Heterogeneity-Aware Benchmark Library for Federated Continual Learning
articles.title_zh: HERO：面向异质性的联邦持续学习基准库
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08784v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Federated continual learning (FCL) evaluates how distributed clients learn from changing data streams while retaining previously learned knowledge. Existing evaluations are difficult to compare because they often change datasets, task splits, client data splits, task orders, backbones, memory assumptions, and reporting rules simultaneously. We introduce HERO, a heterogeneity-aware benchmark library for FCL. HERO builds benchmark streams by separating three choices that are often coupled, namely the task split, the client data split, and the client task sequence. In HERO-Core, the main comparable benchmark, α controls client data skew and h̊o controls task-order mismatch. We evaluate representative FCL methods on CIFAR-100 and TinyImageNet using final average accuracy, average forgetting, and bottom-10% client accuracy. We also include a graph-based Domain-IL portability case study on OGB-MolPCBA, where scaffold-domain granularity changes the input distribution while the prediction task remains fixed. Our results show that method behavior changes across easy and heterogeneous settings, that average accuracy can hide weak bottom-client performance, that task-order mismatch favors different strategies from synchronized evaluation, and that the same HERO interface can expose domain-shift difficulty beyond image-based FCIL. HERO releases benchmark streams, configurations, method implementations, and reporting scripts to support reproducible and setting-aware FCL evaluation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 HERO，一个面向联邦持续学习的异质性敏感基准库，旨在解决现有评测因数据集、任务划分、客户端划分、任务顺序、骨干网络和报告规则同时变化而难以比较的问题。HERO 将任务划分、客户端数据划分和客户端任务序列解耦；在 HERO-Core 中，用 α 控制客户端数据偏斜，用 h̊o 控制任务顺序不匹配。作者在 CIFAR-100、TinyImageNet 及 OGB-MolPCBA 的图域增量案例上评测代表性方法，表明方法表现会随异质性显著变化，平均准确率可能掩盖底部客户端的弱性能。
authors: Thinh T. H. Nguyen, Le-Tuan Nguyen, Minh-Duong Nguyen, Nhi Trinh, Anh Tran Nam Nguyet, Dung D. Le, Kok-Seng Wong

articles.title: A Machine Learning Surrogate for Component Criticality Ranking in Interdependent Power-Communication Networks
articles.title_zh: 互依电力—通信网络中组件关键性排序的机器学习代理模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08918v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cyber-physical power systems are vulnerable to cascading failures caused by tight interdependencies between power and communication infrastructures. Evaluating these failures over large N-k contingency sets with a high-fidelity simulator is computationally prohibitive for resilience planning. Using the previously published Modified Implicative Interdependency Model (MIIM) as the ground-truth cascade simulator, this paper develops a machine-learning surrogate that predicts contingency severity from leakage-free structural features and derives a component-criticality ranking for prioritized hardening analysis. On the IEEE 118-bus system, the Gradient Boosting surrogate achieves Spearman correlations of 0.849 for per-contingency severity prediction and 0.853 for per-component criticality ranking, while remaining stable across three independently sampled datasets. MIIM-derived component criticality itself reproduces only to a Spearman of approximately 0.85 under the present sampling pipeline, and the surrogate operates at this empirical ceiling to within sampling variation. Topological centrality measures on the full interdependent network provide meaningful baselines (Spearman 0.60-0.69), and feature ablation shows that the surrogate's advantage is driven primarily by inter-layer dependency information. These results support a two-stage workflow in which the surrogate rapidly ranks candidate components and MIIM is reserved for selective verification.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对电力—通信互依网络中级联故障评估计算昂贵的问题，构建机器学习代理模型来预测 N-k 故障组合的严重性并生成组件关键性排序。作者以 Modified Implicative Interdependency Model（MIIM）作为高保真级联仿真基准，使用无泄漏结构特征训练模型。IEEE 118 节点系统上的结果显示，梯度提升代理在故障严重性预测和组件关键性排序上均达到约 0.85 的 Spearman 相关水平，接近当前采样流程下 MIIM 关键性本身的可复现上限。

articles.title: AlphaZero in Sparsely Rewarded Games: Limits and Auxiliary Supervision
articles.title_zh: 稀疏奖励博弈中的 AlphaZero：局限与辅助监督
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08984v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AlphaZero has demonstrated that a neural-guided Monte Carlo Tree Search can achieve superhuman performance, but strong play does not necessarily imply perfect play. We study this gap in two oracle-evaluable domains with contrasting structure: Connect Four, a solved partisan game with exact game-theoretic values, and Chomp, an impartial game whose optimal play is governed by Grundy-number structure. Under a unified self-play + MCTS pipeline, we compare vanilla AlphaZero, a multi-frame variant (limited to Chomp), and an AlphaZero Auxiliary Loss (AZAL) that adds oracle-derived policy supervision. We find that vanilla AlphaZero achieves strong play across both domains but cannot preserve the exact trajectories required for optimal play: in Connect Four, it fails to maintain the optimal line of play, while in Chomp, it fails to consistently restore the g=0 invariant. On rectangular Chomp boards, multi-frame inputs alone do not remove this gap. Nevertheless, AZAL substantially improves oracle consistency across multi-seeded full-game traces and sampled-state evaluations. On Chomp, AZAL reaches perfect full-game oracle consistency on 10x11 and high but not complete consistency on 9x10; on Connect Four, AZAL improves oracle-match rate and delays the first oracle mistake, but does not reach perfect play.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察 AlphaZero 在稀疏奖励且可由 oracle 精确评估的博弈中，强对弈能力与严格最优性的差距。作者比较了标准 AlphaZero、多帧变体以及加入 oracle 策略监督的 AlphaZero Auxiliary Loss（AZAL），测试对象包括已求解的 Connect Four 和受 Grundy 数结构约束的 Chomp。结果表明，标准 AlphaZero 虽能达到强水平，但不能稳定保持最优轨迹：在 Connect Four 中偏离最优线，在 Chomp 中不能持续恢复 g=0 不变量；AZAL 则显著提升了全局轨迹和采样状态上的 oracle 一致性。
authors: Brent Kong, Tejas Ram, Tony Yue Yu

articles.title: Forget Narrowly, Retain Broadly: Unlearning as an Asymmetric Generalization Problem
articles.title_zh: 窄范围遗忘、广范围保留：作为非对称泛化问题的机器遗忘
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09236v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine unlearning in LLMs is the targeted removal of specific knowledge while preserving all other capabilities, critical for privacy and safety. Yet existing benchmarks measure it unreliably. They miss knowledge that resurfaces under paraphrased or indirect queries, a failure we call under-forgetting, and lack the semantic, syntactic, and lexical probes needed to verify that unrelated knowledge is preserved, a failure we call over-forgetting. Both failures reflect an asymmetric generalization problem. Forget evaluation must cover diverse query formulations of the same target facts, testing whether forgetting holds beyond exact training prompts. Retain evaluation must probe a far larger and implicitly defined set, namely every fact disjoint from the forget target. The retain set thus defines the effective forget set, yet current datasets provide no fine-grained annotation of this forget-retain boundary. We address this with SUITE, an evaluation protocol and training corpus that captures forget-retain structure for real-world factual domains. Methods trained on SUITE improve substantially, showing that training data is as important as algorithmic design. Building on the obtained insights, we introduce JensUn++, an unlearning algorithm that achieves the best forget-retain utility trade-off across three LLMs, in both sequential and joint unlearning settings. Code and datasets are available at https://amitpeleg.github.io/forget-narrowly-retain-broadly
articles.abstract_zh: 该文讨论大语言模型机器遗忘中的评测缺陷：目标知识可能在改写或间接提问中重新出现，形成遗忘不足；同时缺乏对无关知识保留的细粒度探针，导致过度遗忘难以发现。作者将其形式化为非对称泛化问题：遗忘评估需覆盖同一目标事实的多样查询，而保留评估则涉及远大得多且隐式定义的非目标事实集合。为此，论文提出 SUITE 评测协议和训练语料，用于刻画真实事实域中的遗忘—保留边界，并显示基于该结构训练的方法可显著改善表现。
authors: Amit Peleg, Naman Deep Singh, Naama Pearl, Bibhabasu Mohapatra, Matthias Hein

articles.title: Risk-Aware General-Utility Markov Decision Processes
articles.title_zh: 风险感知的广义效用马尔可夫决策过程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09298v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study general-utility Markov decision processes (GUMDPs) with risk-aware objectives. In this framework, an agent aims to optimize a risk measure of the distribution of objective values, where the objective function depends on the frequency of visitation of states induced by the agent's policy. First, we motivate, propose, and formalize risk-aware GUMDPs, which enable agents and decision makers to trade off expected performance by risk aversion while benefiting from the rich set of objectives that can be cast under the framework of GUMDPs. We focus our attention on the entropic risk measure (ERM). Second, we show how we can solve risk-aware GUMDPs with ERM objectives by resorting to online planning techniques. In particular, we propose an approach based on Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to provably solve risk-aware GUMDPs up to any desired accuracy. Third, we provide a set of experimental results showcasing that our approach is successful when optimizing for a spectrum of risk-aware behaviors in the context of GUMDPs under diverse tasks (standard MDPs, maximum state entropy exploration, imitation learning, and multi-objective MDPs).
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究带风险感知目标的广义效用马尔可夫决策过程（GUMDP），其中智能体优化由策略诱导状态访问频率决定的目标值分布的风险度量。作者重点考虑熵风险度量，使决策者能够在期望性能和风险厌恶之间权衡，同时保留 GUMDP 可表达的丰富目标形式。论文提出基于蒙特卡洛树搜索的在线规划方法，并证明可在任意期望精度下求解该类问题；实验覆盖标准 MDP、最大状态熵探索、模仿学习和多目标 MDP，展示了不同风险偏好下的有效性。
authors: Pedro P. Santos, Fábio Vital, Alberto Sardinha, Francisco S. Melo

articles.title: Learning Physics-Informed Surrogate Model of Linear Elastic Displacement Fields from Geometry
articles.title_zh: 从几何学习线弹性位移场的物理信息代理模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09382v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This work aims to develop a fast and physically consistent surrogate model for real-time structural health monitoring of fractured elastic domains. We propose a physics-informed DeepONet framework that predicts displacement fields from both boundary conditions and fracture geometry, using a dedicated encoding strategy for the latter and without relying on finite-element-generated training data. The traction-free condition on the fracture boundary is imposed weakly through a localized penalty term. The presented numerical example focuses on one representative fracture geometry, demonstrating the feasibility of the formulation and laying the groundwork for extensions to surrogate modeling across diverse fracture geometries.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作旨在为含裂纹弹性域的实时结构健康监测构建快速且物理一致的代理模型。作者提出物理信息 DeepONet 框架，从边界条件和裂纹几何共同预测位移场，并为裂纹几何设计专门编码策略，且不依赖有限元生成的训练数据。裂纹边界上的无牵引条件通过局部惩罚项弱施加；数值示例聚焦一种代表性裂纹几何，验证了方法可行性并为扩展到多样裂纹几何奠定基础。
authors: Rodolphe Barlogis, Ferhat Tamssaouet, Quentin Falcoz, Stéphane Grieu

articles.title: On-Device Adaptive Battery Power Prediction for Electric Vehicles
articles.title_zh: 面向电动汽车的端侧自适应电池功率预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09400v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Adaptive power management in Electric Vehicles (EVs) requires accurate power prediction. Although deep learning models have emerged as highly effective for time-series forecasting in this domain, their performance is prone to degradation when exposed to data with distributions different from the training data. We introduce a novel approach that enables on-device learning in resource-constrained EV systems to continuously adapt pretrained battery prediction models to new, unseen data. We leverage existing pretrained models by transforming them into adaptable versions that retain critical hyperparameter knowledge from their initial training. We comprehensively investigate both online and offline model adaptation strategies. Our results demonstrate significant improvements in forecasting performance across various models and time horizons, achieving mean absolute error reductions of up to 7.49% and 14.88% with online and offline adaptation techniques, respectively. This study highlights the substantial benefit of on-device adaptation, resulting in enhanced battery power predictions than unadapted model deployments in real-world EV scenarios.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作针对电动汽车自适应功率管理中的电池功率预测问题，提出在资源受限车载设备上持续适配预训练时序预测模型的方法，以缓解真实使用中数据分布漂移导致的性能下降。作者将已有预训练模型转换为可自适应版本，并比较在线与离线适配策略。实验显示，多种模型和预测时域下预测误差均降低，在线与离线适配的平均绝对误差最高分别下降7.49%和14.88%。
authors: Avik Bhatnagar, Anton Paule, Tobias Schuermann, Sebastian Reiter, Oliver Bringmann

articles.title: CoCoT-EEG: Contrastive-Pretrained Multiscale Convolutional Transformer for EEG Decoding
articles.title_zh: CoCoT-EEG：用于脑电解码的对比预训练多尺度卷积Transformer
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09543v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Self-supervised pretrained foundation models (FM) have shown early promise for non-invasive electroencephalogram (EEG) decoding applications. Many recent large-scale models converged on the approach of tokenizing raw EEG followed by masked reconstruction pretraining. However, this recipe has been shown to be suboptimal for data, like EEG, with high noise amplitude and information confined to limited dimensions such as narrow frequency bands. Building on this insight, we develop a novel contrastive-pretrained EEG model with multiscale temporal convolution input layers and Transformer encoder blocks (CoCoT). CoCoT matches or beats state-of-the-art reconstruction-pretrained EEG models on extensive benchmark decoding tasks with heterogeneous electrode configurations. Furthermore, CoCoT trained from scratch outperforms previous single-task decoding models and even rivals pretrained models, showcasing the architecture's flexibility and data efficiency. Through systematic ablations, including model architecture and pretraining objective, we demonstrate the viability of contrastive learning for building EEG FMs while suggesting key architectural design considerations, prompting further investigations in alternative large-scale pretraining strategies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出CoCoT，一种面向非侵入式脑电解码的基础模型架构，结合多尺度时间卷积输入层、Transformer编码器和对比式自监督预训练。作者指出，当前常见的脑电分词与掩码重构预训练对高噪声、信息集中于窄频带的EEG并非最优。基准测试表明，CoCoT在异构电极配置的解码任务上达到或超过重构预训练模型；即使从零训练，也优于以往单任务模型并接近预训练模型性能。
authors: Gabriel Mahuas, Victoria Shevchenko, Ugo Tanielian, Yassir Bendou, Richard Gao

articles.title: Quantum-Enhanced Synthetic Data Generation Using Quantum Circuit Born Machines for Imbalanced Tabular Learning
articles.title_zh: 利用量子线路Born机生成量子增强合成数据以处理不平衡表格学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09113v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Data scarcity and class imbalance are persistent challenges in machine learning that degrade model generalization and introduce predictive bias. We present a hybrid quantum-classical framework for synthetic data generation using a Quantum Circuit Born Machine (QCBM) to address these limitations. The proposed approach exploits quantum mechanical properties -- superposition and entanglement -- within a parameterized variational quantum circuit to model complex probability distributions that are difficult for classical generative methods to capture. Experiments are conducted on two tabular benchmark datasets: the Iris dataset and the Telco Customer Churn dataset. Preprocessing includes normalization and PCA-based dimensionality reduction to enable efficient basis encoding for quantum circuits. The QCBM is trained by minimizing Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between real and generated data distributions using a gradient-based parameter-shift optimization rule. Augmenting training data with QCBM-generated synthetic samples at 40-50% of the minority class improves F1-score by approximately 5-15% and minority-class recall by 10-25%. Cross-domain evaluations (Train on Synthetic, Test on Real; and Train on Real, Test on Synthetic) reveal a performance gap of only 3-10%, indicating strong distributional fidelity. Comparative analysis against classical oversampling methods -- SMOTE, Borderline-SMOTE, KMeansSMOTE, and SVM-SMOTE -- shows that QCBM achieves competitive classification performance and produces lower Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) on the Telco dataset, suggesting superior structural similarity in certain imbalanced settings. These findings establish QCBM as a viable complementary tool for data augmentation, particularly for low-dimensional structured tabular data with class imbalance.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种量子-经典混合框架，使用量子线路Born机生成合成表格数据，以缓解数据稀缺和类别不平衡带来的泛化下降与预测偏差。模型通过参数化变分量子线路表征复杂概率分布，并以KL散度为目标、参数移位规则进行梯度优化。Iris和Telco客户流失数据集上的实验表明，在少数类中加入约40–50%的QCBM合成样本可提升F1分数约5–15%，少数类召回率提升约10–25%。
authors: Tanapol Nuatho, Narisorn Sangnakara, Prapong Prechaprapranwong, Rajchawit Sarochawikasit

articles.title: LLM for EDA in Front-End Design: Challenges and Opportunities
articles.title_zh: 前端设计中面向EDA的大语言模型：挑战与机遇
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09616v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As chip complexity increases and time-to-market pressures grow, front-end design has become a critical bottleneck in chip development. Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown great potential in Electronic Design Automation (EDA). Beyond specification understanding, LLMs show the potential to serve as a unified intelligent interface for hardware description language (HDL) generation, testbench construction, and design space exploration. The rise of agentic AI, represented by pioneering systems such as OpenClaw, offers a strategic roadmap for the next generation EDA. From this perspective, this paper discusses the evolution of EDA from localized assistance to autonomous agentic execution. Then, we review representative advances of LLMs in front-end design, focusing on key tasks such as circuit and testbench generation from a shared specification, as well as design quality improvement in established workflows such as high-level synthesis. Finally, we discuss the key challenges and limitations of integrating LLMs into EDA, and outline future opportunities for advancing LLM-enabled front-end design, offering a systematic perspective for researchers interested in leveraging agentic AI technologies for EDA.
articles.abstract_zh: 该综述讨论大语言模型在芯片前端设计自动化中的作用，覆盖从规格理解到HDL生成、测试平台构建和设计空间探索等任务。文章将EDA的发展趋势概括为从局部辅助走向自主智能体执行，并结合OpenClaw等系统讨论agentic AI对下一代EDA流程的启示。作者还总结了LLM融入现有前端设计与高层综合流程时面临的可靠性、验证、质量控制和工程集成挑战。
authors: Kangwei Xu, Bing Li, Ulf Schlichtmann

articles.title: PHINN-EEG: Topological Time-Series Analysis of Dream-State EEG -- Dynamic Betti Curves for Dream Content Classification and Topology-Conditioned Neural Signal Synthesis
articles.title_zh: PHINN-EEG：梦境状态脑电的拓扑时间序列分析——用于梦内容分类的动态Betti曲线与拓扑条件神经信号合成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09662v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Current electroencephalography (EEG)-based dream detection relies on power spectral density (PSD) and statistical moment features, achieving a state-of-the-art area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of approximately 0.70 on the DREAM database (Wong et al., 2025, Nature Communications). We introduce PHINN-EEG (Persistent Homology Inspired Neural Network for EEG), the first topological time-series framework for dream mentation analysis. Using sliding-window Takens delay embeddings and Vietoris-Rips filtrations on multichannel pre-awakening EEG epochs, we extract Dynamic Betti Curves that characterize the geometric architecture of neural activity, not merely its energy. These topological invariants, combined with topology-conditioned flow matching, are analytically projected to outperform existing PSD and catch22 benchmarks, targeting AUC = 0.82-0.90 on the 1,462-awakening open-access subset of the DREAM database (drawn from a full registry of 3,191 total awakenings from 263 participants across 20 independent laboratories). We further introduce a topology-conditioned rectified flow model for dream-state EEG synthesis-with a spectral-conditioned flow model of comparable feature dimensionality as an additional ablation baseline to isolate the value of topological conditioning specifically-and propose a set of candidate Betti transition archetypes linking topology to phenomenological dream report categories, presented as an exploratory hypothesis space pending empirical validation. If validated, this work represents a paradigm shift from spectral energy to phase-space geometry in neural rare-event detection, with potential future implications for wearable BCI dream monitoring.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出PHINN-EEG，将持久同调引入梦境相关EEG分析，用动态Betti曲线描述神经活动的几何结构，而不只依赖功率谱密度或统计矩特征。方法基于多通道觉醒前EEG片段的滑动窗口Takens延迟嵌入和Vietoris-Rips滤波，并结合拓扑条件流匹配。作者预期该框架在DREAM数据库子集上可优于PSD和catch22基线，并进一步提出用于梦境状态EEG合成的拓扑条件整流流模型；具体实证效果需结合原文验证。
authors: Ren Takahashi, Emre Yusuf, Jayabrata Bhaduri

articles.title: Tensor Methods: A Unified and Interpretable Approach for Material Design
articles.title_zh: 张量方法：面向材料设计的统一且可解释方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.10392v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: When designing new materials, it is often necessary to tailor the material design to have some desired properties. As the set of material design parameters grows, the search space grows exponentially, making the actual synthesis and evaluation of all combinations of designs virtually impossible. Even using traditional computational methods, such as Finite Element Analysis (FEA), becomes too computationally heavy to search this design space. Recent methods use machine learning (ML) surrogate models to more efficiently determine optimal material designs; unfortunately, these methods often (i) are notoriously difficult to interpret and (ii) under perform when the training data comes from a non-uniform sampling of the entire design space. In this work, we suggest the use of tensor completion methods as an all-in-one approach for interpretability and predictions. We observe classical tensor methods are able to compete with traditional ML methods in predictions, with the added benefit of their interpretable tensor factors (which are given for free). In our experiments, we are able to rediscover physical phenomena via the tensor factors, indicating that our predictions are aligned with the physics of the problem. This also means these factors could be used by experimentalists to identify potentially novel patterns, given we are able to rediscover existing ones. We also study the effects of both types of surrogate models (traditional ML & tensor-based) when we encounter training data from a non-uniform sampling of the design space. We observe some more specialized tensor methods that are able to give better generalization in these non-uniform sampling scenarios, due to the low-rank constraint. We find the best generalization comes from a tensor model, which is able to improve upon the baseline ML methods by up to 5% on aggregate R², and halve the error in some out of distribution sections.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作主张用张量补全作为材料设计中预测与可解释分析的一体化工具，以应对高维设计参数组合导致的指数级搜索空间。相比常规机器学习代理模型，张量方法在非均匀采样训练数据下具有竞争性预测能力，并能直接给出可解释的张量因子。实验表明，这些因子可帮助重新发现物理现象，为材料设计中的结构—性能关系分析提供透明表示。
authors: Shaan Pakala, Aldair E. Gongora, Brian Giera, Evangelos E. Papalexakis

articles.title: Is data-efficient learning feasible with quantum models?
articles.title_zh: 量子模型能否实现数据高效学习？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.19437v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The importance of analyzing nontrivial datasets when testing quantum machine learning (QML) models is becoming increasingly prominent in literature, yet a cohesive framework for understanding dataset characteristics remains elusive. In this work, we introduce a data-generation tool that allows to construct semi-artificial classical datasets tailored to quantum kernel methods (QKMs). Using this tool, we show that on fully classical datasets, QKMs can require fewer training examples than classical kernels to reach comparable error, providing clear empirical evidence that data-efficient learning with quantum models is possible on classical data. The main motivation behind this tool is to enable the community to perform controlled studies to figure out which dataset characteristics are particularly fitting for quantum models by tuning the data-generation procedure. Additionally, our study brings a spectral-bias-based generalization metric from classical kernel methods into the QML domain and show that the performance predicted by this metric aligns closely with empirical results, thereby closing an important gap between theory and practice in QML generalization. Our tool paves the way for a systematic exploration of dataset complexities. This could potentially contribute to a deeper understanding of the generalization benefits of QKM models (extendable to a broader family of QML models) and shifts the search for quantum advantage from ad hoc benchmark hunting to principled dataset design.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种面向量子核方法的半人工经典数据生成工具，用于可控地分析哪些数据特征适合量子机器学习模型。作者在完全经典数据集上展示，量子核方法在达到相近误差时可能比经典核需要更少训练样本，为量子模型的数据高效学习提供经验证据。文章还将基于谱偏置的泛化度量引入量子机器学习，并表明其预测与实验性能较好一致。
authors: Alona Sakhnenko, Christian B. Mendl, Jeanette M. Lorenz

articles.title: Fine-grained Soundscape Control for Augmented Hearing
articles.title_zh: 面向增强听觉的细粒度声景控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.00395v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Hearables are becoming ubiquitous, yet their sound controls remain blunt: users can either enable global noise suppression or focus on a single target sound. Real-world acoustic scenes, however, contain many simultaneous sources that users may want to adjust independently. We introduce Aurchestra, the first system to provide fine-grained, real-time soundscape control on resource-constrained hearables. Our system has two key components: (1) a dynamic interface that surfaces only active sound classes and (2) a real-time, on-device multi-output extraction network that generates separate streams for each selected class, achieving robust performance for upto 5 overlapping target sounds, and letting users mix their environment by customizing per-class volumes, much like an audio engineer mixes tracks. We optimize the model architecture for multiple compute-limited platforms and demonstrate real-time performance on 6 ms streaming audio chunks. Across real-world environments in previously unseen indoor and outdoor scenarios, our system enables expressive per-class sound control and achieves substantial improvements in target-class enhancement and interference suppression. Our results show that the world need not be heard as a single, undifferentiated stream: with Aurchestra, the soundscape becomes truly programmable.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出Aurchestra，一种面向资源受限可听戴设备的实时细粒度声景控制系统，允许用户独立调节环境中多个同时存在的声源类别，而非仅进行全局降噪或单目标聚焦。系统包含动态界面和端侧多输出声音提取网络，可为选定类别生成独立音频流，并支持最多约5个重叠目标声音的实时处理。作者针对多种受限计算平台优化模型，并在6毫秒流式音频块上实现实时运行，在未见过的室内外场景中提升了目标类别控制能力。
authors: Seunghyun Oh, Malek Itani, Aseem Gauri, Shyamnath Gollakota

articles.title: A Formalization of the Mean-Field Derivation of the Vlasov Equation: AI-Assisted Lean Formalization as a Strategy Game
articles.title_zh: Vlasov方程平均场推导的形式化：作为策略游戏的AI辅助Lean形式化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08986v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We formalize a research result in the Lean 4 proof assistant by having a mathematician direct an AI system, and frame the activity as a formalization game. The objective is to turn a LaTeX document into Lean. The game is won when the development compiles, contains no sorry, and a machine check shows the target theorems rest on Lean's foundational axioms alone. Reuse is a second check, by a definition we introduce: whether the development yields a self-contained layer of general mathematics the wider library could absorb. The case study is a complete, axiom-clean formalization of well-posedness for the nonlinear Vlasov equation via Dobrushin's mean-field route -- existence, uniqueness, the stability estimate and mean-field limit, and a short-window superposition principle (weak solutions are Lagrangian). The human's role was to direct, not to write proofs: to scope the definitions, steer the decompositions, and triage the library's gaps; the AI agent executed. The formalization certifies the proof of each statement as written; whether the written statement is the intended theorem stays the mathematician's judgment. The optimal-transport machinery that fell out of the build (in particular, properties of the Wasserstein-1 metric and the Kantorovich-Rubinstein duality theorem) separates into a self-contained layer that compiles against Mathlib alone: about a sixth of the development (49 of 299 declarations), behind a 22-declaration interface with no reverse dependency. The headline theorems ran in about a week, the full development in about a month. We report the quantitative claims as observations of one game, not as general laws. The game's rules name no particular system, so the methodological framing is meant to outlast the tools of any one run.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作在Lean 4证明助手中形式化了非线性Vlasov方程经Dobrushin平均场路线得到的适定性结果，包括存在性、唯一性、稳定性估计、平均场极限以及短时窗叠加原理。作者将从LaTeX文档到Lean证明的过程描述为一种形式化游戏：数学家负责定义范围、分解策略和库缺口判断，AI系统执行证明构造。最终形式化不含sorry且仅依赖Lean基础公理，同时也强调机器验证保证的是所写陈述的证明，而陈述是否对应预期定理仍需数学家判断。

articles.title: OpenProver: Agentic and Interactive Theorem Proving with Lean 4
articles.title_zh: OpenProver：基于Lean 4的智能体式交互定理证明
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09217v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this system paper, we present OpenProver, an open-source system for LLM-driven automated theorem proving (ATP) with integrated Lean 4 formal verification. OpenProver integrates a Planner-Worker-Verifier architecture inspired by recent ATP agentic systems such as Aletheia. A Planner agent maintains a compact Whiteboard scratchpad and an unbounded Repository of intermediate findings, and decomposes mathematical work into parallel Workers. OpenProver is fully open-source, offers reproducible evaluation through automatic formal verification of generated proofs, and provides an interactive terminal interface for human-guided proof search. In interactive mode, OpenProver allows the human operator to monitor and steer the proof search process, motivated by the established human-AI synergy in interactive code generation. To showcase the potential for quantitative ablation experiments enabled by automatic formal verification, we evaluate OpenProver on ProofNet and compare it with a simple baseline. OpenProver is publicly available at https://github.com/kripner/OpenProver.
articles.abstract_zh: 该系统论文介绍OpenProver，一个开源的LLM驱动自动定理证明系统，并集成Lean 4形式化验证。系统采用Planner-Worker-Verifier架构：规划器维护紧凑白板和中间结果库，将数学任务分解给并行工作器，并由验证器检查证明。OpenProver支持可复现实验和交互式终端，使人类操作者能够监控并引导证明搜索；作者在ProofNet上展示了其与简单基线的比较。

articles.title: Minimal Decision Dynamics and Contextual Probability: A Quantum Tug-of-War Model
articles.title_zh: 最小决策动力学与情境概率：量子拔河模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.10034v2 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Decision making often exhibits context dependence that challenges classical probability theory. This paper develops a quantum-like extension of the Tug-of-War (QTOW) decision-making model to clarify when such context dependence can be represented by a single minimal internal state. The QTOW construction uses a qutrit internal state, conservation-preserving updates, and measurement-induced disturbance to model decision, learning, and probing operations within one coherent state space. Within this minimal representation, KCBS-type probing contexts can be constructed, yielding a witness of non-contextual classical non-embeddability. The main claim is not that quantum theory is uniquely or assumption-freely derived from decision making. Rather, a classical reconstruction of the same operation family requires additional contextual memory, history dependence, or an enlarged hidden-state representation. Thus, contextual probability appears as a resource signature of minimal decision dynamics, while quantum probability provides a compact, memory-efficient realization of this structure.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文发展了拔河决策模型的量子式扩展，用于解释决策中的情境依赖何时可由单一最小内部状态表示。模型使用qutrit内部状态、保持守恒的更新以及测量诱导扰动，将决策、学习和探测操作置于统一状态空间中，并可构造KCBS型探测情境以显示非情境经典嵌入的困难。作者的核心观点是，量子概率为这种结构提供了紧凑且节省记忆的表示，而等价经典重构通常需要额外情境记忆、历史依赖或扩展隐状态。

articles.title: A Novel Parallel QCNN Architecture with Efficient Classical Simulability
articles.title_zh: 一种具有高效经典可模拟性的并行量子卷积神经网络新架构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08928v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This work presents a study of an implementation of a novel Quantum Convolutional Neural Network (QCNN) for binary classification of images from the Modified National Institute of Standards and Technology (MNIST) dataset. Using a novel architecture inspired by previous QCNN and classical convolutional neural network (CNN) implementations, we use a hierarchical partitioning approach to implement a QCNN circuit that can be approximated and simulated efficiently on a classical machine for a large problem. First, the original image is partitioned such that each process handles a smaller portion of the image, which is encoded into independent states. Then, these partitions merge and combine, resulting in states that contain information from both partitions while halving the number of processes. After repeating this until one process remains, we reduce the dimensionality of the state until a single qubit remains for measurement. Using this approach, we can use multiple processes in parallel to simulate a large QCNN program without the need for exponentially growing hardware requirements as the number of qubits increases. In our work, we use this scheme to train a 128-qubit model, which is impossible to run on any classical supercomputer without the novel architecture. We also explore the impact of this new model architecture on prediction accuracy by training it to perform binary classification on the MNIST dataset with a small number of qubits, and comparing it to a model without partitioning. Our initial findings show that partitioning images into smaller sub-images with this architecture does not degrade the model's performance and sometimes even improves it, likely because it reduces the Barren plateaus issue in the partitioning process.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种用于MNIST二分类的量子卷积神经网络架构，目标是在较大问题规模下仍可由经典计算机高效近似模拟。方法采用层次化图像分块：各进程分别编码局部图像片段，随后逐级合并分区状态并减少进程数，最终将状态降维到单量子比特进行测量。该并行结构避免随量子比特数增加而产生指数级硬件需求，为大规模QCNN程序的经典模拟提供了一种工程路径。

articles.title: Video Generation Models are General-Purpose Vision Learners
articles.title_zh: 视频生成模型是通用视觉学习器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09024v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Driven by next-token prediction, NLP shifted from task-specific models into powerful generalist foundation models. What, then, is the equivalent catalyst needed to achieve a general-purpose model in computer vision? In this paper, we contend that large-scale text-to-video generation serves as a strong pre-training paradigm for computer vision, providing the necessary spatiotemporal priors, vision-language alignment, and scalability required for general visual intelligence. We introduce GenCeption, which leverages a pre-trained video generative diffusion backbone to define a feed-forward perception model, capable of performing various vision tasks steered by text instructions. Empirical results demonstrate that GenCeption achieves state-of-the-art performance across a diverse suite of tasks, including depth, surface normal, and camera pose estimation, expression-referring segmentation, and 3D keypoint prediction, often matching or surpassing specialized models (e.g. DepthAnything3, SAM3, D4RT, VGGT-Omega, Sapiens, David, Genmo, and Lotus-2). Furthermore, the video generative pretrained backbone outperforms alternative pretraining paradigms (e.g., V-JEPA, and Video MAE) under comparable settings. Importantly, GenCeption exhibits preliminary data and model scaling properties along with exceptional data efficiency, where it achieves comparable performance with leading models like D4RT and VGGT-Omega with 7 to 500 less training data. Finally, GenCeption also exhibits intriguing emergent behaviors: a model trained exclusively on synthetic human videos generalizes to real-world footage and out-of-distribution object categories (e.g., animals and robots). These findings suggest that video generation is not merely a synthesis tool, but a foundational path toward generalist vision intelligence for the physical world. Project page: https://genception.github.io
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出，大规模文本到视频生成可作为计算机视觉通用基础模型的预训练范式，因为它同时提供时空先验、视觉-语言对齐和可扩展性。所提出的 GenCeption 利用预训练视频扩散生成骨干构建前馈感知模型，并通过文本指令适配深度、法向、相机位姿、指代表达分割和三维关键点等任务。实验显示其在多类视觉任务上达到或超过专用模型，表明视频生成预训练骨干具有强泛化感知能力。
authors: Letian Wang, Chuhan Zhang, Rishabh Kabra, Jasper Uijlings, Steven Waslander, Andrew Zisserman, Joao Carreira, Kaiming He, Misha Andriluka, Eduard Gabriel Bazavan, Andrei Zanfir, Cristian Sminchisescu

articles.title: When Routes Run Out: Adversarial Co-Learning and Explainable Robustness in Quantum Repeater Networks
articles.title_zh: 路由耗尽时：量子中继网络中的对抗协同学习与可解释鲁棒性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09378v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study an adversarial bandit problem for entanglement-based quantum-network routing over a modest graph corpus. Alice selects an end-to-end repeater route for an Ekert-91 protocol (E91) representing her move, while Eve selects an attack surface, either edge intercept--resend or repeater memory degradation. Payoffs are drawn from cached SeQUeNCe-simulated E91 transcripts, and Alice accepts a turn when the finite-sample statistic violates the Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt (CHSH) bound. Performing adversarial co-learning across 50 structured topologies, we find that learned retention tracks a full-matrix minimax reference closely (Pearson r=0.99): under a one-surface Eve action model, bottleneck families have zero retention, while non-bottleneck families follow a 1-1/N coverage principle. We then fit decision-tree explanation models to graph-, attack-, and route-level topology-corpus targets and report their faithfulness. Finally, we construct prompt records for local language models to summarize the tree evidence, resulting in an open-source explanation workflow for quantum-repeater network games.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究基于纠缠的量子网络路由中的对抗多臂老虎机问题：Alice 为 E91 协议选择端到端中继路径，Eve 选择边截获重发或中继存储退化等攻击面。收益来自 SeQUeNCe 模拟的 E91 记录，并以有限样本 CHSH 违背作为接受判据。在 50 个结构化拓扑上的协同学习表明，学习到的保留率与全矩阵极小极大参考高度一致，并揭示瓶颈拓扑零保留及非瓶颈拓扑的覆盖规律；作者还用决策树和本地语言模型构建了开源解释流程。
authors: Brennan Bell, Inti Gabriel Mendoza Estrada, Andreas Trügler, Paul Erker

articles.title: Lean-QIT: Towards a Formal Infrastructure for Quantum Information Theory
articles.title_zh: Lean-QIT：面向量子信息论的形式化基础设施
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09632v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum information theory (QIT) characterizes the capabilities and fundamental limits of quantum information processing, underpinning quantum communication, computation, and error correction. Formalizing its coding theorems requires connecting finite-block protocols, analytic inequalities, and asymptotic limits within a unified machine-checked framework. Existing developments, however, lack a reusable operational layer that defines codes, error criteria, achievable rates, and capacities independently of their information-theoretic characterizations. In this work, we present LeanQIT, a Lean 4 library for finite-dimensional QIT. It provides composable, kernel-checked interfaces for quantum states and channels, source and channel codes, finite-block performance criteria, hypothesis testing, one-shot quantities, and asymptotic rate constructions. Using this infrastructure, we formalize Schumacher's quantum source-coding theorem, the Holevo--Schumacher--Westmoreland classical-capacity theorem, and the entanglement-assisted classical-capacity theorem together with its strong converse. By separating operational definitions from analytic characterizations and exposing reusable achievability, converse, and asymptotic components, Lean-QIT provides a machine-readable foundation for formal QIT and a compositional knowledge substrate for emerging AI-assisted formalization, automated proof search, and agentic reasoning in quantum information and computation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出 LeanQIT，一个面向有限维量子信息论的 Lean 4 库，用于把有限块长协议、解析不等式和渐近极限纳入机器可检验框架。库提供量子态、量子信道、源编码与信道编码、误差准则、假设检验、单次量和渐近速率等可组合接口。作者以此形式化了 Schumacher 量子信源编码定理、Holevo–Schumacher–Westmoreland 经典容量定理以及纠缠辅助经典容量定理及其强逆定理，强调将操作性定义与解析刻画解耦以提高复用性。
authors: Chengkai Zhu, Ziao Tang, Guocheng Zhen, Yimeng Cao, Yusheng Zhao, Ranyiliu Chen, Xuanqiang Zhao, Lei Zhang, Xin Wang

articles.title: Improving Language Agents through BREW: Bootstrapping expeRientially-learned Environmental knoWledge
articles.title_zh: 通过 BREW 改进语言智能体：自举式经验环境知识学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.20297v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents are increasingly capable of complex, multi-step tasks such as GUI automation, tool use, and data manipulation, yet they cannot learn from experience: each new session rediscovers solutions from scratch. We introduce BREW (Bootstrapping expeRientially-learned Environmental knoWledge), a framework that distills an agent's past interaction trajectories into a structured, retrievable knowledge base (KB) of natural-language recipes, concept-level procedural documents that capture what to do, when it applies, and what to watch out for. Drawing on the principle of library learning from program synthesis, BREW decomposes agent memory into modular, concept-localized documents and formalizes KB construction as a state-space search problem. To navigate this space, we introduce Expand-and-Gather Monte Carlo Tree Search (EG-MCTS), a reward-guided algorithm that jointly optimizes recipe accuracy and retrievability across parallel, per-concept search trees. We further adapt hindsight relabeling to convert near-miss trajectories into positive demonstrations, surfacing latent agent competencies as reusable knowledge. On three domain-grounded benchmarks, OSWorld, tau²⁻Bench, and SpreadSheetBench, BREW achieves 10-20% gains in task success and 10-15% fewer execution steps over base agents, while consistently outperforming existing memory-augmented baselines that can degrade below memoryless performance. The resulting KB is inspectable, modular, and extensible, providing a transparent and controllable substrate for agent optimization.
articles.abstract_zh: BREW 旨在解决 LLM 智能体每次会话都从零探索、难以从经验中持续学习的问题。它将过往交互轨迹蒸馏为结构化、可检索的自然语言“配方”知识库，记录适用情境、操作步骤和注意事项。作者将知识库构建形式化为状态空间搜索，并提出 Expand-and-Gather MCTS 来联合优化配方准确性与可检索性，同时用 hindsight relabeling 将接近成功的轨迹转化为可复用示范。
authors: Shashank Kirtania, Param Biyani, Priyanshu Gupta, Yasharth Bajpai, Roshni Iyer, Sumit Gulwani, Gustavo Soares

articles.title: RIS-Assisted Downlink Pinching-Antenna Systems: GNN-Enabled Optimization Approaches
articles.title_zh: RIS 辅助下行夹持天线系统：基于图神经网络的优化方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.20305v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This paper investigates a reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-assisted multi-waveguide pinching-antenna (PA) system (PASS) for multi-user downlink information transmission, motivated by the unknown impact of the integration of emerging PASS and RIS on wireless communications. First, we formulate sum rate (SR) and energy efficiency (EE) maximization problems in a unified framework, subject to constraints on the movable region of PAs, total power budget, and tunable phase of RIS elements. Then, by leveraging a graph-structured topology of the RIS-assisted PASS, a novel three-stage graph neural network (GNN) is proposed, which learns PA positions based on user locations, and RIS phase shifts according to composite channel conditions at the first two stages, respectively, and finally determines beamforming vectors. Specifically, the proposed GNN is achieved through unsupervised training, together with three implementation strategies for its integration with convex optimization, thus offering trade-offs between inference time and solution optimality. Extensive numerical results are provided to validate the effectiveness of the proposed GNN, and to support its unique attributes of viable generalization capability, good performance reliability, and real-time applicability. Moreover, the impact of key parameters on RIS-assisted PASS is illustrated and analyzed.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究可重构智能表面辅助的多波导夹持天线系统在多用户下行传输中的优化问题，统一表述了和速率最大化与能效最大化，并考虑天线可移动区域、总功率和 RIS 相位约束。作者利用系统的图结构提出三阶段 GNN：先根据用户位置学习夹持天线位置，再根据复合信道学习 RIS 相移，最后确定波束成形向量。该 GNN 采用无监督训练，并设计三种与凸优化结合的实现策略，以在推理时延和解最优性之间折中；数值结果验证了方法有效性。
authors: Changpeng He, Yang Lu, Yanqing Xu, Chong-Yung Chi, Arumugam Nallanathan

articles.title: A Quatre-Lobed Arc-Slotted Microstrip Patch Antenna for Ku-Band Applications at 14.45 GHz
articles.title_zh: 用于 14.45 GHz Ku 波段应用的四叶弧形开槽微带贴片天线
articles.abstract: This paper presents the design of a Quatre-Lobed Arc-Slotted microstrip patch antenna, having a size of 8 mm × 8 mm × 0.8 mm, with an objective to attain an optimal value of 14.45 GHz for its operating frequency in the Ku frequency band (12–18 GHz) application. Simple, single-layer microstrip antennas typically involve a design trade-off between the antenna’s profile, cost-effectiveness, level of performance, and stability of radiation patterns. The constructed patch antenna accommodates a microstrip feed with a lumped port. The feed structure facili-tates impedance matching and effective excitation of the dominant mode. The High Frequency Structure Simulator (HFSS) was used to run the full-wave elec-tromagnetic simulations. By including a finite conductor with a dielectric loss, the simulated metal and dielectric structures closely modeled the antenna’s behav-ior in the high-frequency region of the band. The antenna showed an impedance bandwidth of 14.05 to 15.10 GHz (broadside radiation pattern), with reflection coefficient S11 = − 18.5 dB at 14.45 GHz; the angular distribution of the radi-ation pattern was stable and showed a maximal gain of 6.27 dBi, demonstrating effective radiation performance. Thus, the symmetric arc-slot geometry design of the patch antenna facilitated a trade-off between current path control, structural simplicity, and impedance balance. The proposed patch antenna design is a practi-cal and deployable solution for integration into Ku-band satellite communication systems, wireless applications, and high-frequency communication systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文设计了一种 8 mm × 8 mm × 0.8 mm 的四叶弧形开槽微带贴片天线，目标工作频率为 Ku 波段的 14.45 GHz。天线采用微带馈电和集总端口，并通过 HFSS 全波电磁仿真考虑有限导体和介质损耗。仿真结果显示其阻抗带宽为 14.05–15.10 GHz，在 14.45 GHz 处 S11 为 −18.5 dB，最大增益 6.27 dBi，且具有较稳定的宽边辐射方向图。

articles.title: Quantum Tensor Magnetometry with Bright Multi-Dimensional Entangled Lights
articles.title_zh: 利用明亮多维纠缠光的量子张量磁测量
articles.abstract: Tensor measurements play a vital role in both fundamental sciences and interdisciplinary applications such as navigation and remote sensing which require sensitive perception of the gradient of vector fields. Fundamentally, these measurements rely on the estimation of multiple parameters, which is a key focus in metrology. Quantum metrology has achieved remarkable success in surpassing the standard quantum limit for single-parameter estimation, offering extraordinary sensitivity. Quantum multiparameter estimation has also been demonstrated recently with few-particle quantum systems. Here, we develop tensor quantum metrology by advancing multiparameter quantum sensing to an unprecedented level with both high scalability and multidimensional performance, fulfilling the essential demands on sensitivity for tensor measurements. We generate a bright, multidimensional polarization-entangled light source from an atomic ensemble, with three simultaneously squeezed Stokes operators, enabling superior performance in multiparameter quantum sensing compared to conventional polarization-entangled light. By employing such a quantum light in a tensor magnetometry, we achieve a 6 dB quantum enhancement in both direction and amplitude measurements of magnetic field gradient, with a directional gradient sensitivity of 21μrad/cm/√Hz and an amplitude gradient sensitivity of 6 fT/cm/√Hz. As the first realization of high-sensitivity quantum-enhanced sensing of a tensor field, this work marks a milestone in the advancement of quantum metrology.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作将多参数量子传感推进到张量磁测量场景，面向需要矢量场梯度高灵敏感知的导航、遥感等应用。作者从原子系综产生明亮的多维偏振纠缠光源，使三个 Stokes 算符同时压缩，从而优于常规偏振纠缠光的多参数感测性能。将该量子光用于张量磁强计后，实现约 6 dB 的量子增强，展示了可扩展多维量子计量在张量测量中的潜力。

articles.title: Gravitational-Wave Echoes from a Hayward Black Hole under Minimal Geometric Deformation
articles.title_zh: 最小几何形变下 Hayward 黑洞的引力波回声
articles.abstract: We study a regular black-hole geometry obtained by applying a radial minimal geometric deformation (MGD) of dimensionless strength α to the Hayward seed, characterized by its ADM mass M and its regularity scale g,and then trace the construction through the odd-parity perturbation problem. The background sector is kept exact: the deformation function is written in closed form, the Einstein equations separate into seed and decoupler blocks (the decoupler being the additional effective source that deforms the seed), asymptotic flatness is preserved, and the deformed metric remains curvature regular at the center while inheriting the seed horizon structure in an explicit admissible range of the deformation parameter α. In the axial sector we work under the frozen-source odd-parity closure appropriate to a static anisotropic background without an independent propagating odd matter mode. Within that framework the master equation acquires an exact effective potential whose seed contribution retains the nonvacuum Hayward correction proportional to the radial derivative m_H'(r) of the Hayward mass function m_H(r) and whose decoupling contribution is isolated analytically. We show that this potential passes from a single-barrier profile to a genuine max--min--max structure in an open region of the (g,α) plane, so the exact geometry itself supplies a trapping cavity without any externally imposed mirror or phenomenological reflecting surface. A representative characteristic evolution is then used to connect the potential structure to delayed secondary pulses in the time domain. The analysis makes each algebraic step explicit, states every assumption at the point of use, distinguishes exact statements from numerical evidence, and records the numerical methodology in enough detail for direct audit and reproduction.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究在 Hayward 正则黑洞种子度规上施加径向最小几何形变后的正则黑洞几何，并分析其奇宇称扰动。作者保持背景精确处理，给出闭式形变函数，将爱因斯坦方程分解为种子块和解耦块，同时保持渐近平坦性、中心曲率正则性和一定参数范围内的视界结构。在线性轴向扰动中，主方程获得含 Hayward 非真空修正和解耦贡献的精确有效势，用于讨论该类正则黑洞可能产生的引力波回声特征。

articles.title: Empty scaffold allocation bias in molecular distribution shift evaluation
articles.title_zh: 分子分布偏移评估中的空骨架分配偏差
articles.abstract: Scaffold-based evaluation is widely used to estimate molecular machine-learning generalization to unseen scaffolds, but its validity depends on each split unit representing a chemically meaningful shared core. Here we show that this principle breaks down for molecules with empty Bemis–Murcko scaffold representations. These no-scaffold molecules are not an ordinary scaffold class: they lack a common ring–linker framework, are internally heterogeneous, show much lower within-unit similarity than true scaffold groups, and are weakly supported by the scaffold-bearing chemical space. Nevertheless, standard scaffold splitting collapses them into a single empty-scaffold bucket and treats them as one indivisible split unit. Across MoleculeNet and Deep-PK/ADMET benchmarks, this is not rare: 8 of 16 MoleculeNet datasets and 40 of 73 Deep-PK/ADMET tasks contain more than 10% no-scaffold molecules, with several physicochemical endpoints approaching 50%. We further show that Scaffold Split, UMAP-based clustering, DataSAIL and LoHi can all deplete no-scaffold molecules from training while enriching them in validation or test sets. This hidden allocation bias confounds scaffold-level evaluation with residual-subpopulation underrepresentation, compressing classification ranking toward the prior baseline and enriching high-multiple regression error inflation. Empty-Scaffold-Aware repair restores training-side representation while retaining evaluation exposure and controlling train-facing similarity.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文指出，基于 Bemis–Murcko 骨架的数据划分在评估分子机器学习对未见骨架的泛化时，会因“空骨架”分子而产生隐藏偏差。这些无骨架分子并非一个化学上有共同核心的普通骨架类，而是内部异质、相似性低且与有骨架化学空间支撑较弱；但标准 scaffold split 会把它们合并为一个不可拆分单元。作者在 MoleculeNet 和 Deep-PK/ADMET 中发现无骨架分子比例并不罕见，并说明 Scaffold Split、UMAP 聚类、DataSAIL 和 LoHi 都可能使训练集缺失而验证/测试集富集此类分子，从而混淆分布偏移评估。

articles.title: Fabrication and H2S gas sensitive performance of NiO ultrathin film encapsulated VO2(A) nanowire core-shell heterojunction structure
articles.title_zh: NiO 超薄膜包覆 VO2(A) 纳米线核壳异质结的制备及 H2S 气敏性能
articles.abstract: High performance hydrogen sulfide (H2S) gas sensor is highly desired to develop for the harmfulness of H2S to human’s health. In this work, a NiO/VO2(A) nanowire core-shell heterojunction is constructed through chemical precipitation and annealing to improve the sensitivity to H2S. The influence of precursor molar ratios on the composition, morphology, and gas-sensing performance of the core-shell heterojunction structure was investigated. The NiO/VO2(A) nanowire core-shell heterojunction based sensor exhibits high sensitivity when the precursor molar ratio is 1:0.5. The gas response value is reached up to 11.57 to 1 ppm H2S gas at 100°C. And the gas sensor also shows excellent response and recovery characteristics. The high sensing performance is related to the heterojunction between VO2(A) and ultrathin NiO film and the catalytic activity of NiO, which can enhance the chemical adsorption of oxygen on the surface of the heterojunction structure. The results suggest that VO2(A) nanowires core-shell nanostructure have great potential for H2S gas detection.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作通过化学沉淀和退火构筑 NiO/VO2(A) 纳米线核壳异质结，以提升硫化氢气体检测性能。作者考察前驱体摩尔比对组成、形貌和气敏性能的影响，发现 1:0.5 条件下传感器对 100°C、1 ppm H2S 的响应值达到 11.57，并具有较好的响应/恢复特性。性能提升归因于 VO2(A) 与超薄 NiO 膜形成的异质结以及 NiO 催化活性增强了表面氧化学吸附。

articles.title: A Stress-Based Prediction of Support Failure and Its Influence on Machining Quality in Support-Assisted Milling of LPBF Parts
articles.title_zh: LPBF 零件支撑辅助铣削中基于应力的支撑失效预测及其对加工质量的影响
articles.abstract: Laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) enables the fabrication of complex metallic components; however, milling-based post-processing is required to achieve functional surface quality and dimensional accuracy. Once separated from the build plate, the fabricated part must be re-fixed to a milling machine using additional clamping fixtures, and this procedure increases process complexity and machining errors due to repeated setup and alignment. To address this limitation, this study proposes a stress-based design approach for utilizing as-built support structures as structural fixtures during support-assisted milling. Cutting forces of LPBF-fabricated Pure Titanium specimens were experimentally measured under various machining conditions, and a mechanistic load model was established. The derived load model was used to estimate cutting loads for different process parameters. Support-assisted milling experiments were conducted to observe structural behavior and identify the onset of support failure under increasing cutting loads. Finite element simulations were performed using the calculated cutting loads to evaluate stress distributions within the support structures. For each design variable, the critical maximum principal stress corresponding to failure initiation was determined. Validation using a complex cage geometry demonstrated that the proposed stress criterion reliably predicts machining stability. The influence of stress levels on machining quality was further examined. Even below the critical stress threshold, increasing stress resulted in gradual deterioration of straightness error and surface roughness, indicating that stress magnitude affects machining performance prior to structural failure. The proposed approach provides a quantitative framework linking cutting load, stress distribution, failure initiation, and machining quality, thereby enabling predictive evaluation of support-assisted milling feasibility prior to machining.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对激光粉末床熔融零件后处理需重新装夹导致复杂性和误差增加的问题，提出利用成形支撑结构作为支撑辅助铣削夹具的应力设计方法。研究测量纯钛 LPBF 试样在不同铣削条件下的切削力，建立机械载荷模型，并据此估算不同参数下的切削载荷。作者结合支撑辅助铣削实验和有限元仿真，观察支撑结构在载荷增加下的行为与失效起点，并评估设计变量对支撑应力分布和加工质量的影响。

articles.title: A generative framework for precise topology engineering of polymer networks
articles.title_zh: 用于聚合物网络精确拓扑工程的生成式框架
articles.abstract: The mechanical performance of crosslinked polymer networks is typically predicted from the average crosslink density, yet topological heterogeneity of the crosslink functionality distribution P (f) can produce vast differences in elasticity and fracture at fixed density. Existing kinetic and reaction-diffusion algorithms cannot prescribe P (f) precisely, limiting systematic topological studies. We introduce a generative framework that maps abstract graph topologies into physically equilibrated molecular networks at arbitrary resolution. Atomistic simulations of PDMS and PMTFPS built on identical graph topologies reproduce chemical specificity, capturing the distinct glass transition temperatures driven by side-group sterics. A coarse-grained ensemble of over 300 architectures at fixed mean functionality but varied P (f) reveals a state-dependent hierarchy of design drivers: brittle networks fail via local stress concentrations (high betweenness centrality), while tough networks are governed by cooperative load sharing (high eigenvector centrality). Topological order thus acts as an orthogonal design variable to crosslink density, enabling mechanical tuning without altering chemistry.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种生成式框架，可将抽象图拓扑映射为物理平衡的分子聚合物网络，从而在任意分辨率下精确规定交联功能度分布 P(f)。在相同图拓扑上构建的 PDMS 和 PMTFPS 原子模拟能够再现侧基位阻导致的不同玻璃化转变温度，说明框架保留化学特异性。对 300 余种平均功能度固定但 P(f) 不同的粗粒化网络分析表明，脆性网络失效受局部应力集中和高介数中心性控制，而高韧性网络更依赖协同载荷分担和高特征向量中心性，说明拓扑有序性可作为独立于交联密度的力学设计变量。

articles.title: Physics-Informed Ensemble Learning for Structural Wall Plastic Hinge Length Prediction
articles.title_zh: 用于结构墙塑性铰长度预测的物理信息集成学习
articles.abstract: This paper presents a novel stacking ensemble framework for predicting the plastic hinge length of reinforced concrete shear walls, a critical parameter in seismic design and performance assessment. The proposed methodology leverages a two-level ensemble architecture, combining multiple base learners with a meta-learner to capture the complex nonlinear relationships between geometric and material properties and the resulting plastic hinge length. The framework is grounded in a theoretical paradigm that bridges causal inference with stochastic differential geometry, providing rigorous mathematical underpinnings for the learning objective and establishing convergence and generalization guarantees. Comprehensive experimental validation on the Hoult RCSW database, comprising 721 experimental samples, demonstrates the superiority of the proposed approach. The stacking ensemble with a gradient boosting meta-learner achieves the lowest mean squared error of 0.012 square metres and the highest coefficient of determination of 0.916, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art ensemble learning methods and empirical formulations. The framework exhibits robust performance across different wall length ranges, strong transferability to related structural engineering tasks, and stability under input perturbations. This work establishes a new paradigm for data-driven structural engineering, demonstrating the value of ensemble architectures for capturing the stochastic and causal nature of plastic hinge formation in reinforced concrete walls.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种堆叠式集成学习框架，用于预测钢筋混凝土剪力墙在抗震设计与性能评估中的关键参数——塑性铰长度。方法采用两级架构，将多个基学习器与元学习器结合，以刻画几何和材料参数与塑性铰长度之间的复杂非线性关系，并引入因果推断与随机微分几何相关理论作为学习目标和泛化性的数学基础。基于含721个试验样本的Hoult RCSW数据库验证表明，以梯度提升为元学习器的堆叠模型取得最低均方误差0.012 m²和最高决定系数0.916，优于既有集成学习方法和经验公式。

articles.title: Operationalizing Generative Spatial Intelligence: A Conversational GeoAI Framework for Flood Risk Communication
articles.title_zh: 生成式空间智能的操作化：面向洪水风险沟通的对话式GeoAI框架
articles.abstract: Official flood maps, while technically robust, present significant usability challenges for non-expert decision-makers, creating a critical communication gap between scientific flood data and immediate community action. This research addresses this gap by designing and evaluating a novel, human-centered GeoAI framework that integrates a conversational AI assistant with an interactive geospatial interface to transform static maps into dynamic storytelling mediums. Beyond technical tool development, the study draws upon the emerging concept of Generative Spatial Intelligence (GSI) as a geospatial interaction framework that extends the foundations of Exploratory Spatial Data Analysis (ESDA), examining how AI-mediated systems support knowledge generation, contextual interpretation, and human–AI collaborative spatial reasoning. By bridging the gap between physical Earth observation data and their social implications, the proposed framework enables the autonomous, real-time synthesis of multi-domain datasets. We combine principles of user-centered design and GIS to develop an interactive prototype grounded in a domain-specific knowledge graph and a curated database of hydrologic and social geospatial layers. Through data storytelling, the system translates complex map features into plain-language, contextual insights, transforming passive map viewing into an active process of spatial learning and decision support. The AI-powered storytelling capability is evaluated using a targeted test suite of 40 synthesized, domain-specific questions that integrate hydrologic concepts with physical and social geospatial data to simulate realistic flood scenarios. Findings demonstrate that the system effectively synthesizes complex information into location-specific advisories, illustrating how conversational GeoAI can automate the translation of raw spatial telemetry into actionable disaster intelligence and thereby democratize high-stakes emergency decision-making for community leaders.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对官方洪水地图对非专业决策者不够易用、难以转化为社区即时行动的问题，设计并评估了一种以人为中心的GeoAI框架。该框架将对话式AI助手与交互式地理空间界面结合，把静态洪水图转化为动态叙事和解释媒介。研究以生成式空间智能为概念基础，结合用户中心设计、GIS、领域知识图谱及水文和社会数据，以支持实时多源数据综合、情境解释和人机协同空间推理。

articles.title: ℓ0-Regularized Quadratic Surface Support Vector Machines
articles.title_zh: ℓ0正则化二次曲面支持向量机
articles.abstract: Kernel-free quadratic surface support vector machines (QSVM) have recently gained traction due to their flexibility in modeling nonlinear decision boundaries without relying on kernel functions. However, the introduction of a full quadratic classifier significantly increases the number of model parameters, scaling quadratically with data dimensionality, which often leads to overfitting and makes interpretation difficult. To address these challenges, we propose sparse variants of the QSVM by enforcing a cardinality constraint on the model parameters. While enhancing generalization and promoting sparsity, leveraging the ℓ0-norm inevitably incurs additional computational complexity. To tackle this, we develop a penalty decomposition algorithm that produces solutions that provably satisfy the first-order Lu-Zhang optimality conditions. We show that the subproblems arising in the algorithm either admit closed-form solutions or can be solved efficiently via dual formulations, thereby contributing to the method’s overall effectiveness. Besides, we analyze the convergence behavior of the algorithm under both loss settings. In addition, the numerical experiments on public benchmark datasets indicate that the proposed model is competitive with commonly used SVM variants and produces sparse solutions as expected. Moreover, its strong performance on real-world credit datasets demonstrates its potential for credit scoring applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究无核二次曲面支持向量机在非线性分类中的稀疏化问题，以缓解全二次分类器参数量随维度平方增长导致的过拟合和可解释性下降。作者通过对模型参数施加基数约束构造ℓ0正则化QSVM，并提出罚分解算法，所得解可证明满足一阶Lu-Zhang最优性条件。文中说明相关子问题可闭式求解或通过对偶形式高效求解，并分析了不同损失设定下的收敛行为；公共基准数据集实验用于验证其稀疏性和分类性能。

articles.title: A Novel Method for Determining Phase-Specific Microhardness from Non-targeted Automated Testing of Fine-grained Multiphase Structures
articles.title_zh: 由细晶多相组织非定向自动测试确定相特异微硬度的新方法
articles.abstract: Microscale characterization of the mechanical properties of individual phases in multiphase alloys provides important information for alloy design, production, and in-service performance. Automated microhardness testing has significant potential for the statistical characterization of multiphase materials. However, successful application of this technique is limited for fine-grained multiphase structures due to indentations overlapping grain boundaries, and the resulting misinterpretation of the true microhardness of individual phases. To determine the true phase-specific microhardness in multiphase fine-grained structures, a novel experimental-simulation methodology was proposed based on the principle of non-targeted microhardness measurements (NTM). The program for virtual NTM testing was developed and applied to regular and irregular grain morphologies in two-phase microstructures. This provided a quantitative understanding of the statistical relationship between the NTM measured dataset and the underlying microstructure. It was shown that the dimensionless parameter R, defined as the ratio of indentation diameter to the characteristic grain diameter, is a fundamental descriptor of datasets obtained during NTM testing. Simulations proved that, for specific values of the R-ratio, phase fraction and microhardness, NTM test delivers the unique microhardness probability distribution function. This property of datasets from NTM tests was used to determine intrinsic phase characteristics from inverse simulation. The proposed methodology provides a basis for optimizing NTM testing procedures, and, most importantly, improving phase-specific property characterization in fine-grained structures. The proposed combination of stochastic simulation with large experimental dataset from NTM test can be used for alloy design and quality control of multiphase engineering alloys.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种结合实验与模拟的方法，用于从非定向自动微硬度测试数据中反推出细晶多相合金中各相的真实微硬度。针对压痕跨越晶界导致单相硬度误判的问题，作者开发了虚拟非定向微硬度测试程序，并应用于规则和非规则两相晶粒形貌，以量化测量数据与真实显微组织之间的统计关系。研究指出压痕直径与特征晶粒直径之比R是描述误差和可分辨性的关键无量纲参数，可为多相细晶材料的自动硬度统计表征提供依据。

articles.title: A Complex-Quaternionic Riemann–Silberstein Formalism for Single-Photon Electromagnetic Wave Packets
articles.title_zh: 单光子电磁波包的复四元数Riemann–Silberstein形式主义
articles.abstract: Single photons are elementary excitations of the quantized electromagnetic field, yet their electromagnetic structure is often described through separate electric and magnetic field operators. Here we develop a theorem-based complex-quaternionic Riemann-Silberstein representation of single-photon electromagnetic wave packets. The formalism embeds the transverse electric and magnetic components into one helicity-resolved biquaternionic field, so that transversality, electric-magnetic orthogonality, helicity projection, and mode-wise nullity are encoded within a single algebraic structure. We show that the source-free Maxwell equations reduce to one first-order quaternionic Maxwell equation and that canonical quantization yields the one-photon electromagnetic amplitude as a vacuum-to-one-photon transition matrix element. The resulting expression is a spectral superposition of transverse modes weighted by the photon wave-packet envelope. Beyond notational compactness, the construction separates three operational ingredients of a one-photon state: spectral localization, helicity selection, and mode matching to a detector or target mode. The framework is fully compatible with standard QED and clarifies that broadband photon wave packets are generally not pointwise null, although each Fourier component is null.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文发展了一种基于定理的复四元数Riemann–Silberstein表示，用于描述单光子电磁波包。该形式将横向电场和磁场分量嵌入一个按螺旋度分辨的双四元数字段中，使横向性、电磁正交性、螺旋度投影和逐模零性统一编码于同一代数结构。作者表明无源Maxwell方程可化为一个一阶四元数Maxwell方程，正则量子化后单光子电磁振幅可表示为真空到单光子态的跃迁矩阵元，并自然分离谱局域、螺旋度选择和探测/目标模匹配等操作要素。

articles.title: Microstructure and mechanical properties of laser deposition repairing ZM5 magnesium alloy in the aerospace field
articles.title_zh: 航空航天领域ZM5镁合金激光沉积修复的组织与力学性能
articles.abstract: To address metallurgical defects and abnormal damages occurring in magnesium alloy components during casting, machining, and service operation in the aerospace component, research has been conducted on laser deposition repairing of ZM5 alloy. Using equipment such as optical microscopes, scanning electron microscopes, microhardness tester and tensile testing machines, the microstructural characteristics and mechanical properties of the repaired samples were analyzed. The results show that the repaired zone forms a good metallurgical bond with the base material without obviously unfused and crack defects. The microstructure of repaired zone is fine and consists of equiaxed α-Mg matrix, β-Mg17Al12 and Al8Mn5 phases dispersively distributed at the grain boundaries and intragranular. The microhardness of the repaired zone is increased by 27% compared with the base material. The ultimate tensile strength of the repaired sample is slightly lower than that of the base material, but the elongation is higher. Both base materials and the repaired samples show the typical cleavage fracture.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向航空航天镁合金构件在铸造、加工和服役中产生的冶金缺陷及异常损伤，开展ZM5合金激光沉积修复实验。通过光学显微镜、扫描电镜、显微硬度和拉伸测试分析修复区组织与性能，结果显示修复区与基体形成良好冶金结合，未见明显未熔合和裂纹缺陷。修复区由细小等轴α-Mg基体及分散分布于晶界和晶内的β-Mg17Al12、Al8Mn5相组成，显微硬度较基体提高27%；修复样抗拉强度略低于基体但延伸率更高，二者均呈典型解理断裂特征。

articles.title: Validation Of a Modified Normalized Kruskal-Walis Fractal Dimension For Characterizing Pore Structure in Khuff Carbonate Reservoirs, Central Saudi Arabia
articles.title_zh: 改进归一化Kruskal–Wallis分形维数在沙特中部Khuff碳酸盐岩储层孔隙结构表征中的验证
articles.abstract: Carbonate samples were collected from surface exposures of the Khartam Reservoirs within the Permo–Triassic Khuff Formation of central Saudi Arabia. Porosity and permeability measurements were obtained for all samples, and pore-network heterogeneity was investigated using two independent fractal approaches derived from capillary-pressure data. The first method utilized the relationship between log-normalized pore radius, Log(R/Rmax), and Log10(water saturation), whereas the second employed Log(modified normalized Kruskal–Wallis parameter, MNKW) versus Log10(water saturation). In both methods, the fractal dimension was determined from the positive linear coefficient of the fitted quadratic expression according to Df = 2 + b. The calculated fractal dimensions ranged from approximately 2.36 to 2.86 and showed a strong positive association with permeability and pore-network connectivity. Porosity ranged from 2.269–11.253%, whereas permeability ranged from 0.264–3.445 mD. Representative samples with low, average, and high fractal dimensions yielded Df values of approximately 2.36, 2.72, and 2.86, respectively. Corresponding coefficients of determination increased from about 0.826 to 0.995 and 0.9997, indicating that fractal behavior becomes increasingly pronounced as pore-system complexity increases. Comparison of the two approaches demonstrated remarkable consistency. Regression analysis of 26 paired Df values produced a slope of 0.99531, an intercept of 0.00641, and R² = 0.9999986, confirming near-perfect agreement between methods. Bland–Altman analysis revealed a small mean bias (~ 0.0063 Df units) and narrow limits of agreement; however, a strong proportional bias was identified, indicating that differences between methods increase systematically with increasing Df. The results demonstrate that fractal dimension is an effective quantitative descriptor of pore-structure heterogeneity in tight carbonate reservoirs. Both approaches provide robust and highly consistent characterization of pore systems and may be extended to other porous materials, including nanomaterials, ceramics, catalysts, and engineered porous media.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采集沙特中部二叠—三叠系Khuff组Khartam储层地表露头碳酸盐岩样品，测定孔隙度和渗透率，并基于毛管压力数据用两种分形方法表征孔隙网络非均质性。两种方法分别采用log归一化孔径与含水饱和度、以及改进归一化Kruskal–Wallis参数与含水饱和度之间的关系，并由拟合二次式正线性系数计算分形维数Df=2+b。得到的分形维数约为2.36—2.86，与渗透率和孔隙连通性呈强正相关；样品孔隙度为2.269—11.253%，渗透率为0.264—3.445 mD。
authors: Prof. Khalid Elyas Mohamed Elameen AlKhidir

articles.title: Limited propagation of Pb-Pb interactions through graphene and Pb film growth for Pb/graphene/Pb/SiC intercalation systems
articles.title_zh: Pb/石墨烯/Pb/SiC插层体系中Pb–Pb相互作用的有限穿透与Pb薄膜生长
articles.abstract: Author(s): Yong Han, Shen Chen, Marek Kolmer, Michael C. Tringides, and James W. Evans The growth of epitaxial thin films is directed by the substrate. Here, the authors investigate Pb film growth on SiC-supported graphene with an intercalated Pb(111)-like layer under graphene. They find that Pb–Pb interactions propagate only weakly through graphene, and that the potential energy surface for Pb adatoms does not inherit the periodicity of the intercalated Pb layer. Thus, the intercalated Pb(111) does not “remotely” direct the formation of a Pb(111) film. Nevertheless, the intercalated and on-top Pb(111)-like layers are in-registry reflecting their interaction with the same graphene sheet. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 045417] Published Mon Jul 13, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察SiC支撑石墨烯上方Pb薄膜的生长，其中石墨烯下方存在类Pb(111)插层。结果表明，Pb–Pb相互作用只能弱穿透石墨烯，表面Pb吸附原子的势能面并不继承插层Pb的周期性，因此下方Pb(111)层不能“远程”模板化诱导上方形成Pb(111)薄膜。尽管如此，上下类Pb(111)层仍表现出同位相配准，反映出二者都与同一石墨烯片发生相互作用。
authors: Yong Han, Shen Chen, Marek Kolmer, Michael C. Tringides, and James W. Evans

articles.title: Mott-Anderson crossover without metallization in pressurized Sr₃Ir₂O₇
articles.title_zh: 加压Sr₃Ir₂O₇中无金属化的Mott–Anderson交叉
articles.abstract: Author(s): Xia Yin, Weicheng Guo, Miao Li, Chunlei Yang, Chengyu Li, Dong Wang, Jianbo Zhang, Yongjin Chen, Takeshi Nakagawa, Caoshun Zhang, Chunsheng Xia, Pengfei Shan, Xiaoping Yang, Sheng Meng, Jun Chang, Ho-kwang Mao, and Yang Ding Here, the authors use high-pressure transport, low-temperature magnetoresistance, x-ray diffraction and transmission electron microscopy to show that Sr 3 Ir 2 O 7 evolves, without metallization, from a Mott regime dominated by electronic correlations to an Anderson-like localized regime dominated by disorder. Pressure collapses the activation gap near 12–17 GPa, yet low-temperature conduction remains nonmetallic and follows three-dimensional variable-range hopping, highlighting how localization can preempt metallization in bandwidth-tuned correlated materials. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 055114] Published Mon Jul 13, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 作者结合高压输运、低温磁阻、X射线衍射和透射电镜研究Sr₃Ir₂O₇在压力下的电子态演化。结果显示，该材料从电子关联主导的Mott区逐渐转变为无序主导的类Anderson局域区，但未发生金属化。压力在约12–17 GPa附近使激活能隙塌缩，而低温导电仍保持非金属性并服从三维变程跳跃，说明在带宽调控的关联材料中局域化可先于金属态出现。
authors: Xia Yin, Weicheng Guo, Miao Li, Chunlei Yang, Chengyu Li, Dong Wang, Jianbo Zhang, Yongjin Chen, Takeshi Nakagawa, Caoshun Zhang, Chunsheng Xia, Pengfei Shan, Xiaoping Yang, Sheng Meng, Jun Chang, Ho-kwang Mao, and Yang Ding

articles.title: Local pseudopotentials accelerate neural network wavefunction simulations
articles.title_zh: 局域赝势加速神经网络波函数模拟
articles.abstract: Nature Computational Science, Published online: 13 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s43588-026-01027-4 Local pseudopotentials are shown to remove the cost of core electrons from neural network-based quantum Monte Carlo simulations while avoiding the expensive non-local terms of conventional semi-local pseudopotentials. This strategy increases the computational efficiency and preserves accuracy, enabling studies on previously inaccessible strongly correlated iron–sulfur clusters.

articles.title: Characterisation of a strontium cold atom source using fluorescence spectroscopy and time-of-flight
articles.title_zh: 利用荧光光谱和飞行时间法表征锶冷原子源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09604v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate a characterisation methodology for a strontium atomic beam, produced by a two-dimensional magneto-optical trap and delivered via a resonant push beam, using fluorescence spectroscopy and time-of-flight (ToF). This provides insight into the beam characteristics of a cold atom source, allowing for direct measurement of the transverse velocity spread, longitudinal velocity distributions, divergence, and the capturable flux for further cooling. From the ToF measurements, we derive a series of flux-per-longitudinal-velocity distributions at varying push saturation parameters (sₚᵤₛₕ) using both a unidirectional and counter-propagating resonant probe beam. A simulation-derived factor is applied to the unidirectional probe longitudinal velocity distribution to account for differences in the scattering rate scaling. The distributions are integrated up to an estimated 3D-MOT capture velocity of SI30meterpersecond. For our system, we find that at sₚᵤₛₕ = 0.45, we obtain a flux of (1.7 ± 0.4)×10⁸ atoms/s and (1.5 ± 0.4)×10⁸ atoms/s, using a unidirectional probe beam and counter-propagating probe, respectively. These measurements provide a framework for characterising cold atomic sources for applications such as 3D MOT loading and atom interferometers.
