The integration of physics-based damage mechanics with data-driven modelling provides an efficient and accurate approach for predicting impact-induced damage in composite laminates. The proposed methodology offers significant potential for structural health monitoring, damage assessment, and the design of impact-resistant composite structures in aerospace and related engineering applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向碳/环氧正交铺层层合板在低速冲击下的几乎不可见冲击损伤，建立介观损伤力学预测框架。模型将层合板表示为铺层与层间界面的组合，分别采用独立的本构损伤演化规律，并用塑性—损伤耦合描述界面树脂的非线性响应。该框架旨在捕捉基体开裂、纤维—基体脱粘、纤维屈曲和层间分层等损伤起始与演化过程，并结合人工神经网络提升预测能力。

articles.title: Trace hydroxypropyl methylcellulose induced physical crosslinking enables direct 3D printing of aqueous PEDOT:PSS
articles.title_zh: 微量羟丙基甲基纤维素诱导物理交联实现水系PEDOT:PSS直接3D打印
articles.abstract: Organic mixed ionic–electronic conductors (OMIECs), particularly PEDOT:PSS, are widely used in bioelectronic interfaces but remain difficult to directly print due to their intrinsically low viscosity. Conventional strategies that enhance printability—such as polymer over-concentration or chemical crosslinking—often compromise electronic transport and device dynamics. Here we show that trace incorporation of hydroxypropyl methylcellulose (HPMC) provides an effective route to simultaneously regulate processability, mesoscale organization, and electromechanical performance of PEDOT:PSS through interaction-driven physical crosslinking. At an extremely low loading (0.1 wt% relative to PH1000), HPMC selectively interacts with the sulfonate-rich PSS component via hydrogen-bond-mediated interactions, forming a dynamically percolated polymer network that imparts sufficient viscoelasticity for direct ink writing. Multiscale rheological, spectroscopic, and structural analyses reveal that the pronounced viscosity enhancement originates from specific HPMC–PSS coupling rather than the intrinsic thickening effect of HPMC, while the intrinsic electronic structure and carrier density of PEDOT remain largely unchanged. Leveraging this strategy, 3D-printed organic electrochemical transistors with channel as thin as 150 nm exhibit millisecond-scale response, and HPMC-enabled PEDOT:PSS/PVA composite films achieve high conductivity, mechanical robustness, and strongly suppressed strain-induced resistance variations, making them attractive for mechanically compliant electrodes in wearable bioelectronics. These findings reveal that trace additive–induced physical crosslinking can regulate the mesoscale organization of OMIECs, providing a general strategy for engineering printable and mechanically resilient bioelectronic materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作表明，极低含量的羟丙基甲基纤维素（HPMC）可通过相互作用驱动的物理交联，同时调控PEDOT:PSS的可加工性、介观组织和电机械性能。在相对于PH1000为0.1 wt%的添加量下，HPMC主要通过氢键与富磺酸盐的PSS组分相互作用，形成动态贯通聚合物网络，从而赋予墨水直接书写所需的黏弹性。多尺度流变、光谱和结构表征显示，黏度提升源于特异性HPMC–PSS耦合，而非HPMC本身的简单增稠作用，并尽量保留PEDOT的电子结构与载流子特性。

articles.title: Multi-Channel Nanoribbon Arrays for Enhanced Superconductivity in Magic-Angle Graphene
articles.title_zh: 用于增强魔角石墨烯超导性的多通道纳米带阵列
articles.abstract: We propose a conceptual framework for elevating the superconducting critical temperature Tc of magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene (MATBG) through proximity-induced topological coherence protection via patterned cobalt nanoribbon arrays. The central mechanism — the Topological Cooper Scaffold — combines three independently established experimental findings: room-temperature-stable magnetic nodal lines in elemental cobalt [1]; gate-tunable cobalt proximity effects in graphene heterostructures [2]; and strong intervalley phonon coupling in superconducting MATBG [3]. Proximity exchange coupling from cobalt nanoribbon arrays imprints nodal-line spin texture into MATBG flat bands, imposing spin-dependent selection rules that suppress the dominant intervalley phonon pair-breaking channel. A semi-microscopic computational simulation using the McMillan-Allen-Dynes formula with a spin-overlap suppression model demonstrates internal consistency of the proposed mechanism. A new robustness analysis introduces an interface uniformity parameter UΔ ∈ [0,1] representing the spatial variance of the proximity exchange field. Across the full tested range (UΔ = 0.20 to 1.00), the model produces positive ΔTc within the estimated [0.5, 2.0] K range, indicating the mechanism does not require unrealistically perfect interface conditions. Patterned cobalt nanoribbon arrays are proposed as a geometrically engineered heterostructure design offering additional fabrication parameters, reduced strain, and improved per-ribbon interface quality compared to a continuous cobalt film. Five falsifiable experimental predictions are stated with explicit falsification conditions and proposed control devices. This work presents a mechanistic hypothesis supported by computational modeling and literature-derived parameters. It is intended to generate experimentally testable predictions rather than establish factual accuracy.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种概念框架，利用图案化钴纳米带阵列对魔角扭转双层石墨烯施加邻近诱导的拓扑相干保护，以期提高其超导临界温度。作者提出“拓扑库珀支架”机制：钴纳米带的邻近交换耦合将节点线自旋纹理写入MATBG平带，产生自旋依赖选择规则，从而抑制主导的谷间声子破对通道。基于McMillan–Allen–Dynes公式和自旋重叠抑制模型的半微观模拟用于检验机制的内部一致性，并引入界面均匀性参数分析邻近交换场空间不均匀性的影响。

articles.title: Solar Energetic Helium Penetration into the Earth’s Magnetosphere during the September 2017 Ground Level Event
articles.title_zh: 2017年9月地面增强事件期间太阳高能氦离子进入地球磁层
articles.abstract: The period during early September 2017 showed extraordinary solar activity with several strong solar energetic particle (SEP) events including the ground level event (GLE) beginning September 10th and lasting nearly a week. During this time the Relativistic Electron Proton Telescope (REPT) onboard NASA’s twin-spacecraft Van Allen Probes mission observed energetic helium ions penetrating into the Earth’s magnetospheric polar regions. The Earth’s magnetic field usually shields energetic particles; they can still penetrate provided their “cutoff rigidities” are larger than the local vertical cutoff. These so-called cutoffs are determined by particle rigidities, i.e., momentum per unit charge. The Pulse Height Analyzed (PHA) data from REPT enable identifying helium ions as well as measure their spectra. These PHA data were used to characterize helium ions penetrating into the Earth’s magnetosphere including the temporal evolution of their spectra during first weeks of September 2017. Helium is the second most ubiquitous element comprising SEPs and is critically important from a space weather particle radiation perspective. The REPT observations showed contemporaneous helium injection at high latitudes with the SEP event. The injected helium spectra gradually softened during the course of the event. These observations suggest that most likely no dynamic processes within the magnetosphere further energized the injected helium which gradually escaped the magnetosphere.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究分析2017年9月强太阳活动和9月10日地面增强事件期间，NASA范艾伦探测器REPT仪器观测到的高能氦离子进入地球磁层极区现象。利用REPT的脉冲高度分析数据，作者识别氦离子并测量其能谱，进而刻画其在2017年9月初数周内进入磁层的时间演化。研究强调，氦作为太阳高能粒子的重要组成部分，对空间天气辐射环境评估具有关键意义，并展示了磁截止刚度条件下粒子穿透磁层的观测证据。

articles.title: Asymmetric Modulating Role of Action Magnitude in Hand-Action Sequence Effects
articles.title_zh: 动作幅度在手部动作序列效应中的非对称调制作用
articles.abstract: Background Previous studies on hand-action sequence effects have shown significant divergence: some reported an interference effect of “using/grasping on lifting,” whereas others found a facilitation effect. This study proposed that this inconsistency stems from ignoring action magnitude (action-size coding corresponding to object size)—namely, the fundamental differences in neural control strategies between precision and power actions.Methods Through four experiments employing a task-switching paradigm, we systematically examined sequence-effect patterns under different action sequences (use/grasp-lift) and social cues (presence/absence of gestures).Results The results revealed a stable asymmetric sequence effect: prior actions (using or grasping) significantly interfered with subsequent lifting actions, specifically during the switch from precision to power actions. This finding supports the “inhibitory neural locking hypothesis,” suggesting a specific neural unlocking cost when switching from high-inhibition precision actions to synergistic power actions. Conversely, lifting actions consistently facilitated subsequent functional actions, indicating that they provide a “kinematic scaffold” for complex behaviors. Notably, this asymmetric pattern was unaffected by external gesture cues, reflecting the priority of biomechanical constraints over social cues in action planning.Conclusions Overall, by introducing action magnitude as a variable, this study successfully reconciled theoretical controversies in the field: It constructed an integrated model of action hierarchy and neural inhibitory mechanisms and provided key theoretical implications for neurorehabilitation and humanoid robot control.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对既有手部动作序列效应结果不一致的问题，提出差异源于忽略动作幅度，即精细动作与力量动作在神经控制策略上的根本区别。通过四个采用任务切换范式的实验，作者考察使用/抓握—抬举等动作序列以及有无手势社会线索条件下的序列效应。结果显示，从精细动作切换到力量动作时，先前使用或抓握会稳定干扰后续抬举，支持“抑制性神经锁定假说”；相反，抬举动作会促进后续功能性动作，提示其可能提供运动学预激活。

articles.title: Programmable light simulates quantum matter across 300 processes without bigger circuits
articles.title_zh: 可编程光在无需扩大电路的情况下模拟300种量子物质过程
articles.abstract: A team of researchers at the University of Ottawa and its Nexus for Quantum Technologies Institute, in collaboration with researchers from Federico II University in Italy, has developed a programmable quantum simulator that shapes a beam of light to replicate how particles move through complex materials, avoiding the need for ever-larger electronic hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道介绍渥太华大学及其量子技术研究机构与意大利费德里科二世大学研究人员合作开发的可编程量子模拟器。该方法通过整形光束来模拟粒子在复杂材料中的运动，从而避免依赖不断扩展的电子硬件。报道属于新闻性概述，具体实验细节、可模拟过程类型和性能指标需查阅原始研究。

articles.title: Quantum material opens new path for studying unusual electronic behavior
articles.title_zh: 量子材料为研究反常电子行为开辟新路径
articles.abstract: By combining approaches from two rapidly growing fields of quantum physics, researchers at Penn State and Saint Louis University have demonstrated that a novel specialized material can naturally enable a new way to study unusual physical phenomena known as non-Hermitian dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道介绍宾夕法尼亚州立大学和圣路易斯大学研究人员将两个快速发展的量子物理方向结合，展示一种特殊材料可自然支持非厄米动力学研究。非厄米动力学涉及开放、耗散或增益体系中的非常规物理行为，可用于探索异常电子现象。报道为新闻摘要，具体材料体系、实验方案和定量结果需查阅原始论文。

articles.title: Monte-Carlo solution of the Kondo model
articles.title_zh: 近藤模型的蒙特卡洛求解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07797v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Kondo model is a paradigmatic quantum impurity problem realized in a wide variety of experimental platforms and central to the study of strongly correlated electrons. We introduce a discrete model that exactly reproduces the multichannel Kondo model and demonstrate that it can be simulated efficiently. Using cluster Monte Carlo algorithms, we completely eliminate critical slowing down, providing direct access to universal crossover functions and transport properties across a broad range of parameters. Remarkably, the same model captures both the weak- and strong-coupling regimes, unifying descriptions traditionally derived in complementary limits and revealing their common origin. Our method naturally accommodates large channel numbers, anisotropy, interacting one-dimensional leads, and channel asymmetry, yielding predictions for transport properties in charge-Kondo devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一个离散模型，可精确再现多通道近藤模型，并能够高效数值模拟。作者利用簇蒙特卡洛算法消除临界慢化，从而直接获得宽参数范围内的普适交叉函数和输运性质。该方法同时覆盖弱耦合和强耦合区，统一了通常在互补极限下建立的描述，并可自然处理大通道数、各向异性、相互作用一维引线和通道不对称等情形。
authors: Nicolas Paris, Oscar Bouverot-Dupuis, Christophe Mora

articles.title: Electron-Phonon Functional Renormalization Group of Fermi Liquid Instabilities
articles.title_zh: 费米液体不稳定性的电子—声子函数重整化群理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07804v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We formulate a functional renormalization group (FRG) ansatz for correlated electron models that incorporates electronic interactions as well as electron-phonon coupling (EPC) stemming from dispersive phonon bands. Particularizing to the RG flow of the electron-electron interaction vertex, we treat phonon- and electron-mediated Fermi liquid instabilities on equal footing as we analyze tentative electronic order parameters related to charge, spin, nematicity, and superconducting pairing. We illustrate the approach at the example of Peierls-type transitions we find for the Hubbard model on the square lattice coupled to acoustic phonon bands. Our method allows to incorporate full electronic and phononic ab initio input, and thus lends itself to the analysis of electronic order from intertwined electronic interactions and EPC at a microscopically most substantiated level.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究构建了包含电子相互作用和来自色散声子带的电子—声子耦合的函数重整化群框架，用于研究关联电子模型中的费米液体不稳定性。通过跟踪电子—电子相互作用顶角的重整化流，方法可在同一框架内处理声子介导和电子介导的电荷、自旋、向列及超导配对等候选序。作者以耦合声学声子带的方格Hubbard模型中的Peierls型转变为例展示方法，并指出该框架可结合电子和声子的第一性原理输入，以更微观地分析相互交织的有序态。
authors: C. Alexander Baum, Matteo Dürrnagel, Ronny Thomale, Lennart Klebl

articles.title: Parity Anomaly of Preformed Pairs Governs the Thermal Hall Effect above T_c
articles.title_zh: 预形成配对的宇称反常支配 Tc 以上的热霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07807v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A large negative thermal Hall signal has been reported across multiple cuprate families in the pseudogap phase where the superconducting order parameter has vanished, with a magnitude that no existing microscopic theory reproduces without free parameters. Competing proposals based on chiral phonons, spinons, or loop currents each require undetermined coupling constants and do not predict the temperature dependence in terms of an independently measured spectroscopic gap. We show that the parity anomaly of (2+1)-dimensional quantum field theory resolves this long-standing puzzle: the preformed-pair pseudogap Δₘ̊ ₚg(T) enters the parity-odd fermion determinant identically to a condensate mass, yielding the exact parameter-free formula κₓy/T = (π² k_B²/6h),C,tanh[Δₘ̊ ₚg(T)/(2k_BT)], where C is the Chern number of the chiral pairing channel and Δₘ̊ ₚg(T) is directly measurable by ARPES or STM. Coleman-Hill non-renormalization protects the result against higher-loop corrections, and two independent numerical tests, Wilson-loop flux threading and DMRG on p+ip cylinders, confirm the anomaly correlation length to 0.2% accuracy with no power-law finite-size corrections. The theory predicts thermal Hall onset at T^* rather than T_c, provides a falsifiable logarithmic-derivative test against ARPES data, and yields a concrete quantitative target for magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对铜氧化物赝能隙相中超导序参量消失后仍出现的大负热霍尔信号，提出其来源于(2+1)维量子场论中的宇称反常。作者认为预形成配对赝能隙在奇宇称费米子行列式中等同于凝聚体质量，从而给出由陈数和可由 ARPES/STM 测量的赝能隙决定的无参公式；Coleman-Hill 非重整化保证结果不受高阶修正影响，并由数值检验支持。

articles.title: Bogolyubov excitons as a microscopic origin of two-level systems
articles.title_zh: Bogolyubov 激子作为两能级系统的微观起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07812v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-level systems (TLS) are a leading source of decoherence and dielectric loss in Josephson-junction qubits, yet their microscopic origin remains unresolved. We propose an intrinsic, purely electronic TLS candidate: subgap bound states of Bogolyubov quasiparticles. We show that, in a model of a conventional superconductor with electron-electron attraction in the s-wave channel and repulsion in higher-angular-momentum channels, the latter produce an effective attraction between Bogolyubov quasiparticles, forming bound states. These Bogolyubov excitons resemble Bardasis--Schrieffer excitons but are driven by repulsive interactions. Bulk Bogolyubov excitons are not easily detectable through single-particle tunneling or other conventional probes, but we show that surface excitons couple to an external electric field and behave as two-level systems. We examine an idealized model of a bulk superconductor proximity-coupled to a two-dimensional repulsive metal, which could represent an external metallic or semiconductor layer or an underscreened region of the superconductor. The two levels correspond to the absence and presence of a single exciton, which carries an electric dipole moment and exhibits an avoided crossing with a resonator, as observed for TLS. Because this mechanism requires no defects and cannot be eliminated by screening or annealing, it suggests that TLS-like excitations may be intrinsic to superconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种纯电子的本征两能级系统候选：Bogolyubov 准粒子的亚能隙束缚态。作者在常规 s 波超导体模型中说明，高角动量通道排斥相互作用可在 Bogolyubov 准粒子之间诱导有效吸引并形成类似 Bardasis-Schrieffer 激子的束缚态；体激子难以由常规单粒子探针观测，而表面激子可耦合外电场并表现为两能级系统，可能解释约瑟夫森结量子比特中的退相干与介电损耗。

articles.title: Perturbations in the spin-orbital liquid (the Yao-Lee model)
articles.title_zh: 自旋-轨道液体中的微扰：Yao-Lee 模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07869v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: I investigate the stability of the spin-orbital liquid described by the Yao-Lee model in the presence of multiple perturbations that naturally arise in a recently proposed microscopic realization. While most perturbations are irrelevant and do not qualitatively alter the exact solvability, we find that the Kitaev interaction plays a special role: it couples to the  Z₂  gauge field and renders the visons mobile.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究 Yao-Lee 模型所描述自旋-轨道液体在多种自然微扰下的稳定性，背景是近期提出的一个微观实现方案。结果表明，多数微扰为无关微扰，不会定性破坏模型的精确可解结构；但 Kitaev 相互作用具有特殊性，会耦合到 Z2 规范场并使 vison 激发获得可动性。

articles.title: Interplay between Electronic Structure, Chemical Bonding, and Lattice Symmetry in Bismuth Vanadate
articles.title_zh: 钒酸铋中电子结构、化学键合与晶格对称性的相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08327v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bismuth vanadate (BiVO₄₎ is a prototypical oxide photocatalyst that occurs in both tetragonal and monoclinic scheelite phases with markedly different photocatalytic and photoelectrochemical activities. Accurately identifying the monoclinic phase as the ground state and explaining the origin of its symmetry-breaking distortion are unusually challenging from a theoretical perspective, with various levels of theory and associated physical interpretations for this behaviour reported in the literature. Here, we resolve these discrepancies by systematically assessing the role of exact exchange with and without spin-orbit coupling, demonstrating that an accurate treatment of electronic localization is essential to stabilize the monoclinic scheelite structure. Using this framework, we compute the electronic band structure through dense sampling of the Brillouin zone and show that the band edges in monoclinic and tetragonal BiVO₄ lie far from conventional high-symmetry paths, leading to substantial differences in band gaps and carrier effective masses. Choosing the exchange-correlation functional that best reproduces the crystal structure leads to excellent predictions of the band gap once excitonic and thermal effects are taken into account. In addition, we show that the monoclinic distortion is driven by charge transfer between non-equivalent oxygen sites, which breaks the lattice symmetry and is suppressed by self-interaction errors when using semi-local DFT. These results establish a direct connection between the exchange-correlation functional, electronic localization, chemical bonding, and structural stability in BiVO₄, providing a foundation for robust ab initio descriptions of phase stability and optoelectronic properties in such complex oxides.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文系统考察 BiVO4 四方与单斜白钨矿相的稳定性及单斜相对称性破缺畸变的起源。作者比较含/不含自旋轨道耦合的精确交换处理，指出准确描述电子局域化是稳定单斜基态的关键；进一步通过密集布里渊区采样发现两相带边偏离常规高对称路径，因而显著影响带隙与载流子有效质量的评估。
authors: Philip Schwinghammer, Franziska S. Hegner, Frederico P. Delgado, Michel Panhans, Konrad Merkel, Frank Ortmann, Ian D. Sharp, David A. Egger

articles.title: Layer-resolved Electronic Structure and Correlation of Low-n Square-planar Nickelates: A DFT+DMFT Prediction of Superconducting Candidates
articles.title_zh: 低 n 方平面镍酸盐的层分辨电子结构与关联：DFT+DMFT 预言超导候选材料
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08474v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multi-layer square-planar nickelates provide a rare platform in which the nominal Ni valence, dimensionality, and layer-resolved electronic structure can be tuned within the same structural family. Recent experiments have found superconductivity in n=4--8 Rₙ₊₁NiₙO₂ₙ₊₂ compounds, with the highest T_c near n=6, whereas the more heavily hole-doped n=3 member remains nonsuperconducting. Here we propose spacer-layer Cl doping as a route to convert low-n nickelates into superconducting candidates. Compared with changing the layer number n, Cl substitution on the spacer-layer oxygen sites offers a chemically natural way to continuously tune the Ni valence while leaving the NiO₂ planes largely intact; the lower-n compounds may also be more accessible for synthesis. Using density functional theory combined with dynamical mean-field theory, we show that electron-compensated n=2 and n=3 La-based nickelates, targeted to the nominal Ni valence of superconducting n=6, develop Ni-d correlations comparable to those of superconducting higher-n compounds while preserving the characteristic low-energy Ni-d electronic structure. These results suggest spacer-layer Cl doping as a promising strategy for designing low-n square-planar nickelate superconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出通过间隔层 Cl 掺杂调控低层数 Ruddlesden-Popper 方平面镍酸盐的 Ni 价态，从而将 n=2、3 体系转化为潜在超导候选。DFT+DMFT 结果显示，当电子补偿至接近已知超导 n=6 化合物的名义 Ni 价态时，La 基低 n 镍酸盐可形成与高 n 超导体系相近的 Ni-d 关联强度，同时保持特征低能 Ni-d 电子结构。
authors: Jian-Hong She, Rong-Qiang He, Zhong-Yi Lu

articles.title: Exciton valley depolarization in monolayer MoS2: non-Markovian quantum dynamics, intervalley scattering, and the breakdown of the Dyakonov-Perel mechanism
articles.title_zh: 单层 MoS2 中激子谷退极化：非马尔可夫量子动力学、谷间散射与 Dyakonov-Perel 机制失效
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08479v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In monolayer transition metal dichalcogenides, exciton valley relaxation is typically attributed to the Dyakonov-Perel (DP) mechanism, where frequent intravalley scattering with phonons or defects suppresses the intervalley exchange-induced precession and the role of intervalley scattering is considered secondary. Employing a first-principles nonequilibrium exciton Green's function (NEGF) approach with the generalized Kadanoff-Baym ansatz (GKBA), which treats exchange-driven precession and exciton-phonon scattering on an equal footing across the full Brillouin zone, we demonstrate that even in the small momentum regime most favorable to DP physics, realistic exciton-phonon scattering is too weak to induce the motional narrowing that defines the DP regime. Upon accounting for excitons across the entire Brillouin zone, large momentum intervalley scattering becomes the dominant pathway for valley relaxation, shortening the depolarization by a factor of 3-4 relative to intravalley-only models. We find that valley depolarization and decoherence time are approximately 50 fs at 300 K and lengthen to 130 fs at 10 K. By comparing our results with a Lindblad-type collision framework, we explicitly demonstrate the role of non-Markovian effects and reveal that the Markovian Lindblad framework is highly basis dependent. In the valley-pseudospin basis underlying prior analyses, the Lindblad approach artificially amplifies scattering-induced equilibration, biasing the dynamics toward a DP interpretation. Our study provides a comprehensive picture of valley relaxation, and establishes the exciton density matrix approach derived from NEGF+GKBA as a powerful tool for investigating ultrafast exciton dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文采用第一性原理非平衡激子格林函数方法结合 GKBA，在全布里渊区内同等处理交换驱动进动与激子-声子散射。结果显示，即使在最有利于 Dyakonov-Perel 图像的小动量区，真实激子-声子散射也不足以产生动量窄化；考虑全布里渊区后，大动量谷间散射成为谷弛豫主通道，使退极化时间较仅含谷内散射模型缩短约 3–4 倍。计算得到 300 K 下谷退极化和退相干时间约 50 fs，10 K 下延长至约 130 fs。
authors: Yang-hao Chan, Jonah B. Haber, Mit H. Naik, Felipe H. da Jornada, Diana Y. Qiu

articles.title: Heterostructuring as Gateway to Electron Doping of Nickelate Superconductors
articles.title_zh: 异质结构作为镍酸盐超导体电子掺杂的通道
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08553v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Despite enormous expenditures in the research field, the electron-doped side of nickelate superconductors remains uncharted territory. Substituting the trivalent rare-earth cations by a tetravalent one hitherto failed. Here, we demonstrate by first-principles calculations a disorder-free route to electron dope Ruddlesden-Popper nickelates. When intercalating wide-band-gap insulating layers such as LaXO₃ (X=Al, Ga, Sc) into La₂NiO₄, the extra (LaO)⁺ layers act as electron donors, releasing carriers into the Ni-3d orbitals. This electron doping puts La₂NiO₄:La₂AlO₄ naturally in the optimal region for dₓ^₂₋y^₂-wave superconductivity with T_c exceeding 50 K. The same concept also allows us to electron dope La₃Ni₂O₇, the superconductor in the limelight.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种无无序的电子掺杂 Ruddlesden-Popper 镍酸盐策略：在 La2NiO4 中插入宽带隙绝缘 LaXO3（X=Al、Ga、Sc）层。第一性原理计算表明，额外的 (LaO)+ 层可作为电子供体向 Ni-3d 轨道注入载流子，使 La2NiO4:La2AlO4 自然进入有利于 dx2-y2 波超导的最优区域，预测 Tc 可超过 50 K；该思路也可用于电子掺杂 La3Ni2O7。
authors: Chao Deng, Motoharu Kitatani, Guiwen Jiang, Siqi Guo, Niklas Witt, Ao Zhang, Wenfeng Wu, Mi Jiang, Karsten Held, Liang Si

articles.title: Universality of Measurement-Induced Criticality under Symmetry-Breaking Measurements
articles.title_zh: 对称性破缺测量下测量诱导临界性的普适性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08589v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the critical properties of random quantum circuits with a U(1) symmetry subject to local projective measurements that explicitly break this symmetry. We find that, at the measurement-induced phase transition, symmetry-breaking measurements act as a relevant perturbation at large scales, leading to the same universal critical properties as the corresponding monitored random circuit with non-symmetric unitary dynamics. In particular, we consider monitored U(1)-symmetric Haar-random circuits in the limit of large local Hilbert-space dimension, where the trajectory-averaged entanglement entropy can be exactly obtained in terms of a classical statistical mechanics model. In this model, the charge associated with the conservation law follows a symmetric simple exclusion process, in which symmetry-breaking measurements correspond to disordered defects that create and destroy charges. We prove that the charge correlation length remains finite for any measurement rate, ruling out a charge-sharpening transition, in contrast to the case of symmetry-preserving measurements. We further support our predictions at finite local Hilbert-space dimension through numerical finite-size scaling analyses of the entanglement transition in monitored U(1)-symmetric Haar and stabilizer random circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究具有 U(1) 对称性的随机量子线路在局域投影测量显式破缺该对称性时的测量诱导相变。作者发现，在临界点处，对称性破缺测量在大尺度上是相关微扰，使体系流向与无对称酉动力学受监测随机线路相同的普适临界性质；在大局域希尔伯特空间维数极限下，对应经典统计模型中的电荷相关长度对任意测量率均有限，从而排除电荷锐化相变。
authors: Angelo Russotto, Filiberto Ares, Pasquale Calabrese

articles.title: Valley Hall viscosity in the integer quantum Hall phases of (2+1)D Dirac materials
articles.title_zh: (2+1)维 Dirac 材料整数量子霍尔相中的谷霍尔黏滞
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08648v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We calculate the valley-resolved Hall viscosity for Lorentz-invariant integer quantum Hall phases in Semenoff-semiconducting graphene-like systems at zero temperature. The Kubo formalism based discussion reported in Phys. Rev. B 100, 115421 (2019) revealed the divergence of single valley viscous Hall contributions for this case with only a valley-summed Hall viscosity being finite and therefore well-defined. Our approach to the Hall viscosity calculation is based on an equivalent Green function formulation within Wigner-Weyl calculus. We find that the previously identified divergence seems to be regularized to a finite value in a proper representation of the valley-resolved Hall viscosity in terms of energy eigenfunctions and eigenvalues. Together with the local Hall conductivity and its first nonlocal correction, reported as well in Phys. Rev. B 100, 115421 (2019), we extend the empirical relativistic Hoyos-Son formula to individual valleys. Both the original Hoyos-Son formula for Galilean invariant fluids and its relativistic extension to Dirac materials are found to be structurally identical for integer quantum Hall phases and expressible in terms of local electric and viscous Hall responses. In addition we evaluate the valley(-difference) Hall viscosity for biased Bernal bilayer graphene in the chiral fermion low energy approximation. Prospects of measuring valley Hall viscosity in nonlocal transport for mono- and bilayer graphene- and group-VI TMD-based devices are discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文计算 Semenoff 半导体型石墨烯类体系在零温洛伦兹不变整数量子霍尔相中的谷分辨霍尔黏滞。作者采用基于 Wigner-Weyl 演算的格林函数表述，发现此前 Kubo 形式中出现的单谷黏滞霍尔贡献发散可在以能量本征态和本征值表示的适当形式下正则化为有限值；并结合局域霍尔电导及其首个非局域修正，将相对论 Hoyos-Son 公式推广到单个谷。

articles.title: Microwave Studies of Single Crystal TeO2 at Cryogenic Temperatures
articles.title_zh: 低温下单晶 TeO2 的微波研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08668v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We use whispering-gallery-mode analysis to characterise the microwave dielectric properties of single-crystal TeO₂ at cryogenic temperatures and compare its loss performance with other low-loss dielectric materials. Finite-element modelling is combined with measurements at room temperature, 4 K, and 20 mK to develop accurate cryogenic simulations and extract the anisotropic dielectric permittivities, giving ǎrepsilonₚₐᵣₐₗₗₑₗ₌₂₅.75±0.08 and ǎrepsilonₚₑᵣₚ₌₂₀.90±0.07. Loss measurements reveal quality factors as high as 9×10⁶ and minimum loss tangents approaching 3×10⁻⁸, placing TeO₂ among promising low-loss dielectrics for cryogenic microwave applications. Electron-spin-resonance spectroscopy further indicates a clean spin environment, while identifying distinct spin systems consistent with the known properties of the crystal.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文利用回音壁模式分析表征单晶 TeO2 在低温下的微波介电性质，并与其他低损耗介电材料比较。作者结合有限元模拟与室温、4 K 和 20 mK 测量，提取各向异性介电常数 ε∥=25.75±0.08、ε⊥=20.90±0.07；损耗测量显示品质因子最高约 9×10⁶、最小损耗角正切接近 3×10⁻⁸，表明 TeO2 是有潜力的低温微波低损耗介质。电子自旋共振还显示其自旋环境较洁净，并识别出与晶体已知性质一致的自旋系统。
authors: Timothy Holt, Maxim Goryachev, William Campbell, Michael E. Tobar

articles.title: Quantum-Geometric Design of Lattice Generalized Landau Levels
articles.title_zh: 晶格广义朗道能级的量子几何设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08702v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We design lattice models with tailored quantum geometry, including generalized Landau levels (LLs) satisfying the integrated trace condition and higher-Chern bands with ideal quantum geometry. Our models with N=2, 3, and 4 sublattices include a generalized Haldane model (N=2 honeycomb lattice model) with Gaussian-decaying hoppings realizable in twisted bilayer MoTe₂, and N ≥ 3 models with exponentially decaying hoppings. Exact diagonalization reveals fractional Chern insulators in the generalized zeroth LL bands of all three models, a Moore-Read state in the generalized first LL band of the N=4 model, and various interaction-driven topological phasesn̆icodex2013including integer and fractional anomalous Hall crystals and a multicomponent Halperin staten̆icodex2013in the ideal higher-Chern band of the N=3 model. Informed by quantum geometry, our work provides a pathway for lattice realizations of Landau-level and beyond-Landau-level physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文设计了具有可调量子几何的晶格模型，包括满足积分迹条件的广义朗道能级和具有理想量子几何的高陈数能带。作者构造了 N=2、3、4 子晶格模型，其中包括可在扭转双层 MoTe2 中实现、跃迁呈高斯衰减的广义 Haldane 蜂窝模型，以及跃迁指数衰减的 N≥3 模型；精确对角化显示这些模型中可出现分数量子陈绝缘体、Moore-Read 态、整数量子/分数量子反常霍尔晶体和多分量 Halperin 态等相。

articles.title: Competing Chern states revealed by quasiparticle charging in moiré rhombohedral graphene
articles.title_zh: 准粒子充电揭示莫尔菱方石墨烯中的竞争陈态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08710v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Moiré materials realize a versatile platform for exploring the physics of fractional Chern insulators (FCIs). The recently observed evolution from FCIs to an extended quantum anomalous Hall background upon lowering the electronic temperature in moiré rhombohedral graphene (mRG)8 raises a fundamental question: Is it caused by a failure to equilibrate the edge states of an FCI or by a genuine phase transition in the bulk from an FCI to a generalized anomalous Hall crystal? Here we address this question by probing quasiparticle charging in a mesoscopic mRG antidot device and by bulk resistance measurements, both of which are bulk-sensitive and free from complications from edge states. Tunneling to the mRG antidot reveals quasiparticles carrying one electron charge for both Chern states at filling factors ν=1 and 2/3 at low temperatures. Temperature dependence measurements of the bulk resistance near ν=2/3 further suggest a thermodynamic phase transition from an FCI to a generalized anomalous Hall crystal at temperatures below about 150mK. The results clearly exclude the edge state equilibration scenario and favor the phase transition scenario. Our work establishes mesoscopic probes as a powerful approach to uncover competing ground states in moiré materials and provides a basis for probing fractionalized excitations in FCIs.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文利用介观莫尔菱方石墨烯反点器件中的准粒子充电以及体电阻测量，检验低温下从分数陈绝缘体向扩展量子反常霍尔背景演化的起源。反点隧穿实验显示，ν=1 和 2/3 两个陈态在低温下的准粒子均携带一个电子电荷；ν=2/3 附近体电阻的温度依赖进一步表明，约 150 mK 以下发生从分数陈绝缘体到广义反常霍尔晶体的热力学相变，从而排除了边缘态未平衡情景。
authors: Hongyuan Li, Zuhan Geng, Junseok Seo, Chenxi Xu, Yifan Jiang, Shenyong Ye, Zhenqi Hua, Jiabin Xie, Lujin Min, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Kenji Yasuda, Xiaomeng Liu, Long Ju, Jie Shan, Kin Fai Mak

articles.title: Chiral Tube Algebras I: Topological Defect Lines, Twisted Modules, and Finite Gauging
articles.title_zh: 手征管代数 I：拓扑缺陷线、扭曲模与有限规范化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07786v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Chiral algebras and topological defect lines (TDLs) represent two complementary notions of symmetry in 2d conformal field theories. In this paper, we introduce chiral tube algebras to unify and extend these two notions. Chiral tube algebras generalize chiral algebras in two ways. First, they extend the action of chiral algebras beyond the local Hilbert space to include defect Hilbert spaces twisted by TDLs. Second, they allow for non-local chiral currents attached by TDLs and thus can map between different defect Hilbert spaces, analogous to the tube algebras of TDLs. Since local chiral currents can become non-local after finite gauging, chiral tube algebras provide a natural framework for describing the image of chiral algebras under such gauging. We illustrate this framework through a variety of examples that generalize familiar chiral algebras, including Kac-Moody algebras, W algebras, superconformal algebras, and their orbifolds/bosonizations. We construct their irreducible modules, which are isomorphic to twisted modules of the corresponding chiral algebras, and use them to organize local and defect Hilbert spaces. In a subsequent paper, we will study chiral tube algebras generated by non-local chiral currents with fractional spins, which have no counterparts in chiral algebras.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文引入“手征管代数”，用于统一二维共形场论中的手征代数与拓扑缺陷线两类对称性。该结构将手征代数作用从局域希尔伯特空间推广到由拓扑缺陷线扭曲的缺陷希尔伯特空间，并允许带有缺陷线的非局域手征流在不同缺陷扇区之间映射。作者说明该框架可自然描述有限规范化后手征代数的像，并通过 Kac-Moody 代数、W 代数、超共形代数及其轨形化/玻色化等例子构造不可约模与组织局域及缺陷希尔伯特空间。
authors: Nathan Benjamin, Ho Tat Lam, Conghuan Luo

articles.title: Observation of coherent flux-charge interaction in a gate-tunable fluxonium
articles.title_zh: 门控可调 fluxonium 中相干磁通-电荷相互作用的观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07798v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Interactions that mix conjugate variables, such as the flux through a circuit element and the charge across it, lie outside the reach of the elementary couplings of superconducting circuits. Capacitors connect charge to charge, and inductors connect flux to flux, while no two-terminal element couples flux to charge directly. A native flux-charge coupling would thus serve as a circuit primitive in its own right, opening direct routes to non-reciprocity, protected modes, and unconventional readout. In this work, we demonstrate a flux-charge coupling by harnessing a voltage-tunable Josephson junction with parametrically modulated critical current, which mediates the interaction between a classical charge variable and a quantum flux operator. Relying on parity-selection rules in a hybrid superconducting-semiconductor fluxonium, we isolate the flux-charge coupling from other parasitic capacitive contributions and perform cross-quadrature-activated coherent control of states. Critically, we realize a flux-charge coupling that scales linearly with driving amplitude while keeping the transition energy first-order-insensitive to gate voltage. Such unconventional interaction broadens the toolbox of superconducting circuits with a critical missing component that enables the coherent coupling of conjugate variables.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作在混合超导-半导体 fluxonium 中实验实现并观测了磁通变量与电荷变量之间的相干耦合，这类耦合通常不能由电容或电感等基本二端元件直接提供。作者利用电压可调约瑟夫森结及其临界电流的参数调制，在经典电荷变量和量子磁通算符之间介导相互作用。借助宇称选择规则，他们将目标磁通-电荷耦合与寄生电容效应区分开来，并实现了跨正交象限激活的相干态控制；该耦合随驱动振幅线性增长，同时保持跃迁能量对门电压一阶不敏感。
authors: Brian D. Isakov, Shikhar Singh, Adrian Parra-Rodriguez, David Feldstein-Bofill, Zhenhai Sun, Anders Kringhøj, Svend Krøjer, Alexandre Blais, Morten Kjaergaard, András Gyenis

articles.title: Thermodynamic Structure and Composition in Nonlinear Convection-Diffusion
articles.title_zh: 非线性对流-扩散中的热力学结构与组成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07829v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Nonlinear convection--diffusion systems play a central role in transport phenomena, including mass transfer, heat transfer, porous-media transport, and coupled continuum processes with source, exchange, and interface effects. In such systems, the key question is often not only which governing partial differential equation is used, but whether the model preserves a consistent thermodynamic balance under the operations that arise naturally in transport analysis: restriction to subdomains, coupling across interfaces, linearization near equilibrium, and discretization for computation. This paper develops a continuum-first framework for open nonlinear convection--diffusion systems in which thermodynamic consistency is formulated as a free-energy balance with nonnegative bulk dissipation and explicit boundary and source contributions. Within this setting, nonlinear transport systems are defined as structured objects built from admissible state fields, storage functionals, constitutive flux decompositions, sources, and boundary ports. We prove that the thermodynamic balance is preserved under exact structure-preserving transformations, restriction to subdomains, local-to-global reconstruction over compatible domain decompositions, and power-conserving interconnection of open subsystems. We then derive classical linear convection--diffusion models as tangent thermodynamic descendants at equilibrium and show that the same invariant survives weak formulation, semidiscretization, and fully discrete time stepping when the numerical design respects thermodynamic structure. Nonlinear drift--diffusion and porous-medium convection--diffusion are used as explicit examples. The resulting contribution is a compositional transport framework in which the second law remains visible across continuum modeling, subsystem coupling, linear approximation, and computation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文为开放非线性对流-扩散系统建立了以连续介质为出发点的热力学一致性框架，将自由能平衡、非负体耗散以及边界和源项贡献显式纳入模型结构。作者把非线性输运系统表述为由可允许状态场、储能泛函、本构通量分解、源项和边界端口组成的结构化对象。研究证明，在子域限制、界面耦合、近衡线性化和计算离散化等常见操作下，若采用精确的保结构变换，热力学平衡关系可被保持。

articles.title: Complex spacing ratio statistics in the partially open asymmetric quantum baker map
articles.title_zh: 部分开放非对称量子 baker 映射中的复间距比统计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07878v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the complex eigenvalue statistics of the asymmetric quantum baker map with partial projective openings. The classical asymmetric baker map, with its discontinuity at q=2/3, is fully chaotic, has no reflection symmetry, and provides a clean setting with tunable escape rate and fractal repeller dimension. We consider three distinct opening geometries in position space: localized (contiguous channels), random, and uniform (equispaced channels), all controlled by a tunable amplitude reflectivity parameter h̊o that interpolates between the fully open (h̊o=0) and the closed (h̊o=1) limits. We use the partially truncated circular unitary ensemble (PTCUE) as the random matrix theory benchmark. The main focus is on the joint distribution of the complex spacing ratio z, defined as the ratio of the distances from an eigenvalue to its nearest and next-nearest neighbors in the complex plane. We find a smooth crossover from a quasi-1D spectral regime, where eigenvalues cluster near the unit circle and the phase distribution of z is peaked, to a two-dimensional Ginibre-like regime, where the distribution becomes nearly uniform and level repulsion is fully developed. Both the number of open channels M and the reflectivity h̊o modulate this crossover, and h̊o provides an additional continuous control even at fixed opening size. All three opening models converge to PTCUE statistics at large M, while differences are most pronounced for the localized model at small M. No evidence of an abrupt transition is found. This crossover which suggests a universal behavior, has deep consequences for open quantum and wave-chaotic experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究带部分投影开口的非对称量子 baker 映射的复本征值统计，并以部分截断圆酉系综作为随机矩阵基准。作者比较了位置空间中局域、随机和均匀三类开口几何，并通过反射振幅参数在全开与闭合极限之间连续调节逃逸。核心量为复平面中最近邻与次近邻距离之比的联合分布；结果显示谱统计从本征值靠近单位圆的准一维区域平滑过渡到接近 Ginibre 型的二维区域，且开口几何会显著影响这一交叉行为。
authors: Leonardo Ermann, Pablo Sesin, Alejandro M. F. Rivas, Pablo D. Bergamasco, Gabriel G. Carlo

articles.title: Optimizing LZSM protocol for high-fidelity gates in open-system fluxonium
articles.title_zh: 开放系统 fluxonium 中高保真量子门的 LZSM 协议优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07999v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum gates based on resonant Rabi oscillations are inherently slow for small-frequency qubits. They are also prone to errors due to counter-rotating terms. However, when the anharmonicity is sufficiently high, as in the fluxonium architecture, alternative manipulation protocols can outperform standard resonant driving. In this work, we implement fast, high-fidelity quantum gates based on a one-period Landau-Zener-Stückelberg-Majorana (LZSM) driving protocol. We derive analytical expressions that simplify the exploration of the parameter space while accounting for the multi-level structure of the circuit. Furthermore, we analyze the role of leakage, discussing strategies to mitigate it and identifying regimes in which it becomes the dominant source of error. Finally, to evaluate the impact of dissipation on gate fidelity, we develop a robust formalism suitable for analyzing the open-system performance of quantum gates in the strong driving regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作针对低频 fluxonium 量子比特中常规共振 Rabi 门速度慢且受反旋项误差影响的问题，研究基于单周期 Landau-Zener-Stückelberg-Majorana 驱动的快速高保真量子门。作者推导了便于搜索参数空间的解析表达式，同时纳入电路多能级结构的影响。文章进一步分析泄漏误差及其抑制策略，并建立适用于强驱动开放系统量子门性能评估的形式体系，以量化耗散对门保真度的影响。
authors: Santiago Ferreyra, Valentin Reparaz, Maria Jose Sanchez, Leandro Tosi, Daniel Dominguez

articles.title: Quantum and Classical Potts Criticality in Driven-Dissipative Bosonic Lattices
articles.title_zh: 驱动-耗散玻色晶格中的量子与经典 Potts 临界性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08425v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The emergence of equilibrium universality from intrinsically nonequilibrium dynamics is a fundamental open problem. Bose-Hubbard lattices realized in photonic and circuit-QED platforms provide a versatile setting to engineer nonlinear interactions, dissipation, and multiphoton processes. Here we investigate a Bose-Hubbard lattice subject to three-photon parametric driving, whose nonequilibrium steady state spontaneously breaks a mathbb Z₃ symmetry and realizes the criticality of the three-state Potts model, a three-state generalization of the Ising model. Using a variational phase-space approach with systematically controllable accuracy based on a Variational Multi-Gaussian ansatz, we perform finite-size scaling analyses in one and two spatial dimensions. We find that, in two-dimensional lattices with single-photon losses, the nonequilibrium steady-state transition belongs to the universality class of the 2D classical three-state Potts model. In contrast, in one-dimensional lattices with three-photon losses, the transition is governed by the one-dimensional quantum three-state Potts universality class. These results establish driven-dissipative bosonic lattices as a platform for emergent Potts criticality and identify multiphoton dissipation as a mechanism that promotes nonequilibrium critical behavior from classical to quantum universality classes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究具有三光子参数驱动的 Bose-Hubbard 晶格，其非平衡稳态可自发破缺 Z₃ 对称性并实现三态 Potts 模型临界性。作者采用基于变分多高斯拟设的可控相空间方法，在一维和二维中进行有限尺寸标度分析。结果表明，含单光子损耗的二维晶格稳态相变属于二维经典三态 Potts 普适类，而含三光子损耗的一维晶格相变受一维量子三态 Potts 普适类支配，展示了驱动耗散体系中平衡普适性的涌现方式。
authors: Jacopo Tosca, Zejian Li, Cristiano Ciuti

articles.title: Renormalization flows for 1D mixed states and a quantum Goursat lemma
articles.title_zh: 一维混态的重整化流与量子 Goursat 引理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08568v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Renormalization provides a framework for relating microscopic models of physical systems to effective descriptions at larger length scales. This procedure is studied for the boundary states of non-chiral two-dimensional topologically ordered models. The initial data consist of renormalization fixed points built from representations of finite-dimensional C^*-Hopf algebras, which are then perturbed by uniform on-site noise quantum channels and repeatedly coarse-grained. The resulting flows admit an intrinsic algebraic description in terms of completely positive maps on the C^*-Hopf algebra or, equivalently, positive linear functionals on its enveloping C^*-Hopf algebra. Their iteration is governed by convolution powers, and convergent trajectories yield new matrix product density operator fixed points, described by finite *-quantum hypergroups. This provides a concrete physical interpretation of such structures. For finite group algebras and their duals, we provide explicit classifications via Goursat's lemma for groups. Finally, we formulate and prove a quantum generalization of Goursat's lemma for finite-dimensional C^*-Hopf algebras, a result of independent interest, which gives an explicit structural description of all convergent renormalization trajectories.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究非手征二维拓扑有序模型边界态的重整化流，从有限维 C*-Hopf 代数表示构造的固定点出发，加入均匀在位噪声量子信道并反复粗粒化。所得流可用 C*-Hopf 代数上的完全正映射或其包络 C*-Hopf 代数上的正线性泛函内禀描述，其迭代由卷积幂控制。收敛轨道产生新的矩阵乘积密度算符固定点，并由有限 *-量子超群描述；作者还对有限群代数及其对偶给出基于 Goursat 引理的分类，并证明有限维 C*-Hopf 代数的量子 Goursat 引理。
authors: Léo Le-Nestour, David Pérez-García, Alberto Ruiz-de-Alarcón

articles.title: Operational meaning of Markov gap in tripartite entanglement of quantum dynamics
articles.title_zh: 量子动力学三方纠缠中 Markov 间隙的操作含义
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08615v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate how irreducible multipartite entanglement, a long-range correlation by nature, can emerge from short-range dynamics far from equilibrium. Focusing on the Markov gap as a probe of irreducible tripartite entanglement (IrTE) in free-fermion chains, we uncover qualitatively distinct dynamical behaviors: the Markov gap grows either quasi-linearly or in staircase-like jumps depending on the initial state. We also propose attainable upper and lower bounds for the onset time of IrTE based on the Lieb-Robinson bound. Strikingly, the Markov gap saturates to a volume-law value on a timescale tsim! L², much slower than the ballistic spreading of bipartite correlations. To understand what information about the wavefunctions is revealed by the Markov gap calculation, we introduce the concept of essential tripartite fermion (ETF) and an associated tripartite null matrix. The value of Markov gap closely tracks the number of small singular values of this tripartite null matrix, yielding a transparent, operational physical interpretation of the measure. We further demonstrate that several dynamical signatures persist in the interacting XXZ chain.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文以自由费米子链中的 Markov 间隙为探针，研究远离平衡的短程动力学如何生成不可约三方纠缠这种长程关联。作者发现 Markov 间隙随初态不同可呈准线性增长或阶梯式跃迁，并基于 Lieb-Robinson 界提出不可约三方纠缠出现时间的可达上下界。其饱和到体积律值的时间尺度约为 L²，显著慢于二体关联的弹道传播；通过引入“本质三方费米子”和三方零矩阵，作者将 Markov 间隙与该矩阵小奇异值数目联系起来，给出清晰的操作性物理解释。
authors: Zongsheng Zhou, Riqiang Zhang, Yu-Xiang Zhang

articles.title: Triangulene-based diradicals as a blueprint for molecular quantum platforms with optical addressability and long spin coherence times
articles.title_zh: 基于 triangulene 的双自由基：兼具光学可寻址性与长自旋相干时间的分子量子平台蓝图
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08634v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The identification of molecules that combine long spin coherence times and efficient spin-optical interfaces, ideally at room temperature, is pivotal towards the development of molecular quantum technology. By means of advanced first-principles methods, we here unravel the electronic structure for triangulene (1), its aza-cation derivative (2), and the crystal of 2,6,10-tri-tert-butyl-4,8,12-trimesityl-triangulene (3), and show that these organic diradicals possess a triplet ground state well separated from the first singlet excited state approaching 0.5 eV, closely resembling solid-state defects like nitrogen vacancy centers. In addition, we compute spin decoherence times due to the interaction with phonons and surrounding nuclear spins, showing that a deuterated molecule of 3 in a nuclear spin-free environment would support T₂ = 0.21 ms at 10 K. Importantly, we show that the engineering of specific low-energy vibrations could significantly improve T₂ toward the limit imposed by the molecular core spin relaxation, here estimated to be as long as T₁₌₂₇ ms at 300 K for 2. Finally, we compute two-phonon contributions to inter-system crossing at 300 K for2 as a luminescent prototype, and find that it is highly spin-selective, supporting the possibility to engineer optical read out and spin initialization. These results advance a unified first-principles theoretical foundation of spin decoherence and spin-selective excited-state processes and point to novel chemical design strategies for optically addressable, highly coherent molecular qubits.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用先进第一性原理方法解析 triangulene、其氮杂阳离子衍生物及取代 triangulene 晶体的电子结构，指出这些有机双自由基具有与第一单重激发态相隔近 0.5 eV 的三重态基态，类似氮空位中心等固态缺陷。作者计算了由声子和周围核自旋导致的自旋退相干，预测氘代分子在无核自旋环境中低温下可支持毫秒以下量级的 T₂。研究还表明，通过工程化特定低能振动可显著提高 T₂，并给出分子芯自旋弛豫所设极限及系间窜越相关声子过程的计算分析。
authors: Arup Sarkar, Cathal Hogan, Conor Ryan, Lorenzo A. Mariano, Alessandro Lunghi

articles.title: Temperature Beyond Equilibrium in Isolated Quantum Many-Body Systems and Their Subsystems
articles.title_zh: 孤立量子多体系统及其子系统中超越平衡的温度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08655v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Temperature is one of the central concepts of thermodynamics, yet its meaning away from equilibrium remains elusive. This problem is particularly acute in isolated quantum many-body systems: their states evolve unitarily, need not be close to equilibrium, and can retain energy coherence, a feature with no classical thermodynamic analogue. A non-stationary quantum state contains two kinds of energy fluctuations. One is associated with energy populations and has the usual thermodynamic interpretation; the other arises from coherence between energy sectors and drives time dependence. We propose that temperature, also out of equilibrium, locates the state within the family of regular states compatible with its energy-coherence structure. This leads to a natural definition of temperature for regular nonequilibrium states. The resulting inverse temperature is not generally the derivative of thermodynamic entropy with respect to energy. Indeed the principle of maximum entropy does not extend in its usual form; it is replaced by a principle of minimum discrimination information. We also develop the corresponding theory for subsystems, where temperature cannot in general be inferred from the reduced state alone. Instead, it is determined by the induced local thermodynamic structure, with boundary ambiguities removed in the thermodynamic limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文讨论孤立量子多体系统中非平衡态温度的定义问题，强调非平稳量子态同时包含能级布居引起的热力学能量涨落和能量相干引起的时间依赖涨落。作者提出，非平衡温度应将态定位在与其能量相干结构相容的规则态族中，从而得到适用于规则非平衡态的自然温度定义。由此得到的逆温度一般不等于热力学熵对能量的导数，传统最大熵原理也需由最小判别信息原理替代；文章还将该理论推广到子系统情形。

articles.title: Absence of quantum advantage for approximate spin glass optimization
articles.title_zh: 近似自旋玻璃优化中量子优势的缺失
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08708v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We perform a semiclassical, large-spin S, analysis of the quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) on the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick (SK) model, using the truncated Wigner approximation. Fixing the QAOA angles to their previously determined optimal S=1/2 values, we observe a non-monotonic dependence of the final energy on the spin. At small S the semiclassics is dominated by noise, while the large-S limit is constrained by the exponential growth of the initial fluctuations. For a depth-p QAOA one achieves the optimal balance at S of order p, resulting in a convergence of the final energy to the Parisi value like log(p)/p. We find that the semiclassics slightly outperforms the true spin-1/2 QAOA, and thus suggest they both converge to the Parisi value in the same way. Finally, removing all the initial noise, and re-optimizing the parameters to account for that change, results in superior performance with 1/p convergence.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文采用截断 Wigner 近似，对 Sherrington-Kirkpatrick 自旋玻璃模型上的量子近似优化算法进行大自旋半经典分析。固定 QAOA 角为先前确定的 S=1/2 最优值时，最终能量随自旋大小呈非单调变化：小自旋区受噪声主导，大自旋极限则受初始涨落指数增长限制。对于深度 p 的 QAOA，最优平衡出现在 S 约为 p 的量级，最终能量以 log(p)/p 收敛到 Parisi 值；半经典结果略优于真实自旋 1/2 QAOA，暗示二者具有相同收敛标度，而去除初始噪声并重新优化参数可实现 1/p 收敛。

articles.title: Approaching Carnot Efficiency at Finite Power in an Experimentally Feasible Quantum Heat Engine
articles.title_zh: 在实验可行的量子热机中以有限功率逼近 Carnot 效率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08713v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Whether a heat engine can approach Carnot efficiency while maintaining finite power is a fundamental question in finite-time thermodynamics. For classical Markovian heat engines with local interactions, the power-efficiency trade-off forbids an asymptotic approach to Carnot efficiency at finite power. In quantum systems, by contrast, degeneracy, symmetry, and collective jumps have been theoretically predicted to enable such an asymptotic attainment by enhancing activity. It has remained open, however, whether this mechanism can be realized in an experimentally implementable heat engine. In this Letter, we propose a superconducting-circuit heat engine that emulates the collective enhancement, thereby enabling an asymptotic approach to Carnot efficiency at finite power. This result demonstrates that, in an implementable model, such an enhanced dissipative mechanism circumvents the power-efficiency trade-off of classical Markovian engines. Our work connects abstract bounds in finite-time thermodynamics to a concrete circuit-QED platform and suggests a route toward quantum-device design based on collectively enhanced dissipative processes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对有限时间热力学中的核心问题，提出一种可实验实现的超导电路热机，用于在保持有限功率的同时渐近逼近 Carnot 效率。经典局域 Markov 热机通常受功率-效率权衡限制，而量子体系中的简并、对称性和集体跃迁可通过增强活性规避该限制。作者设计的电路 QED 平台模拟了这种集体增强耗散机制，表明抽象的量子热力学界限可转化为具体器件方案，并为基于集体耗散过程的量子热机设计提供路径。
authors: Shogo Toma, Atsushi Noguchi, Ken Funo, Hiroyasu Tajima

articles.title: Irreducible Geometry of Higher-Order Correlator Families
articles.title_zh: 高阶关联函数族的不可约几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08761v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Programmable quantum simulators are beginning to access correlators of increasing complexity, ranging from four-point out-of-time-ordered correlators to even higher-order many-body correlators. The theoretical framework for interpreting such data, however, remains comparatively underdeveloped. Although a variety of higher-order correlators can be constructed straightforwardly, their physical meaning is often difficult to infer. A further complication is that different correlators are generally not independent: some may be mutually redundant, while others may encode genuinely distinct information. These features make it necessary to analyze correlators not as isolated quantities, but as a structured family. In this work, we develop a geometric framework for the collective analysis of higher-order correlator families. By representing correlators as inner products between operator words, we recast each family as a geometry in operator space. The key idea is to introduce conditioning subspaces that separate this geometry into reducible information, already explained by a chosen resolved sector, and irreducible information, encoded in the residual correlator geometry. Focusing on the latter component, we define irreducible volume profiles that quantify how broadly the unexplained part of a correlator family spreads over independent geometric directions. This perspective leads to several complementary forms of conditioning. Canonical conditioning optimally explains a correlator family. Targeted conditioning fixes the resolved sector to isolate a chosen physical feature. Krylov and cross conditioning extend the framework from a single correlator family to comparisons among correlator geometries. Our framework reveals irreducible structures hidden at the level of individual correlator values and establishes correlator geometry as a higher-level description of quantum many-body dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种用于整体分析高阶关联函数族的几何框架，以应对可编程量子模拟中日益复杂的多体关联数据解释问题。作者将关联函数表示为算符词之间的内积，从而把关联函数族重写为算符空间中的几何结构，并引入条件化子空间来区分可由已解析扇区解释的可约信息与真正新的不可约信息。该方法强调不同高阶关联函数之间的冗余与独立性，为判定其物理含义提供系统工具。

articles.title: Exact Quench Dynamics from Thermal Pure Quantum States
articles.title_zh: 由热纯量子态出发的精确淬火动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.05346v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present an exact solution for entanglement entropy for the real-time dynamics following a quench from a thermal pure quantum (TPQ) state in a free-fermion system. In contrast to the usual linear growth and saturation behavior, the entanglement entropy exhibits a characteristic double-plateau structure. We establish this behavior through three complementary approaches: an exact conformal field theory calculation on the Klein bottle, finite-size Gaussian-state simulations, and a quasiparticle picture that becomes quantitatively accurate in the scaling regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文给出了自由费米子体系中从热纯量子态淬火后的实时纠缠熵精确解。不同于通常的线性增长并饱和，纠缠熵表现出特征性的双平台结构。作者通过克莱因瓶上的共形场论精确计算、有限尺寸高斯态数值模拟以及在标度区定量有效的准粒子图像相互验证了这一行为。

articles.title: A Local Structural Basis to Resolve Amorphous Ices
articles.title_zh: 区分无定形冰的局域结构基础
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.17488v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Phases with distinct thermodynamic properties must differ in their underlying microscopic configurations. While ordered phases are readily distinguished by unit cells and space groups, the local structural basis differentiating amorphous phases is less apparent. Here, using a new probabilistic data-driven framework applied to molecular simulations of water, we identify local collective variables that discriminate low-density and high-density amorphous (LDA and HDA) ices and characterize pressure-induced transitions between them. As expected, descriptors related to local density effectively distinguish LDA and HDA; however, phase identity is surprisingly encoded within the first coordination shell. Furthermore, the pressure-induced LDA--HDA transformation proceeds through redistribution between LDA- and HDA-like local environments with no evidence for intermediate structures, consistent with a first-order-like phase transition. This contrasts with the gradual structural evolution observed in other amorphous systems, such as metallic glasses. Critically, local hydrogen density reveals pronounced structural hysteresis between compression and decompression pathways, which is not apparent in orientational order parameters, demonstrating that the microscopic interpretation of amorphous transformations depends fundamentally on descriptor choice. These findings are robust across force fields and provide a general strategy for characterizing disordered phases lacking obvious distinguishing features.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用一种概率型数据驱动框架分析水的分子模拟，识别能够区分低密度与高密度无定形冰的局域集体变量，并刻画压力诱导的相变过程。除局域密度描述符外，作者发现相身份已显著编码在第一配位壳层内。LDA 到 HDA 的转变主要表现为 LDA 类与 HDA 类局域环境的重新分配，而未发现中间结构，支持类一级相变图像，并揭示了与局域氢密度相关的结构滞后。
authors: Quinn M. Gallagher, Ryan J. Szukalo, Nicolas Giovambattista, Pablo G. Debenedetti, Michael A. Webb

articles.title: Controlling Waiting Time Statistics in Monitored Collective Spins: Mitigating Detector's Resolution Barrier in Measurement-Induced Phase Transitions
articles.title_zh: 受监测集体自旋中的等待时间统计控制：缓解测量诱导相变中的探测器时间分辨率障碍
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01332v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In collective dissipative spin systems, the postselection barrier can be partially mitigated; however, a further obstacle may be posed by the finite temporal resolution of detectors. In this work, we investigate how initial-state inhomogeneities can control waiting-time statistics between quantum jumps, thereby mitigating the detector-resolution problem. We consider a collectively monitored spin model with a boundary time-crystalline phase, introducing inhomogeneity by partitioning the ensemble into two subsystems rotated by an angle θ. We find that the measurement-induced phase transition survives under inhomogeneities, with different entanglement scaling regimes. The waiting time increases with θ, scaling as 1/N but with a prefactor strongly enhanced by orders of magnitude, and in the anti-aligned limit θ = π it remains finite, fully resolving the resolution barrier. This mitigation, however, comes at a cost: the entanglement saturation time becomes significantly longer, partially reintroducing the postselection barrier. Our results highlight a trade-off between detector resolution and postselection overhead, with direct implications for the experimental observation of measurement-induced phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究集体耗散自旋系统中初态非均匀性如何调控量子跃迁之间的等待时间统计，从而缓解探测器有限时间分辨率带来的限制。作者考虑具有边界时间晶体相的集体监测自旋模型，并通过将体系分成相对旋转角为 θ 的两个子系统引入非均匀性。结果表明测量诱导相变在非均匀条件下仍然存在，等待时间随 θ 增大而显著延长，在反平行极限可保持有限，但代价是纠缠饱和时间大幅增加，形成探测分辨率与后选择开销之间的权衡。

articles.title: Bockstein braiding statistics
articles.title_zh: Bockstein 编织统计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02280v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Braiding statistics, familiar from anyons in fractional quantum Hall systems, are a central manifestation of topology in quantum physics. Ordinary braiding extends naturally to higher-dimensional excitations: a p-dimensional excitation and a q-dimensional excitation can braid in d=p+q+2 spatial dimensions. In this work, we identify a new type of mutual statistics that exists in one lower spatial dimension, d=p+q+1. This includes particle-particle statistics in one dimension, particle-loop statistics in two dimensions, and loop-loop or particle-membrane statistics in three dimensions. The corresponding field-theory response is governed by the Bockstein homomorphism, so we call the invariant Bockstein braiding statistics. On lattices, the Bockstein statistics is measured by the Berry phase accumulated in a universal microscopic unitary process built from local excitation operators. We further show that nontrivial Bockstein braiding is the statistical manifestation of a mixed anomaly of the corresponding symmetries. This anomaly rules out a fully symmetric gapped phase, obstructs simultaneous condensation of the two excitations, and implies fractionalization of higher-form symmetries. We illustrate these consequences in a (1+1)-dimensional spin-frac12 chain, where Bockstein braiding statistics detects the mixed anomaly between prodᵢ Xᵢ and prodᵢ CZᵢ,ᵢ₊₁, and in strongly coupled (3+1)-dimensional continuum gauge theories.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种存在于通常高维编织统计低一维空间中的新型相互统计，涵盖一维粒子-粒子、二维粒子-环以及三维环-环或粒子-膜等情形。其场论响应由 Bockstein 同态控制，因此被称为 Bockstein 编织统计；在晶格上可通过由局域激发算符构造的普适微观幺正过程中的 Berry 相测量。作者进一步指出，非平庸 Bockstein 编织是相应对称性混合异常的统计表现，会阻碍完全对称的有能隙相及相关激发的同时凝聚。

articles.title: Ultra-high-speed chemiluminescence tomography of spinning-mode detonation waves
articles.title_zh: 旋转模爆轰波的超高速化学发光层析成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07971v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This work presents a chemiluminescence tomography campaign to reconstruct time-resolved, three-dimensional reacting structures in detonation waves propagating through ethylene-based mixtures at 1 atm. Images of chemiluminescence are recorded simultaneously by five cameras through a cylindrical sapphire test section, and a custom calibration procedure is developed to account for refraction through the cylinder. The images are combined to reconstruct an effective emission source term field at megahertz rates. Reconstructions are reported for a persistent spinning detonation, a failed spinning detonation, and a case with counter-propagating transverse fronts. The reconstructed fields enable visualization of wave morphologies, determination of the axial and azimuthal wave speeds, and estimation of key geometric and kinematic parameters. These results demonstrate time-resolved chemiluminescence tomography as a non-intrusive tool for resolving volumetric detonation dynamics that are difficult to infer from point, planar, or line-of-sight diagnostics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究开展化学发光层析成像实验，以兆赫兹速率重构乙烯基混合物中传播爆轰波的时间分辨三维反应结构。实验通过五台相机经圆柱形蓝宝石测试段同步记录化学发光图像，并发展了考虑圆柱折射的定制标定方法。重构结果覆盖持续旋转爆轰、失败旋转爆轰及相向传播横向波前等情形，可用于可视化波形、测定轴向和方位波速并估计关键几何与运动学参数。
authors: Amit K. Singh, Mateo Gomez, Kevin Y. Cho, Aaron W. Skiba, Samuel J. Grauer

articles.title: Kime-Representation Formulations of Three Open Problems in the Foundations of Classical Mechanics: Uncertainty, Invariant Entropy, and Directional Degrees of Freedom
articles.title_zh: 经典力学基础中三个开放问题的 Kime 表示表述：不确定性、不变熵与方向自由度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07851v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We give mathematically self-contained formulations, in the complex-time (kime) representation, of three open problems from the foundations of classical mechanics: (I) the extension of the classical entropic uncertainty principle to non-canonical variables and to multiple degrees of freedom; (II) the characterization of coordinate-invariant measures and entropies, i.e., the question of why continuous physical quantities must be paired for an invariant entropy to exist; and (III) the construction of a classical relativistic directional degree of freedom (a classical analogue of a spin-1/2 system). Throughout, the kime phase is interpreted {statistically as a latent circular random variable whose law Φ models the intrinsic trial-to-trial variability of repeated, identically controlled experiments indexed by the kime magnitude. The mathematical bridge is an exact symplectic identification of the kime cone with the action-angle chart of a one-degree-of-freedom phase space, under which the kime measure is the Liouville measure and the phase law becomes the angular conditional of a Liouville density. Specifically, we (i) prove a sharp entropic uncertainty relation on the kime cylinder whose extremal family is von Mises x Gaussian, together with a sharp circular Fisher-information inequality saturated exactly by von Mises laws; (ii) prove an exact non-canonical uncertainty relation in which the correction term is the geometric mean of the Poisson bracket, clarifying the conjectured role of the expected bracket; (iii) prove aggregate multi-degree-of-freedom bounds via the Williamson normal form and Fischer's inequality, and isolate the per-degree-of-freedom refinement as a precise open problem of symplectic Schur-Horn type; (iv) prove that diffusion of the kime phase produces monotone entropy growth with the equipartitioned (Haar-uniform) phase law.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文在复时间即 kime 表示中，对经典力学基础的三个开放问题给出自洽数学表述：非正则变量和多自由度情形下的经典熵不确定性原理、坐标不变测度与熵的刻画，以及经典相对论方向自由度的构造。作者将 kime 相位解释为潜在圆随机变量，其分布描述重复受控实验中的内禀试次间波动，并通过 kime 锥与一自由度相空间作用-角变量图的辛同构建立与 Liouville 测度的联系。该框架试图把不确定性、熵不变性和类自旋方向变量统一到经典统计-辛几何语言中。

articles.title: Low-latency FPGA-based electronic control system for fast preparation of defect-free atom arrays
articles.title_zh: 用于快速制备无缺陷原子阵列的低延迟 FPGA 电子控制系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08687v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The scalability of neutral atom quantum computing demands integrated electronic control systems with low latency, modular architecture, and real-time feedback capability. Here, we present an FPGA-based electronic control system that eliminates the PC from the feedback loop, integrating photon counting, real-time decision-making, and waveform generation within a unified PXIe architecture. The system achieves a total feedback latency of 282,μ s and is validated in practical experiments by assembling defect-free atom arrays from 24 stochastically loaded optical tweezers. A single-round rearrangement achieves a filling fraction of sim96%, while feedback-controlled iterative rearrangement over five rounds boosts the success probability for generating a 10-atom defect-free array from 65.7% to 95.4%. This system establishes the electronic infrastructure necessary for mid-circuit measurement and real-time quantum error correction on neutral-atom platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作面向中性原子量子计算的可扩展控制需求，提出一种基于 FPGA 的低延迟电子控制系统，将光子计数、实时判决和波形生成集成在统一 PXIe 架构中，并将 PC 移出反馈回路。系统总反馈延迟为 282 微秒，并通过从 24 个随机装载光镊中组装无缺陷原子阵列得到实验验证。单轮重排填充率约为 96%，五轮反馈迭代将生成 10 原子无缺陷阵列的成功率由 65.7% 提升至 95.4%，为中性原子平台的中途测量和实时量子纠错提供电子基础设施。
authors: Ya-Dong Hu, Dong-Qi Ma, Tian-Yang Zhang, Liang Chen, Yi-Chen Zhang, Xiao-Kang Zhong, Wen-Yi Zhu, Hong-Jie Fan, Qing-Xuan Jie, Yan-Lei Zhang, Gang Li, Xi-Feng Ren, Xu-Liang Zhang, Guang-Can Guo, Zhu-Bo Wang, Chang-Ling Zou

articles.title: Optimal-Transport-Based Cell Resampling for Negative and Pathological Event Weights
articles.title_zh: 面向负权重与病态事件权重的最优输运单元重采样
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08723v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Negative and pathologically large Monte Carlo event weights strain the computing budgets of experiments at the Large Hadron Collider. Cell resampling algorithms locally redistribute event weights among nearby events in a metric space. We study the performance of metrics defined in terms of Optimal Transport, namely the Energy Mover's Distance and a spectral variant, in the context of such algorithms. As these metrics are insensitive to the addition of soft and collinear radiation, they may be applied directly to particles at any stage of event generation. When applied to samples simulated at next-to-leading-order in quantum chromodynamics, this approach reduces the observed bias relative to other cell resampling techniques presented in the literature. We also study the Cross-Section Mover's Distance as an unbinned, broadly-applicable figure of merit for quantifying the bias introduced by any full-phase-space reweighting.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对大型强子对撞机模拟中负权重和异常大 Monte Carlo 事件权重带来的计算压力，考察基于单元重采样的局域权重再分配方法。作者研究了由最优输运定义的度量，包括 Energy Mover's Distance 及其谱变体；这些度量对软辐射和共线辐射不敏感，可直接用于事件生成任意阶段的粒子。应用于次领头阶 QCD 样本时，该方法相较已有单元重采样技术降低了观测偏差，并提出 Cross-Section Mover's Distance 作为无分箱、广适用的全相空间重加权偏差评估指标。
authors: Regan Doherty, Lauren Hay, Rishabh Jain, Matt LeBlanc, Julia Marrinan, Camille Mauceri, Jennifer Roloff

articles.title: Plasma-state metasurfaces for ultra-intensive field manipulation
articles.title_zh: 用于超强场操控的等离子体态超表面
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.15567v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: High-power lasers offer ultrahigh intensities for plasma interactions, but they lack advanced techniques to control the properties of the fields, because no optical elements could withstand their high intensities. The vibrant field of metasurfaces has transformed modern optics by enabling unprecedented control over light at subwavelength through deliberate design. However, metasurfaces have traditionally been limited to solid-state materials and low light intensities. Extending the sophisticated capabilities of metasurfaces from solids into the plasma realm would open new horizons for high-field science. Here, we experimentally demonstrate plasma-state metasurfaces (PSMs) through the photonic spin Hall effect and stable-propagating vortex beam generation irradiated by intense light. Time-resolved pump-probe measurements reveal that the functionality of PSMs can persist for several picoseconds, making them suitable for controlling ultra-intense femtosecond lasers, even in state-of-the-art multi-petawatt systems. Harnessing the powerful toolkit of metasurfaces, this approach holds the promise to revolutionize our ability to manipulate the amplitude, phase, polarization, and wavefront of high-power lasers during their pulse duration. It also opens new possibilities for innovative applications in laser-plasma interactions such as compact particle acceleration and novel radiation sources.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出并实验展示等离子体态超表面，将传统固态低强度超表面的亚波长光场调控能力扩展到可承受超强激光的等离子体环境。作者通过强光照射下的光子自旋霍尔效应和稳定传播涡旋光束产生验证其功能。时间分辨泵浦-探测测量表明，这类等离子体态超表面的功能可持续数皮秒，适用于调控超强飞秒激光乃至多拍瓦级系统，为高场科学中的光场整形提供新途径。
authors: Zi-Yu Chen, Hao Xu, Jiao Jia, Yanjie Chen, Siyu Chen, Yan Zhang, Mingxuan Wei, Minghao Ma, Runze Li, Fan Yang, Mo Li, Guangwei Lu, Weijun Zhou, Hanmi Mou, Zhuofan Zhang, Zhida Yang, Jian Gao, Feng liu, Boyuan Li, Min Chen, Liming Chen, Yongtian Wang, Lingling Huang, Wenchao Yan, Shuang Zhang, Jie Zhang

articles.title: Topological States Enabled by Non-local Nonlinearity in Synthetic Dimensions
articles.title_zh: 合成维度中由非局域非线性产生的拓扑态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.02199v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The interplay between topology and nonlinearity represents a central challenge in modern physics. Here, we investigate this interplay by considering a synthetic Su-Schrieffer-Heeger lattice with all-to-all nonlocal interactions. We find that the distinctive nonlinearity maintains an effective chiral symmetry and leads to a quantized nonlinear winding and Berry phase, as corroborated by the developed Bogoliubov nonlinear adiabatic theory. Increasing nonlinearity drives a sequence of topological transitions signaled by the appearance of characteristic swallowtail band structures at intermediate interaction strengths and band swapping in the strong nonlinear regime. The band swapping results in quantized fractional windings and double-period Bloch oscillations that are closely related to discrete time crystals. Remarkably, even starting from a topologically trivial linear system, nonlocal nonlinearity can induce an emergent topological phase with fractional windings. Experimentally, our model can be realized using photons in a degenerate optical cavity with Rydberg-mediated interactions. Our results establish a rigorous framework and pave the way for exploring nonlinear topological phenomena and their applications in synthetic quantum platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察具有全连接非局域相互作用的合成 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger 晶格中拓扑与非线性的相互作用。作者发现这种非局域非线性可保持有效手征对称性，并产生量子化的非线性绕数和 Berry 相，其结果由 Bogoliubov 非线性绝热理论支持。随着非线性增强，体系经历一系列拓扑转变，包括中等相互作用下的燕尾能带结构和强非线性区的能带交换；后者导致分数量子化绕数和双周期 Bloch 振荡，并可在原本线性拓扑平庸体系中诱导新兴拓扑相。
authors: Chong-Xiao Chen, Zheng-Wei Zhou, Han Pu, Xi-Wang Luo

articles.title: Quantum Dynamical and isotopic effects for Hydrogen isotopes scattering at W(110) surface
articles.title_zh: 氢同位素在 W(110) 表面散射的量子动力学与同位素效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.05426v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the scattering of hydrogen isotopes at the W(110) surface using both classical and quantum dynamics approaches to elucidate the role of quantum effects in this system. To characterize the scattering process we focus on key observables, including the absorption probability and diffraction channels that we evaluate at the quasi-classical and quantum levels. The quantum dynamics reveal pronounced resonance structures in the absorption curve that we rationalize in terms of diffraction-mediated selective adsorption and focused sticking mechanisms. Diffraction probabilities for reflected trajectories exhibit strong quantum effects at low incident energies, where classical dynamics underestimate the back scattering probability. These effects become less pronounced with increasing isotope mass, from hydrogen to tritium, however discrepancies between the classical and quantum description persist at low incident energies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文结合经典和量子动力学方法研究氢同位素在 W(110) 表面的散射，以阐明该体系中的量子效应。作者重点分析吸附概率和衍射通道等观测量，并在准经典与量子层面进行比较。量子动力学在吸附曲线中显示出显著共振结构，可由衍射介导的选择性吸附和聚焦黏附机制解释；低入射能下反射轨迹的衍射概率呈强量子效应，经典动力学低估背散射概率，且这些差异随同位素质量从氢到氚增大而减弱但仍存在。
authors: Raúl Bombín, Oihana Galparsoro, Daniel Peláez, Jean Christophe Tremblay, Cédric Crespos, Pascal Larregaray

articles.title: Radical-Fragment Many-Body Expansion for Linear Alkane Quantum Chemistry
articles.title_zh: 用于线性烷烃量子化学的自由基片段多体展开
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31117v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce a radical-fragment many-body expansion at the two-body level (MBE2) for quantum chemistry of linear alkanes. Instead of heterolytic bond cleavage with hydrogen capping atoms and electrostatic embedding like in Fragment Molecular Orbital (FMO), we perform homolytic C-C bond cleavage to produce open-shell radical fragments (CH3, CH2) treated with restricted open-shell Hartree-Fock (ROHF) in isolation. The two-body MBE2 assembly formula reconstructs total alkane energies from only four unique fragment calculations regardless of chain length, reducing the maximum qubit requirement. We benchmark this framework against five energy solvers (RHF, CCSD, VQE, ADAPT-VQE, and SQD) across 11 linear alkanes from butane (C4H10) to hexacosane (C26H54). The MBE2 decomposition achieves a 12.3x qubit reduction for C26H54 (from 368 to 30 qubits) and a 12.8x reduction in unique calculations via symmetry exploitation. MBE2-VQE and MBE2-SQD (executed on IBM quantum hardware) closely track their respective classical MBE2 references, demonstrating that fragmentation-based quantum chemistry is viable for scaling quantum solvers to large molecular systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种面向线性烷烃量子化学的二体自由基片段多体展开方法：通过均裂 C–C 键生成开壳层 CH3/CH2 自由基片段，并用 ROHF 对孤立片段处理，而非采用 FMO 中的异裂、氢封端和静电嵌入。二体 MBE 组装公式可用与链长无关的少数唯一片段计算重构总能量，从而显著降低量子比特需求。对 C4H10 到 C26H54 的 11 种线性烷烃及 RHF、CCSD、VQE、ADAPT-VQE、SQD 等求解器的测试表明，该框架可大幅压缩计算规模，并使基于量子硬件的 MBE2-VQE/MBE2-SQD 接近相应经典片段参考。
authors: Daniel Sierra-Sosa, Jorge Saavedra, Santiago Solares, Gregorio Toscano-Pulido

articles.title: PhasorFlow: A Python Library for Unit Circle Based Computing
articles.title_zh: PhasorFlow：一个基于单位圆计算的 Python 库
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.15886v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present PhasorFlow, an open-source Python library for computing on the S¹ unit circle. Inputs are encoded as complex phasors z=eⁱφ on the N-torus (T^N); as computation proceeds through unitary wave-interference gates, global norm is preserved while components drift into C^N, letting algorithms leverage continuous geometric gradients. PhasorFlow makes three contributions. First, we formalize the Phasor Circuit model (N threads, M gates) with a 22-gate library spanning standard-unitary, non-linear, neuromorphic, and encoding operations under full matrix-algebra simulation. Second, we present the Variational Phasor Circuit (VPC), analogous to variational quantum circuits, optimizing continuous phase parameters for classification. Third, we introduce the Phasor Transformer, replacing QK^TV attention with a parameter-free DFT token-mixing layer inspired by FNet. We validate on spatial classification, time-series prediction, financial volatility, neuromorphic tasks, and -- for the VPC -- real motor-imagery EEG, where it matches standard baselines at a fraction of their parameters.
